by
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),

    intro q ξ x

    intro q ξ
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
  have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>

      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
      Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
      h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖

      (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_

      dsimp [fourierLine, C]

            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _

            exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x

      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    calc
      (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by
        gcongr
      _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
  have hm1Profile_add : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),

    dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]

      ring

      ext x
      simp [Complex.real_smul]
      ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_smul]
    simp [Complex.real_smul]
    ring

    filter_upwards with ξ
    exact hm1Profile_smul c q ξ
  let toHm1Linear : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →ₗ[ℝ] Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=

    have h_range : Set.range toHm1 = (LinearMap.range toHm1Linear : Set (Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))) := by

    rw [h_range, Submodule.span_eq]
  have h_clos : (Hm1 : Set (Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))) = closure (Set.range toHm1) := by
    dsimp [Hm1]
    rw [h_span, LinearMap.coe_range]

  refine ⟨q, ?_⟩

            congr 1 with x
            exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    calc
      (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
  have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
      Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
      h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
    refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
      (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact h_bound_pw q ξ
  have hm1Profile_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      hm1Profile (q₁ - q₂) ξ = hm1Profile q₁ ξ - hm1Profile q₂ ξ := by
    intro q₁ q₂ ξ
    dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₁ x - q₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₁ x : ℂ) -
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₂ x : ℂ)) := by
      ext x
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand q₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand q₂ ξ)]
    ring
  have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
    intro q
    dsimp [toHm1]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_sub : ∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 (q₁ - q₂) = toHm1 q₁ - toHm1 q₂ := by
    intro q₁ q₂
    rw [h_toHm1 (q₁ - q₂), h_toHm1 q₁, h_toHm1 q₂, ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem q₁) (h_mem q₂)]
    apply MemLp.toLp_congr
    filter_upwards with ξ
    exact hm1Profile_sub q₁ q₂ ξ
  have h_norm_le : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖ := by
    intro q
    let I_q : ℝ := ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(q : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * I_q
    have h_norm_sq : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(h_mem q).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
      rw [h_toHm1 q, hξ, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have h_int_hm1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (h_mem q).1).mp (h_mem q)
    have h_int_le : ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * Real.pi := by
      calc
        ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2
          ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
            integral_mono h_int_hm1 (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)) (h_bound_pw q)
        _ = C ^ 2 * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul (C ^ 2) _
        _ = C ^ 2 * Real.pi := by rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
    have h_C_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_C_sq : C ^ 2 * Real.pi ≤ I_q ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [C]
      rw [h_C_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      have h_pi : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_q ^ 2 * Real.pi = (1 / 2) * I_q ^ 2 := by
        have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
        field_simp
      rw [h_pi]
      have : 0 ≤ I_q ^ 2 := sq_nonneg I_q
      linarith
    have h_Iq_eq : I_q = ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖ := by
      change ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(q : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ = ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖
      rw [integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm q.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable,
          ← eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm,
          eLpNorm_congr_ae (q.coeFn_toLp 1 volume).symm,
          ← Lp.norm_def,
          SchwartzMap.toLpCLM_apply]
    have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← h_Iq_eq]
      linarith [h_norm_sq, h_int_le, h_C_sq]
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt
  let L := SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)
  have h_cont_toHm1 : Continuous toHm1 := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro q₀
    rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    have hL : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₀, dist (L q) (L q₀) < ε :=
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp L.continuous.continuousAt ε hε
    refine hL.mono (fun q hq => ?_)
    have h_dist_le : dist (toHm1 q) (toHm1 q₀) ≤ dist (L q) (L q₀) := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← h_sub q q₀, ← map_sub L q q₀]
      exact h_norm_le (q - q₀)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_dist_le hq
  have h_cont_iota : Continuous ι := h_cont_toHm1.subtype_mk _
  exact h_cont_iota.comp h_cont_u

informal_problem.statement:
(h_exists : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∃ u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u ∧ u 0 = q)
    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      IsSchwartzSolution u → IsSchwartzSolution v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v)
    (q : Hm1) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ u v : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      IsSchwartzSolution u → IsSchwartzSolution v →
      ‖ι (u 0) - q‖ < η → ‖ι (v 0) - q‖ < η →
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T → ‖ι (u t) - ι (v t)‖ < ε

signature.name: schwartz_flow_uniform_cauchy_on_compact
signature.statement:
(h_exists : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∃ u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u ∧ u 0 = q)
    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      IsSchwartzSolution u → IsSchwartzSolution v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v)
    (q : Hm1) (T : ℝ) (hT : 0 < T) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ η > 0, ∀ u v : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      IsSchwartzSolution u → IsSchwartzSolution v →
      ‖ι (u 0) - q‖ < η → ‖ι (v 0) - q‖ < η →
      ∀ t : ℝ, |t| ≤ T → ‖ι (u t) - ι (v t)‖ < ε

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, K_alpha, C_int, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, hK_alpha, hC_int,
    _h_alpha_eq, h_alpha_ratio, h_interp⟩ := diagGreen_alpha_and_interpolation
  obtain ⟨δ₀_kdv, hδ₀_kdv_pos, hδ₀_kdv_le, h_kdv⟩ :=
    kdv_alpha_conservation_small_data h_exists h_unique δ₁ hδ₁
  obtain ⟨δ₀_reg, C_rem, Φ_reg, hδ₀_reg_pos, _hδ₀_reg_le, hC_rem,
    h_reg_inv, h_reg_lip, h_reg_rem⟩ :=
    regularized_flow_approximation h_exists h_unique δ₁ hδ₁
  set δ₀ := min δ₀_kdv δ₀_reg
  have hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀ := lt_min hδ₀_kdv_pos hδ₀_reg_pos
  obtain ⟨lam, S, hlam_pos, _hlam_le, _hS_eval, hS_sol, hS_ball,
    hS_nonexp, hS_inv, hS_kappa⟩ := kdv_scaling_symmetry q δ₀ hδ₀
  set T' := lam⁻¹ ^ 3 * T
  have hT' : 0 < T' := by positivity
  set ε' := lam ^ 2 * ε
  have hε' : 0 < ε' := by positivity
  set θ_M := ε' / (12 * C_int * K_alpha)
  have hθ_M : 0 < θ_M := by positivity
  obtain ⟨M, hM_ge2, η_M, hη_M, h_tail_M⟩ := hm1KappaSq_tail_control q θ_M hθ_M
  have hM_ge1 : 1 ≤ M := by linarith
  set F_M := C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 * C_rem * T'
  have hF_M : 0 < F_M := by positivity
  set θ_κ := ε' / (12 * F_M)
  have hθ_κ : 0 < θ_κ := by positivity
  obtain ⟨κ₀, hκ₀_ge2, η_κ, hη_κ, h_tail_κ⟩ := hm1KappaSq_tail_control q θ_κ hθ_κ
  set κ := max κ₀ (1 / θ_κ + 2)
  have hκ_ge_κ₀ : κ₀ ≤ κ := le_max_left _ _
  have hκ_ge2 : 2 ≤ κ := le_trans hκ₀_ge2 hκ_ge_κ₀
  have hκ_ge1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hκ_gt_inv : 1 / θ_κ < κ := by
    have : 1 / θ_κ + 2 ≤ κ := le_max_right _ _
    linarith
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_inv_κ : 1 / κ < θ_κ := by
    rw [div_lt_iff₀ hκ_pos]
    have : (1 / θ_κ) * θ_κ < κ * θ_κ := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hκ_gt_inv hθ_κ
    rw [one_div_mul_cancel (ne_of_gt hθ_κ)] at this
    linarith
  obtain ⟨L_κ, hL_κ, h_lip_κ⟩ := h_reg_lip κ hκ_ge2 T' hT'
  set η := min (min 1 (min η_M η_κ)) (ε' / (6 * L_κ))
  have hη : 0 < η := by positivity
  have hη_le1 : η ≤ 1 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hη_le_M : η ≤ η_M :=
    le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hη_le_κ : η ≤ η_κ :=
    le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hη_le_lip : η ≤ ε' / (6 * L_κ) := min_le_right _ _
  refine ⟨η, hη, ?_⟩
  intro u v hu hv hu0 hv0 t ht
  set τ := lam⁻¹ ^ 3 * t
  have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam_pos
  have h_lam_τ : lam ^ 3 * τ = t := by
    dsimp [τ]
    field_simp
  have hτ : |τ| ≤ T' := by
    dsimp [τ, T']
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (by positivity)
  have h_single : ∀ w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution w → ‖ι (w 0) - q‖ < η →
      ‖ι (S (w t)) - ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (w 0)))‖ < ε' / 3 ∧ ‖ι (S (w 0))‖ ≤ δ₀_reg := by
    intro w hw hw0
    set w' : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => S (w (lam ^ 3 * s))
    have hw'_sol : IsSchwartzSolution w' := hS_sol w hw
    have hw'0_eq : w' 0 = S (w 0) := by
      dsimp [w']
      rw [mul_zero]
    have hw'τ_eq : w' τ = S (w t) := by
      dsimp [w']
      rw [h_lam_τ]
    have hw0_lt1 : ‖ι (w 0) - q‖ < 1 := lt_of_lt_of_le hw0 hη_le1
    have hw'0_ball : ‖ι (w' 0)‖ ≤ δ₀ := by
      rw [hw'0_eq]
      exact hS_ball (w 0) hw0_lt1
    have hw'0_kdv : ‖ι (w' 0)‖ ≤ δ₀_kdv := le_trans hw'0_ball (min_le_left _ _)
    have hw'0_reg : ‖ι (w' 0)‖ ≤ δ₀_reg := le_trans hw'0_ball (min_le_right _ _)
    have hw'0_δ₁ : ‖ι (w' 0)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans hw'0_kdv hδ₀_kdv_le
    have h_kdv_w' := h_kdv w' hw'_sol hw'0_kdv
    have hw'τ_δ₁ : ‖ι (w' τ)‖ ≤ δ₁ := h_kdv_w'.1 τ
    have hw'τ_alpha : alphaFunctional M (w' τ) = alphaFunctional M (w' 0) :=
      h_kdv_w'.2 M hM_ge1 τ
    have h_reg_w' := h_reg_inv κ hκ_ge2 (w' 0) hw'0_reg τ
    have hreg_δ₁ : ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0))‖ ≤ δ₁ := h_reg_w'.1
    have hreg_alpha : alphaFunctional M (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) = alphaFunctional M (w' 0) :=
      h_reg_w'.2 M hM_ge1
    have h_M_w0 : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' 0))) < θ_M := by
      rw [hw'0_eq]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hS_kappa M hM_ge1 (w 0))
        (h_tail_M M le_rfl (w 0) (lt_of_lt_of_le hw0 hη_le_M))
    have h_M_w'τ : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' τ))) < K_alpha * θ_M := by
      calc Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' τ)))
        _ ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' 0))) :=
          h_alpha_ratio M hM_ge1 (w' τ) (w' 0) hw'τ_δ₁ hw'0_δ₁ hw'τ_alpha
        _ < K_alpha * θ_M := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_M_w0 hK_alpha
    have h_M_reg : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)))) < K_alpha * θ_M := by
      calc Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0))))
        _ ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' 0))) :=
          h_alpha_ratio M hM_ge1 (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) (w' 0) hreg_δ₁ hw'0_δ₁ hreg_alpha
        _ < K_alpha * θ_M := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_M_w0 hK_alpha
    have h_κ_w0 : Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι (w' 0))) < θ_κ := by
      rw [hw'0_eq]
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (hS_kappa κ hκ_ge1 (w 0))
        (h_tail_κ κ hκ_ge_κ₀ (w 0) (lt_of_lt_of_le hw0 hη_le_κ))
    have h_rem_bound :
        Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff (w' τ) x - recipGreenDiff (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) x)) <
          C_rem * T' * (2 * θ_κ) := by
      calc Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff (w' τ) x - recipGreenDiff (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) x))
        _ ≤ C_rem * T' * (Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι (w' 0))) + 1 / κ) :=
          h_reg_rem κ hκ_ge2 T' hT' w' hw'_sol hw'0_reg τ hτ
        _ < C_rem * T' * (2 * θ_κ) := by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
          linarith
    have h_interp_bound := h_interp M hM_ge1 (w' τ) (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) hw'τ_δ₁ hreg_δ₁
    have h_term1 :
        C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 *
          Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff (w' τ) x - recipGreenDiff (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) x)) <
          ε' / 6 := by
      have h_eq : C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 * (C_rem * T' * (2 * θ_κ)) = ε' / 6 := by
        dsimp [θ_κ, F_M]
        have : F_M ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hF_M
        field_simp
        ring
      calc C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 *
            Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff (w' τ) x - recipGreenDiff (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)) x))
        _ < C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 * (C_rem * T' * (2 * θ_κ)) :=
          mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_rem_bound (by positivity)
        _ = ε' / 6 := h_eq
    have h_term2 :
        C_int * (Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' τ))) + Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0))))) <
          ε' / 6 := by
      have h_eq : C_int * (2 * (K_alpha * θ_M)) = ε' / 6 := by
        dsimp [θ_M]
        have : C_int ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hC_int
        have : K_alpha ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hK_alpha
        field_simp
        ring
      calc C_int * (Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (w' τ))) + Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι (Φ_reg κ τ (w' 0)))))
        _ < C_int * (2 * (K_alpha * θ_M)) := by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ hC_int
          linarith
        _ = ε' / 6 := h_eq
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← hw'τ_eq, ← hw'0_eq]
      linarith
    · rw [← hw'0_eq]
      exact hw'0_reg
  obtain ⟨hu_approx, hu'0_reg⟩ := h_single u hu hu0
  obtain ⟨hv_approx, hv'0_reg⟩ := h_single v hv hv0
  have h_mid : ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (u 0))) - ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (v 0)))‖ < ε' / 3 := by
    have h_u0_v0 : ‖ι (u 0) - ι (v 0)‖ < 2 * η := by
      have h_tri : ‖ι (u 0) - ι (v 0)‖ ≤ ‖ι (u 0) - q‖ + ‖q - ι (v 0)‖ :=
        norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub (ι (u 0)) q (ι (v 0))
      rw [norm_sub_rev q (ι (v 0))] at h_tri
      linarith
    have h_S_u0_v0 : ‖ι (S (u 0)) - ι (S (v 0))‖ < 2 * η :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (hS_nonexp (u 0) (v 0)) h_u0_v0
    have h_lip_bound := h_lip_κ (S (u 0)) (S (v 0)) hu'0_reg hv'0_reg τ hτ
    have h_2η : L_κ * (2 * η) ≤ ε' / 3 := by
      have h1 : L_κ * (2 * η) ≤ L_κ * (2 * (ε' / (6 * L_κ))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by linarith) (le_of_lt hL_κ)
      have h2 : L_κ * (2 * (ε' / (6 * L_κ))) = ε' / 3 := by
        have : L_κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hL_κ
        field_simp
        ring
      linarith
    calc ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (u 0))) - ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (v 0)))‖
      _ ≤ L_κ * ‖ι (S (u 0)) - ι (S (v 0))‖ := h_lip_bound
      _ < L_κ * (2 * η) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_S_u0_v0 hL_κ
      _ ≤ ε' / 3 := h_2η
  have h_S_diff : ‖ι (S (u t)) - ι (S (v t))‖ < ε' := by
    have h_tri1 : ‖ι (S (u t)) - ι (S (v t))‖ ≤
        ‖ι (S (u t)) - ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (u 0)))‖ +
        ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (u 0))) - ι (S (v t))‖ :=
      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
    have h_tri2 : ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (u 0))) - ι (S (v t))‖ ≤
        ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (u 0))) - ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (v 0)))‖ +
        ‖ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (v 0))) - ι (S (v t))‖ :=
      norm_sub_le_norm_sub_add_norm_sub _ _ _
    rw [norm_sub_rev (ι (Φ_reg κ τ (S (v 0)))) (ι (S (v t)))] at h_tri2
    linarith
  calc ‖ι (u t) - ι (v t)‖

      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
        (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
      calc
        (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
    have hm1Profile_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        hm1Profile (q₁ - q₂) ξ = hm1Profile q₁ ξ - hm1Profile q₂ ξ := by
      intro q₁ q₂ ξ
      dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₁ x - q₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₁ x : ℂ) -
            Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₂ x : ℂ)) := by
        ext x
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand q₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand q₂ ξ)]
      ring
    have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
      intro q
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
    have h_sub : ∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 (q₁ - q₂) = toHm1 q₁ - toHm1 q₂ := by
      intro q₁ q₂
      rw [h_toHm1 (q₁ - q₂), h_toHm1 q₁, h_toHm1 q₂, ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem q₁) (h_mem q₂)]
      apply MemLp.toLp_congr
      filter_upwards with ξ
      exact hm1Profile_sub q₁ q₂ ξ
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro w₁ w₂
      ext1
      exact h_sub w₁ w₂
    · intro w
      rw [← Submodule.norm_coe, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
      unfold hm1KappaSq
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards with ξ
      have h_one : (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) = 1 := by
        have : 4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 = 4 + ξ ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [this, div_self (by positivity)]
      rw [h_one, one_mul, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    · intro κ hκ w
      dsimp [hm1KappaSq, ι]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(h_mem w).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
      rw [h_toHm1 w, hξ]
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [h_sq]
      have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
  have s4 : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x)) →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      lam ^ 3 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
        lam * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro lam hlam hlam_le S hS_eval κ hκ w
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam
    have h_fl_scale : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (S w) ξ = (lam : ℂ) * fourierLine w (lam⁻¹ * ξ) := by
      intro ξ
      dsimp [fourierLine]
      have h_int_eq :
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((S w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => (lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I) * (w (lam * x) : ℂ))) := by
        ext x
        rw [hS_eval w x]
        have h_mul : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = -(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I := by
          push_cast
          have h_lam_c : (lam : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlam_ne
          field_simp
        rw [h_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_int_eq, integral_const_mul]
      let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => Complex.exp (-(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) * (w y : ℂ)
      have h_cov : (∫ x : ℝ, g (lam * x)) = |lam⁻¹| • ∫ y : ℝ, g y :=
        Measure.integral_comp_mul_left g lam
      change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ((lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * ∫ x : ℝ, g (lam * x)) =
        (lam : ℂ) * (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ y : ℝ, g y)
      rw [h_cov, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hlam), Complex.real_smul]
      push_cast
      have h_lam_c : (lam : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlam_ne
      field_simp
    have h_norm_fl_scale : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 = lam ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine w (lam⁻¹ * ξ)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      rw [h_fl_scale ξ, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hlam), mul_pow]
    have h_freq_cov :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (∫ ζ : ℝ, (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)) := by
      let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => (lam ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)
      have h_lhs_eq :
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => G (lam⁻¹ * ξ)) := by
        ext ξ
        dsimp [G]
        rw [h_norm_fl_scale ξ]
        have : lam ^ 2 * (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 := by
          calc lam ^ 2 * (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2 = (lam * lam⁻¹) ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 1 ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne]
          _ = ξ ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [this]
      rw [h_lhs_eq, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left G lam⁻¹, inv_inv, abs_of_pos hlam, smul_eq_mul,
          ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1 with ζ
      dsimp [G]
      ring
    rw [h_freq_cov]
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ = ‖w x‖ := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (w p.2 : ℂ)) := by
      have := w.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine w) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖
    have h_fl_sq_bound : ∀ ζ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      intro ζ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand ζ x
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    have h_int_base : Integrable (fun ζ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_meas_num : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
        h_meas_fl.norm.pow 2
      have h_cont_den : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ζ => by positivity)
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h_meas_num.mul h_cont_den.aestronglyMeasurable
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono' h_meas ?_
      filter_upwards with ζ
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nonneg, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h_den : 1 + ζ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      have h_inv : (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ζ ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_den
      have := h_fl_sq_bound ζ
      gcongr
    have h_upper_pw : ∀ ζ : ℝ,
        (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2) ≤
        lam * (‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)) := by
      intro ζ
      have h_lam_sq_le : lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have h_den_le : lam ^ 2 * (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2) ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      calc
        (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)
          ≤ (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (lam ^ 2 * (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)) := by
            gcongr
        _ = lam * (‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)) := by
            have : 4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
            field_simp
    have h_int_scaled : Integrable (fun ζ : ℝ => (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_meas_num : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul (h_meas_fl.norm.pow 2)
      have h_cont_den : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ζ => by positivity)
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h_meas_num.mul h_cont_den.aestronglyMeasurable
      refine (h_int_base.const_mul lam).mono' h_meas ?_
      filter_upwards with ζ
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
      exact h_upper_pw ζ
    have h_lower_pw : ∀ ζ : ℝ,
        lam ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)) ≤
        (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2) := by
      intro ζ
      have h_lam_sq_le : lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have h_den_le : 4 * κ ^ 2 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2 ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      gcongr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_mono (h_int_base.const_mul (lam ^ 3)) h_int_scaled h_lower_pw
    · rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_mono h_int_scaled (h_int_base.const_mul lam) h_upper_pw
  let R : ℝ := ‖q‖ + 1
  have hR_def : R = ‖q‖ + 1 := rfl
  have hR_pos : 0 < R := by positivity
  let lam : ℝ := min 1 ((δ₀ / R) ^ 2)
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by positivity
  have hlam_le : lam ≤ 1 := min_le_left _ _
  have hlam_le_ratio : lam ≤ (δ₀ / R) ^ 2 := min_le_right _ _
  have h_sqrt_lam_le1 : Real.sqrt lam ≤ 1 := Real.sqrt_le_one.mpr hlam_le
  have h_sqrt_lam_R : Real.sqrt lam * R ≤ δ₀ := by
    have h1 : Real.sqrt lam ≤ Real.sqrt ((δ₀ / R) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt hlam_le_ratio
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h1
    exact (le_div_iff₀ hR_pos).mp h1
  obtain ⟨S_clm, hS_eval, hS_rhs⟩ := s1 lam hlam_pos
  obtain ⟨h_iota_sub, h_norm_sq, h_kappa_eq⟩ := s3
  have h_norm_bounds : ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * ‖ι w‖ ∧
      ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ≤ ‖ι w‖ ∧
      ‖ι w‖ ≤ lam⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨h_low, h_high⟩ := s4 lam hlam_pos hlam_le (⇑S_clm) hS_eval 1 le_rfl w
    rw [← h_kappa_eq 1 le_rfl w, ← h_kappa_eq 1 le_rfl (S_clm w),
        ← h_norm_sq w, ← h_norm_sq (S_clm w)] at h_low h_high
    have h_upper_sqrt : ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * ‖ι w‖ := by
      have h_sq_le : ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (Real.sqrt lam * ‖ι w‖) ^ 2 := by
        rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt hlam_pos)]
        exact h_high
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt
    have h_upper_one : ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ≤ ‖ι w‖ := by
      calc ‖ι (S_clm w)‖
        _ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * ‖ι w‖ := h_upper_sqrt
        _ ≤ 1 * ‖ι w‖ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sqrt_lam_le1 (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = ‖ι w‖ := one_mul _
    have h_lower_inv : ‖ι w‖ ≤ lam⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ := by
      have h_lam4_le : lam ^ 4 ≤ lam ^ 3 := by
        have : lam ^ 3 * lam ≤ lam ^ 3 * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hlam_le (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : (lam ^ 2 * ‖ι w‖) ^ 2 ≤ ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ^ 2 := by
        calc (lam ^ 2 * ‖ι w‖) ^ 2
          _ = lam ^ 4 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ lam ^ 3 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lam4_le (sq_nonneg _)
          _ ≤ ‖ι (S_clm w)‖ ^ 2 := h_low
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
      rw [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt
      have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sqrt (show 0 ≤ lam⁻¹ ^ 2 by positivity)
      have h_cancel : lam⁻¹ ^ 2 * (lam ^ 2 * ‖ι w‖) = ‖ι w‖ := by
        have : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam_pos
        field_simp
      rwa [h_cancel] at h_mul
    exact ⟨h_upper_sqrt, h_upper_one, h_lower_inv⟩
  refine ⟨lam, ⇑S_clm, hlam_pos, hlam_le, hS_eval, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro u hu
    exact s2 lam hlam_pos S_clm hS_eval hS_rhs u hu
  · intro w hw
    have h_w_le_R : ‖ι w‖ ≤ R := by
      have h_tri : ‖ι w‖ ≤ ‖q‖ + ‖ι w - q‖ := norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (ι w) q
      linarith [hR_def, h_tri, hw]
    calc ‖ι (S_clm w)‖
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * ‖ι w‖ := (h_norm_bounds w).1
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt lam * R := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_w_le_R (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)
      _ ≤ δ₀ := h_sqrt_lam_R
  · intro w₁ w₂
    rw [← h_iota_sub (S_clm w₁) (S_clm w₂), ← S_clm.map_sub, ← h_iota_sub w₁ w₂]
    exact (h_norm_bounds (w₁ - w₂)).2.1
  · intro w₁ w₂
    rw [← h_iota_sub (S_clm w₁) (S_clm w₂), ← S_clm.map_sub, ← h_iota_sub w₁ w₂]
    exact (h_norm_bounds (w₁ - w₂)).2.2
  · intro κ hκ w
    obtain ⟨_, h_high⟩ := s4 lam hlam_pos hlam_le (⇑S_clm) hS_eval κ hκ w
    rw [← h_kappa_eq κ hκ w, ← h_kappa_eq κ hκ (S_clm w)] at h_high
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
      rw [h_kappa_eq κ hκ w]
      exact integral_nonneg (fun ξ => by positivity)
    apply Real.sqrt_le_sqrt
    calc hm1KappaSq κ (ι (S_clm w))
      _ ≤ lam * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := h_high
      _ ≤ 1 * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlam_le h_nonneg
      _ = hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := one_mul _

informal_problem.statement:
(q : Hm1) (θ : ℝ) (hθ : 0 < θ) :
    ∃ κ₀ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ₀ ∧ ∃ η₀ : ℝ, 0 < η₀ ∧
      ∀ κ : ℝ, κ₀ ≤ κ → ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ‖ι w - q‖ < η₀ → Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) < θ

by
  have h_m_nonneg : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (ξ : ℝ), 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ ξ
    have h_pos : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (le_of_lt h_pos)
  have h_m_le_one : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (ξ : ℝ), (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro κ hκ ξ
    have h_pos : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt h_pos)
  have h_int : ∀ (h : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
    intro h κ hκ
    have h_base : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(h : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (Lp.memLp h).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      refine Continuous.div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2))
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) ?_
      intro ξ
      have : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      exact ne_of_gt this
    refine h_base.mono' (h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_base.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_m_nonneg κ hκ ξ) (sq_nonneg _))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one κ hκ ξ)
  have h_norm_sq : ∀ g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ),
      ‖g‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro g
    have h1 : ‖g‖ ^ 2 = @inner ℝ (Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) _ g g :=
      (real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq g).symm
    have h2 : @inner ℝ (Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) _ g g =
        ∫ ξ : ℝ, @inner ℝ ℂ _ ((g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) ((g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) :=
      MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def g g
    rw [h1, h2]
    congr 1
    ext ξ
    exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq ((g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
  have h_s1 : ∀ (f g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) ≤
        2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) +
        2 * ‖f - g‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro f g κ hκ
    have h_fg_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (Lp.memLp (f - g)).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
    have h_ae : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume,
        ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
          2 * (((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) +
          2 * ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub f g] with ξ hξ
      have h_tri : ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ≤ ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ + ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ := by
        rw [hξ]
        exact norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' ((f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ) ((g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
      have h_sq : ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
          2 * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [norm_nonneg ((f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ), norm_nonneg ((g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ),
          norm_nonneg (((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ),
          sq_nonneg (‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ - ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖)]
      have hm0 := h_m_nonneg κ hκ ξ
      have hm1 := h_m_le_one κ hκ ξ
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖]
    calc ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * (((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) +
          2 * ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) :=
        integral_mono_ae (h_int f κ hκ)
          (((h_int g κ hκ).const_mul 2).add (h_fg_int.const_mul 2)) h_ae
      _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, 2 * (((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2)) +
          (∫ ξ : ℝ, 2 * ‖((f - g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) :=
        integral_add ((h_int g κ hκ).const_mul 2) (h_fg_int.const_mul 2)
      _ = 2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) +
          2 * ‖f - g‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, ← h_norm_sq (f - g)]
  let g : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := (q : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
  let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n ξ =>
    ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * (2 + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
  have hF_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) volume := by
    intro n
    have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 + (n : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    exact (h_int g (2 + (n : ℝ)) hn).aestronglyMeasurable
  have hB_int : Integrable B volume :=
    (Lp.memLp g).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  have hF_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F n ξ‖ ≤ B ξ := by
    intro n
    have hn : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 + (n : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_m_nonneg _ hn ξ) (sq_nonneg _))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one _ hn ξ)
  have hF_lim : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume, Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F n ξ) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards with ξ
    dsimp [F]
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 : ℝ) + (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_left _ 2 tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (2 + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      simpa only [sq] using Filter.Tendsto.atTop_mul_atTop₀ h1 h1
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 4 * (2 + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.Tendsto.atTop_add (Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num) h2) tendsto_const_nhds
    have h4 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * (2 + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      Filter.Tendsto.div_atTop tendsto_const_nhds h3
    simpa only [div_mul_eq_mul_div] using h4
  have h_tendsto := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence B hF_meas hB_int hF_bound hF_lim
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] at h_tendsto
  have h_ev : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (∫ ξ : ℝ, F n ξ) < θ ^ 2 / 4 :=
    h_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by positivity))
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_ev.exists
  have hκ₀_ge2 : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 2 + (N : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) N]
  refine ⟨2 + (N : ℝ), hκ₀_ge2, θ / 2, by positivity, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ w hw
  have hκ₀_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 + (N : ℝ) := by linarith
  have hκ_ge1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have h_anti : hm1KappaSq κ q ≤ hm1KappaSq (2 + (N : ℝ)) q := by
    dsimp [hm1KappaSq]
    refine integral_mono (h_int g κ hκ_ge1) (h_int g (2 + (N : ℝ)) hκ₀_ge1) ?_
    intro ξ
    have h_sq_le : (2 + (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 ≤ κ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    have h_den_pos : 0 < 4 * (2 + (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_div : (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * (2 + (N : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
      div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h_den_pos (by linarith)
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div (sq_nonneg _)
  have h_pert : hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) ≤ 2 * hm1KappaSq κ q + 2 * ‖ι w - q‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h_coe_norm : ‖(ι w : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) - (q : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))‖ = ‖ι w - q‖ := by
      rw [← Submodule.coe_sub]
      rfl
    simpa only [hm1KappaSq, h_coe_norm] using
      h_s1 (ι w : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) (q : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)) κ hκ_ge1
  have h_w_sq : ‖ι w - q‖ ^ 2 < θ ^ 2 / 4 := by
    have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖ι w - q‖ := norm_nonneg _
    nlinarith
  have h_q_lt : hm1KappaSq (2 + (N : ℝ)) q < θ ^ 2 / 4 := hN
  have h_total : hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) < θ ^ 2 := by linarith
  exact (Real.sqrt_lt' hθ).mpr h_total

informal_problem.statement:
∃ (δ₁ c₁ c₂ K_alpha C_int : ℝ),
      0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ ≤ c₂ ∧ 0 < K_alpha ∧ 0 < C_int ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ₁ →
        c₁ * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) ≤ κ * alphaFunctional κ w ∧
        κ * alphaFunctional κ w ≤ c₂ * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ₁ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ₁ →
        alphaFunctional κ w₁ = alphaFunctional κ w₂ →
        Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₁)) ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₂))) ∧
      (∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ₁ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ₁ →
        ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ≤
          C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 *
            Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x)) +
          C_int * (Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι w₁)) + Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι w₂))))

∃ (δ₁ c₁ c₂ K_alpha C_int : ℝ),
      0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ ≤ c₂ ∧ 0 < K_alpha ∧ 0 < C_int ∧

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1NormSq_le_hm2NormSq_add_highFreq :
      ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ),
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) →
        h1NormSq f ≤ (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * hm2NormSq f + (5 / 2) * h1HighFreqSq M f := by
    intro M hM f hf_int
    have h_hm2_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2)) := by
      ext ξ
      have hpos : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    have h_hm2_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) := by
      rw [h_hm2_eq]
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3) :=
        continuous_const.div ((continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)).pow 3) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine Integrable.bdd_mul (c := 1) hf_int h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3 :=
        one_le_pow₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ])
      exact div_le_one_of_le₀ this (by positivity)
    have h_hf_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2)) := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.pow 2)).div
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine Integrable.bdd_mul (c := 2) hf_int h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg M, sq_nonneg ξ]
    have h_pw : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) +
        (5 / 2) * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2)) := by
      intro ξ
      rcases le_total (ξ ^ 2) (M ^ 2) with hle | hge
      · have h1 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3 ≤ (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (by linarith) 3
        have h2 : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≤ (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
          rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith [ (by ring : (4 + ξ ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 3) ]
        have h3 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
            ((M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
        have h4 : 0 ≤ (5 / 2) * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2)) := by
          positivity
        linarith [ (by ring : ((M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 =
          (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2)) ]
      · have h2 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (5 / 2) * ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
          rw [← mul_div_assoc, le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith
        have h3 : (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
            ((5 / 2) * ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
          nlinarith [ (by positivity : 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2), h2 ]
        have h4 : 0 ≤ (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) := by positivity
        linarith [ (by ring : ((5 / 2) * ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) =
          (5 / 2) * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2))) ]
    have h_int_rhs : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) +
        (5 / 2) * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2))) :=
      (h_hm2_int.const_mul _).add (h_hf_int.const_mul _)
    calc h1NormSq f
      _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 := rfl
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) +
            (5 / 2) * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2))) :=
          integral_mono hf_int h_int_rhs h_pw
      _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2)) +
          (∫ ξ : ℝ, (5 / 2) * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2))) :=
          integral_add (h_hm2_int.const_mul _) (h_hf_int.const_mul _)
      _ = (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 3 * hm2NormSq f + (5 / 2) * h1HighFreqSq M f := by
          rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
          rfl
  obtain ⟨δ_alpha, hδ_alpha, h_rem⟩ := alphaFunctional_cubic_remainder_bound
  obtain ⟨δ_lip, hδ_lip, h_int_single, h_bilip⟩ := recipGreenDiff_biLipschitz_h1
  refine ⟨min δ_alpha δ_lip, 3 / 8, 5 / 8, Real.sqrt (5 / 3), 10,
    lt_min hδ_alpha hδ_lip, by norm_num, by norm_num, by positivity, by norm_num, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro κ hκ w hw
    have hw_alpha : ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_alpha := le_trans hw (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_quad := alphaQuadFunctional_eq_half_hm1KappaSq κ hκ w
    have h_abs := abs_le.mp (h_rem κ hκ w hw_alpha)
    constructor <;> linarith
  · intro κ hκ w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ h_eq
    have hw₁_alpha : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_alpha := le_trans hw₁ (min_le_left _ _)
    have hw₂_alpha : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ_alpha := le_trans hw₂ (min_le_left _ _)
    have h_quad₁ := alphaQuadFunctional_eq_half_hm1KappaSq κ hκ w₁
    have h_quad₂ := alphaQuadFunctional_eq_half_hm1KappaSq κ hκ w₂
    have h_abs₁ := abs_le.mp (h_rem κ hκ w₁ hw₁_alpha)
    have h_abs₂ := abs_le.mp (h_rem κ hκ w₂ hw₂_alpha)
    have h_ratio : hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₁) ≤ (5 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₂) := by
      have : κ * alphaFunctional κ w₁ = κ * alphaFunctional κ w₂ := by rw [h_eq]
      linarith
    calc Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₁))
      _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((5 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₂)) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_ratio
      _ = Real.sqrt (5 / 3) * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₂)) :=
        Real.sqrt_mul (by norm_num) _
  · intro M hM w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
    have hw₁_lip : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_lip := le_trans hw₁ (min_le_right _ _)
    have hw₂_lip : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ_lip := le_trans hw₂ (min_le_right _ _)
    set ΔΨ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x

by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, h_quad⟩ := alphaFunctional_one_quadratic_bounds
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h_deriv⟩ := alphaFunctional_hasDerivAt_kdv
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h_ortho⟩ := kdvRHS_orthogonality_diagGreen
  have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ hc₁₂
  set δ' : ℝ := min δ (min δ₁ (min δ₂ δ₃))
  have hδ' : 0 < δ' := by positivity
  have hδ'_le_δ : δ' ≤ δ := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ'_le_δ₁ : δ' ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ'_le_δ₂ : δ' ≤ δ₂ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hδ'_le_δ₃ : δ' ≤ δ₃ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  set δ₀ : ℝ := (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ'
  have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := by positivity
  have hδ₀_le_half : δ₀ ≤ δ' / 2 := by
    have h_div_le : c₁ / (2 * c₂) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      linarith
    calc δ₀ = (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ' := rfl
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * δ' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div_le (le_of_lt hδ')
      _ = δ' / 2 := by ring
  have hδ₀_le_δ : δ₀ ≤ δ := by linarith
  refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le_δ, ?_⟩
  intro u hu hu0
  have h_local_cons : ∀ (t : ℝ), (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, ‖ι (u s)‖ ≤ δ') →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → alphaFunctional κ (u t) = alphaFunctional κ (u 0) := by
    intro t h_ball κ hκ
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => alphaFunctional κ (u τ)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, HasDerivAt g 0 s := by
      intro s hs
      have hs_δ₂ : ‖ι (u s)‖ ≤ δ₂ := le_trans (h_ball s hs) hδ'_le_δ₂
      have hs_δ₃ : ‖ι (u s)‖ ≤ δ₃ := le_trans (h_ball s hs) hδ'_le_δ₃
      have hd := h_deriv u hu κ hκ s hs_δ₂
      rw [h_ortho κ hκ (u s) hs_δ₃] at hd
      exact hd
    have h_mvt : ∀ (a b : ℝ), a < b → Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 t → g b = g a := by
      intro a b hab h_sub
      have h_cont_ab : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b) :=
        fun x hx => (hg_deriv x (h_sub hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have h_deriv_ab : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt g 0 x :=
        fun x hx => hg_deriv x (h_sub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx))
      obtain ⟨c, _, hc_slope⟩ :=
        exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope g (fun _ => 0) hab h_cont_ab h_deriv_ab
      have h_ne : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab)
      have h_sub_zero : g b - g a = 0 := (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hc_slope.symm).resolve_right h_ne
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub_zero
    rcases lt_trichotomy 0 t with ht_pos | rfl | ht_neg
    · exact h_mvt 0 t ht_pos Set.Icc_subset_uIcc
    · rfl
    · exact (h_mvt t 0 ht_neg Set.Icc_subset_uIcc').symm
  have hf_step : ∀ (t : ℝ), (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, ‖ι (u s)‖ ≤ δ') → ‖ι (u t)‖ ≤ δ' / 2 := by
    intro t h_ball
    have hu0_δ₁ : ‖ι (u 0)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (h_ball 0 Set.left_mem_uIcc) hδ'_le_δ₁
    have hut_δ₁ : ‖ι (u t)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (h_ball t Set.right_mem_uIcc) hδ'_le_δ₁
    have h_cons_1 : alphaFunctional 1 (u t) = alphaFunctional 1 (u 0) :=
      h_local_cons t h_ball 1 le_rfl
    have h_ut_lower : c₁ * ‖ι (u t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ alphaFunctional 1 (u t) :=
      (h_quad (u t) hut_δ₁).1
    have h_u0_upper : alphaFunctional 1 (u 0) ≤ c₂ * ‖ι (u 0)‖ ^ 2 :=
      (h_quad (u 0) hu0_δ₁).2
    have h_u0_sq : ‖ι (u 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 :=

    have h_c2_le : c₂ * ‖ι (u 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_u0_sq (le_of_lt hc₂)
    have h_alg : c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h_diff : c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 - c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 =

        dsimp [δ₀]
        have : c₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc₂
        field_simp
        ring
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ c₁ * (c₂ - c₁) * δ' ^ 2 / (4 * c₂) := by
        have : 0 ≤ c₂ - c₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hc₁₂
        positivity
      linarith
    have h_c1_sq : c₁ * ‖ι (u t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖ι (u t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_c1_sq hc₁
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq_le (by positivity)).2
  have h_abs_uIcc : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ∈ Set.uIcc 0 b → |a| ≤ |b| ∧ (|a| = |b| → a = b) := by
    intro a b h
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at h
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · have hb : 0 ≤ b := le_trans h1 h2
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      exact ⟨h2, id⟩
    · have hb : b ≤ 0 := le_trans h1 h2
      rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos hb]
      exact ⟨by linarith, fun h_eq => by linarith⟩
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => ‖ι (u τ)‖
  have hf_cont : Continuous f := (schwartz_solution_continuous_hm1 u hu).norm
  have hf_all : ∀ τ : ℝ, f τ ≤ δ' := by
    intro τ
    by_contra! h_gt
    let S : Set ℝ := Set.uIcc 0 τ ∩ {s : ℝ | δ' ≤ f s}
    have hS_compact : IsCompact S :=
      isCompact_uIcc.inter_right (isClosed_Ici.preimage hf_cont)
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := ⟨τ, Set.right_mem_uIcc, le_of_lt h_gt⟩
    obtain ⟨s₀, ⟨hs₀_uIcc, hs₀_ge⟩, hs₀_min⟩ :=
      hS_compact.exists_isMinOn hS_nonempty continuous_abs.continuousOn
    change δ' ≤ f s₀ at hs₀_ge
    have h_le_s₀ : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 s₀, f s ≤ δ' := by
      intro s hs
      by_contra! hs_gt
      have hδ'_mem : δ' ∈ Set.uIcc (f 0) (f s) :=
        Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith [show f 0 ≤ δ₀ from hu0, hδ₀_le_half], le_of_lt hs_gt⟩)
      obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁_mem, hs₁_eq⟩ :=
        intermediate_value_uIcc hf_cont.continuousOn hδ'_mem
      have hs_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 s₀ := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_left hs
      have hs₀_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s₀ ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 τ := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_left hs₀_uIcc
      have hs₁_in_S : s₁ ∈ S := ⟨hs₀_sub (hs_sub hs₁_mem), le_of_eq hs₁_eq.symm⟩
      have h_min_s₁ : |s₀| ≤ |s₁| := hs₀_min hs₁_in_S
      have h_abs1 := h_abs_uIcc hs₁_mem
      have h_abs2 := h_abs_uIcc hs
      have h_eq1 : s₁ = s := h_abs1.2 (by linarith [h_abs1.1, h_abs2.1])
      subst h_eq1
      linarith
    have hs₀_half : f s₀ ≤ δ' / 2 := hf_step s₀ h_le_s₀
    linarith

  exact h_local_cons t (fun s _ => hf_all s) κ hκ

  have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
      Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
      h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
    refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
      (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
    filter_upwards with ξ
    have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
      dsimp [fourierLine, C]
      rw [norm_mul]
      gcongr
      calc
        ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
          ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
            congr 1 with x
            exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    calc
      (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
  have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
    intro q
    dsimp [toHm1]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have s4 : ∀ (μ : ℝ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      hm1KappaSq μ (ι w) = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * μ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro μ w
    dsimp [hm1KappaSq, ι]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [(h_mem w).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
    rw [h_toHm1 w, hξ]
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq]
    have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have s5 : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam →
      ∀ (S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x)) →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * (lam * κ) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        lam * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro lam hlam S hS_eval κ w
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam
    have h_fl_scale : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (S w) ξ = (lam : ℂ) * fourierLine w (lam⁻¹ * ξ) := by
      intro ξ
      dsimp [fourierLine]
      have h_int_eq :
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((S w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => (lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I) * (w (lam * x) : ℂ))) := by
        ext x
        rw [hS_eval w x]
        have h_mul : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = -(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I := by
          push_cast
          have h_lam_c : (lam : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlam_ne
          field_simp
        rw [h_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_int_eq, integral_const_mul]
      let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => Complex.exp (-(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) * (w y : ℂ)
      have h_cov : (∫ x : ℝ, g (lam * x)) = |lam⁻¹| • ∫ y : ℝ, g y :=
        Measure.integral_comp_mul_left g lam
      change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ((lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * ∫ x : ℝ, g (lam * x)) =
        (lam : ℂ) * (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ y : ℝ, g y)
      rw [h_cov, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hlam), Complex.real_smul]
      push_cast
      have h_lam_c : (lam : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlam_ne
      field_simp
    have h_norm_fl_scale : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 = lam ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine w (lam⁻¹ * ξ)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      rw [h_fl_scale ξ, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hlam), mul_pow]
    let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2)
    have h_lhs_eq :
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * (lam * κ) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => G (lam⁻¹ * ξ)) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp [G]
      rw [h_norm_fl_scale ξ]
      have h_den : 4 * (lam * κ) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 = lam ^ 2 * (4 * κ ^ 2 + (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2) := by
        have h_xi : lam ^ 2 * (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 := by
          calc lam ^ 2 * (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2 = (lam * lam⁻¹) ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 1 ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne]
          _ = ξ ^ 2 := by ring
        linarith [show 4 * (lam * κ) ^ 2 = lam ^ 2 * (4 * κ ^ 2) by ring]
      rw [h_den, mul_div_mul_left _ _ (pow_ne_zero 2 hlam_ne)]
    rw [h_lhs_eq, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left G lam⁻¹, inv_inv, abs_of_pos hlam, smul_eq_mul]
  intro h_exists h_unique q
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, _K_alpha, _C_int, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, _hK_alpha, _hC_int,
    h_quad, _h_alpha_ratio, _h_interp⟩ := diagGreen_alpha_and_interpolation
  have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ hc₁₂
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀, _hδ₀_le, h_cons⟩ :=
    kdv_alpha_conservation_small_data h_exists h_unique δ₁ hδ₁
  obtain ⟨lam, S, hlam_pos, hlam_le, hS_eval, hS_sol, hS_init,
    _hS_nonexp, _hS_inv, _hS_kappa⟩ := kdv_scaling_symmetry q δ₀ hδ₀
  have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam_pos
  have hκ₀ : 1 ≤ lam⁻¹ := by
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hlam_le (le_of_lt (inv_pos.mpr hlam_pos))
    rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne, one_mul] at h_mul
  refine ⟨lam⁻¹, hκ₀, c₂ / c₁, div_pos hc₂ hc₁, ?_⟩
  intro u hu hu0 t κ hκ
  change hm1KappaSq κ (ι (u t)) ≤ (c₂ / c₁) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι (u 0))
  set w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun τ => S (u (lam ^ 3 * τ))
  have hw_sol : IsSchwartzSolution w := hS_sol u hu
  have hw0_eq : w 0 = S (u 0) := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [mul_zero]
  have hw0_bound : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ≤ δ₀ := by
    rw [hw0_eq]
    exact hS_init (u 0) hu0
  have hκ' : 1 ≤ lam * κ := by
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hκ (le_of_lt hlam_pos)
    rwa [mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne] at h_mul
  set τ : ℝ := (lam ^ 3)⁻¹ * t
  have hwτ_eq : w τ = S (u t) := by
    dsimp [w, τ]
    rw [mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (pow_ne_zero 3 hlam_ne)]
  have h_w_cons := h_cons w hw_sol hw0_bound
  have hwτ_δ₁ : ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ δ₁ := h_w_cons.1 τ
  have hw0_δ₁ : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ≤ δ₁ := h_w_cons.1 0
  have h_alpha_eq : alphaFunctional (lam * κ) (w τ) = alphaFunctional (lam * κ) (w 0) :=
    h_w_cons.2 (lam * κ) hκ' τ
  have h_low := (h_quad (lam * κ) hκ' (w τ) hwτ_δ₁).1
  have h_high := (h_quad (lam * κ) hκ' (w 0) hw0_δ₁).2
  have h_c1_c2 : c₁ * hm1KappaSq (lam * κ) (ι (w τ)) ≤ c₂ * hm1KappaSq (lam * κ) (ι (w 0)) := by
    have : (lam * κ) * alphaFunctional (lam * κ) (w τ) =
        (lam * κ) * alphaFunctional (lam * κ) (w 0) := by rw [h_alpha_eq]
    linarith
  have h_w_bound : hm1KappaSq (lam * κ) (ι (w τ)) ≤ (c₂ / c₁) * hm1KappaSq (lam * κ) (ι (w 0)) := by
    rw [div_mul_eq_mul_div, le_div_iff₀' hc₁]
    exact h_c1_c2
  rw [hwτ_eq, hw0_eq] at h_w_bound
  have h_scale_eq : ∀ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      hm1KappaSq (lam * κ) (ι (S v)) = lam * hm1KappaSq κ (ι v) := by
    intro v
    rw [s4 (lam * κ) (S v), s5 lam hlam_pos S hS_eval κ v, ← s4 κ v]
  rw [h_scale_eq (u t), h_scale_eq (u 0)] at h_w_bound
  exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left (by linarith) hlam_pos

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_alpha_and_interpolation
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ (δ₁ c₁ c₂ K_alpha C_int : ℝ),
      0 < δ₁ ∧ 0 < c₁ ∧ c₁ ≤ c₂ ∧ 0 < K_alpha ∧ 0 < C_int ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ₁ →
        c₁ * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) ≤ κ * alphaFunctional κ w ∧
        κ * alphaFunctional κ w ≤ c₂ * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ₁ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ₁ →
        alphaFunctional κ w₁ = alphaFunctional κ w₂ →
        Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₁)) ≤ K_alpha * Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w₂))) ∧
      (∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ₁ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ₁ →
        ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ≤
          C_int * (M ^ 2 + 4) ^ 2 *
            Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x)) +
          C_int * (Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι w₁)) + Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq M (ι w₂))))

subgoal_signatures.name: kdv_alpha_conservation_small_data
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(h_exists : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∃ u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u ∧ u 0 = q)
    (h_unique : ∀ u v : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      IsSchwartzSolution u → IsSchwartzSolution v → u 0 = v 0 → u = v)
    (δ : ℝ) (hδ : 0 < δ) :
    ∃ δ₀ : ℝ, 0 < δ₀ ∧ δ₀ ≤ δ ∧
      ∀ u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u → ‖ι (u 0)‖ ≤ δ₀ →
        (∀ t : ℝ, ‖ι (u t)‖ ≤ δ) ∧
        (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ t : ℝ, alphaFunctional κ (u t) = alphaFunctional κ (u 0))

subgoal_signatures.name: kdv_scaling_symmetry
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(q : Hm1) (δ₀ : ℝ) (hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀) :
    ∃ (lam : ℝ) (S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1 ∧
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x)) ∧
      (∀ u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u →
        IsSchwartzSolution (fun t => S (u (lam ^ 3 * t)))) ∧
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w - q‖ < 1 → ‖ι (S w)‖ ≤ δ₀) ∧
      (∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (S w₁) - ι (S w₂)‖ ≤ ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖) ∧
      (∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ≤ lam⁻¹ ^ 2 * ‖ι (S w₁) - ι (S w₂)‖) ∧
      (∀ κ : ℝ, 1 ≤ κ → ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι (S w))) ≤ Real.sqrt (hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)))

  have h_ae : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume,

    filter_upwards [MeasureTheory.Lp.coeFn_sub f g] with ξ hξ
    have h_tri : ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ≤

    have h_sq_diff : 0 ≤ (‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ -

    have h_sq_bound : ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤

by
  intro g κ₀ ε₁ hε₁
  have h_m_nonneg : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (ξ : ℝ), 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ ξ
    have h_pos : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact div_nonneg (by positivity) (le_of_lt h_pos)
  have h_m_le_one : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (ξ : ℝ), (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    intro κ hκ ξ
    have h_pos : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
    exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (le_of_lt h_pos)
  have hB_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
    (Lp.memLp g).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
  let M : ℝ := max 1 κ₀
  have hM₁ : 1 ≤ M := le_max_left 1 κ₀
  let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n ξ =>
    (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * (M + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
  have hF_meas : ∀ n : ℕ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) volume := by
    intro n
    have hn : 1 ≤ M + (n : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * (M + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      refine Continuous.div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2))
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) ?_
      intro ξ
      have : 0 < 4 * (M + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      exact ne_of_gt this
    exact h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hB_int.aestronglyMeasurable
  have hF_bound : ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F n ξ‖ ≤ B ξ := by
    intro n
    have hn : 1 ≤ M + (n : ℝ) := by linarith [Nat.cast_nonneg (α := ℝ) n]
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_m_nonneg (M + (n : ℝ)) hn ξ) (sq_nonneg _))]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one (M + (n : ℝ)) hn ξ)
  have hF_lim : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume, Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => F n ξ) Filter.atTop (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
    filter_upwards with ξ
    dsimp [F]
    have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => M + (n : ℝ)) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.tendsto_atTop_add_const_left _ M tendsto_natCast_atTop_atTop
    have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => (M + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop := by
      simpa only [sq] using Filter.Tendsto.atTop_mul_atTop₀ h1 h1
    have h3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun n : ℕ => 4 * (M + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
      Filter.Tendsto.atTop_add (Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop (by norm_num) h2) tendsto_const_nhds
    have h4 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun n : ℕ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) / (4 * (M + (n : ℝ)) ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      Filter.Tendsto.div_atTop tendsto_const_nhds h3
    simpa only [div_mul_eq_mul_div] using h4
  have h_tendsto := MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_of_dominated_convergence B hF_meas hB_int hF_bound hF_lim
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero] at h_tendsto
  have h_ev : ∀ᶠ n : ℕ in Filter.atTop, (∫ ξ : ℝ, F n ξ) < ε₁ :=
    h_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε₁)
  obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := h_ev.exists
  refine ⟨M + (N : ℝ), ?_, hN⟩
  have hN_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (N : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg N
  dsimp [M]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hu : IsSchwartzSolution u) (μ : ℝ) (hμ_pos : 0 < μ) (hμ_le : μ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ u_μ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u_μ ∧
      ‖ι (u_μ 0)‖ ≤ μ * ‖ι (u 0)‖ ∧
      ∀ t : ℝ, μ ^ 3 * ‖ι (u t)‖ ≤ ‖ι (u_μ (t / μ ^ 6))‖

(u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hu : IsSchwartzSolution u) (μ : ℝ) (hμ_pos : 0 < μ) (hμ_le : μ ≤ 1) :
    ∃ u_μ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsSchwartzSolution u_μ ∧
      ‖ι (u_μ 0)‖ ≤ μ * ‖ι (u 0)‖ ∧
