proof.tactics:
by
  have s1 : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam →
      ∃ S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x)) ∧
        (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, kdvRHS (S w) x = lam ^ 5 * kdvRHS w (lam * x)) := by
    intro lam hlam
    let g_lam : ℝ →L[ℝ] ℝ := lam • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ ℝ
    have h_temp : Function.HasTemperateGrowth g_lam := g_lam.hasTemperateGrowth
    let K : NNReal := Real.toNNReal lam⁻¹
    have h_anti : AntilipschitzWith K g_lam := by
      rw [antilipschitzWith_iff_le_mul_dist]
      intro x y
      have hK : (K : ℝ) = lam⁻¹ := Real.coe_toNNReal _ (by positivity)
      rw [hK, Real.dist_eq, Real.dist_eq]
      have h_glam : ∀ z : ℝ, g_lam z = lam * z := fun z => by dsimp [g_lam]
      rw [h_glam x, h_glam y, ← mul_sub, abs_mul, abs_of_pos hlam, ← mul_assoc,
          inv_mul_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt hlam), one_mul]
    let S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) :=
      (lam ^ 2) • SchwartzMap.compCLMOfAntilipschitz ℝ h_temp h_anti
    have hS_eval : ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x) := by
      intro w x
      dsimp [S, g_lam]
    refine ⟨S, hS_eval, ?_⟩
    intro w x
    have hS_fn : (S w : ℝ → ℝ) = fun z => lam ^ 2 * w (lam * z) := by
      ext z
      exact hS_eval w z
    have h_iter : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (S w) x = lam ^ 2 * (lam ^ n * iteratedDeriv n w (lam * x)) := by
      intro n
      have hw_n : ContDiff ℝ (↑n) (w : ℝ → ℝ) := w.smooth n
      have h_comp_n : ContDiff ℝ (↑n) (fun z : ℝ => w (lam * z)) :=
        hw_n.comp (contDiff_const.mul contDiff_id)
      rw [hS_fn, iteratedDeriv_const_mul h_comp_n.contDiffAt (lam ^ 2),
          iteratedDeriv_comp_const_mul hw_n lam]
    have h_d1 : deriv (S w) x = lam ^ 3 * deriv w (lam * x) := by
      rw [← iteratedDeriv_one, h_iter 1, iteratedDeriv_one]
      ring
    have h_d3 : iteratedDeriv 3 (S w) x = lam ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv 3 w (lam * x) := by
      rw [h_iter 3]
      ring
    dsimp [kdvRHS]
    rw [h_d3, h_d1, hS_eval w x]
    ring
  have s2 : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → ∀ (S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x)) →
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, kdvRHS (S w) x = lam ^ 5 * kdvRHS w (lam * x)) →
      ∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), IsSchwartzSolution u →
      IsSchwartzSolution (fun t => S (u (lam ^ 3 * t))) := by
    intro lam hlam S hS_eval hS_rhs u hu t
    set c : ℝ := lam ^ 3
    have hc_pos : 0 < c := by positivity
    have hc_ne : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc_pos
    obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_rhs⟩ := hu (c * t)
    refine ⟨c • S v, ?_, ?_⟩
    · show HasFDerivAtFilter (fun t' => S (u (c * t')))
        (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (c • S v)) t (nhds t)
      rw [hasFDerivAtFilter_iff_isLittleOTVS]
      rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul]
      · have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun s : ℝ => (s - c * t)⁻¹ • (u s - u (c * t) - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (s - c * t)))
            (nhds (c * t)) (nhds 0) :=
          hv_deriv.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
        have h_ct : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => c * t') (nhds t) (nhds (c * t)) :=
          (continuous_const.mul continuous_id).tendsto t
        let L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := c • S
        have h_L : Filter.Tendsto L (nhds 0) (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using L.continuous.tendsto 0
        have h_comp := h_L.comp (h_lim.comp h_ct)
        have h_eq :
            (fun x : ℝ => (x - t)⁻¹ • (S (u (c * x)) - S (u (c * t)) - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (c • S v)) (x - t))) =
            (L ∘ (fun s : ℝ => (s - c * t)⁻¹ • (u s - u (c * t) - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (s - c * t))) ∘ (fun t' : ℝ => c * t')) := by
          ext x : 1
          dsimp [L, Function.comp]
          have h_sc1 : c * (c * x - c * t)⁻¹ = (x - t)⁻¹ := by
            have : c * x - c * t = c * (x - t) := by ring
            rw [this, mul_inv, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hc_ne, one_mul]
          have h_sc2 : c * x - c * t = (x - t) * c := by ring
          rw [map_smul, map_sub, map_sub, map_smul, smul_smul, smul_smul, h_sc1, h_sc2]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_comp
      · filter_upwards with x hx
        have hxt : x = t := sub_eq_zero.mp hx
        subst hxt
        simp
    · intro x
      rw [SchwartzMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hS_eval v x, hv_rhs (lam * x), hS_rhs (u (c * t)) x]
      dsimp [c]
      ring
  have h_norm_sq_eq : ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
      intro q ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      intro q
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
        (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
      calc
        (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
    have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
      intro q
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
    intro w
    change ‖toHm1 w‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [(h_mem w).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
    rw [h_toHm1 w, hξ, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq, div_eq_inv_mul]
  have s3 : ∀ (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → lam ≤ 1 →
      ∀ (S : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, S w x = lam ^ 2 * w (lam * x)) →
      ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      lam ^ 3 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ι (S w)‖ ^ 2 ∧
      ‖ι (S w)‖ ^ 2 ≤ lam * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro lam hlam hlam_le S hS_eval w
    rw [h_norm_sq_eq w, h_norm_sq_eq (S w)]
    have hlam_ne : lam ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hlam
    have h_fl_scale : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (S w) ξ = (lam : ℂ) * fourierLine w (lam⁻¹ * ξ) := by
      intro ξ
      dsimp [fourierLine]
      have h_int_eq :
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((S w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => (lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I) * (w (lam * x) : ℂ))) := by
        ext x
        rw [hS_eval w x]
        have h_mul : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = -(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((lam * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I := by
          push_cast
          have h_lam_c : (lam : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlam_ne
          field_simp
        rw [h_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_int_eq, integral_const_mul]
      let g : ℝ → ℂ := fun y => Complex.exp (-(((lam⁻¹ * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) * (w y : ℂ)
      have h_cov : (∫ x : ℝ, g (lam * x)) = |lam⁻¹| • ∫ y : ℝ, g y :=
        Measure.integral_comp_mul_left g lam
      change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ((lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * ∫ x : ℝ, g (lam * x)) =
        (lam : ℂ) * (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ y : ℝ, g y)
      rw [h_cov, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hlam), Complex.real_smul]
      push_cast
      have h_lam_c : (lam : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hlam_ne
      field_simp
    have h_norm_fl_scale : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 = lam ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine w (lam⁻¹ * ξ)‖ ^ 2 := by
      intro ξ
      rw [h_fl_scale ξ, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt hlam), mul_pow]
    have h_freq_cov :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (∫ ζ : ℝ, (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)) := by
      let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => (lam ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)
      have h_lhs_eq :
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (S w) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => G (lam⁻¹ * ξ)) := by
        ext ξ
        dsimp [G]
        rw [h_norm_fl_scale ξ]
        have : lam ^ 2 * (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2 = ξ ^ 2 := by
          calc lam ^ 2 * (lam⁻¹ * ξ) ^ 2 = (lam * lam⁻¹) ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = 1 ^ 2 * ξ ^ 2 := by rw [mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne]
          _ = ξ ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [this]
      rw [h_lhs_eq, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left G lam⁻¹, inv_inv, abs_of_pos hlam, smul_eq_mul,
          ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1 with ζ
      dsimp [G]
      ring
    rw [h_freq_cov]
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ = ‖w x‖ := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (w p.2 : ℂ)) := by
      have := w.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine w) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖
    have h_fl_sq_bound : ∀ ζ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 := by
      intro ζ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand ζ x
      exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    have h_int_base : Integrable (fun ζ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_meas_num : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
        h_meas_fl.norm.pow 2
      have h_cont_den : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => (4 + ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ζ => by positivity)
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2)) volume := by

      filter_upwards with ζ
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nonneg, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h_den : 1 + ζ ^ 2 ≤ 4 + ζ ^ 2 := by linarith
      have h_inv : (4 + ζ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ζ ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_den
      have := h_fl_sq_bound ζ
      gcongr
    have h_upper_pw : ∀ ζ : ℝ,
        (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2) ≤
        lam * (‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2)) := by
      intro ζ
      have h_lam_sq_le : lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have h_den_le : lam ^ 2 * (4 + ζ ^ 2) ≤ 4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2 := by nlinarith

          ≤ (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (lam ^ 2 * (4 + ζ ^ 2)) := by
            gcongr
        _ = lam * (‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2)) := by
            have : 4 + ζ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity

    have h_int_scaled : Integrable (fun ζ : ℝ => (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_meas_num : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul (h_meas_fl.norm.pow 2)
      have h_cont_den : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ζ => by positivity)
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ζ : ℝ => (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2)) volume := by
        simpa [div_eq_mul_inv] using h_meas_num.mul h_cont_den.aestronglyMeasurable
      refine (h_int_base.const_mul lam).mono' h_meas ?_
      filter_upwards with ζ
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
      exact h_upper_pw ζ
    have h_lower_pw : ∀ ζ : ℝ,
        lam ^ 3 * (‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2)) ≤
        (lam ^ 3 * ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2) := by
      intro ζ
      have h_lam_sq_le : lam ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
      have h_den_le : 4 + lam ^ 2 * ζ ^ 2 ≤ 4 + ζ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      rw [← mul_div_assoc]
      gcongr
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← integral_const_mul]

    · rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_mono h_int_scaled (h_int_base.const_mul lam) h_upper_pw
  let lam : ℝ := μ ^ 2
  have hlam_def : lam = μ ^ 2 := rfl
  have hlam_pos : 0 < lam := by positivity
  have hlam_le : lam ≤ 1 := by nlinarith
  obtain ⟨S_clm, hS_eval, hS_rhs⟩ := s1 lam hlam_pos
  let u_μ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun τ => S_clm (u (lam ^ 3 * τ))
  refine ⟨u_μ, s2 lam hlam_pos S_clm hS_eval hS_rhs u hu, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have hu_μ0 : u_μ 0 = S_clm (u 0) := by
      dsimp [u_μ]
      rw [mul_zero]
    rw [hu_μ0]
    obtain ⟨_, h_high⟩ := s3 lam hlam_pos hlam_le (⇑S_clm) hS_eval (u 0)
    have h_sq : ‖ι (S_clm (u 0))‖ ^ 2 ≤ (μ * ‖ι (u 0)‖) ^ 2 := by
      calc ‖ι (S_clm (u 0))‖ ^ 2
        _ ≤ lam * ‖ι (u 0)‖ ^ 2 := h_high
        _ = (μ * ‖ι (u 0)‖) ^ 2 := by rw [hlam_def]; ring
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt

    have h_time : lam ^ 3 * (t / μ ^ 6) = t := by
      rw [hlam_def]
      have hμ_ne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ_pos

    have hu_μt : u_μ (t / μ ^ 6) = S_clm (u t) := by
      dsimp [u_μ]
      rw [h_time]
    rw [hu_μt]
    obtain ⟨h_low, _⟩ := s3 lam hlam_pos hlam_le (⇑S_clm) hS_eval (u t)
    have h_sq : (μ ^ 3 * ‖ι (u t)‖) ^ 2 ≤ ‖ι (S_clm (u t))‖ ^ 2 := by
      calc (μ ^ 3 * ‖ι (u t)‖) ^ 2

    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt

by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, h_quad⟩ := alphaFunctional_one_quadratic_bounds
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h_deriv⟩ := alphaFunctional_hasDerivAt_kdv
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h_ortho⟩ := kdvRHS_orthogonality_diagGreen
  have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ hc₁₂
  let δ : ℝ := min δ₁ (min δ₂ δ₃)
  have hδ : 0 < δ := lt_min hδ₁ (lt_min hδ₂ hδ₃)
  have hδ_le₁ : δ ≤ δ₁ := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_le₂ : δ ≤ δ₂ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ_le₃ : δ ≤ δ₃ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  let δ₀ : ℝ := (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ
  have hδ₀ : 0 < δ₀ := by positivity
  have hδ₀_le : δ₀ ≤ δ / 2 := by
    have h1 : c₁ * δ ≤ c₂ * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc₁₂ (le_of_lt hδ)
    have h2 : δ₀ = (c₁ * δ) / (2 * c₂) := by ring
    have h3 : δ / 2 = (c₂ * δ) / (2 * c₂) := by
      field_simp [ne_of_gt hc₂]
    rw [h2, h3]
    exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
  refine ⟨δ, hδ, δ₀, hδ₀, hδ₀_le, ?_⟩
  intro w hw hw0 t h_ball
  let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => alphaFunctional 1 (w τ)
  have hG_deriv : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, HasDerivAt G 0 s := by
    intro s hs
    have hs_le : ‖ι (w s)‖ ≤ δ := h_ball s hs
    have hd := h_deriv w hw 1 le_rfl s (le_trans hs_le hδ_le₂)
    have ho := h_ortho 1 le_rfl (w s) (le_trans hs_le hδ_le₃)
    rw [ho] at hd
    exact hd
  have hG_const_Icc : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a < b → Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 t → G b = G a := by
    intro a b hab h_sub
    have h_cont : ContinuousOn G (Set.Icc a b) :=
      fun x hx => (hG_deriv x (h_sub hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h_der : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt G 0 x :=
      fun x hx => hG_deriv x (h_sub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx))
    obtain ⟨c, _, hc⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope G (fun _ => 0) hab h_cont h_der
    have hba : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab)
    have h_sub_zero : G b - G a = 0 := (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hc.symm).resolve_right hba
    linarith
  have hG_eq : G t = G 0 := by
    rcases lt_trichotomy 0 t with hlt | rfl | hgt
    · exact hG_const_Icc hlt Set.Icc_subset_uIcc
    · rfl
    · exact (hG_const_Icc hgt Set.Icc_subset_uIcc').symm
  have hw0_δ₁ : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (h_ball 0 Set.left_mem_uIcc) hδ_le₁
  have hwt_δ₁ : ‖ι (w t)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (h_ball t Set.right_mem_uIcc) hδ_le₁
  have h_wt_low : c₁ * ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ G t := (h_quad (w t) hwt_δ₁).1
  have h_w0_high : G 0 ≤ c₂ * ‖ι (w 0)‖ ^ 2 := (h_quad (w 0) hw0_δ₁).2
  have hw0_sq : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 :=
    sq_le_sq.mpr (by rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), abs_of_pos hδ₀]; exact hw0)
  have h_c2_w0 : c₂ * ‖ι (w 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 :=
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw0_sq (le_of_lt hc₂)
  have h_alg : c₁ * (δ / 2) ^ 2 - c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 = c₁ * (c₂ - c₁) * δ ^ 2 / (4 * c₂) := by
    dsimp [δ₀]
    field_simp [ne_of_gt hc₂]
    ring
  have h_alg_nonneg : 0 ≤ c₁ * (δ / 2) ^ 2 - c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_alg]
    have h_sub_nonneg : 0 ≤ c₂ - c₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hc₁₂
    positivity
  have h_c1_sq : c₁ * ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ / 2) ^ 2 := by linarith
  have h_wt_sq : ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (δ / 2) ^ 2 :=
    le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_c1_sq hc₁
  exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_wt_sq (by positivity)).2

by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, h_quad⟩ := alphaFunctional_one_quadratic_bounds

  have hδ'_le_δ₂ : δ' ≤ δ₂ :=

  have hδ'_le_δ₃ : δ' ≤ δ₃ :=

    have h_w0_upper : alphaFunctional 1 w₀ ≤ c₂ * ‖ι w₀‖ ^ 2 :=

    have h_w0_sq : ‖ι w₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 :=

    have h_c2_le : c₂ * ‖ι w₀‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 :=

        have : c₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc₂

    have h_c1_sq : c₁ * ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 :=

  obtain ⟨w, hw_sol, hw0, hw_ball⟩ :=

    have h_diag_scale : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
        diagGreen κ w x = lam * diagGreen 1 (S w) (κ * x) := by
      intro w x
      dsimp [diagGreen, greenKernel]
      simp_rw [h_iter_scale w _ x x]
      exact tsum_mul_left
    obtain ⟨g₁, hg₁⟩ := h_reg κ hκ1 f₁ (le_trans hf₁ (min_le_left _ _))
    obtain ⟨g₂, hg₂⟩ := h_reg κ hκ1 f₂ (le_trans hf₂ (min_le_left _ _))
    let g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := g₁ - g₂
    have hg_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, g x = diagGreen κ f₁ x - diagGreen κ f₂ x := by
      intro x
      change g₁ x - g₂ x = diagGreen κ f₁ x - diagGreen κ f₂ x
      rw [hg₁ x, hg₂ x]
      ring
    have hr_eq_g : r = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g := by
      ext x
      have hd1 : deriv (diagGreen κ f₁) x = deriv g₁ x := by
        have h_fn : diagGreen κ f₁ = fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g₁ y := funext hg₁
        rw [h_fn]
        exact ((g₁.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).const_add (1 / (2 * κ))).deriv
      have hd2 : deriv (diagGreen κ f₂) x = deriv g₂ x := by
        have h_fn : diagGreen κ f₂ = fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g₂ y := funext hg₂
        rw [h_fn]
        exact ((g₂.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt).const_add (1 / (2 * κ))).deriv
      rw [hr x, hd1, hd2]
      change deriv g₁ x - deriv g₂ x = (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (g₁ - g₂)) x
      rw [map_sub, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
    let Δg₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => diagGreen 1 (S f₁) u - diagGreen 1 (S f₂) u
    have hg_scale : ∀ x : ℝ, g x = lam * Δg₁ (κ * x) := by
      intro x
      rw [hg_eq x, h_diag_scale f₁ x, h_diag_scale f₂ x]
      dsimp [Δg₁]
      ring
    have hSf₁ : ‖ι (S f₁)‖ ≤ 1 / 256 := le_trans (hS_norm f₁) (le_trans hf₁ (min_le_right _ _))
    have hSf₂ : ‖ι (S f₂)‖ ≤ 1 / 256 := le_trans (hS_norm f₂) (le_trans hf₂ (min_le_right _ _))
    obtain ⟨hΔ_int, hΔ_h1int, hΔ_h1norm⟩ := h_one_diff (S f₁) (S f₂) hSf₁ hSf₂
    have h_fl_g : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine g ξ = (lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ) := by
      intro ξ
      dsimp [fourierLine]
      have h_int_eq :
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => (lam : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-(((lam * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((κ * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I) * (Δg₁ (κ * x) : ℂ))) := by
        ext x
        rw [hg_scale x]
        have h_mul : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = -(((lam * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * ((κ * x : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I := by
          dsimp [lam]
          push_cast
          have h_κ_c : (κ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr hκ_ne
          field_simp
        rw [h_mul]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_int_eq, integral_const_mul]
      let H : ℝ → ℂ := fun u => Complex.exp (-(((lam * ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (Δg₁ u : ℂ)
      have h_cov : (∫ x : ℝ, H (κ * x)) = |κ⁻¹| • ∫ u : ℝ, H u :=
        Measure.integral_comp_mul_left H κ
      change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ((lam : ℂ) * ∫ x : ℝ, H (κ * x)) =
        (lam ^ 2 : ℂ) * (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ u : ℝ, H u)
      rw [h_cov, abs_of_pos hlam_pos, Complex.real_smul]
      dsimp [lam]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_pw_r : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤
        lam * ((4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro ξ
      rw [hr_eq_g, h_fl_deriv g ξ, norm_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_real, Complex.norm_I,
          mul_one, Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_pow, sq_abs, h_fl_g ξ, norm_mul]
      have h_lam2_norm : ‖(lam ^ 2 : ℂ)‖ = lam ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Complex.ofReal_pow, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      rw [h_lam2_norm, mul_pow]
      have h_xi_div : ξ ^ 2 * ((lam ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) =
          (ξ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * (lam ^ 4 * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2) := by ring
      rw [h_xi_div]
      have h1 : ξ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ (by linarith) (by positivity)
      have h2 : lam ^ 4 ≤ lam * (4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2) := by

        have : 1 ≤ 4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (lam * ξ)]
        nlinarith
      calc (ξ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * (lam ^ 4 * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ 1 * (lam ^ 4 * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
        _ = lam ^ 4 * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2 := one_mul _
        _ ≤ (lam * (4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2)) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
        _ = lam * ((4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2) := by ring
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => (4 + ζ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ ζ‖ ^ 2
    have hΦ_comp_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => lam * Φ (lam * ξ)) volume :=
      (hΔ_h1int.comp_mul_left' hlam_ne).const_mul lam
    have hΦ_comp_eq : (∫ ξ : ℝ, lam * Φ (lam * ξ)) = h1NormSq Δg₁ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left Φ lam, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hlam_pos),

      rfl
    have hr_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
        have hr_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine r) := h_fl_cont r r.integrable
        exact Continuous.div (hr_fl_cont.norm.pow 2) (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine hΦ_comp_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact h_pw_r ξ
    have h_r_sq_le : ‖ι r‖ ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ‖ι (f₁ - f₂)‖) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_norm_sq_eq r]
      have h_S_diff : ‖ι (S f₁ - S f₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ι (f₁ - f₂)‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← S.map_sub]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hS_norm (f₁ - f₂)) 2
      calc ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, lam * Φ (lam * ξ) := integral_mono hr_int hΦ_comp_int h_pw_r
        _ = h1NormSq Δg₁ := hΦ_comp_eq
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖ι (S f₁ - S f₂)‖ ^ 2 := hΔ_h1norm
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖ι (f₁ - f₂)‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_S_diff (by norm_num)
        _ ≤ 9 * ‖ι (f₁ - f₂)‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖ι (f₁ - f₂)‖]
        _ = (3 * ‖ι (f₁ - f₂)‖) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_r_sq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt
  have gronwall_bound_of_hasDerivAt_sq :
      ∀ (D E' : ℝ → ℝ) (K T' : ℝ),
        0 ≤ K →
        (∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ D s) →
        (∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => D τ ^ 2) (E' s) s) →
        (∀ s : ℝ, |E' s| ≤ 2 * K * D s ^ 2) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T' → D t ≤ Real.exp (K * T') * D 0 := by
    intro D E' K T' hK hD h_deriv h_bound t ht
    let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => D τ ^ 2
    have hE_nn : ∀ s : ℝ, 0 ≤ E s := fun s => sq_nonneg (D s)
    have h_abs_bound : ∀ s : ℝ, -(2 * K * E s) ≤ E' s ∧ E' s ≤ 2 * K * E s :=
      fun s => abs_le.mp (h_bound s)
    have h_E_le : E t ≤ Real.exp (2 * K * |t|) * E 0 := by
      rcases lt_trichotomy 0 t with ht_pos | rfl | ht_neg
      · let F_pos : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (-2 * K * s) * E s
        let F_pos' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (-2 * K * s) * (E' s - 2 * K * E s)
        have hF_pos_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt F_pos (F_pos' s) s := by
          intro s
          have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => -2 * K * τ) (-2 * K) s := by
            simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (-2 * K)
          have h_exp : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * K * τ)) (Real.exp (-2 * K * s) * (-2 * K)) s :=
            h_lin.exp
          have h_mul := h_exp.mul (h_deriv s)
          convert h_mul using 1
          dsimp [F_pos', E]
          ring
        have hF_pos_cont : ContinuousOn F_pos (Set.Icc 0 t) :=
          fun x _ => (hF_pos_deriv x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        have hF_pos_deriv_oo : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo 0 t, HasDerivAt F_pos (F_pos' x) x :=
          fun x _ => hF_pos_deriv x
        obtain ⟨c, _, hc_slope⟩ :=
          exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope F_pos F_pos' ht_pos hF_pos_cont hF_pos_deriv_oo
        have hc_nonpos : F_pos' c ≤ 0 := by
          dsimp [F_pos']
          exact mul_nonpos_of_nonneg_of_nonpos (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _))
            (sub_nonpos.mpr (h_abs_bound c).2)
        have h_diff_nonpos : F_pos t - F_pos 0 ≤ 0 := by
          have h_div_le : (F_pos t - F_pos 0) / (t - 0) ≤ 0 := by
            rw [← hc_slope]
            exact hc_nonpos
          exact ((div_nonpos_iff.mp h_div_le).resolve_left (fun h => by linarith [h.2])).1
        have hF_le : F_pos t ≤ E 0 := by
          have hF0 : F_pos 0 = E 0 := by
            dsimp [F_pos]
            rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
          linarith
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF_le (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (2 * K * t)))
        have h_cancel : Real.exp (2 * K * t) * F_pos t = E t := by
          dsimp [F_pos]
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          have : 2 * K * t + -2 * K * t = 0 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
        have h_abs_eq : 2 * K * t = 2 * K * |t| := by
          rw [abs_of_pos ht_pos]
        rw [h_cancel, h_abs_eq] at h_mul
        exact h_mul
      · rw [abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
      · let F_neg : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (2 * K * s) * E s
        let F_neg' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s => Real.exp (2 * K * s) * (E' s + 2 * K * E s)
        have hF_neg_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt F_neg (F_neg' s) s := by
          intro s
          have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => 2 * K * τ) (2 * K) s := by
            simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_mul (2 * K)
          have h_exp : HasDerivAt (fun τ : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * K * τ)) (Real.exp (2 * K * s) * (2 * K)) s :=
            h_lin.exp
          have h_mul := h_exp.mul (h_deriv s)
          convert h_mul using 1
          dsimp [F_neg', E]
          ring
        have hF_neg_cont : ContinuousOn F_neg (Set.Icc t 0) :=
          fun x _ => (hF_neg_deriv x).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
        have hF_neg_deriv_oo : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo t 0, HasDerivAt F_neg (F_neg' x) x :=
          fun x _ => hF_neg_deriv x
        obtain ⟨c, _, hc_slope⟩ :=
          exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope F_neg F_neg' ht_neg hF_neg_cont hF_neg_deriv_oo
        have hc_nonneg : 0 ≤ F_neg' c := by
          dsimp [F_neg']
          have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ E' c + 2 * K * E c := by linarith [(h_abs_bound c).1]
          exact mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) h_sum_nn
        have h_diff_nonneg : 0 ≤ F_neg 0 - F_neg t := by
          have h_div_nn : 0 ≤ (F_neg 0 - F_neg t) / (0 - t) := by
            rw [← hc_slope]
            exact hc_nonneg
          exact ((div_nonneg_iff.mp h_div_nn).resolve_right (fun h => by linarith [h.2])).1
        have hF_le : F_neg t ≤ E 0 := by
          have hF0 : F_neg 0 = E 0 := by
            dsimp [F_neg]
            rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
          linarith
        have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hF_le (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos (-2 * K * t)))
        have h_cancel : Real.exp (-2 * K * t) * F_neg t = E t := by
          dsimp [F_neg]
          rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
          have : -2 * K * t + 2 * K * t = 0 := by ring
          rw [this, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
        have h_abs_eq : -2 * K * t = 2 * K * |t| := by
          rw [abs_of_neg ht_neg]
          ring
        rw [h_cancel, h_abs_eq] at h_mul
        exact h_mul
    have h_exp_mono : Real.exp (2 * K * |t|) ≤ Real.exp (2 * K * T') := by
      apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht (by positivity)
    have h_E_T' : D t ^ 2 ≤ (Real.exp (K * T') * D 0) ^ 2 := by
      have h_exp_sq : Real.exp (2 * K * T') = Real.exp (K * T') ^ 2 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_nat_mul]
        push_cast
        ring_nf
      calc D t ^ 2 = E t := rfl
        _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * K * |t|) * E 0 := h_E_le
        _ ≤ Real.exp (2 * K * T') * E 0 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_exp_mono (hE_nn 0)
        _ = (Real.exp (K * T') * D 0) ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [E]
          rw [h_exp_sq]
          ring
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (K * T') * D 0 := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (hD 0)
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_E_T' h_rhs_nn).2
  obtain ⟨δ_lip, C_0, hδ_lip, hC_0, h_green_lip⟩ := diagGreen_deriv_diff_hm1_lipschitz
  refine ⟨δ_lip, hδ_lip, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ T' hT'
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  set K : ℝ := 16 * κ ^ 5 * C_0
  have hK_nn : 0 ≤ K := by positivity
  set L_κ : ℝ := Real.exp (K * T')
  have hL_κ_pos : 0 < L_κ := Real.exp_pos _
  refine ⟨L_κ, hL_κ_pos, ?_⟩
  intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ hb₁ hb₂ t ht
  let D : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => ‖ι (w₁ τ) - ι (w₂ τ)‖
  let E' : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    2 * inner ℝ (ι (w₁ s) - ι (w₂ s)) (ι (hw₁ s).choose - ι (hw₂ s).choose)
  have h_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => D τ ^ 2) (E' s) s := by
    intro s
    have hd₁ : HasDerivAt (fun τ => ι (w₁ τ)) (ι (hw₁ s).choose) s :=
      h_iota_deriv w₁ (hw₁ s).choose s (hw₁ s).choose_spec.1
    have hd₂ : HasDerivAt (fun τ => ι (w₂ τ)) (ι (hw₂ s).choose) s :=
      h_iota_deriv w₂ (hw₂ s).choose s (hw₂ s).choose_spec.1
    exact (hd₁.sub hd₂).norm_sq
  have h_bound : ∀ s : ℝ, |E' s| ≤ 2 * K * D s ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    let v₁ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := (hw₁ s).choose
    have hv₁_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, v₁ x = regFlowRHS κ (w₁ s) x := (hw₁ s).choose_spec.2
    let v₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := (hw₂ s).choose
    have hv₂_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, v₂ x = regFlowRHS κ (w₂ s) x := (hw₂ s).choose_spec.2
    let f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := w₁ s - w₂ s
    let f' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f
    let c_κ : ℝ := 16 * κ ^ 5
    have hc_κ_pos : 0 < c_κ := by dsimp [c_κ]; positivity
    have hc_κ_ne : c_κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc_κ_pos
    let r : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := c_κ⁻¹ • ((v₁ - v₂) - (4 * κ ^ 2) • f')
    have hr_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, r x = deriv (diagGreen κ (w₁ s)) x - deriv (diagGreen κ (w₂ s)) x := by
      intro x
      have hf'_eq : f' x = deriv (w₁ s) x - deriv (w₂ s) x := by
        change (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (w₁ s - w₂ s)) x = deriv (w₁ s) x - deriv (w₂ s) x
        rw [map_sub, SchwartzMap.sub_apply, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
      change c_κ⁻¹ * ((v₁ x - v₂ x) - (4 * κ ^ 2) * f' x) =
        deriv (diagGreen κ (w₁ s)) x - deriv (diagGreen κ (w₂ s)) x
      rw [hv₁_eq x, hv₂_eq x, hf'_eq]
      dsimp [regFlowRHS, c_κ]
      field_simp
      ring
    have hv_decomp : v₁ - v₂ = c_κ • r + (4 * κ ^ 2) • f' := by
      dsimp [r]
      rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hc_κ_ne, sub_add_cancel]
    have h_inner_eq : inner ℝ (ι (w₁ s) - ι (w₂ s)) (ι v₁ - ι v₂) =
        c_κ * inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r) := by
      rw [← h_iota_sub (w₁ s) (w₂ s), ← h_iota_sub v₁ v₂]
      change inner ℝ (ι f) (ι (v₁ - v₂)) = c_κ * inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r)
      rw [hv_decomp, h_iota_add (c_κ • r) ((4 * κ ^ 2) • f'),
          h_iota_smul c_κ r, h_iota_smul (4 * κ ^ 2) f',
          inner_add_right, inner_smul_right, inner_smul_right]
      have h_zero : inner ℝ (ι f) (ι f') = 0 := inner_iota_derivCLM_self_eq_zero f
      rw [h_zero, mul_zero, add_zero]
    have hE'_eq : E' s = (2 * c_κ) * inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r) := by
      change 2 * inner ℝ (ι (w₁ s) - ι (w₂ s)) (ι v₁ - ι v₂) = (2 * c_κ) * inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r)
      rw [h_inner_eq]
      ring
    have h_cs : |inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r)| ≤ ‖ι f‖ * ‖ι r‖ := abs_real_inner_le_norm (ι f) (ι r)
    have h_r_lip : ‖ι r‖ ≤ C_0 * ‖ι f‖ :=
      h_green_lip κ hκ (w₁ s) (w₂ s) r (hb₁ s) (hb₂ s) hr_eq
    have h_Df : ‖ι f‖ = D s := by
      change ‖ι (w₁ s - w₂ s)‖ = ‖ι (w₁ s) - ι (w₂ s)‖
      rw [h_iota_sub]
    have h_inner_le : |inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r)| ≤ C_0 * D s ^ 2 := by
      calc |inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r)|
        _ ≤ ‖ι f‖ * ‖ι r‖ := h_cs
        _ ≤ ‖ι f‖ * (C_0 * ‖ι f‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_r_lip (norm_nonneg _)
        _ = C_0 * D s ^ 2 := by rw [h_Df]; ring
    rw [hE'_eq, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * c_κ)]
    calc 2 * c_κ * |inner ℝ (ι f) (ι r)|
      _ ≤ 2 * c_κ * (C_0 * D s ^ 2) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inner_le (by positivity)
      _ = 2 * K * D s ^ 2 := by dsimp [K, c_κ]; ring
  exact gronwall_bound_of_hasDerivAt_sq D E' K T' hK_nn (fun s => norm_nonneg _) h_deriv h_bound t ht

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ_comm, hδ_comm, h_surf⟩ := commuting_kdv_reg_flow_surface h_exists h_unique
  obtain ⟨δ_diag, hδ_diag, h_diag⟩ := bivariate_schwartz_flows_to_diffFlow
  set δ_target : ℝ := min δ' (min δ_comm δ_diag)
  have hδ_target : 0 < δ_target := by positivity
  have hδ_target_le_δ' : δ_target ≤ δ' := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_target_le_comm : δ_target ≤ δ_comm :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ_target_le_diag : δ_target ≤ δ_diag :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨δ_kdv, hδ_kdv_pos, hδ_kdv_le, h_kdv⟩ :=
    kdv_alpha_conservation_small_data h_exists h_unique δ_target hδ_target
  obtain ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le, h_reg⟩ :=
    reg_flow_apriori_trapping_and_conservation δ_kdv hδ_kdv_pos
  have hδ₀_le_δ' : δ₀ ≤ δ' := le_trans hδ₀_le (le_trans hδ_kdv_le hδ_target_le_δ')
  refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le_δ', ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ u w hu hw hw0 hu0 t
  have hκ_ge1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hw0_ball : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ≤ δ₀ := by rwa [hw0]
  obtain ⟨hw_ball, hw_alpha⟩ := h_reg κ hκ w hw hw0_ball
  let U : ℝ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s τ => (h_exists (w τ)).choose s
  have hU_kdv : ∀ τ : ℝ, IsSchwartzSolution (fun s => U s τ) :=
    fun τ => ((h_exists (w τ)).choose_spec).1
  have hU_init : ∀ τ : ℝ, U 0 τ = w τ :=
    fun τ => ((h_exists (w τ)).choose_spec).2
  have hU_zero_eq : (fun s => U s 0) = u :=
    h_unique (fun s => U s 0) u (hU_kdv 0) hu ((hU_init 0).trans hw0)
  have hU_zero : ∀ s : ℝ, U s 0 = u s :=
    fun s => congr_fun hU_zero_eq s
  have hU0_eq_w : (fun τ => U 0 τ) = w := funext hU_init
  have hU_reg0 : IsRegFlowSolution κ (fun τ => U 0 τ) := by rwa [hU0_eq_w]
  have hU_ball : ∀ s τ : ℝ, ‖ι (U s τ)‖ ≤ δ_target := by
    intro s τ
    have h_init_ball : ‖ι (U 0 τ)‖ ≤ δ_kdv := by
      rw [hU_init τ]
      exact hw_ball τ
    exact (h_kdv (fun s' => U s' τ) (hU_kdv τ) h_init_ball).1 s
  have hU_alpha : ∀ s τ : ℝ, alphaFunctional κ (U s τ) = alphaFunctional κ (U 0 τ) := by
    intro s τ
    have h_init_ball : ‖ι (U 0 τ)‖ ≤ δ_kdv := by
      rw [hU_init τ]
      exact hw_ball τ
    exact (h_kdv (fun s' => U s' τ) (hU_kdv τ) h_init_ball).2 κ hκ_ge1 s
  have hU_reg : ∀ s : ℝ, IsRegFlowSolution κ (fun τ => U s τ) :=
    h_surf κ hκ U hU_kdv hU_reg0 (fun s τ => le_trans (hU_ball s τ) hδ_target_le_comm)
  let z : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => U s (t - s)
  refine ⟨z, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact h_diag κ hκ U hU_kdv hU_reg (fun s τ => le_trans (hU_ball s τ) hδ_target_le_diag) t
  · dsimp [z]
    rw [sub_zero, hU_init t]
  · dsimp [z]
    rw [sub_self, hU_zero t]
  · intro s
    exact le_trans (hU_ball s (t - s)) hδ_target_le_δ'
  · intro s
    dsimp [z]
    rw [hU_alpha s (t - s), hU_init (t - s), hw_alpha κ hκ_ge1 (t - s), hw0]

      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (4 * κ)).mono' h_cont_F_R.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with w
      have h_nn : 0 ≤ 4 * κ / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nn, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h_pi : 1 ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
      have h_w2 : w ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2 := by
        calc w ^ 2 = 1 * w ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pi (sq_nonneg w)
        _ = (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_inv : (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + w ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv (by positivity)
    have hF_int : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier f) volume := by
      rw [funext h_fourier]
      exact hF_R_int.ofReal
    have h_inv := congr_fun (Continuous.fourierInv_fourier_eq hf_cont hf_int hF_int) u
    have h_re_eq : RCLike.re (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (FourierTransform.fourier f) u) = RCLike.re (f u) :=
      congr_arg RCLike.re h_inv
    rw [Real.fourierInv_eq'] at h_re_eq
    have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) := by
        rw [funext h_fourier]
        exact Continuous.smul (by fun_prop) (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_cont_F_R)
      refine hF_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with w
      rw [h_fourier w, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul,
          Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    rw [← integral_re h_inv_int] at h_re_eq
    have h_re_lhs :
        (fun w : ℝ => RCLike.re (Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w)) =
        (fun w : ℝ => (4 * κ) * (Real.cos ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2))) := by
      ext w
      have h_inner : 2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u = (2 * Real.pi * w) * u := by
        change 2 * Real.pi * (u * w) = (2 * Real.pi * w) * u
        ring
      rw [h_fourier w, smul_eq_mul, h_inner, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
      set c : ℝ := Real.cos ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u)
      set s : ℝ := Real.sin ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u)
      set d : ℝ := 4 * κ / (4 * κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)
      have h_prod : ((c : ℂ) + (s : ℂ) * I) * (d : ℂ) = ((c * d : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((s * d : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_prod]
      simp only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero]
      dsimp [c, d]
      ring
    have h_re_rhs : RCLike.re (f u) = Real.exp (-2 * κ * |u|) := by
      dsimp [f, f_R]
    rw [h_re_lhs, h_re_rhs, integral_const_mul] at h_re_eq
    let h_func : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    have h_cov := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left h_func (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h_2pi_pos), smul_eq_mul] at h_cov
    change (4 * κ) * ∫ w : ℝ, h_func (2 * Real.pi * w) = Real.exp (-2 * κ * |u|) at h_re_eq
    rw [h_cov] at h_re_eq
    have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    have h_κ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
    set I_val : ℝ := ∫ ξ : ℝ, h_func ξ
    calc I_val
      _ = (Real.pi / (2 * κ)) * ((4 * κ) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_val)) := by
          field_simp
          ring
      _ = (Real.pi / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |u|) := by rw [h_re_eq]
  have s4 : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ u : ℝ,
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * u) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (Real.pi / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |u|)) →
      (1 / (8 * κ)) * (∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) * w y * w z) =
        (1 / 2) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ w h_cos
    have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
    have hw_cont : Continuous (w : ℝ → ℝ) := w.continuous
    have hw_int : Integrable (w : ℝ → ℝ) volume := w.integrable
    have h_cos_w_int : ∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) volume := by
      intro ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) := by fun_prop
      refine hw_int.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      calc |Real.cos (ξ * y)| * |w y| ≤ 1 * |w y| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |w y| := one_mul _
    have h_sin_w_int : ∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) volume := by
      intro ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) := by fun_prop
      refine hw_int.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      calc |Real.sin (ξ * y)| * |w y| ≤ 1 * |w y| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.abs_sin_le_one _) (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |w y| := one_mul _
    have h_fl_sq : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (w y * w z) := by
      intro ξ
      let c_val : ℝ := ∫ y : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y
      let s_val : ℝ := ∫ y : ℝ, Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y
      have h_int_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) =
          (c_val : ℂ) - I * (s_val : ℂ) := by
        have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) =
            (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.cos (ξ * x) * w x : ℝ) : ℂ) - I * ((Real.sin (ξ * x) * w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
          ext x
          have h_arg : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = (↑(-(ξ * x)) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
          rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin,
              Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
          push_cast
          ring
        have h1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.cos (ξ * x) * w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume :=
          (h_cos_w_int ξ).ofReal
        have h2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => I * ((Real.sin (ξ * x) * w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume :=
          (h_sin_w_int ξ).ofReal.const_mul I
        have hc1 : (∫ x : ℝ, ((Real.cos (ξ * x) * w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) = (c_val : ℂ) :=
          Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm (h_cos_w_int ξ)
        have hc2 : (∫ x : ℝ, ((Real.sin (ξ * x) * w x : ℝ) : ℂ)) = (s_val : ℂ) :=
          Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm (h_sin_w_int ξ)
        rw [h_fn, integral_sub h1 h2, integral_const_mul, hc1, hc2]
      have h_norm_c : ‖(c_val : ℂ) - I * (s_val : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 = c_val ^ 2 + s_val ^ 2 := by
        rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply]
        simp [Complex.sub_re, Complex.sub_im, Complex.mul_re, Complex.mul_im,
              Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im]
        ring
      have h_norm_fl : ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * (c_val ^ 2 + s_val ^ 2) := by
        dsimp [fourierLine]
        rw [h_int_eq, norm_mul, mul_pow, h_norm_c, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real,
            Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _), inv_pow,
            Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity : 0 ≤ 2 * Real.pi)]
      have h_sum_sq : c_val ^ 2 + s_val ^ 2 =
          ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) * (w y * w z) := by
        have hc : c_val ^ 2 = ∫ y : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * c_val := by
          dsimp [c_val]; rw [sq, ← integral_mul_const]
        have hs : s_val ^ 2 = ∫ y : ℝ, (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * s_val := by
          dsimp [s_val]; rw [sq, ← integral_mul_const]
        rw [hc, hs, ← integral_add ((h_cos_w_int ξ).mul_const c_val) ((h_sin_w_int ξ).mul_const s_val)]
        congr 1 with y
        have hc_in : (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * c_val = ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * (Real.cos (ξ * z) * w z) := by
          dsimp [c_val]; rw [← integral_const_mul]
        have hs_in : (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * s_val = ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * (Real.sin (ξ * z) * w z) := by
          dsimp [s_val]; rw [← integral_const_mul]
        rw [hc_in, hs_in, ← integral_add ((h_cos_w_int ξ).const_mul _) ((h_sin_w_int ξ).const_mul _)]
        congr 1 with z
        have h_sub : ξ * (y - z) = ξ * y - ξ * z := by ring
        rw [h_sub, Real.cos_sub]
        ring
      rw [h_norm_fl, h_sum_sq, mul_div_assoc, div_eq_inv_mul, ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1
      congr 1 with y
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1 with z
      ring
    let H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ y z => (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (w y * w z)
    have h_H_bound : ∀ ξ y z : ℝ, ‖H ξ y z‖ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (‖w y‖ * ‖w z‖) := by
      intro ξ y z
      dsimp [H]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)]
      have h1 : |Real.cos (ξ * (y - z))| / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        calc |Real.cos (ξ * (y - z))| / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
          _ ≤ 1 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by gcongr; exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
          _ = (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := one_div _
          _ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
    have h_int_ξz : ∀ y : ℝ, Integrable (Function.uncurry (fun ξ z => H ξ y z)) (volume.prod volume) := by
      intro y
      have h_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry (fun ξ z => H ξ y z)) := by
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, H]
        exact Continuous.mul (Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun p => by positivity)) (by fun_prop)
      have h_dom : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (‖w y‖ * ‖w p.2‖)) (volume.prod volume) :=
        integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mul_prod (hw_int.norm.const_mul ‖w y‖)
      refine h_dom.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with p
      exact h_H_bound p.1 y p.2
    have h_int_z_for : ∀ ξ y : ℝ, Integrable (fun z : ℝ => H ξ y z) volume := by
      intro ξ y
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => H ξ y z) := by
        dsimp [H]
        exact Continuous.mul (Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun _ => by positivity)) (by fun_prop)
      refine ((hw_int.norm.const_mul ‖w y‖).const_mul (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with z
      exact h_H_bound ξ y z
    have h_int_ξy : Integrable (Function.uncurry (fun ξ y => ∫ z : ℝ, H ξ y z)) (volume.prod volume) := by
      have h_cont3 : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ => H p.1.1 p.1.2 p.2) := by
        dsimp [H]
        exact Continuous.mul (Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun p => by positivity)) (by fun_prop)
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry (fun ξ y => ∫ z : ℝ, H ξ y z)) (volume.prod volume) :=
        h_cont3.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      let C_w : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, ‖w z‖
      have h_dom : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (‖w p.2‖ * C_w)) (volume.prod volume) :=
        integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mul_prod (hw_int.norm.mul_const C_w)
      refine h_dom.mono' h_meas ?_
      filter_upwards with p
      dsimp [Function.uncurry, C_w]
      calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, H p.1 p.2 z‖
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖H p.1 p.2 z‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (‖w p.2‖ * ‖w z‖) := by
            refine integral_mono (h_int_z_for p.1 p.2).norm
              ((hw_int.norm.const_mul ‖w p.2‖).const_mul (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) ?_
            intro z
            exact h_H_bound p.1 p.2 z
        _ = (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * (‖w p.2‖ * ∫ z : ℝ, ‖w z‖) := by
            rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
    have h_rhs_eq :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H ξ y z := by
      have h1 : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, H ξ y z) := by
        ext ξ
        exact h_fl_sq ξ
      rw [h1, integral_const_mul, integral_integral_swap h_int_ξy]
      congr 1
      congr 1 with y
      exact integral_integral_swap (h_int_ξz y)
    rw [h_rhs_eq]
    have h_inner_eval : ∀ y z : ℝ,
        ∫ ξ : ℝ, H ξ y z = (Real.pi / (2 * κ)) * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) * w y * w z) := by
      intro y z
      dsimp [H]
      rw [integral_mul_const, (h_cos (y - z)).2]
      ring
    have h_double_eq :
        (∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H ξ y z) =
        (Real.pi / (2 * κ)) * ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) * w y * w z := by
      have h1 : (fun y : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H ξ y z) =
          (fun y : ℝ => (Real.pi / (2 * κ)) * ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) * w y * w z) := by
        ext y
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1 with z
        exact h_inner_eval y z
      rw [h1, integral_const_mul]
    rw [h_double_eq]
    have : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    have : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
    set J : ℝ := ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |y - z|) * w y * w z
    field_simp
    ring
  have s5 : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro κ hκ w
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ = ‖w x‖ := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have h_mem : MemLp (hm1Profile w) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (w p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := w.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine w) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile w) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
        (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
      calc
        (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
    have h_toHm1 : toHm1 w = h_mem.toLp (hm1Profile w) := by
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos h_mem]
    dsimp [hm1KappaSq, ι]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [h_mem.coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
    rw [h_toHm1, hξ]
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq]
    have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  intro κ hκ w
  have h1 := s2 κ hκ w (s1 κ hκ)
  have h2 := s4 κ hκ w (s3 κ hκ)
  have h3 := s5 κ hκ w
  rw [h1, h2, h3]

informal_problem.statement:

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (δ_lip : ℝ),
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_lip →
        Integrable (recipGreenDiff w) ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (recipGreenDiff w) ξ‖ ^ 2)) →
      (∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_lip → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ_lip →
        h1NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x) ≤ 9 * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2) →
      ∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_lip → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ_lip →
        h1HighFreqSq M (fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x) ≤
          36 * (hm1KappaSq M (ι w₁) + hm1KappaSq M (ι w₂))

signature.name: recipGreenDiff_highFreq_from_lipschitz
signature.statement:
∀ (δ_lip : ℝ),
      (∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_lip →
        Integrable (recipGreenDiff w) ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (recipGreenDiff w) ξ‖ ^ 2)) →
      (∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_lip → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ_lip →
        h1NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x) ≤ 9 * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2) →
      ∀ M : ℝ, 1 ≤ M → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_lip → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ_lip →
        h1HighFreqSq M (fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x) ≤
          36 * (hm1KappaSq M (ι w₁) + hm1KappaSq M (ι w₂))

proof.tactics:
by
  have s1 : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (h : ℝ), ∃ w_h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      (∀ x : ℝ, w_h x = w (x + h)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, recipGreenDiff w_h x = recipGreenDiff w (x + h)) := by
    intro w h
    have h_temp : Function.HasTemperateGrowth (fun x : ℝ => x + h) :=
      Function.HasTemperateGrowth.id.add (Function.HasTemperateGrowth.const h)
    have h_anti : AntilipschitzWith 1 (fun x : ℝ => x + h) :=
      (isometry_add_right h).antilipschitz
    let w_h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.compCLMOfAntilipschitz ℝ h_temp h_anti w
    have hw_h : ∀ x : ℝ, w_h x = w (x + h) := fun x => rfl
    refine ⟨w_h, hw_h, ?_⟩
    have h_free : ∀ x y : ℝ, freeGreenKernel 1 x y = freeGreenKernel 1 (x + h) (y + h) := by
      intro x y
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
      rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
    have h_iter : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
        greenIterKernel 1 w_h ℓ x y = greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ (x + h) (y + h) := by
      intro ℓ
      induction ℓ with
      | zero =>
        intro x y
        exact h_free x y
      | succ ℓ ih =>
        intro x y
        dsimp [greenIterKernel]
        congr 1
        have h_integrand : (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w_h ℓ x z * w_h z * freeGreenKernel 1 z y) =
            (fun z : ℝ => (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ (x + h) u * w u * freeGreenKernel 1 u (y + h)) (z + h)) := by
          ext z
          dsimp
          rw [ih x z, hw_h z, h_free z y]
        rw [h_integrand]
        exact MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
          (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ (x + h) u * w u * freeGreenKernel 1 u (y + h)) h
    intro x
    have h_gk : greenKernel 1 w_h x x = greenKernel 1 w (x + h) (x + h) :=
      tsum_congr (fun ℓ => h_iter ℓ x x)
    dsimp [recipGreenDiff, diagGreen]
    rw [h_gk]
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)‖ = ‖g x‖ := by
    intro g ξ x
    have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable g volume → ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) volume := by
    intro g hg ξ
    have h_cont_exp : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by fun_prop
    have h_meas_g : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => (g x : ℂ)) volume :=
      Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hg.aestronglyMeasurable
    refine hg.norm.mono' (h_cont_exp.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_g) ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
  have fourierLine_sub : ∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable F₁ volume → Integrable F₂ volume → ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
      fourierLine (fun x => F₁ x - F₂ x) ξ = fourierLine F₁ ξ - fourierLine F₂ ξ := by
    intro F₁ F₂ hF₁ hF₂ ξ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((F₁ x - F₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F₁ x : ℂ) -
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F₂ x : ℂ)) := by
      ext x
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand F₁ hF₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand F₂ hF₂ ξ), mul_sub]
  have fourierLine_shift : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (h ξ : ℝ),
      fourierLine (fun x => F (x + h)) ξ = Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) * fourierLine F ξ := by
    intro F h ξ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F (x + h) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) *
          ((fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (F u : ℂ)) (x + h))) := by
      ext x
      dsimp
      rw [← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_const_mul,
        MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self (fun u : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (u : ℂ)) * I) * (F u : ℂ)) h]
    ring
  have fourierLine_shift_sub : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable F volume → ∀ (h ξ : ℝ),
      fourierLine (fun x => F (x + h) - F x) ξ =
        (Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1) * fourierLine F ξ := by
    intro F hF h ξ
    rw [fourierLine_sub (fun x => F (x + h)) F (hF.comp_add_right h) hF ξ, fourierLine_shift F h ξ]
    ring
  have s2 :
      (∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable F volume → ∀ (h : ℝ),
        h1NormSq (fun x => F (x + h) - F x) =
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F ξ‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume ∧
        (∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → hm1KappaSq M (ι w) = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
        (∀ (w_h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (h : ℝ), (∀ x : ℝ, w_h x = w (x + h)) →
          ‖ι w_h‖ = ‖ι w‖ ∧
          ‖ι w_h - ι w‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)))) := by
    have h_mem_and_int : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      intro q
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      have h_sq_eq : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
        intro ξ
        have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
          rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), div_eq_inv_mul]
      have h_int_sq : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
        let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
        refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono' (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
        filter_upwards with ξ
        have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
          dsimp [fourierLine, C]
          rw [norm_mul]
          gcongr
          calc
            ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
              ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
                norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
            _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
                congr 1 with x
                exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq_eq ξ, div_eq_inv_mul]
        have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
          linarith
        have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
        calc
          (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
      have h_mem : MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
        (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas).mpr h_int_sq
      have h_int_div : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
        have h_fn_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) = (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
          ext ξ
          exact (h_sq_eq ξ).symm
        rwa [h_fn_eq]
      exact ⟨h_mem, h_int_div⟩
    have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
      fun q => (h_mem_and_int q).1
    have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
      intro q
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
    have h_iota_sub : ∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ι (q₁ - q₂) = ι q₁ - ι q₂ := by
      intro q₁ q₂
      ext1
      change toHm1 (q₁ - q₂) = toHm1 q₁ - toHm1 q₂
      rw [h_toHm1 (q₁ - q₂), h_toHm1 q₁, h_toHm1 q₂, ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem q₁) (h_mem q₂)]
      apply MemLp.toLp_congr
      filter_upwards with ξ
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      have h_sub_fn : (⇑(q₁ - q₂) : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x => q₁ x - q₂ x := rfl
      rw [h_sub_fn, fourierLine_sub q₁ q₂ q₁.integrable q₂.integrable ξ, mul_sub]
    have h_kappa_eq : ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        hm1KappaSq κ (ι q) = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      intro κ hκ q
      dsimp [hm1KappaSq, ι]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(h_mem q).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
      rw [h_toHm1 q, hξ]
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [h_sq]
      have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    have h_norm_sq : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ‖ι q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      intro q
      have h1 : ‖ι q‖ ^ 2 = hm1KappaSq 1 (ι q) := by
        rw [← Submodule.norm_coe, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
        unfold hm1KappaSq
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards with ξ
        have h_one : (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) = 1 := by
          have : 4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 = 4 + ξ ^ 2 := by ring
          rw [this, div_self (by positivity)]
        rw [h_one, one_mul, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      rw [h1, h_kappa_eq 1 le_rfl q]
      congr 1 with ξ
      ring
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro F hF h
      dsimp [h1NormSq]
      congr 1 with ξ
      rw [fourierLine_shift_sub F hF h ξ, norm_mul, mul_pow]
      ring
    · intro w
      refine ⟨(h_mem_and_int w).2, fun M hM => h_kappa_eq M hM w, ?_⟩
      intro w_h h hw_h
      have hw_h_fn : (w_h : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x => w (x + h) := by
        ext x
        exact hw_h x
      have h_norm_eq_sq : ‖ι w_h‖ ^ 2 = ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_norm_sq w_h, h_norm_sq w]
        congr 1 with ξ
        rw [hw_h_fn, fourierLine_shift w h ξ, norm_mul]
        have h_exp : (ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
        rw [h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
      have h_norm_eq : ‖ι w_h‖ = ‖ι w‖ := by
        have h_sqrt := congrArg Real.sqrt h_norm_eq_sq
        rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt
      refine ⟨h_norm_eq, ?_⟩
      rw [← h_iota_sub w_h w, h_norm_sq (w_h - w)]
      congr 1 with ξ
      have h_diff_fn : (⇑(w_h - w) : ℝ → ℝ) = fun x => w (x + h) - w x := by
        ext x
        change w_h x - w x = w (x + h) - w x
        rw [hw_h x]
      rw [h_diff_fn, fourierLine_shift_sub w w.integrable h ξ, norm_mul, mul_pow]
      ring
  have s3 : ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ξ) →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ξ) →
      Integrable A volume →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume →
      (∀ h : ℝ,
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * A ξ) ≤
          9 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2)))) →
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * A ξ) ≤
        18 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro M hM A B hA_nn hB_nn hA_int hB_int h_shift
    have hM_pos : 0 < M := by linarith
    have h_norm_sq : ∀ (ξ h : ℝ), ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 = 2 * (1 - Real.cos (ξ * h)) := by
      intro ξ h
      have h_exp : (ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I = Complex.I * ((ξ * h : ℝ) : ℂ) := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_I_mul_ofReal_sub_one (ξ * h), Real.norm_eq_abs, sq_abs]
      have h_cos : Real.cos (ξ * h) = 2 * Real.cos (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2 - 1 := by
        have h2 : ξ * h = 2 * (ξ * h / 2) := by ring
        conv_lhs => rw [h2]
        exact Real.cos_two_mul (ξ * h / 2)
      have h_sin_sq := Real.sin_sq (ξ * h / 2)
      linarith [ (by ring : (2 * Real.sin (ξ * h / 2)) ^ 2 = 4 * Real.sin (ξ * h / 2) ^ 2) ]
    have h_norm_sq_le_four : ∀ (ξ h : ℝ), ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 ≤ 4 := by
      intro ξ h
      rw [h_norm_sq ξ h]
      have h_cos_ge : -1 ≤ Real.cos (ξ * h) := Real.neg_one_le_cos (ξ * h)
      linarith
    have h_laplace : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        ∫ h in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 =
          (2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      intro ξ
      have h_denom : 0 < 4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h_denom_ne : 4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_denom
      let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun h =>
        Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * (-2 + (4 * M * (2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h))) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
      let g' : ℝ → ℝ := fun h =>
        (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2
      have hg_deriv : ∀ h : ℝ, HasDerivAt g (g' h) h := by
        intro h
        have hd_lin1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -2 * M * x) (-2 * M) h := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id h).const_mul (-2 * M)
        have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * M * x)) (Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * (-2 * M)) h :=
          (Real.hasDerivAt_exp (-2 * M * h)).comp h hd_lin1
        have hd_lin2 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => ξ * x) ξ h := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id h).const_mul ξ
        have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * x)) (-Real.sin (ξ * h) * ξ) h :=
          (Real.hasDerivAt_cos (ξ * h)).comp h hd_lin2
        have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (ξ * x)) (Real.cos (ξ * h) * ξ) h :=
          (Real.hasDerivAt_sin (ξ * h)).comp h hd_lin2
        have hd_inner : HasDerivAt
            (fun x : ℝ => -2 + (4 * M * (2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * x) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * x))) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
            (0 + (4 * M * (2 * M * (-Real.sin (ξ * h) * ξ) - ξ * (Real.cos (ξ * h) * ξ))) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) h := by
          refine (hasDerivAt_const h (-2 : ℝ)).add ?_
          exact (((hd_cos.const_mul (2 * M)).sub (hd_sin.const_mul ξ)).const_mul (4 * M)).div_const (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
        have hd_prod := hd_exp.mul hd_inner
        convert hd_prod using 1
        dsimp [g']
        rw [h_norm_sq ξ h]
        field_simp
        ring
      have hg_cont : ContinuousWithinAt g (Set.Ici 0) 0 :=
        (hg_deriv 0).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have hg'_nonneg : ∀ h ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), 0 ≤ g' h := by
        intro h _
        dsimp [g']
        positivity
      have hg_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto g Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
        let C : ℝ := 2 + (4 * M * (2 * M + |ξ|)) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
        have h_exp_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * C) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by

            Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (by linarith) Filter.tendsto_id

        refine squeeze_zero (fun h => norm_nonneg _) (fun h => ?_) h_exp_tendsto
        dsimp [g, C]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        gcongr
        have h_tri1 : |-2 + (4 * M * (2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h))) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)| ≤
            |-2| + |(4 * M * (2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h))) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
        have h_abs2 : |(-2 : ℝ)| = 2 := by norm_num
        rw [h_abs2, abs_div, abs_of_pos h_denom, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 4 * M)] at h_tri1
        have h_tri2 : |2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h)| ≤ 2 * M + |ξ| := by
          calc |2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h)|
            _ ≤ |2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h)| + |ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h)| := abs_sub _ _
            _ = 2 * M * |Real.cos (ξ * h)| + |ξ| * |Real.sin (ξ * h)| := by
                rw [abs_mul (2 * M), abs_mul ξ, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * M)]

                gcongr
                · exact Real.abs_cos_le_one (ξ * h)
                · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one (ξ * h)

        have h_div_le : 4 * M * |2 * M * Real.cos (ξ * h) - ξ * Real.sin (ξ * h)| / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤
            4 * M * (2 * M + |ξ|) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by gcongr
        linarith
      have h_int := MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_nonneg hg_cont (fun h _ => hg_deriv h) hg'_nonneg hg_tendsto
      rw [h_int]
      dsimp [g]
      simp only [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
      field_simp
      ring
    let μ : Measure ℝ := volume.restrict (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ))
    have h_fM_int : Integrable (fun h : ℝ => 8 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) μ := by
      let g0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun h => -4 * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)

        intro h
        have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -2 * M * x) (-2 * M) h := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id h).const_mul (-2 * M)
        have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * M * x)) (Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * (-2 * M)) h :=
