        convert hd_exp.const_mul (-4) using 1
        ring
      have hg0_cont : ContinuousWithinAt g0 (Set.Ici 0) 0 :=
        (hg0_deriv 0).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have hg0_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto g0 Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => (-2 * M) * h) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop_of_neg (by linarith) Filter.tendsto_id
        have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun h : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
          Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp h1
        simpa [g0] using h2.const_mul (-4)
      exact MeasureTheory.integrableOn_Ioi_deriv_of_nonneg hg0_cont (fun h _ => hg0_deriv h)
        (fun h _ => by positivity) hg0_tendsto
    have h_fubini : ∀ (D : ℝ → ℝ), (∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ξ) → Integrable D volume →
        Integrable (fun h : ℝ => (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * D ξ) μ ∧
        (∫ h : ℝ, (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * D ξ) ∂μ) =
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * D ξ := by
      intro D hD_nn hD_int
      let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun h ξ =>
        (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * (‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * D ξ)
      have h_dom_int : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (8 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * p.1)) * D p.2) (μ.prod volume) :=
        h_fM_int.mul_prod hD_int
      have hK_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry K) (μ.prod volume) := by
        have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
            (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * p.1)) * ‖Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2) := by
          fun_prop
        have h_D_snd : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => D p.2) (μ.prod volume) :=
          hD_int.aestronglyMeasurable.comp_snd
        have h_eq : Function.uncurry K = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
            ((2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * p.1)) * ‖Complex.exp ((p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2) * D p.2 := by
          ext ⟨h, ξ⟩
          dsimp [Function.uncurry, K]
          ring
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_D_snd
      have hK_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry K) (μ.prod volume) := by
        refine h_dom_int.mono' hK_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ⟨h, ξ⟩ => ?_)
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, K]
        have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * (‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * D ξ) := by
          have := hD_nn ξ
          positivity
        rw [abs_of_nonneg h_nonneg]
        calc 2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * (‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * D ξ)
          _ ≤ 2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * (4 * D ξ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_norm_sq_le_four ξ h) (hD_nn ξ)) (by positivity)
          _ = 8 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h) * D ξ := by ring
      have h_lhs_eq : (fun h : ℝ => (2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * D ξ) =
          (fun h : ℝ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, K h ξ) := by
        ext h
        dsimp [K]
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
      refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
      · rw [h_lhs_eq]
        exact hK_int.integral_prod_left
      · rw [h_lhs_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_integral_swap hK_int]
        congr 1 with ξ
        have h_inner_eq : (fun h : ℝ => K h ξ) =
            (fun h : ℝ => ((2 * M * Real.exp (-2 * M * h)) * ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2) * D ξ) := by
          ext h
          dsimp [K]
          ring
        rw [h_inner_eq, integral_mul_const, h_laplace ξ]
    let D₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => 9 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2))
    have hD₂_nn : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ D₂ ξ := fun ξ => by
      dsimp [D₂]
      have := hB_nn ξ
      positivity
    have hD₂_int : Integrable D₂ volume := hB_int.const_mul 9
    obtain ⟨h_int_A_μ, h_eq_A⟩ := h_fubini A hA_nn hA_int
    obtain ⟨h_int_D₂_μ, h_eq_D₂⟩ := h_fubini D₂ hD₂_nn hD₂_int
    have h_avg_le :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * A ξ) ≤
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * D₂ ξ := by
      rw [← h_eq_A, ← h_eq_D₂]
      refine integral_mono h_int_A_μ h_int_D₂_μ (fun h => ?_)
      dsimp [D₂]
      have h_pull : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (9 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2)))) =
          9 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
        have : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (9 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2)))) =
            (fun ξ : ℝ => 9 * (‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2)))) := by
          ext ξ; ring
        rw [this, integral_const_mul]
      rw [h_pull]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_shift h) (by positivity)
    have h_BM_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
        ext ξ
        have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
      rw [h_eq]
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)).div
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine Integrable.bdd_mul (c := 1) hB_int h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_le_one (by positivity)]
      nlinarith
    have h_rhs_le :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * D₂ ξ) ≤
          18 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_) (h_BM_int.const_mul 18) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      · have := hD₂_nn ξ
        positivity
      · dsimp [D₂]
        have h_B := hB_nn ξ
        have h_2xi : 2 * ξ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by linarith
        have h_div_le : (2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 2 := by
          rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
          linarith
        have h_factor : ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (9 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2))) =
            ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * (9 * (B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
          ring
        rw [h_factor]
        have h_rhs_eq : 18 * (B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) = 2 * (9 * (B ξ / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by ring
        rw [h_rhs_eq]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div_le (by positivity)
    exact le_trans h_avg_le h_rhs_le
  have s4 : ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → ∀ (F₁ F₂ : ℝ → ℝ),
      Integrable F₁ volume →
      Integrable F₂ volume →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ ^ 2) volume →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2) volume →
      h1HighFreqSq M (fun x => F₁ x - F₂ x) ≤
        2 * h1HighFreqSq M F₁ + 2 * h1HighFreqSq M F₂ := by
    intro M hM F₁ F₂ hF₁ hF₂ hF₁_h1 hF₂_h1
    have h_hf_int : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F ξ‖ ^ 2) volume →
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F ξ‖ ^ 2)) volume := by
      intro F hF_int
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
        (continuous_const.mul (continuous_id.pow 2)).div
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine Integrable.bdd_mul (c := 2) hF_int h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity), div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg M, sq_nonneg ξ]
    have h_int₁ := (h_hf_int F₁ hF₁_h1).const_mul 2
    have h_int₂ := (h_hf_int F₂ hF₂_h1).const_mul 2
    dsimp [h1HighFreqSq]
    rw [← integral_const_mul, ← integral_const_mul, ← integral_add h_int₁ h_int₂]
    refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => by positivity) (h_int₁.add h_int₂) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    dsimp
    rw [fourierLine_sub F₁ F₂ hF₁ hF₂ ξ]
    have h_tri : ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ - fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ≤ ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ :=
      norm_sub_le _ _
    have h_sq_tri : ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ - fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_tri 2
    have h_quad : (‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ - ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖)]
    have h_norm_sq_le : ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ - fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 :=
      le_trans h_sq_tri h_quad
    have h_weight_nn : 0 ≤ ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by positivity
    have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_norm_sq_le h_weight_nn
    linarith [ (by ring : ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ - fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 =
        ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ - fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2)),
      (by ring : ((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (4 + ξ ^ 2) * (2 * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2) =
        2 * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F₁ ξ‖ ^ 2)) +
        2 * (((2 * ξ ^ 2) / (4 * M ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine F₂ ξ‖ ^ 2))) ]
  intro δ_lip h_int_single h_lip M hM w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
  have h_single : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_lip →
      h1HighFreqSq M (recipGreenDiff w) ≤ 18 * hm1KappaSq M (ι w) := by
    intro w hw
    obtain ⟨hF_int, hF_h1_int⟩ := h_int_single w hw
    obtain ⟨hB_int, h_kappa_eq, h_shift_hm1⟩ := s2.2 w
    let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (recipGreenDiff w) ξ‖ ^ 2
    let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2
    have hA_nn : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ A ξ := fun ξ => by dsimp [A]; positivity
    have hB_nn : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ξ := fun ξ => by dsimp [B]; positivity
    have h_shift : ∀ h : ℝ,
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * A ξ) ≤
          9 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp ((ξ : ℂ) * (h : ℂ) * I) - 1‖ ^ 2 * (B ξ / (4 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
      intro h
      obtain ⟨w_h, hw_h_eval, hw_h_recip⟩ := s1 w h
      obtain ⟨hw_h_norm, hw_h_diff⟩ := h_shift_hm1 w_h h hw_h_eval
      have hw_h_le : ‖ι w_h‖ ≤ δ_lip := by
        rw [hw_h_norm]
        exact hw
      have h_lip_h := h_lip w_h w hw_h_le hw
      have h_lhs_fn : (fun x : ℝ => recipGreenDiff w_h x - recipGreenDiff w x) =
          (fun x : ℝ => recipGreenDiff w (x + h) - recipGreenDiff w x) := by
        ext x
        rw [hw_h_recip x]
      rw [h_lhs_fn, s2.1 (recipGreenDiff w) hF_int h, hw_h_diff] at h_lip_h
      exact h_lip_h
    have h_bound := s3 M hM A B hA_nn hB_nn hF_h1_int hB_int h_shift
    rw [← h_kappa_eq M hM] at h_bound
    exact h_bound
  have h_w₁ := h_single w₁ hw₁
  have h_w₂ := h_single w₂ hw₂
  have h_sub := s4 M hM (recipGreenDiff w₁) (recipGreenDiff w₂)
    (h_int_single w₁ hw₁).1 (h_int_single w₂ hw₂).1
    (h_int_single w₁ hw₁).2 (h_int_single w₂ hw₂).2
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  have schwartz_hasDerivAt_quad_seminorm_and_hm1_tendsto :
      ∀ (w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (s : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt w v s →
        (∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ),
          |f y| ≤ (2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) f)) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖ι (w τ)‖) (nhds s) (nhds ‖ι (w s)‖) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, |w τ y - w s y - (τ - s) * v y|) (nhds s) (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w τ - w s))) ^ 2) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    intro w v s h_deriv
    let p : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0
    have hp_decay : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), |f y| ≤ (2 * p f) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      intro f y
      set D : ℝ := |f y|
      have hD_nn : 0 ≤ D := abs_nonneg _
      have h0 := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 0 f y
      rw [pow_zero, one_mul, iteratedDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h0
      have h4 := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 4 0 f y
      have hy4 : |y| ^ 4 = y ^ 4 := by
        calc |y| ^ 4 = (|y| ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
          _ = y ^ 4 := by ring
      rw [hy4, iteratedDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h4
      have h_poly : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 4) := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - y ^ 2)]
      have h_mul : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D ≤ 2 * p f := by

    schwartz_hasDerivAt_quad_seminorm_and_hm1_tendsto w v s h_deriv
  let P₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → ℝ :=
    fun f => 2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) f)
  have hP₀_nn : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), 0 ≤ P₀ f :=
    fun f => mul_nonneg zero_le_two (apply_nonneg _ f)
  set B₂ : ℝ := P₀ (w s)
  have hB₂_nn : 0 ≤ B₂ := hP₀_nn (w s)
  set K_Q : ℝ := 160 * π ^ 3 * M ^ 3 * (1 + π * B₂)
  set D : ℝ := ∫ x : ℝ, (1 / (2 * M) - diagGreen M (w s) x) * v x
  have hD_eq : D = ∫ x : ℝ, (1 / (2 * M) - diagGreen M (w s) x) * regFlowRHS κ (w s) x := by
    dsimp [D]
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    dsimp only
    rw [hv_eq x]
  rw [← hD_eq, hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
  have hs_lt_quarter : ‖ι (w s)‖ < 1 / 4 := by linarith
  have hV_ball : ∀ᶠ τ in nhds s, ‖ι (w τ)‖ < 1 / 4 :=
    h_norm_tendsto.eventually (Iio_mem_nhds hs_lt_quarter)
  let U : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ =>
    (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, |w τ y - w s y - (τ - s) * v y|) +
      K_Q * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P₀ (w τ - w s)) ^ 2)
  have hU_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto U (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    have h_q : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => K_Q * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P₀ (w τ - w s)) ^ 2)) (nhds s) (nhds (K_Q * 0)) :=
      h_quad_tendsto.const_mul K_Q
    have h_sum := h_lin_tendsto.add h_q
    simpa [U] using h_sum
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hU_tendsto
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => by positivity) ?_
  filter_upwards [hV_ball] with τ hτ
  have hτ_quarter : ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := le_of_lt hτ
  have h_lin_bound :=
    alphaFunctional_sub_and_linearization_bound M hM h_bound h_tele (w τ) (w s) v
      hτ_quarter hs_quarter B₂ (P₀ (w τ - w s)) hB₂_nn (hP₀_nn (w τ - w s))
      (hP_decay (w s)) (hP_decay (w τ - w s)) (h_fub_Δ τ) (τ - s)
  have h_norm_eq : ‖alphaFunctional M (w τ) - alphaFunctional M (w s) - (τ - s) • D‖ =
      |alphaFunctional M (w τ) - alphaFunctional M (w s) - (τ - s) * D| := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul]
  rw [h_norm_eq]
  have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lin_bound (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg (τ - s)))
  calc ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * |alphaFunctional M (w τ) - alphaFunctional M (w s) - (τ - s) * D|
    _ ≤ ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ((∫ y : ℝ, |w τ y - w s y - (τ - s) * v y|) +
          160 * π ^ 3 * M ^ 3 * (1 + π * B₂) * (P₀ (w τ - w s)) ^ 2) := h_mul
    _ = U τ := by dsimp [U, K_Q]; ring

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ_reg, hδ_reg, h_reg⟩ := diagGreen_sub_const_mem_schwartz
  obtain ⟨δ_ode, hδ_ode, h_ode⟩ := diagGreen_third_order_ode
  refine ⟨min δ_reg δ_ode, lt_min hδ_reg hδ_ode, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ M hM w hw
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hw_reg : ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_reg := le_trans hw (min_le_left _ _)
  have hw_ode : ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_ode := le_trans hw (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨g_tilde_M, hgM_eq⟩ := h_reg M hM w hw_reg
  obtain ⟨g_tilde_κ, hgκ_eq⟩ := h_reg κ hκ1 w hw_reg
  have h_sub_M : (fun y => diagGreen M w y - 1 / (2 * M)) = (g_tilde_M : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    ext y
    rw [hgM_eq y]
    ring
  have h_sub_κ : (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) = (g_tilde_κ : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    ext y
    rw [hgκ_eq y]
    ring
  have hgM_ode : ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 g_tilde_M x =
      2 * deriv w x * (1 / (2 * M) + g_tilde_M x) +
      4 * w x * deriv g_tilde_M x +
      4 * M ^ 2 * deriv g_tilde_M x := by
    intro x
    have hx := h_ode M hM w hw_ode x
    rw [h_sub_M, hgM_eq x] at hx
    exact hx
  have hgκ_ode : ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 g_tilde_κ x =
      2 * deriv w x * (1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde_κ x) +
      4 * w x * deriv g_tilde_κ x +
      4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv g_tilde_κ x := by
    intro x
    have hx := h_ode κ hκ1 w hw_ode x
    rw [h_sub_κ, hgκ_eq x] at hx
    exact hx
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun f => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f
  have hD_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), D f x = deriv f x :=
    fun f x => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ f x
  have hD2_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), D (D f) x = iteratedDeriv 2 f x := by
    intro f x
    rw [hD_apply]
    have h : (D f : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv 1 f := by
      ext y
      rw [hD_apply, iteratedDeriv_one]
    rw [h, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have hD3_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), D (D (D f)) x = iteratedDeriv 3 f x := by
    intro f x
    rw [hD_apply]
    have h : (D (D f) : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv 2 f := funext (hD2_apply f)
    rw [h, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have h_hasDerivAt : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt f (D f x) x := by
    intro f x
    rw [hD_apply]
    exact (f.smooth'.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
  have h_mul_int : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Integrable (fun x => f x * g x) volume := by
    intro f g
    have hg : Integrable g volume := g.integrable
    have hf_cont : Continuous f := f.continuous
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := f.toBoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range.exists_norm_le
    exact hg.bdd_mul hf_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => hC (f x) ⟨x, rfl⟩)
  have h_deriv_κ : ∀ x : ℝ, deriv (diagGreen κ w) x = D g_tilde_κ x := by
    intro x
    have h_eq : diagGreen κ w = fun y => 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde_κ y := funext hgκ_eq
    rw [h_eq]
    exact ((h_hasDerivAt g_tilde_κ x).const_add (1 / (2 * κ))).deriv
  let w0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := w
  let w1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D w0
  let m0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := g_tilde_M
  let m1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D m0
  let m2 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D m1
  let m3 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D m2
  let k0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := g_tilde_κ
  let k1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k0
  let k2 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k1
  let k3 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k2
  have h_integrand : (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * M) - diagGreen M w x) * regFlowRHS κ w x) =
      (fun x : ℝ => -16 * κ ^ 5 * (m0 x * k1 x) - 4 * κ ^ 2 * (m0 x * w1 x)) := by
    ext x
    dsimp only [regFlowRHS, m0, k0, k1, w0, w1]
    rw [hgM_eq x, h_deriv_κ x, hD_apply w x]
    ring
  rw [h_integrand]
  have h_drift : ∫ x : ℝ, m0 x * w1 x = 0 := by
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      2 * (w0 x * m0 x) - (1 / 2) * m2 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * w0 x + 2 * M ^ 2 * m0 x
    have hΦ_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt Φ (m0 x * w1 x) x := by
      intro x
      have hw0 := h_hasDerivAt w0 x
      have hm0 := h_hasDerivAt m0 x
      have hm2 := h_hasDerivAt m2 x
      have hd : HasDerivAt Φ
          (2 * (w1 x * m0 x + w0 x * m1 x) - (1 / 2) * m3 x +
            (1 / (2 * M)) * w1 x + 2 * M ^ 2 * m1 x) x :=
        ((((hw0.mul hm0).const_mul 2).sub (hm2.const_mul (1 / 2))).add
          (hw0.const_mul (1 / (2 * M)))).add (hm0.const_mul (2 * M ^ 2))
      convert hd using 1
      dsimp only [w0, w1, m0, m1, m2, m3]
      rw [hD3_apply g_tilde_M x, hD_apply w x, hD_apply g_tilde_M x, hgM_ode x]
      have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := by linarith
      field_simp
      ring
    have hΦ_tendsto : ∀ l : Filter ℝ, l ≤ Filter.cocompact ℝ → Filter.Tendsto Φ l (nhds 0) := by
      intro l hl
      have hz : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds 0) := fun f =>
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty f).mono_left hl
      have h2 : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l (nhds 0) := fun f g => by
        simpa only [mul_zero] using (hz f).mul (hz g)
      simpa only [Φ, mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] using
        ((((h2 w0 m0).const_mul 2).sub ((hz m2).const_mul (1 / 2))).add
          ((hz w0).const_mul (1 / (2 * M)))).add ((hz m0).const_mul (2 * M ^ 2))
    have h_ftc := MeasureTheory.integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hΦ_deriv (h_mul_int m0 w1)
      (hΦ_tendsto Filter.atBot atBot_le_cocompact)
      (hΦ_tendsto Filter.atTop atTop_le_cocompact)
    linarith
  have h_bilin : ∫ x : ℝ, m0 x * k1 x = 0 := by
    by_cases hMκ : M = κ
    · have hm0_eq_k0 : ∀ x : ℝ, m0 x = k0 x := by
        intro x
        dsimp only [m0, k0]
        have h1 := hgM_eq x
        have h2 := hgκ_eq x
        subst hMκ
        linarith
      have h_eq_fn : (fun x : ℝ => m0 x * k1 x) = (fun x : ℝ => k0 x * k1 x) := by
        ext x
        rw [hm0_eq_k0 x]
      rw [h_eq_fn]
      let S : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (1 / 2) * (k0 x * k0 x)
      have hS_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt S (k0 x * k1 x) x := by
        intro x
        have hk0 := h_hasDerivAt k0 x
        have hd : HasDerivAt S ((1 / 2) * (k1 x * k0 x + k0 x * k1 x)) x :=
          (hk0.mul hk0).const_mul (1 / 2)
        convert hd using 1
        ring
      have hS_tendsto : ∀ l : Filter ℝ, l ≤ Filter.cocompact ℝ → Filter.Tendsto S l (nhds 0) := by
        intro l hl
        have hz : Filter.Tendsto k0 l (nhds 0) :=
          (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty k0).mono_left hl
        simpa only [S, mul_zero] using (hz.mul hz).const_mul (1 / 2)
      have h_ftc := MeasureTheory.integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hS_deriv (h_mul_int k0 k1)
        (hS_tendsto Filter.atBot atBot_le_cocompact)
        (hS_tendsto Filter.atTop atTop_le_cocompact)
      linarith
    · let Ω : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
        ((1 / (2 * κ)) * m2 x + m2 x * k0 x - m1 x * k1 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * k2 x + m0 x * k2 x) -
        ((1 / (M * κ)) * w0 x + (2 / M) * (w0 x * k0 x) + (2 / κ) * (w0 x * m0 x) +
          4 * (w0 x * m0 x * k0 x)) -
        ((2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m0 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k0 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m0 x * k0 x))
      have hΩ_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt Ω (4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) * (m0 x * k1 x)) x := by
        intro x
        have hw0 := h_hasDerivAt w0 x
        have hm0 := h_hasDerivAt m0 x
        have hm1 := h_hasDerivAt m1 x
        have hm2 := h_hasDerivAt m2 x
        have hk0 := h_hasDerivAt k0 x
        have hk1 := h_hasDerivAt k1 x
        have hk2 := h_hasDerivAt k2 x
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt
            (fun x => (1 / (2 * κ)) * m2 x + m2 x * k0 x - m1 x * k1 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * k2 x + m0 x * k2 x)
            ((1 / (2 * κ)) * m3 x + (m3 x * k0 x + m2 x * k1 x) - (m2 x * k1 x + m1 x * k2 x) +
              (1 / (2 * M)) * k3 x + (m1 x * k2 x + m0 x * k3 x)) x :=
          (((((hm2.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))).add (hm2.mul hk0)).sub (hm1.mul hk1)).add
            (hk2.const_mul (1 / (2 * M)))).add (hm0.mul hk2))
        have hd2 : HasDerivAt
            (fun x => (1 / (M * κ)) * w0 x + (2 / M) * (w0 x * k0 x) + (2 / κ) * (w0 x * m0 x) +
              4 * (w0 x * m0 x * k0 x))
            ((1 / (M * κ)) * w1 x + (2 / M) * (w1 x * k0 x + w0 x * k1 x) +
              (2 / κ) * (w1 x * m0 x + w0 x * m1 x) +
              4 * ((w1 x * m0 x + w0 x * m1 x) * k0 x + (w0 x * m0 x) * k1 x)) x :=
          ((((hw0.const_mul (1 / (M * κ))).add ((hw0.mul hk0).const_mul (2 / M))).add
            ((hw0.mul hm0).const_mul (2 / κ))).add (((hw0.mul hm0).mul hk0).const_mul 4))
        have hd3 : HasDerivAt
            (fun x => (2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m0 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k0 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m0 x * k0 x))
            ((2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m1 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k1 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m1 x * k0 x + m0 x * k1 x)) x :=
          (((hm0.const_mul (2 * M ^ 2 / κ)).add (hk0.const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2 / M))).add
            ((hm0.mul hk0).const_mul (4 * M ^ 2)))
        have hd : HasDerivAt Ω _ x := (hd1.sub hd2).sub hd3
        convert hd using 1
        dsimp only [w0, w1, m0, m1, m2, m3, k0, k1, k2, k3]
        rw [hD3_apply g_tilde_M x, hD3_apply g_tilde_κ x, hD_apply w x,
            hD_apply g_tilde_M x, hD_apply g_tilde_κ x, hgM_ode x, hgκ_ode x]
        have hM_ne : M ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := by linarith
        field_simp
        ring
      have hΩ_tendsto : ∀ l : Filter ℝ, l ≤ Filter.cocompact ℝ → Filter.Tendsto Ω l (nhds 0) := by
        intro l hl
        have hz : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto f l (nhds 0) := fun f =>
          (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty f).mono_left hl
        have h2 : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x) l (nhds 0) := fun f g => by
          simpa only [mul_zero] using (hz f).mul (hz g)
        have h3 : ∀ f g h : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f x * g x * h x) l (nhds 0) := fun f g h => by
          simpa only [mul_zero] using (h2 f g).mul (hz h)
        have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun x => (1 / (2 * κ)) * m2 x + m2 x * k0 x - m1 x * k1 x + (1 / (2 * M)) * k2 x + m0 x * k2 x)
            l (nhds 0) := by
          simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] using
            (((((hz m2).const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))).add (h2 m2 k0)).sub (h2 m1 k1)).add
              ((hz k2).const_mul (1 / (2 * M)))).add (h2 m0 k2)
        have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun x => (1 / (M * κ)) * w0 x + (2 / M) * (w0 x * k0 x) + (2 / κ) * (w0 x * m0 x) +
              4 * (w0 x * m0 x * k0 x))
            l (nhds 0) := by
          simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] using
            ((((hz w0).const_mul (1 / (M * κ))).add ((h2 w0 k0).const_mul (2 / M))).add
              ((h2 w0 m0).const_mul (2 / κ))).add ((h3 w0 m0 k0).const_mul 4)
        have ht3 : Filter.Tendsto
            (fun x => (2 * M ^ 2 / κ) * m0 x + (2 * κ ^ 2 / M) * k0 x + 4 * M ^ 2 * (m0 x * k0 x))
            l (nhds 0) := by
          simpa only [mul_zero, add_zero, sub_zero] using
            (((hz m0).const_mul (2 * M ^ 2 / κ)).add ((hz k0).const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2 / M))).add
              ((h2 m0 k0).const_mul (4 * M ^ 2))
        simpa only [Ω, sub_zero] using (ht1.sub ht2).sub ht3
      have h_int_scaled : Integrable (fun x => 4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) * (m0 x * k1 x)) volume :=
        (h_mul_int m0 k1).const_mul (4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2))
      have h_ftc := MeasureTheory.integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hΩ_deriv h_int_scaled
        (hΩ_tendsto Filter.atBot atBot_le_cocompact)
        (hΩ_tendsto Filter.atTop atTop_le_cocompact)
      rw [sub_zero, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul] at h_ftc
      have h_coeff_ne : 4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) ≠ 0 := by
        have h_diff_ne : κ - M ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm hMκ)
        have h_sum_ne : κ + M ≠ 0 := by linarith
        have h_fac : 4 * (κ ^ 2 - M ^ 2) = 4 * (κ - M) * (κ + M) := by ring
        rw [h_fac]
        exact mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero (by norm_num) h_diff_ne) h_sum_ne
      exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h_ftc).resolve_left h_coeff_ne
  have h1 : Integrable (fun x => -16 * κ ^ 5 * (m0 x * k1 x)) volume :=
    (h_mul_int m0 k1).const_mul (-16 * κ ^ 5)
  have h2 : Integrable (fun x => 4 * κ ^ 2 * (m0 x * w1 x)) volume :=
    (h_mul_int m0 w1).const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2)
  rw [MeasureTheory.integral_sub h1 h2, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul,
      MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, h_bilin, h_drift]
  ring

by
  have h_trans_apply : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), regTranslate a f x = f (x + a) :=
    fun _ _ _ => rfl
  have h_trans_zero : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), regTranslate 0 f = f := by
    intro f
    ext x
    change f (x + 0) = f x
    rw [add_zero]
  have h_hm1Profile_trans : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      hm1Profile (regTranslate a f) ξ =
        Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) * hm1Profile f ξ := by
    intro a f ξ
    have h_fl : fourierLine (regTranslate a f) ξ =
        Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine f ξ := by
      dsimp [fourierLine]
      rw [← mul_left_comm ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)]
      congr 1
      rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      have h_int_eq :
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((regTranslate a f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
            (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * ((x + a : ℝ) : ℂ)) * I) * (f (x + a) : ℂ))) := by
        ext x
        rw [h_trans_apply, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_int_eq]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
        (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) * (f y : ℂ))) a
    dsimp [hm1Profile]
    rw [h_fl, mul_left_comm]
  have h_trans_norm : ∀ (a : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι (regTranslate a f)‖ = ‖ι f‖ := by
    intro a f
    change ‖toHm1 (regTranslate a f)‖ = ‖toHm1 f‖
    have h_norm_pt : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile (regTranslate a f) ξ‖ = ‖hm1Profile f ξ‖ := by
      intro ξ
      rw [h_hm1Profile_trans, norm_mul]
      have h_exp : ((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I = ((ξ * a : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
    have h_elpn : eLpNorm (hm1Profile (regTranslate a f)) 2 volume =
        eLpNorm (hm1Profile f) 2 volume :=
      eLpNorm_congr_norm_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_norm_pt)
    have h_aesm_iff : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile (regTranslate a f)) volume ↔
        AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile f) volume := by
      have h_cont_pos : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I)) := by
        fun_prop
      have h_cont_neg : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I))) := by
        fun_prop
      constructor
      · intro h
        have h_eq : hm1Profile f = fun ξ : ℝ =>
            Complex.exp (-(((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I)) * hm1Profile (regTranslate a f) ξ := by
          ext ξ
          rw [h_hm1Profile_trans, ← mul_assoc, ← Complex.exp_add, neg_add_cancel,
              Complex.exp_zero, one_mul]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_cont_neg.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h
      · intro h
        have h_eq : hm1Profile (regTranslate a f) = fun ξ : ℝ =>
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) * hm1Profile f ξ := by
          ext ξ
          exact h_hm1Profile_trans a f ξ
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_cont_pos.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h
    have h_mem_iff : MemLp (hm1Profile (regTranslate a f)) 2 volume ↔
        MemLp (hm1Profile f) 2 volume :=
      ⟨fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h_aesm_iff.mp h1, h_elpn ▸ h2⟩,
       fun ⟨h1, h2⟩ => ⟨h_aesm_iff.mpr h1, h_elpn.symm ▸ h2⟩⟩
    dsimp [toHm1]
    by_cases h : MemLp (hm1Profile f) 2 volume
    · have h' : MemLp (hm1Profile (regTranslate a f)) 2 volume := h_mem_iff.mpr h
      rw [dif_pos h', dif_pos h, Lp.norm_toLp, Lp.norm_toLp, h_elpn]
    · have h' : ¬ MemLp (hm1Profile (regTranslate a f)) 2 volume := fun hc => h (h_mem_iff.mp hc)
      rw [dif_neg h', dif_neg h]
  have h_iter_trans : ∀ (κ a : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ (regTranslate a f) ℓ x y =
        greenIterKernel κ f ℓ (x + a) (y + a) := by
    intro κ a f ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      dsimp [greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro x y
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      congr 1
      have h_eq :
          (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ (regTranslate a f) ℓ x z * regTranslate a f z * freeGreenKernel κ z y) =
          (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ f ℓ (x + a) (z + a) * f (z + a) * freeGreenKernel κ (z + a) (y + a)) := by
        ext z
        rw [ih x z, h_trans_apply]
        dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
        rw [add_sub_add_right_eq_sub]
      rw [h_eq]
      exact MeasureTheory.integral_add_right_eq_self
        (fun z' : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ f ℓ (x + a) z' * f z' * freeGreenKernel κ z' (y + a)) a
  have h_trans_dg : ∀ (κ a : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      deriv (diagGreen κ (regTranslate a f)) x = deriv (diagGreen κ f) (x + a) := by
    intro κ a f x
    have h_dg : diagGreen κ (regTranslate a f) = fun y => diagGreen κ f (y + a) := by
      ext y
      dsimp [diagGreen, greenKernel]
      exact tsum_congr (fun ℓ => h_iter_trans κ a f ℓ y y)
    rw [h_dg, deriv_comp_add_const]
  have h_bootstrap : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ' → Continuous f → f 0 ≤ δ' / 2 →
      (∀ t : ℝ, (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, f s ≤ δ') → f t ≤ δ' / 2) →
      ∀ t : ℝ, f t ≤ δ' := by
    intro f δ' hδ' hf_cont hf0 h_halve
    have h_abs_uIcc : ∀ a b : ℝ, a ∈ Set.uIcc 0 b → |a| ≤ |b| ∧ (|a| = |b| → a = b) := by
      intro a b hab
      rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hab with ⟨ha0, hab'⟩ | ⟨hba', ha0⟩
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg ha0, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans ha0 hab')]
        exact ⟨hab', id⟩
      · rw [abs_of_nonpos ha0, abs_of_nonpos (le_trans hba' ha0)]
        exact ⟨neg_le_neg hba', neg_inj.mp⟩
    intro τ
    by_contra! h_gt
    let S : Set ℝ := Set.uIcc 0 τ ∩ {s : ℝ | δ' ≤ f s}
    have hS_compact : IsCompact S :=
      isCompact_uIcc.inter_right (isClosed_Ici.preimage hf_cont)
    have hS_nonempty : S.Nonempty := ⟨τ, Set.right_mem_uIcc, le_of_lt h_gt⟩
    obtain ⟨s₀, ⟨hs₀_uIcc, hs₀_ge⟩, hs₀_min⟩ :=
      hS_compact.exists_isMinOn hS_nonempty continuous_abs.continuousOn
    change δ' ≤ f s₀ at hs₀_ge
    have h_le_s₀ : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 s₀, f s ≤ δ' := by
      intro s hs
      by_contra! hs_gt
      have h_mem_img : δ' ∈ Set.uIcc (f 0) (f s) :=
        Set.mem_uIcc.mpr (Or.inl ⟨by linarith, le_of_lt hs_gt⟩)
      obtain ⟨s₁, hs₁_uIcc, hs₁_eq⟩ :=
        intermediate_value_uIcc (hf_cont.continuousOn) h_mem_img
      have hs_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 s₀ :=
        Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc Set.left_mem_uIcc hs
      have hs₀_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s₀ ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 τ :=
        Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc Set.left_mem_uIcc hs₀_uIcc
      have hs₁_S : s₁ ∈ S := ⟨hs₀_sub (hs_sub hs₁_uIcc), le_of_eq hs₁_eq.symm⟩
      have h_min_s₁ : |s₀| ≤ |s₁| := hs₀_min hs₁_S
      have h1 := h_abs_uIcc s₁ s hs₁_uIcc
      have h2 := h_abs_uIcc s s₀ hs
      have h_eq_abs : |s₁| = |s| := le_antisymm h1.1 (le_trans h2.1 h_min_s₁)
      have h_eq_s : s₁ = s := h1.2 h_eq_abs
      subst h_eq_s
      linarith
    have hs₀_halve : f s₀ ≤ δ' / 2 := h_halve s₀ h_le_s₀
    linarith
  obtain ⟨h_chain, h_cont_norm⟩ := regTranslate_moving_frame_hasDerivAt_and_continuous
  obtain ⟨δ_loc, hδ_loc, h_trunc⟩ := reg_moving_frame_truncated_global_existence
  refine ⟨δ_loc, hδ_loc, ?_⟩
  intro δ' hδ'_pos hδ'_le κ hκ w₀ hw₀ h_trap
  obtain ⟨w_tilde, hw_tilde0, hw_tilde_deriv⟩ := h_trunc δ' hδ'_pos hδ'_le κ hκ w₀
  let w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun t => regTranslate (4 * κ ^ 2 * t) (w_tilde t)
  have hw0 : w 0 = w₀ := by
    dsimp [w]
    rw [mul_zero, hw_tilde0, h_trans_zero]
  have hw_norm_eq : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖ι (w t)‖ = ‖ι (w_tilde t)‖ :=
    fun t => h_trans_norm (4 * κ ^ 2 * t) (w_tilde t)
  have hw_local_sol : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖ι (w s)‖ ≤ δ' →
      ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt w v s ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, v x = regFlowRHS κ (w s) x := by
    intro s hs
    have hs_tilde : ‖ι (w_tilde s)‖ ≤ δ' := by rwa [← hw_norm_eq s]
    obtain ⟨v_tilde, hv_tilde_deriv, hv_tilde_eq⟩ := hw_tilde_deriv s
    obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_eq⟩ :=
      h_chain w_tilde v_tilde (4 * κ ^ 2) s hv_tilde_deriv
    refine ⟨v, hv_deriv, fun x => ?_⟩
    rw [hv_eq x, hv_tilde_eq hs_tilde (x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * s),
        ← h_trans_dg κ (4 * κ ^ 2 * s) (w_tilde s) x]
    rfl
  have hw_cont_norm : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => ‖ι (w t)‖) := by
    have h_eq : (fun t : ℝ => ‖ι (w t)‖) = (fun t : ℝ => ‖ι (w_tilde t)‖) :=
      funext hw_norm_eq
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_cont_norm w_tilde (fun s => ⟨(hw_tilde_deriv s).choose, (hw_tilde_deriv s).choose_spec.1⟩)
  have hw0_norm : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ≤ δ' / 2 := by
    rw [hw0]
    exact hw₀
  have hw_ball : ∀ t : ℝ, ‖ι (w t)‖ ≤ δ' := by
    apply h_bootstrap (fun t => ‖ι (w t)‖) δ' hδ'_pos hw_cont_norm hw0_norm
    intro t h_ivl
    exact h_trap w t hw0 (fun s hs => ⟨hw_local_sol s (h_ivl s hs), h_ivl s hs⟩)
  have hw_sol : IsRegFlowSolution κ w := fun t => hw_local_sol t (hw_ball t)
  exact ⟨w, hw_sol, hw0, hw_ball⟩

by

  intro κ _hκ z hz s hs x
  have h1_le : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := le_rfl
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel 1 p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel 1 a b| ≤ 1 / (2 * (1 : ℝ)) := by
    intro a b
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]

      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ a b| ≤ M := by

      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => M * (1 / (2 * 1)) * ‖w u‖

        h_w_int.norm.const_mul (M * (1 / (2 * 1)))

        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, ‖F (a, b) u‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F (a, b))
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, bound u := integral_mono_ae hF_int.norm h_bound_int (hF_dom (a, b))
  have h_cont : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 p.2) :=
    fun w ℓ => (h_iter_cont_bound w ℓ).1
  have h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ a b| ≤ (1 / (2 * 1)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ := by
    intro w hw ℓ a b
    calc |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ a b|
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * 1)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ := greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound 1 h1_le w ℓ a b
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * 1)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw ℓ) (by positivity)
  have h_tele := greenIterKernel_sub_eq_sum_antidiagonal 1 h1_le
  have h_hm1_le_L1_sq : ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y|) ^ 2 := by
    intro w₁ w₂
    let q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := w₁ - w₂
    have h_iter1_sub : (fun a : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 a a - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 a a) =
        (fun a : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 q 1 a a) := by
      ext a
      rw [h_tele w₁ w₂ 0 a a, Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_zero]
      dsimp [greenIterKernel, q]
      congr 1
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun u => ?_)
      simp only [Finset.sum_singleton]
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      ring
    have h_norm_sub_eq : ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2 = ‖ι q‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← (greenIterKernel_one_first_h1_isometry w₁ w₂).2.2.2.2.2.2.2,
          h_iter1_sub,
          (greenIterKernel_one_first_h1_isometry q 0).2.2.2.1]
    have hq_abs_int : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => |q u|) volume := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using q.integrable.norm
    set I_q : ℝ := ∫ u : ℝ, |q u|
    have hIq_nn : 0 ≤ I_q := integral_nonneg (fun u => abs_nonneg _)
    have h_inner_le : ∀ y : ℝ,
        |∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u| ≤ |q y| * I_q := by
      intro y
      let F_y : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u
      have hFy_cont : Continuous F_y := by
        dsimp [F_y]
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      have hFy_dom : ∀ u : ℝ, ‖F_y u‖ ≤ |q y| * |q u| := by
        intro u
        dsimp [F_y]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
        have h_exp : Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) ≤ 1 :=
          Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith [abs_nonneg (y - u)])
        calc Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * |q y| * |q u|
          _ ≤ 1 * |q y| * |q u| := by
            apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
            · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_exp (abs_nonneg _)
            · exact abs_nonneg _
          _ = |q y| * |q u| := by ring
      have hFy_int : Integrable F_y volume :=
        (hq_abs_int.const_mul |q y|).mono' hFy_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFy_dom)
      calc |∫ u : ℝ, F_y u|
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, ‖F_y u‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm F_y
        _ ≤ ∫ u : ℝ, |q y| * |q u| := integral_mono hFy_int.norm (hq_abs_int.const_mul |q y|) hFy_dom
        _ = |q y| * I_q := integral_const_mul |q y| _
    have h_double_le : (∫ y : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u) ≤ I_q ^ 2 := by
      calc ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u
        _ ≤ |∫ y : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u| := le_abs_self _
        _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, ‖∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun y : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u)
        _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, |q y| * I_q := by
          have h_outer_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u) := by
            let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun y u => Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q u
            have hK_meas : ∀ y : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (K y) volume := by
              intro y
              have hc : Continuous (K y) := by
                dsimp [K]
                have := q.continuous
                fun_prop
              exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
            have hK_dom : ∀ y : ℝ, ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, ‖K y u‖ ≤ |q u| := by
              intro y
              filter_upwards with u
              dsimp [K]
              rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
              have h_exp : Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) ≤ 1 :=
                Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith [abs_nonneg (y - u)])
              exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (abs_nonneg _) h_exp
            have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ u : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun y : ℝ => K y u) := by
              filter_upwards with u
              dsimp [K]
              fun_prop
            have h_int_K_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, K y u) :=
              continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom hq_abs_int hK_cont
            have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u) =
                (fun y : ℝ => q y * ∫ u : ℝ, K y u) := by
              ext y
              dsimp [K]
              rw [← integral_const_mul]
              congr 1
              ext u
              ring
            rw [h_eq]
            exact q.continuous.mul h_int_K_cont
          have h_outer_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => ‖∫ u : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - u|) * q y * q u‖) volume := by
            refine (hq_abs_int.mul_const I_q).mono' h_outer_cont.norm.aestronglyMeasurable
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
            rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _), Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact h_inner_le y
          refine integral_mono h_outer_int (hq_abs_int.mul_const I_q) (fun y => ?_)
          rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
          exact h_inner_le y
        _ = I_q * I_q := integral_mul_const I_q _
        _ = I_q ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_exp_id := exp_two_abs_double_integral_eq_hm1_norm_sq q
    have h_Iq_eq : I_q = ∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y| := rfl
    rw [h_norm_sub_eq, ← h_Iq_eq]
    nlinarith [h_double_le, h_exp_id]
  obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_eq⟩ := hz s
  obtain ⟨h_l1_lin, h_l1_sq⟩ := schwartz_hasDerivAt_l1_tendsto z v s hv_deriv
  have h_norm_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    have h_c : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖) :=
      (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm
    simpa using h_c.tendsto s
  have h_hm1_sq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖ι (z τ) - ι (z s)‖ ^ 2) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    have h_prod_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖ * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (∫ y : ℝ, |z τ y - z s y|) ^ 2))
        (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_norm_sub_tendsto.mul h_l1_sq
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_prod_tendsto
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => sq_nonneg _)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => ?_)
    have h_eq : (∫ y : ℝ, |z τ y - z s y|) ^ 2 =
        ‖τ - s‖ * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (∫ y : ℝ, |z τ y - z s y|) ^ 2) := by
      by_cases hτ : τ = s
      · subst hτ
        simp
      · have h_ne : ‖τ - s‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hτ)
        exact (mul_inv_cancel_left₀ h_ne _).symm
    rw [← h_eq]
    exact h_hm1_le_L1_sq (z τ) (z s)
  have hV_nhds : ∀ᶠ τ in nhds s, ‖ι (z τ)‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by
    have h_lt : ∀ᶠ τ in nhds s, ‖ι (z τ) - ι (z s)‖ ^ 2 < (1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
      (tendsto_order.mp h_hm1_sq_tendsto).2 ((1 / 8 : ℝ) ^ 2) (by norm_num)
    filter_upwards [h_lt] with τ hτ
    have h_diff_le : ‖ι (z τ) - ι (z s)‖ ≤ 1 / 8 := by
      nlinarith [norm_nonneg (ι (z τ) - ι (z s))]
    have h_tri : ‖ι (z τ)‖ ≤ ‖ι (z s)‖ + ‖ι (z τ) - ι (z s)‖ :=
      norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (ι (z τ)) (ι (z s))
    linarith
  have hs_quarter : ‖ι (z s)‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := by linarith
  have hg_ne : diagGreen 1 (z s) x ≠ 0 :=
    (diagGreen_sub_and_linearization_bound 1 h1_le h_cont h_bound h_tele (z s) (z s) v hs_quarter hs_quarter 0 x).1
  set I : ℝ := ∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel 1 (z s) x y * diffFlowRHS κ (z s) y * greenKernel 1 (z s) y x
  set D : ℝ := -∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel 1 (z s) x y * v y * greenKernel 1 (z s) y x
  have hD_eq : D = -I := by
    dsimp [D, I]
    congr 1
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    dsimp only
    rw [hv_eq y]
  have hg_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun τ => diagGreen 1 (z τ) x) (-I) s := by
    rw [← hD_eq, hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
    have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ =>
          ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (∫ y : ℝ, |z τ y - z s y - (τ - s) * v y|) +
          ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (∫ y : ℝ, |z τ y - z s y|) ^ 2)
        (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_l1_lin.add h_l1_sq
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_upper_tendsto
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => by positivity) ?_
    filter_upwards [hV_nhds] with τ hτ_quarter
    have h_lin_bound :=
      (diagGreen_sub_and_linearization_bound 1 h1_le h_cont h_bound h_tele (z τ) (z s) v hτ_quarter hs_quarter (τ - s) x).2
    have h_norm_eq : ‖diagGreen 1 (z τ) x - diagGreen 1 (z s) x - (τ - s) • D‖ =
        |diagGreen 1 (z τ) x - diagGreen 1 (z s) x - (τ - s) * D| := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul]
    rw [h_norm_eq, ← mul_add]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_lin_bound (by positivity)
  have h2g_ne : 2 * diagGreen 1 (z s) x ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hg_ne
  have h2g_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun τ => 2 * diagGreen 1 (z τ) x) (2 * (-I)) s :=
    hg_deriv.const_mul 2
  have h_inv_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun τ => (2 * diagGreen 1 (z τ) x)⁻¹)
      (-(2 * (-I)) / (2 * diagGreen 1 (z s) x) ^ 2) s :=
    h2g_deriv.inv h2g_ne
  have h_sub_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun τ => 1 - 1 / (2 * diagGreen 1 (z τ) x))
      (-(-(2 * (-I)) / (2 * diagGreen 1 (z s) x) ^ 2)) s := by
    simpa only [one_div] using h_inv_deriv.const_sub (1 : ℝ)
  have h_fun_eq : (fun τ => 1 - 1 / (2 * diagGreen 1 (z τ) x)) =
      (fun τ => recipGreenDiff (z τ) x) := rfl
  rw [h_fun_eq] at h_sub_deriv
  refine h_sub_deriv.congr_deriv ?_
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_sub_eq_sum_antidiagonal
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
      -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z)

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_and_linearization_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ)
    (h_cont : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2))
    (h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ)
    (h_tele : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
        -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z))
    (w₁ w₂ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hw₁ : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (hw₂ : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (h x : ℝ) :
    diagGreen κ w₂ x ≠ 0 ∧
    |diagGreen κ w₁ x - diagGreen κ w₂ x -
      h * (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x)| ≤
      (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y|) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: schwartz_hasDerivAt_l1_tendsto
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (s : ℝ)
    (h_deriv : HasDerivAt u v s) :
    Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, |u τ y - u s y - (τ - s) * v y|) (nhds s) (nhds 0) ∧
    Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (∫ y : ℝ, |u τ y - u s y|) ^ 2) (nhds s) (nhds 0)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_one_first_h1_isometry
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ∧
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) = ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 ∧
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x) ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x) ∧
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x) = ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2

informal_problem.statement:
∃ δ₂ : ℝ, 0 < δ₂ ∧
      ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ₂ →
        ∀ x : ℝ,
          ∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel 1 w x y * kdvRHS w y * greenKernel 1 w y x =
            2 * deriv w x * diagGreen 1 w x - 2 * (w x - 2) * deriv (diagGreen 1 w) x

signature.name: kdvRHS_greenKernel_integral_identity
signature.statement:
∃ δ₂ : ℝ, 0 < δ₂ ∧
      ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ₂ →
        ∀ x : ℝ,
          ∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel 1 w x y * kdvRHS w y * greenKernel 1 w y x =
            2 * deriv w x * diagGreen 1 w x - 2 * (w x - 2) * deriv (diagGreen 1 w) x

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 4, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro w hw x

  obtain ⟨h_symm, h_off_d1, h_off_d2, h_off_bd⟩ :=

    greenKernel_halfLine_ode_and_jump 1 h1_le w hw h_diag_d h_symm h_off_d1 h_off_d2 h_off_bd
  obtain ⟨h_tend_L, h_tend_R, _, _⟩ :=
    greenKernel_halfLine_tendsto_and_integrable 1 h1_le w hw
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun f => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f
  have hD_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), D f y = deriv f y :=
    fun f y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ f y
  have hD2_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), D (D f) y = iteratedDeriv 2 f y := by
    intro f y
    rw [hD_apply]
    have h : (D f : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv 1 f := by
      ext z
      rw [hD_apply, iteratedDeriv_one]
    rw [h, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have hD3_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), D (D (D f)) y = iteratedDeriv 3 f y := by
    intro f y
    rw [hD_apply]
    have h : (D (D f) : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv 2 f := funext (hD2_apply f)
    rw [h, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have h_hasDerivAt : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), HasDerivAt f (D f y) y := by
    intro f y
    rw [hD_apply]
    exact (f.smooth'.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
  let w0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := w
  let w1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D w0
  let w2 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D w1
  let w3 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D w2
  let K : (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun G DG y =>
    (-w2 y + 2 * (w0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * w0 y - 4) * (G y) ^ 2 +
      2 * w1 y * G y * DG y -
      2 * (w0 y - 2) * (DG y) ^ 2
  have hK_deriv : ∀ (G DG : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt G (DG y) y →
      HasDerivAt DG ((1 ^ 2 + w y) * G y) y →
      HasDerivAt (K G DG) (G y * kdvRHS w y * G y) y := by
    intro G DG y hG hDG
    have hw0 := h_hasDerivAt w0 y
    have hw1 := h_hasDerivAt w1 y
    have hw2 := h_hasDerivAt w2 y
    have h_coeff1 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => -w2 y' + 2 * (w0 y') ^ 2 - 2 * w0 y' - 4)
        (-w3 y + 2 * (2 * w0 y ^ 1 * w1 y) - 2 * w1 y) y :=
      (((hw2.neg).add ((hw0.pow 2).const_mul 2)).sub (hw0.const_mul 2)).sub_const 4
    have h_G2 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => (G y') ^ 2) (2 * G y ^ 1 * DG y) y :=
      hG.pow 2
    have h_term1 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => (-w2 y' + 2 * (w0 y') ^ 2 - 2 * w0 y' - 4) * (G y') ^ 2)
        ((-w3 y + 2 * (2 * w0 y ^ 1 * w1 y) - 2 * w1 y) * (G y) ^ 2 +
          (-w2 y + 2 * (w0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * w0 y - 4) * (2 * G y ^ 1 * DG y)) y :=
      h_coeff1.mul h_G2
    have h_term2 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => 2 * w1 y' * G y' * DG y')
        ((2 * w2 y * G y + 2 * w1 y * DG y) * DG y +
          (2 * w1 y * G y) * ((1 ^ 2 + w y) * G y)) y :=
      ((hw1.const_mul 2).mul hG).mul hDG
    have h_coeff3 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => 2 * (w0 y' - 2)) (2 * w1 y) y :=
      (hw0.sub_const 2).const_mul 2
    have h_DG2 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => (DG y') ^ 2)
        (2 * DG y ^ 1 * ((1 ^ 2 + w y) * G y)) y :=
      hDG.pow 2
    have h_term3 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => 2 * (w0 y' - 2) * (DG y') ^ 2)
        (2 * w1 y * (DG y) ^ 2 + 2 * (w0 y - 2) * (2 * DG y ^ 1 * ((1 ^ 2 + w y) * G y))) y :=
      h_coeff3.mul h_DG2
    refine ((h_term1.add h_term2).sub h_term3).congr_deriv ?_
    dsimp only [kdvRHS, w0, w1, w2, w3]
    rw [hD3_apply w y, hD_apply w y]
    ring
  have hK_tendsto : ∀ (G DG : ℝ → ℝ) (l : Filter ℝ),
      l ≤ Filter.cocompact ℝ →
      Filter.Tendsto G l (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto DG l (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (K G DG) l (nhds 0) := by
    intro G DG l hl hG hDG
    have hz : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds 0) := fun g =>
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty g).mono_left hl
    have h_coeff1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => -w2 y + 2 * (w0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * w0 y - 4) l (nhds (-4)) := by
      have ht := ((((hz w2).neg).add (((hz w0).pow 2).const_mul 2)).sub ((hz w0).const_mul 2)).sub
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => (4 : ℝ)) l (nhds 4))
      simpa using ht
    have h_G2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (G y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hG.pow 2
    have h_DG2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (DG y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hDG.pow 2
    have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (-w2 y + 2 * (w0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * w0 y - 4) * (G y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_coeff1.mul h_G2
    have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 2 * w1 y * G y * DG y) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (((hz w1).const_mul 2).mul hG).mul hDG
    have ht3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 2 * (w0 y - 2) * (DG y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      have hc3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 2 * (w0 y - 2)) l (nhds (2 * (0 - 2))) :=
        ((hz w0).sub tendsto_const_nhds).const_mul 2
      simpa using hc3.mul h_DG2
    simpa [K] using (ht1.add ht2).sub ht3
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenKernel 1 w x y * kdvRHS w y * greenKernel 1 w y x
  let F_L : ℝ → ℝ := K (greenKernelLeft 1 w x) (greenDerivLeft 1 w x)
  let F_R : ℝ → ℝ := K (greenKernelRight 1 w x) (greenDerivRight 1 w x)
  have hF_L_deriv : ∀ y ∈ Set.Iic x, HasDerivAt F_L (f y) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hd := hK_deriv (greenKernelLeft 1 w x) (greenDerivLeft 1 w x) y
      (h_d1_LR x y).1 ((h_d2_LR x y).1 hy)
    have h_eq1 : greenKernelLeft 1 w x y = greenKernel 1 w x y := (h_eq_LR x y).1 hy
    have h_eq2 : greenKernel 1 w y x = greenKernel 1 w x y := h_G_symm y x
    refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h_eq1, h_eq2]
  have hF_R_deriv : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ici x, HasDerivAt F_R (f y) y := by
    intro y hy
    have hd := hK_deriv (greenKernelRight 1 w x) (greenDerivRight 1 w x) y
      (h_d1_LR x y).2 ((h_d2_LR x y).2 hy)
    have h_eq1 : greenKernelRight 1 w x y = greenKernel 1 w x y := (h_eq_LR x y).2 hy
    have h_eq2 : greenKernel 1 w y x = greenKernel 1 w x y := h_G_symm y x
    refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h_eq1, h_eq2]
  have hF_L_tend : Filter.Tendsto F_L Filter.atBot (nhds 0) :=
    hK_tendsto (greenKernelLeft 1 w x) (greenDerivLeft 1 w x) Filter.atBot
      atBot_le_cocompact (h_tend_L x).1 (h_tend_L x).2
  have hF_R_tend : Filter.Tendsto F_R Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    hK_tendsto (greenKernelRight 1 w x) (greenDerivRight 1 w x) Filter.atTop
      atTop_le_cocompact (h_tend_R x).1 (h_tend_R x).2
  have h_kdv_int : Integrable (kdvRHS w) volume := by
    have h_eq : kdvRHS w = fun y => -w3 y + 6 * (w0 y * w1 y) := by
      ext y
      dsimp only [kdvRHS, w0, w1, w2, w3]
      rw [hD3_apply w y, hD_apply w y]
      ring
    rw [h_eq]
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := w0.toBoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range.exists_norm_le
    have hw01 : Integrable (fun y => w0 y * w1 y) volume :=
      w1.integrable.bdd_mul w0.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hC0 (w0 y) ⟨y, rfl⟩)
    exact w3.integrable.neg.add (hw01.const_mul 6)
  have h_G_cont : Continuous (fun y => greenKernel 1 w x y) := by
    have hL_cont : Continuous (greenKernelLeft 1 w x) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (h_d1_LR x y).1.continuousAt
    have hR_cont : Continuous (greenKernelRight 1 w x) :=
      continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (h_d1_LR x y).2.continuousAt
    have h_if : (fun y => greenKernel 1 w x y) =
        fun y => if y ≤ x then greenKernelLeft 1 w x y else greenKernelRight 1 w x y := by
      ext y
      split_ifs with hy
      · exact ((h_eq_LR x y).1 hy).symm
      · exact ((h_eq_LR x y).2 (le_of_not_ge hy)).symm
    rw [h_if]
    refine Continuous.if_le hL_cont hR_cont continuous_id continuous_const ?_
    intro y hy
    have hyx : y = x := hy
    rw [hyx, (h_eq_LR x x).1 le_rfl, (h_eq_LR x x).2 le_rfl]
  have h_G_bd : ∀ y : ℝ, |greenKernel 1 w x y| ≤ 1 := by
    intro y
    have h_geom : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) :=
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_left (1 / 2)
    have h_term : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
      intro ℓ
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y|
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * 1)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ := greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound 1 h1_le w ℓ x y
        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
          have hp : ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw ℓ
          linarith
    have h_sum_norm : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_term h_geom
    calc |greenKernel 1 w x y|
      _ = ‖∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_norm
      _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_term h_sum_norm h_geom
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := tsum_mul_left
      _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - 1 / 4)⁻¹ := by
        rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
      _ ≤ 1 := by norm_num
  have h_int_f : Integrable f volume := by
    have h_f_eq : f = fun y => (greenKernel 1 w x y * greenKernel 1 w x y) * kdvRHS w y := by
      ext y
      dsimp [f]
      rw [h_G_symm y x]
      ring
    rw [h_f_eq]
    have h_G2_bd : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖greenKernel 1 w x y * greenKernel 1 w x y‖ ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
      calc |greenKernel 1 w x y| * |greenKernel 1 w x y|
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (h_G_bd y) (h_G_bd y) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 1 := mul_one 1
    exact h_kdv_int.bdd_mul (h_G_cont.mul h_G_cont).aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_G2_bd)
  have h_int_L : ∫ y in Set.Iic x, f y = F_L x - 0 := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    · exact (hF_L_deriv x Set.self_mem_Iic).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun y hy => hF_L_deriv y (Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self hy)
    · exact h_int_f.integrableOn
    · exact hF_L_tend
  have h_int_R : ∫ y in Set.Ioi x, f y = 0 - F_R x := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    · exact (hF_R_deriv x Set.self_mem_Ici).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun y hy => hF_R_deriv y (Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self hy)
    · exact h_int_f.integrableOn
    · exact hF_R_tend
  have h_split : (∫ y : ℝ, f y) = (∫ y in Set.Iic x, f y) + (∫ y in Set.Ioi x, f y) := by
    rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
    exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic h_int_f).symm
  change (∫ y : ℝ, f y) =
    2 * deriv w x * diagGreen 1 w x - 2 * (w x - 2) * deriv (diagGreen 1 w) x
  rw [h_split, h_int_L, h_int_R]
  dsimp [F_L, F_R, K]
  have h_gx_L : greenKernelLeft 1 w x x = diagGreen 1 w x := (h_eq_LR x x).1 le_rfl
  have h_gx_R : greenKernelRight 1 w x x = diagGreen 1 w x := (h_eq_LR x x).2 le_rfl
  have h_dgx_L : greenDerivLeft 1 w x x = (diagGreenDeriv 1 w x + 1) / 2 := (h_jump_LR x).1
  have h_dgx_R : greenDerivRight 1 w x x = (diagGreenDeriv 1 w x - 1) / 2 := (h_jump_LR x).2
  have h_w1_x : w1 x = deriv w x := hD_apply w x
  have h_dgd_eq : diagGreenDeriv 1 w x = deriv (diagGreen 1 w) x := ((h_diag x).2).deriv.symm
  rw [h_gx_L, h_gx_R, h_dgx_L, h_dgx_R, h_w1_x, h_dgd_eq]

subgoal_signatures.name: greenKernel_halfLine_ode_and_jump
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y)
          (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) x x) x) →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ ((∫ z : ℝ, |w z|) / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w x ∧ HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ w) (diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → greenKernelLeft κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → greenKernelRight κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ,

        greenDerivRight κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a - 1) / 2) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelLeft κ w a) (greenDerivLeft κ w a x) x ∧
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelRight κ w a) (greenDerivRight κ w a x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → HasDerivAt (greenDerivLeft κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelLeft κ w a x) x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → HasDerivAt (greenDerivRight κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelRight κ w a x) x))

      ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ →

  rw [h_int_val, h_flux_deriv, hg1_eq' x, h_deriv_1 x, ← hD_apply w0 x]
  have hm0_ne : 1 / 2 + m0 x ≠ 0 := by
    rw [← hg1_eq' x]
    exact hg1_ne
  exact h_final_alg κ (w0 x) (w1 x) (m0 x) (m1 x) (k0 x) (k1 x) hκ_ne hκ2_ne hm0_ne

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_const_mem_schwartz
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_reg : ℝ, 0 < δ_reg ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_reg →
        ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_third_order_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_ode : ℝ, 0 < δ_ode ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_ode →
        ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
          2 * deriv w x * diagGreen κ w x +
          4 * w x * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x +
          4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_diag_hasDerivAt
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y)
        (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) x x) x

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_hasDerivAt_and_symm
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y x) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) x) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x) x) ∧
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ ((∫ z : ℝ, |w z|) / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenKernel_halfLine_ode_and_jump
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y)
          (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) x x) x) →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ ((∫ z : ℝ, |w z|) / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w x ∧ HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ w) (diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → greenKernelLeft κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → greenKernelRight κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        greenDerivLeft κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a + 1) / 2 ∧
        greenDerivRight κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a - 1) / 2) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelLeft κ w a) (greenDerivLeft κ w a x) x ∧
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelRight κ w a) (greenDerivRight κ w a x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → HasDerivAt (greenDerivLeft κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelLeft κ w a x) x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → HasDerivAt (greenDerivRight κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelRight κ w a x) x))

subgoal_signatures.name: greenKernel_halfLine_tendsto_and_integrable
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (greenKernelLeft κ w a) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (greenDerivLeft κ w a) Filter.atBot (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (greenKernelRight κ w a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (greenDerivRight κ w a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x))
          Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun x => -((greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ,
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2))
          volume)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

informal_problem.statement:
∃ δ₄ : ℝ, 0 < δ₄ ∧
      ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ →
        ∀ z : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          IsDiffFlowSolution κ z →
          (∀ s : ℝ, ‖ι (z s)‖ ≤ δ₄) →
          (∀ s x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => recipGreenDiff (z τ) x) (-deriv (recipGreenFlux κ (z s)) x) s) →
          ∀ t : ℝ, ∀ M_flux : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_flux →
            (∀ s : ℝ, Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (deriv (recipGreenFlux κ (z s)))) ≤ M_flux) →
            Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff (z t) x - recipGreenDiff (z 0) x)) ≤
              |t| * M_flux

signature.name: diff_flow_hm2NormSq_minkowski_bound
signature.statement:
∃ δ₄ : ℝ, 0 < δ₄ ∧
      ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ →
        ∀ z : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          IsDiffFlowSolution κ z →
          (∀ s : ℝ, ‖ι (z s)‖ ≤ δ₄) →

            (∀ s : ℝ, Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (deriv (recipGreenFlux κ (z s)))) ≤ M_flux) →
            Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => recipGreenDiff (z t) x - recipGreenDiff (z 0) x)) ≤
              |t| * M_flux

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 4, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro κ _hκ z hz hz_ball h_pw t M_flux hM_flux h_flux
  have h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ := by
    intro w hw ℓ x y
    have h1 := greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound 1 le_rfl w ℓ x y
    have h_pow : ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw ℓ
    calc |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y|
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * 1)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ := h1
      _ = (1 / 2) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow (by norm_num)
  have h_tele := greenIterKernel_sub_eq_sum_antidiagonal 1 le_rfl
  let p : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0
  let P : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → ℝ := fun f => 2 * p f
  have hP_nn : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), 0 ≤ P f := fun f => by dsimp [P]; positivity
  have h_decay : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), |f y| ≤ P f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    intro f y
    have h0 : |f y| ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 0 f y
    have h4 : y ^ 4 * |f y| ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 f := by
      have h := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 4 0 f y
      have hy4 : |y| ^ 4 = y ^ 4 := by
        have : |y| ^ 4 = (|y| ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
        rw [this, sq_abs]
        ring
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs, hy4] using h
    have hp_apply : p f = SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 f := rfl
    have h_quad_le : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 4) := by
      have : 0 ≤ (1 - y ^ 2) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (1 - y ^ 2)
      linarith
    have h_mul : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * |f y| ≤ P f := by
      dsimp [P]
      calc (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * |f y|
        _ ≤ (2 * (1 + y ^ 4)) * |f y| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_quad_le (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = 2 * (|f y| + y ^ 4 * |f y|) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 f) := by linarith
        _ = 2 * p f := by rw [hp_apply]
    have h_pos : 0 < (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by positivity
    calc |f y|
      _ = ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * |f y|) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by field_simp
      _ ≤ P f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by positivity)
  have hP_cont : Continuous P := by
    dsimp [P]
    have hc0 : Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f) :=
      (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm ⟨0, 0⟩
    have hc4 : Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0 f) :=
      (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm ⟨4, 0⟩
    exact continuous_const.mul (hc0.add hc4)
  let Ψ : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun s x => recipGreenDiff (z s) x
  let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun s x => deriv (recipGreenFlux κ (z s)) x
  have h_s_props : ∀ s : ℝ,
      Integrable (Ψ s) volume ∧
      Integrable (F s) volume ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)|)
        (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    intro s
    obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, _hv_eq⟩ := hz s
    have h_inv_smul : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => (τ - s)⁻¹ • (z τ - z s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (τ - s)))
        (nhds s) (nhds 0) :=
      hv_deriv.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
    have h_p_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => P ((τ - s)⁻¹ • (z τ - z s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (τ - s))))
        (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      have h0 : P 0 = 0 := by simp [P]
      simpa [h0] using (hP_cont.tendsto 0).comp h_inv_smul
    have h_rem_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v))
        (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      refine h_p_tendsto.congr (fun τ => ?_)
      dsimp only [Function.comp_apply, P]
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, map_smul_eq_mul, norm_inv]
      ring
    let Q₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v)
    have h_diff_bound : ∀ τ : ℝ, P (z τ - z s) ≤ ‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v) := by
      intro τ
      have h_alg : z τ - z s = (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) + (τ - s) • v := by
        rw [sub_add_cancel]
      have h_tri : P (z τ - z s) ≤ P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) + ‖τ - s‖ * P v := by
        change 2 * p (z τ - z s) ≤ 2 * p (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) + ‖τ - s‖ * (2 * p v)
        have h1 : p (z τ - z s) ≤ p (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) + p ((τ - s) • v) := by
          conv_lhs => rw [h_alg]
          exact map_add_le_add p _ _
        have h2 : p ((τ - s) • v) = ‖τ - s‖ * p v := map_smul_eq_mul p (τ - s) v
        linarith
      have h_rem_eq : P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) = ‖τ - s‖ * Q₁ τ := by
        dsimp [Q₁]
        by_cases hτ : τ = s
        · subst hτ
          simp [P]
        · have h_ne : ‖τ - s‖ ≠ 0 := norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hτ)
          exact (mul_inv_cancel_left₀ h_ne _).symm
      linarith
    have h_quad_bound : ∀ τ : ℝ,
        ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2 ≤ ‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v) ^ 2 := by
      intro τ
      have h_sq : (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2 ≤ (‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (hP_nn _) (h_diff_bound τ) 2
      have h_mul : ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2 ≤ ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v)) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _))
      have h_inv_sq : ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ‖τ - s‖ ^ 2 = ‖τ - s‖ := by
        rcases eq_or_ne ‖τ - s‖ 0 with h0 | hne
        · rw [h0]
          ring
        · field_simp
      calc ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2
        _ ≤ ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v)) ^ 2 := h_mul
        _ = (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ‖τ - s‖ ^ 2) * (Q₁ τ + P v) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = ‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v) ^ 2 := by rw [h_inv_sq]
    have h_norm_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖) :=
        (continuous_id.sub continuous_const).norm
      simpa using h_cont.tendsto s
    have h_factor_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => (Q₁ τ + P v) ^ 2) (nhds s) (nhds ((0 + P v) ^ 2)) :=
      (h_rem_tendsto.add tendsto_const_nhds).pow 2
    have h_upper2 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖ * (Q₁ τ + P v) ^ 2) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_norm_sub_tendsto.mul h_factor_tendsto
    have h_quad_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2) (nhds s) (nhds 0) :=
      tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_upper2
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => by positivity)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_quad_bound)
    let δΨ_s : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      (-1 / (2 * (diagGreen 1 (z s) x) ^ 2)) *
        ∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel 1 (z s) x y * v y * greenKernel 1 (z s) y x
    let C_s : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ =>
      32 * π * (1 + π * P (z s)) * P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) +
      160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * P (z s)) * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2
    have h_peetre_τ : ∀ τ : ℝ,
        Integrable (Ψ s) volume ∧
        Integrable δΨ_s volume ∧
        (∀ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * δΨ_s x| ≤ C_s τ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧
        (∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * δΨ_s x|) ≤ π * C_s τ := by
      intro τ
      have h_sub_decay : ∀ y : ℝ, |z τ y - z s y| ≤ P (z τ - z s) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
        fun y => h_decay (z τ - z s) y
      have h_rem_decay : ∀ y : ℝ,
          |z τ y - z s y - (τ - s) * v y| ≤ P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
        fun y => h_decay (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) y
      have h_lin := recipGreenDiff_sub_and_linearization_peetre_bound h_bound h_tele
        (z τ) (z s) v (hz_ball τ) (hz_ball s)
        (P (z s)) (P v) (P (z τ - z s)) (P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v))
        (hP_nn (z s)) (hP_nn v) (hP_nn (z τ - z s)) (hP_nn (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v))
        (h_decay (z s)) (h_decay v) h_sub_decay (τ - s) h_rem_decay
      refine ⟨h_lin.1, h_lin.2.1, h_lin.2.2.1, ?_⟩
      calc ∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * δΨ_s x|
        _ ≤ 32 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * P (z s)) * P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v) +
            160 * π ^ 3 * (1 + π * P (z s)) * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2 := h_lin.2.2.2
        _ = π * C_s τ := by dsimp [C_s]; ring
    have hΨs_int : Integrable (Ψ s) volume := (h_peetre_τ s).1
    have hδΨs_int : Integrable δΨ_s volume := (h_peetre_τ s).2.1
    have hCs_nn : ∀ τ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_s τ := by
      intro τ
      dsimp [C_s]
      have := hP_nn (z s)
      have := hP_nn (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v)
      positivity
    have hCs_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * C_s τ) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => (32 * π * (1 + π * P (z s))) * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v)))
          (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_rem_tendsto.const_mul (32 * π * (1 + π * P (z s)))
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => (160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * P (z s))) * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2))
          (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_quad_tendsto.const_mul (160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * P (z s)))
      have h_sum : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ =>
            (32 * π * (1 + π * P (z s))) * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * P (z τ - z s - (τ - s) • v)) +
            (160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * P (z s))) * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (P (z τ - z s)) ^ 2))
          (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h1.add h2
      refine h_sum.congr (fun τ => ?_)
      dsimp [C_s, P, p]
      ring
    have h_deriv_δΨ : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (fun τ => Ψ τ x) (δΨ_s x) s := by
      intro x
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hCs_tendsto
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => by positivity)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, smul_eq_mul]
      have h_pt := (h_peetre_τ τ).2.2.1 x
      have h_inv_le_one : (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith)
      have h_le_Cs : |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * δΨ_s x| ≤ C_s τ := by
        calc |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * δΨ_s x|
          _ ≤ C_s τ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := h_pt
          _ ≤ C_s τ * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_le_one (hCs_nn τ)
          _ = C_s τ := mul_one _
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le_Cs (by positivity)
    have h_neg_F_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, -F s x = δΨ_s x :=
      fun x => (h_pw s x).unique (h_deriv_δΨ x)
    have hFs_eq : F s = fun x => -δΨ_s x := by
      ext x
      have := h_neg_F_eq x
      linarith
    have hFs_int : Integrable (F s) volume := by
      rw [hFs_eq]
      exact hδΨs_int.neg
    refine ⟨hΨs_int, hFs_int, ?_⟩

  have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun τ : ℝ => ‖L ((τ - s)⁻¹ • (u τ - u s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (τ - s)))‖)
      (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    rw [← h_normL_zero]
    exact (h_cont_normL.tendsto 0).comp h_inv_smul
  have h_I_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
      (fun τ : ℝ => ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ‖I (u τ) - I (u s) - (τ - s) • I v‖)
      (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_upper_tendsto
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => by positivity)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => ?_)
    change ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ‖I (u τ) - I (u s) - (τ - s) • I v‖ ≤
      ‖L ((τ - s)⁻¹ • (u τ - u s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (τ - s)))‖
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, map_smul, norm_smul, norm_inv, ← h_I_rem τ]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_norm_le _) (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _))
  have h_I_deriv : HasDerivAt (fun τ => I (u τ)) (I v) s :=
    hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto.mpr h_I_tendsto
  have h_half_deriv := h_I_deriv.const_mul (1 / 2 : ℝ)
  dsimp [I] at h_half_deriv
  simp_rw [hv_eq] at h_half_deriv
  exact h_half_deriv

informal_problem.statement:
∃ δ_dom : ℝ, 0 < δ_dom ∧
      ∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), IsSchwartzSolution u →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (s : ℝ), ‖ι (u s)‖ ≤ δ_dom →
        ∃ (V : Set ℝ) (bound : ℝ → ℝ),
          V ∈ nhds s ∧
          (∀ τ ∈ V, AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => rhoDensity κ (u τ) x) volume) ∧
          Integrable (fun x : ℝ => rhoDensity κ (u s) x) volume ∧
          AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => rhoDerivDensity κ (u s) (kdvRHS (u s)) x) volume ∧
          (∀ x : ℝ, ∀ τ ∈ V, ‖rhoDerivDensity κ (u τ) (kdvRHS (u τ)) x‖ ≤ bound x) ∧
          Integrable bound volume
