proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 8, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro u hu κ hκ s hs
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_cont_iota : Continuous (fun t => ι (u t)) :=
    schwartz_solution_continuous_hm1 u hu
  have h_cont_u : Continuous u := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t
    obtain ⟨v, h_deriv, _⟩ := hu t
    have h_inv_smul := h_deriv.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
    have h_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => t' - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [sub_self] using (continuousAt_id.sub (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => t) t)).tendsto
    have h_smul_zero : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ • (u t' - u t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t))))
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_sub_tendsto.smul h_inv_smul
    have h_rem_eq : (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ • (u t' - u t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t)))) =
        (fun t' : ℝ => u t' - u t - (t' - t) • v) := by
      ext t' : 1
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
      by_cases h_eq : t' = t
      · subst h_eq; simp
      · rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq), one_smul]
    rw [h_rem_eq] at h_smul_zero
    have h_lin : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => u t + (t' - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds (u t)) := by
      simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := u t)).add (h_sub_tendsto.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v)))
    have h_sum := h_smul_zero.add h_lin
    have h_sum_eq : (fun t' : ℝ => (u t' - u t - (t' - t) • v) + (u t + (t' - t) • v)) = u := by
      ext t' : 1; abel
    simpa [h_sum_eq, zero_add] using h_sum
  let P : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → ℝ := fun n f =>
    2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n) f + (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 n) f)
  have h_sem_cont : ∀ k n : ℕ, Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n) f) := by
    intro k n
    rw [← SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
    exact (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, n)
  have hP_cont : ∀ n : ℕ, Continuous (P n) :=
    fun n => continuous_const.mul ((h_sem_cont 0 n).add (h_sem_cont 4 n))
  have hP_nn : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), 0 ≤ P n f := by
    intro n f
    dsimp [P]
    have h0 : 0 ≤ (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n) f := apply_nonneg _ _
    have h4 : 0 ≤ (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 n) f := apply_nonneg _ _
    linarith
  have hP_bound : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ),
      |iteratedDeriv n f y| ≤ P n f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 ∧
      |iteratedDeriv n f y| ≤ P n f := by
    intro n f y
    set D : ℝ := |iteratedDeriv n f y|
    have hD_nn : 0 ≤ D := abs_nonneg _
    have h0 := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 n f y
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h0
    have h4 := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 4 n f y
    have hy4 : |y| ^ 4 = y ^ 4 := by
      calc |y| ^ 4 = (|y| ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
        _ = y ^ 4 := by ring
    rw [hy4, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h4
    have h_poly : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 4) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - y ^ 2)]
    have h_mul : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D ≤ P n f := by
      calc (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D
        _ ≤ (2 * (1 + y ^ 4)) * D := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_poly hD_nn
        _ = 2 * (D + y ^ 4 * D) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n) f + (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 n) f) := by
          linarith [h0, h4]
        _ = P n f := rfl
    have h_pos : 0 < 1 + y ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_ne : 1 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_pos
    have h_decay : D ≤ P n f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      calc D = ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
            field_simp [h_ne]
        _ ≤ P n f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by positivity)
    have h_unif : D ≤ P n f := by
      have h_one_le : 1 ≤ (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y]
      calc D = 1 * D := (one_mul D).symm
        _ ≤ (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_one_le hD_nn
        _ ≤ P n f := h_mul
    exact ⟨h_decay, h_unif⟩
  let Φ_sem : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → ℝ := fun f => P 0 f + P 3 f + 6 * P 0 f * P 1 f
  have hΦ_cont : Continuous Φ_sem :=
    ((hP_cont 0).add (hP_cont 3)).add ((continuous_const.mul (hP_cont 0)).mul (hP_cont 1))
  have hΦ_nn : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), 0 ≤ Φ_sem f := by
    intro f
    dsimp [Φ_sem]
    have := hP_nn 0 f
    have := hP_nn 1 f
    have := hP_nn 3 f
    positivity
  have hΦ_f : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), |f y| ≤ Φ_sem f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    intro f y
    have h0 := (hP_bound 0 f y).1
    rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0
    have h_le : P 0 f ≤ Φ_sem f := by
      dsimp [Φ_sem]
      have := hP_nn 0 f
      have := hP_nn 1 f
      have := hP_nn 3 f
      nlinarith
    exact le_trans h0 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_le (by positivity))
  have hΦ_kdv : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), |kdvRHS f y| ≤ Φ_sem f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    intro f y
    have h0_unif := (hP_bound 0 f y).2
    rw [iteratedDeriv_zero] at h0_unif
    have h1_dec := (hP_bound 1 f y).1
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one] at h1_dec
    have h3_dec := (hP_bound 3 f y).1
    have h_tri : |kdvRHS f y| ≤ |iteratedDeriv 3 f y| + 6 * |f y| * |deriv f y| := by
      dsimp [kdvRHS]
      calc |-(iteratedDeriv 3 f y) + 6 * f y * deriv f y|
        _ ≤ |-(iteratedDeriv 3 f y)| + |6 * f y * deriv f y| := abs_add_le _ _
        _ = |iteratedDeriv 3 f y| + 6 * |f y| * |deriv f y| := by
          rw [abs_neg, abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)]
    have h_prod : |f y| * |deriv f y| ≤ P 0 f * (P 1 f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul h0_unif h1_dec (abs_nonneg _) (hP_nn 0 f)
    have h_le : P 3 f + 6 * P 0 f * P 1 f ≤ Φ_sem f := by
      dsimp [Φ_sem]
      linarith [hP_nn 0 f]
    calc |kdvRHS f y|
      _ ≤ |iteratedDeriv 3 f y| + 6 * (|f y| * |deriv f y|) := by linarith [h_tri]
      _ ≤ P 3 f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 + 6 * (P 0 f * (P 1 f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)) := by
        linarith [h3_dec, h_prod]
      _ = (P 3 f + 6 * P 0 f * P 1 f) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ Φ_sem f * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_le (by positivity)
  set M : ℝ := Φ_sem (u s) + 1
  have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := by linarith [hΦ_nn (u s)]
  set V : Set ℝ := {τ : ℝ | ‖ι (u τ)‖ < 1 / 4} ∩ {τ : ℝ | Φ_sem (u τ) < M}
  have hV_open : IsOpen V :=
    (isOpen_lt h_cont_iota.norm continuous_const).inter
      (isOpen_lt (hΦ_cont.comp h_cont_u) continuous_const)
  have hs_in_V : s ∈ V := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change ‖ι (u s)‖ < 1 / 4; linarith
    · change Φ_sem (u s) < Φ_sem (u s) + 1; linarith
  have hV_nhds : V ∈ nhds s := hV_open.mem_nhds hs_in_V
  have hV_ball : ∀ τ ∈ V, ‖ι (u τ)‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := fun τ hτ => le_of_lt hτ.1
  have hV_u : ∀ τ ∈ V, ∀ y : ℝ, |u τ y| ≤ M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
    fun τ hτ y => le_trans (hΦ_f (u τ) y) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hτ.2) (by positivity))
  have hV_kdv : ∀ τ ∈ V, ∀ y : ℝ, |kdvRHS (u τ) y| ≤ M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
    fun τ hτ y => le_trans (hΦ_kdv (u τ) y) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (le_of_lt hτ.2) (by positivity))
  have h_peetre : ∀ x y : ℝ,
      ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) ≤ 8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro x y
    set t : ℝ := |y - x|
    have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := abs_nonneg _
    have ht_sq : t ^ 2 = (y - x) ^ 2 := sq_abs (y - x)
    have h_exp_half : 1 + t / 2 ≤ Real.exp (t / 2) := by
      linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (t / 2)]
    have h_exp_sq : (1 + t / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (κ * t) := by
      have h1 : (1 + t / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (t / 2) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_exp_half 2
      have h2 : Real.exp (t / 2) ^ 2 = Real.exp t := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, add_halves]
      have h3 : Real.exp t ≤ Real.exp (κ * t) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_mul_of_one_le_left ht_nn hκ)
      linarith
    have h_t_sq : 1 + t ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.exp (κ * t) := by
      have h_alg : 1 + t ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (1 + t / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have h_x_sq : 1 + x ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * y - x), sq_nonneg (y - x), sq_nonneg (y * (y - x)), ht_sq]
    have h_x_exp : 1 + x ^ 2 ≤ 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * Real.exp (κ * t) := by
      calc 1 + x ^ 2
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2) := h_x_sq
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (4 * Real.exp (κ * t)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_t_sq (by positivity)
        _ = 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * Real.exp (κ * t) := by ring
    have h_prod_exp : (1 + x ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * t) ≤ 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) := by
      have h_cancel : Real.exp (κ * t) * Real.exp (-κ * t) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, show κ * t + -κ * t = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * t)
        _ ≤ (8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * Real.exp (κ * t)) * Real.exp (-κ * t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_x_exp (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (Real.exp (κ * t) * Real.exp (-κ * t)) := by ring
        _ = 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) := by rw [h_cancel, mul_one]
    have hx_ne : 1 + x ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
    have hy_ne : 1 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
    calc ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * t)
      _ = ((1 + x ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * t)) * ((1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) := by
        field_simp [hx_ne, hy_ne]
      _ ≤ (8 * (1 + y ^ 2)) * ((1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod_exp (by positivity)
      _ = 8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [hx_ne, hy_ne]
  have h_peel_lemma : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ) →
      (∀ y : ℝ, |w y| ≤ M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ w p.1 p.2) ∧
      Continuous (diagGreen κ w) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, |greenKernel κ w x y| ≤ 1 / κ) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |diagGreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ)| ≤ (4 * π * M / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ x y : ℝ, |greenKernel κ w y x| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + (4 * π * M / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    intro w h_pt hw_decay
    have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) := by
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]; fun_prop
    have h_fg_pos : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel κ a b := by
      intro a b; dsimp [freeGreenKernel]; positivity
    have h_fg_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ a b| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      intro a b
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (2 * κ)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity)
        (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a - b)]))
    have h_iter_cont : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2) := by
      intro ℓ
      induction ℓ with
      | zero => exact h_fg_cont
      | succ ℓ ih =>
        let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z p.2
        let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * ‖w z‖
        have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume := w.integrable.norm.const_mul _
        have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
          intro p
          have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
            ih.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
          have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
            h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
          exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
        have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p z‖ ≤ bound z := by
          intro p
          filter_upwards with z
          dsimp [F, bound]
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          have h1 := h_pt ℓ p.1 z
          have h2 := h_fg_bound z p.2
          calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|
            _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|) * |w z| := by ring
            _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * |w z| :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)) (abs_nonneg _)
        have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p z) := by
          filter_upwards with z
          dsimp [F]
          have h_c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
            ih.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
          have h_c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
            h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
          exact (h_c1.mul continuous_const).mul h_c2
        exact (continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont).neg
    have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) :=
      summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h_geom_tsum : (∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) = 4 / 3 := by
      rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
      norm_num
    let u_geom : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ
    have hu_sum : Summable u_geom := h_geom_sum.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ))
    have hu_tsum : (∑' ℓ : ℕ, u_geom ℓ) = 2 / (3 * κ) := by
      calc ∑' ℓ : ℕ, u_geom ℓ
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := tsum_mul_left
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (4 / 3) := by rw [h_geom_tsum]
        _ = 2 / (3 * κ) := by ring
    have hG_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ w p.1 p.2) :=
      continuous_tsum h_iter_cont hu_sum (fun ℓ p => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_pt ℓ p.1 p.2)
    have hg_cont : Continuous (diagGreen κ w) :=
      hG_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_id)
    have h_iter_sum : ∀ a b : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b) :=
      fun a b => Summable.of_norm_bounded hu_sum (fun ℓ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_pt ℓ a b)
    have hG_le : ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenKernel κ w x y| ≤ 1 / κ := by
      intro x y
      calc |greenKernel κ w x y|
        _ = ‖∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y‖ := by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; rfl
        _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y‖ :=
          norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (h_iter_sum x y).norm
        _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, u_geom ℓ :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun ℓ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_pt ℓ x y)
            (h_iter_sum x y).norm hu_sum

          calc (M / (2 * κ ^ 2)) * (((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|))
            _ ≤ (M / (2 * κ ^ 2)) * (8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_peetre x y) (by positivity)
            _ = (4 * M / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        have h_term2 : ((4 * π * M ^ 2 / κ ^ 3) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) ≤
            (4 * π * M ^ 2 / κ ^ 3) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_sq_le (by positivity)
        calc |greenKernel κ w x y| * |v y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|
          _ ≤ ((1 / κ) * (M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)) *
              ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + (4 * π * M / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul h_prod12 h3 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (M / (2 * κ ^ 2)) * (((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|)) +
              ((4 * π * M ^ 2 / κ ^ 3) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) := by ring
          _ ≤ (4 * M / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ +
              (4 * π * M ^ 2 / κ ^ 3) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
          _ = D_x * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by dsimp [D_x]; ring
      have h_dom_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => D_x * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) volume :=
        integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul D_x
      have hFGx_int : Integrable (F_G x) volume :=
        h_dom_int.mono' (hFG_meas x) (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hFG_pw)
      have hIG_le : |∫ y : ℝ, F_G x y| ≤ D_x * π := by
        calc |∫ y : ℝ, F_G x y|
          _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, ‖F_G x y‖ := by simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F_G x)
          _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, D_x * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_mono hFGx_int.norm h_dom_int hFG_pw
          _ = D_x * ∫ y : ℝ, (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul D_x _
          _ = D_x * π := by rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
      set g : ℝ := diagGreen κ w x
      have hg_low : 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ g := hg_ge x
      have h_2gsq_low : 1 / (8 * κ ^ 2) ≤ 2 * g ^ 2 := by
        have h_sq : (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2 ≤ g ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) hg_low 2
        have h_id : 2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2 = 1 / (8 * κ ^ 2) := by field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
        linarith
      have h_inv_2gsq : (2 * g ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 8 * κ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← one_div]
        have h1 : 1 / (2 * g ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (1 / (8 * κ ^ 2)) :=
          one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) h_2gsq_low
        have h2 : 1 / (1 / (8 * κ ^ 2)) = 8 * κ ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]
        linarith
      have h_inv_κ_le : 1 / κ ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ hκ (le_of_lt hκ_pos)
      have h_first : |-(∫ y : ℝ, F_G x y) / (2 * g ^ 2)| ≤
          (32 * π * M + 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [abs_div, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x))), div_eq_mul_inv]
        have h_prod : |∫ y : ℝ, F_G x y| * (2 * g ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (D_x * π) * (8 * κ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul hIG_le h_inv_2gsq (by positivity) (by positivity)
        have h_alg : (D_x * π) * (8 * κ ^ 2) =
            (32 * π * M + 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * (1 / κ)) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [D_x]; field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
        have h_le_one : 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * (1 / κ) ≤ 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) h_inv_κ_le
        have h_coef_le : (32 * π * M + 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2 * (1 / κ)) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤
            (32 * π * M + 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_tri : |rhoDerivDensity κ w v x| ≤
          |-(∫ y : ℝ, F_G x y) / (2 * g ^ 2)| +
          |(1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y| :=
        abs_add_le _ _
      linarith [hv_conv_bound x]
    exact ⟨h_rho_cont, h_rho_bound, h_deriv_cont, h_deriv_bound⟩
  let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (36 * π * M + 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹
  have h_tau : ∀ τ ∈ V,
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => rhoDensity κ (u τ) x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |rhoDensity κ (u τ) x| ≤ (20 * π * M) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) ∧
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => rhoDerivDensity κ (u τ) (kdvRHS (u τ)) x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, |rhoDerivDensity κ (u τ) (kdvRHS (u τ)) x| ≤ bound x) := by
    intro τ hτ
    obtain ⟨v_τ, _, hv_τ_eq⟩ := hu τ
    have hv_fun : (v_τ : ℝ → ℝ) = kdvRHS (u τ) := funext hv_τ_eq
    have hv_decay : ∀ y : ℝ, |v_τ y| ≤ M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
      intro y
      rw [hv_τ_eq y]
      exact hV_kdv τ hτ y
    have h_pt_τ : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
        |greenIterKernel κ (u τ) ℓ a b| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ := by
      intro ℓ a b
      calc |greenIterKernel κ (u τ) ℓ a b|
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι (u τ)‖ ^ ℓ := greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound κ hκ (u τ) ℓ a b
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hV_ball τ hτ) ℓ) (by positivity)
    obtain ⟨hG_cont, hg_cont, hG_le, hg_ge, hg_diff, hG_peel⟩ :=
      h_peel_lemma (u τ) h_pt_τ (hV_u τ hτ)
    obtain ⟨h_rho_cont, h_rho_bound, h_deriv_cont, h_deriv_bound⟩ :=
      h_dom_lemma (u τ) v_τ hG_cont hg_cont hG_le hg_ge hg_diff hG_peel (hV_u τ hτ) hv_decay
    rw [hv_fun] at h_deriv_cont h_deriv_bound
    exact ⟨h_rho_cont, h_rho_bound, h_deriv_cont, h_deriv_bound⟩
  obtain ⟨hs_rho_cont, hs_rho_bound, hs_deriv_cont, _⟩ := h_tau s hs_in_V
  refine ⟨V, bound, hV_nhds, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro τ hτ
    exact (h_tau τ hτ).1.aestronglyMeasurable
  · refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (20 * π * M)).mono'
      hs_rho_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact hs_rho_bound x
  · exact hs_deriv_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
  · intro x τ hτ
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact (h_tau τ hτ).2.2.2 x
  · exact integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (36 * π * M + 32 * π ^ 2 * M ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:

informal_problem.statement:
∃ δ_weyl : ℝ, 0 < δ_weyl ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_weyl →
      ∀ (y : ℝ),
        ∫ x : ℝ, (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) =
          diagGreen κ w y

signature.name: greenKernel_sq_div_diagGreen_sq_integral
signature.statement:
∃ δ_weyl : ℝ, 0 < δ_weyl ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_weyl →
      ∀ (y : ℝ),
        ∫ x : ℝ, (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) =

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 4, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ w hw y
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_diag_d := greenIterKernel_diag_hasDerivAt κ hκ w
  obtain ⟨h_symm, h_off_d1, h_off_d2, h_off_bd⟩ :=
    greenIterKernel_offDiag_hasDerivAt_and_symm κ hκ w
  obtain ⟨h_G_symm, h_diag, h_eq_LR, h_jump_LR, h_d1_LR, h_d2_LR⟩ :=
    greenKernel_halfLine_ode_and_jump κ hκ w hw h_diag_d h_symm h_off_d1 h_off_d2 h_off_bd
  obtain ⟨h_tend_L, h_tend_R, h_tend_F, h_int⟩ :=
    greenKernel_halfLine_tendsto_and_integrable κ hκ w hw
  have h_diag_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < diagGreen κ w x := by
    intro x
    have h_low : 0 < 1 / (4 * κ) := by positivity
    exact lt_of_lt_of_le h_low (h_diag x).1
  have h_wronsk_L : ∀ x : ℝ, x ≤ y →
      2 * diagGreen κ w x * greenDerivLeft κ w y x -
        diagGreenDeriv κ w x * greenKernelLeft κ w y x =
        greenKernelLeft κ w y x := by
    intro x hx
    let W_L : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      greenKernelLeft κ w x ξ * greenDerivLeft κ w y ξ -
        greenDerivLeft κ w x ξ * greenKernelLeft κ w y ξ
    have hW_L_deriv : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Iic x, HasDerivAt W_L 0 ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ_x : ξ ≤ x := hξ
      have hξ_y : ξ ≤ y := le_trans hξ_x hx
      have hd1_x := (h_d1_LR x ξ).1
      have hd2_x := (h_d2_LR x ξ).1 hξ_x
      have hd1_y := (h_d1_LR y ξ).1
      have hd2_y := (h_d2_LR y ξ).1 hξ_y
      refine ((hd1_x.mul hd2_y).sub (hd2_x.mul hd1_y)).congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hW_L_cont : ContinuousWithinAt W_L (Set.Iic x) x :=
      (hW_L_deriv x Set.right_mem_Iic).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hW_L_io : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Iio x, HasDerivAt W_L 0 ξ :=
      fun ξ hξ => hW_L_deriv ξ (Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self hξ)
    have hW_L_tend : Filter.Tendsto W_L Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by
      have ht := ((h_tend_L x).1.mul (h_tend_L y).2).sub ((h_tend_L x).2.mul (h_tend_L y).1)
      simpa using ht
    have h_int_W_L := MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      hW_L_cont hW_L_io MeasureTheory.integrableOn_zero hW_L_tend
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero, sub_zero] at h_int_W_L
    have hW_L_zero : W_L x = 0 := h_int_W_L.symm
    dsimp [W_L] at hW_L_zero
    have h_gx : greenKernelLeft κ w x x = diagGreen κ w x :=
      (h_eq_LR x x).1 le_rfl
    have h_dgx : greenDerivLeft κ w x x = (diagGreenDeriv κ w x + 1) / 2 :=
      (h_jump_LR x).1
    rw [h_gx, h_dgx] at hW_L_zero
    linarith
  have h_wronsk_R : ∀ x : ℝ, y ≤ x →
      2 * diagGreen κ w x * greenDerivRight κ w y x -
        diagGreenDeriv κ w x * greenKernelRight κ w y x =
        -greenKernelRight κ w y x := by
    intro x hx
    let W_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
      greenKernelRight κ w x ξ * greenDerivRight κ w y ξ -
        greenDerivRight κ w x ξ * greenKernelRight κ w y ξ
    have hW_R_deriv : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Ici x, HasDerivAt W_R 0 ξ := by
      intro ξ hξ
      have hξ_x : x ≤ ξ := hξ
      have hξ_y : y ≤ ξ := le_trans hx hξ_x
      have hd1_x := (h_d1_LR x ξ).2
      have hd2_x := (h_d2_LR x ξ).2 hξ_x
      have hd1_y := (h_d1_LR y ξ).2
      have hd2_y := (h_d2_LR y ξ).2 hξ_y
      refine ((hd1_x.mul hd2_y).sub (hd2_x.mul hd1_y)).congr_deriv ?_
      ring
    have hW_R_cont : ContinuousWithinAt W_R (Set.Ici x) x :=
      (hW_R_deriv x Set.left_mem_Ici).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hW_R_oi : ∀ ξ ∈ Set.Ioi x, HasDerivAt W_R 0 ξ :=
      fun ξ hξ => hW_R_deriv ξ (Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self hξ)
    have hW_R_tend : Filter.Tendsto W_R Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have ht := ((h_tend_R x).1.mul (h_tend_R y).2).sub ((h_tend_R x).2.mul (h_tend_R y).1)
      simpa using ht
    have h_int_W_R := MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      hW_R_cont hW_R_oi MeasureTheory.integrableOn_zero hW_R_tend
    rw [MeasureTheory.integral_zero, zero_sub] at h_int_W_R
    have hW_R_zero : W_R x = 0 := by linarith
    dsimp [W_R] at hW_R_zero
    have h_gx : greenKernelRight κ w x x = diagGreen κ w x :=
      (h_eq_LR x x).2 le_rfl
    have h_dgx : greenDerivRight κ w x x = (diagGreenDeriv κ w x - 1) / 2 :=
      (h_jump_LR x).2
    rw [h_gx, h_dgx] at hW_R_zero
    linarith
  let f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
    (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)
  let F_L : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x)
  let F_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => -((greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x))
  have hF_L_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Iic y, HasDerivAt F_L (f x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h2g_ne : 2 * diagGreen κ w x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [h_diag_pos x])
    have hd_num : HasDerivAt (fun x' => (greenKernelLeft κ w y x') ^ 2)
        (2 * greenKernelLeft κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivLeft κ w y x) x :=
      ((h_d1_LR y x).1).pow 2
    have hd_den : HasDerivAt (fun x' => 2 * diagGreen κ w x')
        (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x :=
      ((h_diag x).2).const_mul 2
    refine (hd_num.div hd_den h2g_ne).congr_deriv ?_
    have hw_L := h_wronsk_L x hx
    have h_eq_y : greenKernelLeft κ w y x = greenKernel κ w y x := (h_eq_LR y x).1 hx
    have h_sym_xy : greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x := h_G_symm x y
    have h_num_eq :
        (2 * greenKernelLeft κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivLeft κ w y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w x) -
          greenKernelLeft κ w y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x)) =
        2 * (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 := by
      calc (2 * greenKernelLeft κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivLeft κ w y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w x) -
            greenKernelLeft κ w y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x))
        _ = 2 * greenKernelLeft κ w y x *
              (2 * diagGreen κ w x * greenDerivLeft κ w y x -
                diagGreenDeriv κ w x * greenKernelLeft κ w y x) := by ring
        _ = 2 * greenKernelLeft κ w y x * greenKernelLeft κ w y x := by rw [hw_L]
        _ = 2 * (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 := by ring
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h_num_eq, h_eq_y, h_sym_xy]
    ring
  have hF_R_deriv : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ici y, HasDerivAt F_R (f x) x := by
    intro x hx
    have h2g_ne : 2 * diagGreen κ w x ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by linarith [h_diag_pos x])
    have hd_num : HasDerivAt (fun x' => (greenKernelRight κ w y x') ^ 2)
        (2 * greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w y x) x :=
      ((h_d1_LR y x).2).pow 2
    have hd_den : HasDerivAt (fun x' => 2 * diagGreen κ w x')
        (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x :=
      ((h_diag x).2).const_mul 2
    refine ((hd_num.div hd_den h2g_ne).neg).congr_deriv ?_
    have hw_R := h_wronsk_R x hx
    have h_eq_y : greenKernelRight κ w y x = greenKernel κ w y x := (h_eq_LR y x).2 hx
    have h_sym_xy : greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x := h_G_symm x y
    have h_num_eq :
        -((2 * greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w x) -
          greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x)) / (2 * diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) =
        2 * (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2 := by
      have h_top :
          (2 * greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w x) -
            greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x)) =
          -2 * (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 := by
        calc (2 * greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 1 * greenDerivRight κ w y x * (2 * diagGreen κ w x) -
              greenKernelRight κ w y x ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreenDeriv κ w x))
          _ = 2 * greenKernelRight κ w y x *
                (2 * diagGreen κ w x * greenDerivRight κ w y x -
                  diagGreenDeriv κ w x * greenKernelRight κ w y x) := by ring
          _ = 2 * greenKernelRight κ w y x * (-greenKernelRight κ w y x) := by rw [hw_R]
          _ = -2 * (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 := by ring
      rw [h_top]
      ring
    dsimp [f]
    rw [h_num_eq, h_eq_y, h_sym_xy]
    ring
  have h_int_L : ∫ x in Set.Iic y, f x = F_L y - 0 := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    · exact (hF_L_deriv y Set.right_mem_Iic).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun x hx => hF_L_deriv x (Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self hx)
    · exact (h_int y).integrableOn
    · exact (h_tend_F y).1
  have h_int_R : ∫ x in Set.Ioi y, f x = 0 - F_R y := by
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
    · exact (hF_R_deriv y Set.left_mem_Ici).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    · exact fun x hx => hF_R_deriv x (Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self hx)
    · exact (h_int y).integrableOn
    · exact (h_tend_F y).2
  have h_split : (∫ x : ℝ, f x) = (∫ x in Set.Iic y, f x) + (∫ x in Set.Ioi y, f x) := by
    rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
    exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic (h_int y)).symm
  change (∫ x : ℝ, f x) = diagGreen κ w y
  rw [h_split, h_int_L, h_int_R]
  dsimp [F_L, F_R]
  have h_gy_L : greenKernelLeft κ w y y = diagGreen κ w y := (h_eq_LR y y).1 le_rfl
  have h_gy_R : greenKernelRight κ w y y = diagGreen κ w y := (h_eq_LR y y).2 le_rfl
  have h_gy_ne : diagGreen κ w y ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (h_diag_pos y)
  rw [h_gy_L, h_gy_R]
  field_simp
  ring

subgoal_signatures.name: greenKernel_halfLine_ode_and_jump
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),

      _ = C_mx * π := by rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]

  have hG_peel : ∀ x y : ℝ,

    intro x y

    have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B_x := by dsimp [B_x]; positivity
    have h_sum_m : Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y x) :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom_sum.mul_left B_x)
        (fun m => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_peel_step m y x)
    have h_peel_sum : |greenKernel κ w y x - freeGreenKernel κ y x| ≤ (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      calc |greenKernel κ w y x - freeGreenKernel κ y x|
        _ = ‖∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y x‖ := by rw [h_peel_eq y x, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y x‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_m.norm
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, B_x * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_peel_step m y x)
            h_sum_m.norm (h_geom_sum.mul_left B_x)
        _ = B_x * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
        _ = B_x * (4 / 3) := by rw [h_geom_tsum]
        _ ≤ B_x * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by norm_num) hB_nn
        _ = (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by dsimp [B_x]; ring
    have h_tri : |greenKernel κ w y x| ≤
        |freeGreenKernel κ y x| + |greenKernel κ w y x - freeGreenKernel κ y x| := by
      have h_id : greenKernel κ w y x =
          freeGreenKernel κ y x + (greenKernel κ w y x - freeGreenKernel κ y x) := by ring
      calc |greenKernel κ w y x|
        _ = |freeGreenKernel κ y x + (greenKernel κ w y x - freeGreenKernel κ y x)| :=
          congr_arg abs h_id
        _ ≤ |freeGreenKernel κ y x| + |greenKernel κ w y x - freeGreenKernel κ y x| :=
          abs_add_le _ _
    have h_fg_eq : |freeGreenKernel κ y x| = (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) :=
      abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_pos y x)
    linarith [h_peel_sum]
  have h_exp_two_kappa_int : ∀ y : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) = 1 / κ := by
    intro y
    set b : ℝ := 2 * κ
    have hb_pos : 0 < b := by positivity
    have hb_ne : b ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hb_pos
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => -Real.exp (-b * u) / b
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
      dsimp [F]; fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ u ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-b * u)) u := by
      intro u _
      have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => -b * u) (-b) u := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_mul (-b)
      have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-b * u)) (Real.exp (-b * u) * (-b)) u :=
        h1.exp
      have h3 : HasDerivAt F (-(Real.exp (-b * u) * (-b)) / b) u :=
        (h2.neg).div_const b
      refine h3.congr_deriv ?_
      field_simp [hb_ne]
    have h_int_Ioi_b : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-b * u)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume :=
      exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hb_pos
    have hF_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => b * u) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hb_pos Filter.tendsto_id
      have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun u : ℝ => -b * u) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot := by
        have h_eq : (fun u : ℝ => -b * u) = (fun u : ℝ => -(b * u)) := by ext u; ring

        Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp h2
      have h4 : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds (-0 / b)) :=
        (h3.neg).div_const b
      simpa using h4
    have h_Ioi_val : (∫ u in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-b * u)) = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      rw [integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv h_int_Ioi_b hF_tendsto]
      dsimp [F, b]
      rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
      ring
    let g0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => Real.exp (-b * |u|)
    have hg0_eq_Ioi : Set.EqOn g0 (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-b * u)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
      intro u hu

    have hg0_int_Ioi : IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Ioi 0) volume :=
      h_int_Ioi_b.congr_fun hg0_eq_Ioi.symm measurableSet_Ioi
    have h_Ioi_g0 : (∫ u in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), g0 u) = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi hg0_eq_Ioi]
      exact h_Ioi_val
    have hg0_int_Ici : IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Ici 0) volume := by

    have hg0_even : ∀ u : ℝ, g0 (-u) = g0 u := by
      intro u; dsimp [g0]; rw [abs_neg]
    have hg0_int_Iic : IntegrableOn g0 (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h_comp := hg0_int_Ici.comp_neg
      simpa [hg0_even] using h_comp
    have h_Iic_g0 : (∫ u in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), g0 u) = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g0
      simp only [neg_zero, hg0_even] at h_neg
      rw [h_neg, h_Ioi_g0]
    have h_univ_g0 : (∫ u : ℝ, g0 u) = 1 / κ := by
      rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hg0_int_Iic hg0_int_Ioi, h_Iic_g0, h_Ioi_g0]
      field_simp [hκ_ne]
      ring
    have h_shift : (∫ x : ℝ, g0 (x - y)) = ∫ u : ℝ, g0 u :=
      integral_sub_right_eq_self g0 y
    have h_fun_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|)) = (fun x : ℝ => g0 (x - y)) := by
      ext x; dsimp [g0, b]; ring_nf
    rw [h_fun_eq, h_shift, h_univ_g0]
  let F2 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x y => (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y)
  have hF2_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry F2) := by
    have : Function.uncurry F2 = fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * |p.1 - p.2|) * v p.2) := rfl
    rw [this]
    have := v.continuous
    fun_prop
  have hF2_pw : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖Function.uncurry F2 p‖ ≤ ((4 * M_v) * (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro ⟨x, y⟩
    change |(1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y)| ≤ ((4 * M_v) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) ≤ Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) := by
      rw [abs_sub_comm x y]
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (y - x)])
    have h_prod : Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * |v y| ≤
        Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) * (M_v * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) :=
      mul_le_mul h_exp_le (hv_decay y) (abs_nonneg _) (Real.exp_nonneg _)
    calc (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * |v y|)
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) * (M_v * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_prod (by norm_num)
      _ = ((1 / 2) * M_v) * (((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|)) := by ring
      _ ≤ ((1 / 2) * M_v) * (8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_peetre x y) (by positivity)
      _ = ((4 * M_v) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
  have h_dom2 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ((4 * M_v) * (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) (volume.prod volume) :=
    (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (4 * M_v)).mul_prod integrable_inv_one_add_sq
  have hF2_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry F2) (volume.prod volume) :=
    h_dom2.mono' hF2_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF2_pw)
  have h_pull2_eq : (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y) =
      (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y : ℝ, F2 x y) := by
    ext x
    dsimp [F2]
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
  have hT2_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y) volume := by
    rw [h_pull2_eq]
    exact hF2_int.integral_prod_left
  have hT2_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, (1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y) =
      ∫ x : ℝ, (1 / (2 * κ)) * v x := by
    rw [h_pull2_eq, integral_integral_swap hF2_int]
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
    have h_inner : (fun x : ℝ => F2 x y) = (fun x : ℝ => ((1 / 2) * v y) * Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|)) := by
      ext x; dsimp [F2]; ring
    dsimp only
    rw [h_inner, integral_const_mul, h_exp_two_kappa_int y]
    ring
  have hg_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < diagGreen κ w x :=
    fun x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hg_ge x)
  have h2gsq_ne : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun x => ne_of_gt (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x)))
  let F1 : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x y =>
    ((greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) * v y
  have hF1_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry F1) := by
    have : Function.uncurry F1 = fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      ((greenKernel κ w p.1 p.2 * greenKernel κ w p.2 p.1) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w p.1) ^ 2)) * v p.2 := rfl
    rw [this]
    have hG_swap : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ w p.2 p.1) :=
      hG_cont.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst)
    have hg_p1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => 2 * (diagGreen κ w p.1) ^ 2) :=
      continuous_const.mul ((hg_cont.comp continuous_fst).pow 2)
    have hv_p2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => v p.2) := v.continuous.comp continuous_snd
    exact (((hG_cont.mul hG_swap).div hg_p1 (fun p => h2gsq_ne p.1)).mul hv_p2)
  set C_wv : ℝ := 32 * M_v + 32 * π * M_w * M_v
  have hF1_pw : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ‖Function.uncurry F1 p‖ ≤ (C_wv * (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro ⟨x, y⟩
    change |((greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) * v y| ≤
      (C_wv * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹
    rw [abs_mul, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x)))]
    have h_denom : 1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) ≤ 8 * κ ^ 2 := by
      have h_sq : (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2 ≤ (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hg_ge x) 2
      have h1 : 1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2) :=
        one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq zero_le_two)
      have h2 : 1 / (2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2) = 8 * κ ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
      linarith
    have h_G_prod : |greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x| ≤
        (1 / κ) * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      mul_le_mul (hG_le x y) (hG_peel x y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
    have h_quot : (|greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) ≤
        4 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + 32 * π * M_w * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      calc (|greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)
        _ = (|greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|) * (1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((1 / κ) * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹)) *
            (8 * κ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul h_G_prod h_denom (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = 4 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + (32 * π * M_w / κ) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
        _ ≤ 4 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + 32 * π * M_w * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          have h_div_le : 32 * π * M_w / κ ≤ 32 * π * M_w :=
            div_le_self (by positivity) hκ
          have h_term : (32 * π * M_w / κ) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 32 * π * M_w * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div_le (by positivity)
          linarith
    have h_inv_sq_le : ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 ≤ (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      have h_inv_le_one : (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 1 := inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg y])
      calc ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 = (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := sq _
        _ ≤ 1 * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_le_one (by positivity)
        _ = (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := one_mul _
    calc ((|greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) * |v y|
      _ ≤ (4 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + 32 * π * M_w * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (M_v * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul h_quot (hv_decay y) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (4 * M_v) * (((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|)) +
          (32 * π * M_w * M_v * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (4 * M_v) * (8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) +
          (32 * π * M_w * M_v * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_peetre x y) (by positivity))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv_sq_le (by positivity))
      _ = (C_wv * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by dsimp [C_wv]; ring
  have h_dom1 : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (C_wv * (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + p.2 ^ 2)⁻¹) (volume.prod volume) :=
    (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul C_wv).mul_prod integrable_inv_one_add_sq
  have hF1_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry F1) (volume.prod volume) :=
    h_dom1.mono' hF1_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hF1_pw)
  have h_pull1_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -(∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y * v y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) =
      (fun x : ℝ => -∫ y : ℝ, F1 x y) := by
    ext x
    have h_inner_eq : (fun y : ℝ => (greenKernel κ w x y * v y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) =
        (fun y : ℝ => F1 x y) := by
      ext y; dsimp [F1]; ring
    rw [neg_div, ← integral_div, h_inner_eq]
  have hT1_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ =>
      -(∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y * v y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) volume := by
    rw [h_pull1_eq]
    exact hF1_int.integral_prod_left.neg
  have hgv_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen κ w x * v x) volume := by
    refine (v.integrable.norm.const_mul (1 / κ)).mono' (hg_cont.mul v.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hG_le x x) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hT1_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, -(∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y * v y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) =
      -∫ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x * v x := by
    rw [h_pull1_eq, integral_neg, integral_integral_swap hF1_int]
    congr 1
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun y => ?_))
    dsimp [F1]
    rw [integral_mul_const, h_weyl y]
  have h_kv_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * v x) volume :=
    v.integrable.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_rho_eq : (fun x : ℝ => rhoDerivDensity κ w v x) =
      (fun x : ℝ => (-(∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y * v y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) +
        ((1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y)) := rfl
  have h_rhs_eq : (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * v x - diagGreen κ w x * v x) =
      (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ) - diagGreen κ w x) * v x) := by
    ext x; ring
  calc ∫ x : ℝ, rhoDerivDensity κ w v x
    _ = (∫ x : ℝ, -(∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y * v y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) +
        (∫ x : ℝ, (1 / 2) * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * κ * |x - y|) * v y) := by
      rw [h_rho_eq, integral_add hT1_int hT2_int]
    _ = -(∫ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x * v x) + (∫ x : ℝ, (1 / (2 * κ)) * v x) := by
      rw [hT1_eq, hT2_eq]
    _ = (∫ x : ℝ, (1 / (2 * κ)) * v x) - (∫ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x * v x) := by ring
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ((1 / (2 * κ)) * v x - diagGreen κ w x * v x) :=
      (integral_sub h_kv_int hgv_int).symm
    _ = ∫ x : ℝ, (1 / (2 * κ) - diagGreen κ w x) * v x := by rw [h_rhs_eq]

(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :

proof.tactics:
by
  have hw_int : Integrable w := w.integrable
  have hw_norm_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |w z|) := hw_int.abs
  have hw_cont : Continuous w := w.continuous
  have h_s3 : ∀ (K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ × ℝ => K p.1 p.2.1 p.2.2) →
      (∀ x y z : ℝ, 0 ≤ K x y z) →

    have h_cont_fhat : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => ((4 / (4 + (2 * π * w) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
      refine Continuous.comp continuous_ofReal ?_
      exact Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun w => by positivity)
    have hF_int : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier f) volume := by
      rw [h_fourier]
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul 4).mono' h_cont_fhat.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with w
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have h_pi : 1 ≤ 2 * π := by linarith [Real.two_le_pi]
      have h_sq_le : w ^ 2 ≤ (2 * π * w) ^ 2 := by
        have : 1 * w ^ 2 ≤ (2 * π) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 := by
          apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (sq_nonneg w)
          nlinarith
        linarith
      have h_den : 1 + w ^ 2 ≤ 4 + (2 * π * w) ^ 2 := by linarith
      have h_inv : (4 + (2 * π * w) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + w ^ 2)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h_den
      rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
      gcongr
    have h_inv_eq := congr_fun (Continuous.fourierInv_fourier_eq hf_cont hf_int hF_int) u
    have h_re_inv := congr_arg Complex.re h_inv_eq
    have hfu : (f u).re = Real.exp (-2 * |u|) := ofReal_re _
    rw [Real.fourierInv_eq', h_fourier, hfu] at h_re_inv
    have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * inner ℝ v u) * I) • ((4 / (4 + (2 * π * v) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * inner ℝ v u) * I) • ((4 / (4 + (2 * π * v) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
        (by fun_prop : Continuous fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * inner ℝ v u) * I)).smul h_cont_fhat
      refine hF_int.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with v
      rw [h_fourier]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
      exact le_rfl
    rw [← RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, ← integral_re h_inv_int] at h_re_inv
    have h_re_integrand : (fun x : ℝ => RCLike.re (Complex.exp (↑(2 * π * inner ℝ x u) * I) • ((4 / (4 + (2 * π * x) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ))) =
        (fun w : ℝ => (4 / (4 + (2 * π * w) ^ 2)) * Real.cos (2 * π * w * u)) := by
      ext w
      rw [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re]
      simp only [smul_eq_mul, RCLike.inner_apply, starRingEnd_apply, star_trivial]
      rw [mul_comm (Complex.exp _), Complex.mul_re, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
          Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re]
      congr 2
      ring
    rw [h_re_integrand] at h_re_inv
    let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => 4 * (Real.cos (ξ * u) / (4 + ξ ^ 2))
    have h_G_comp : (fun w : ℝ => (4 / (4 + (2 * π * w) ^ 2)) * Real.cos (2 * π * w * u)) =
        (fun w : ℝ => G (2 * π * w)) := by
      ext w
      dsimp [G]
      ring
    rw [h_G_comp, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left G (2 * π)] at h_re_inv
    have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * π := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h_2pi_pos), smul_eq_mul] at h_re_inv
    dsimp [G] at h_re_inv
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h_re_inv
    have h_pi_ne : π ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    set I_val := ∫ ξ : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * u) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
    have h_alg : I_val = (π / 2) * ((2 * π)⁻¹ * (4 * I_val)) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h_alg, h_re_inv]
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
    intro q ξ x
    have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
    intro q ξ
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
  have s2 : (1 / 8) * (∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w y * w z) =
      (1 / 2) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    have hw_cont : Continuous (w : ℝ → ℝ) := w.continuous
    have hw_int : Integrable (w : ℝ → ℝ) volume := w.integrable
    have h_cos_w_int : ∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) volume := by
      intro ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) := by fun_prop
      refine hw_int.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with y
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Real.cos _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (Real.abs_cos_le_one _)
    have h_sin_w_int : ∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) volume := by
      intro ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) := by fun_prop
      refine hw_int.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with y
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Real.sin _)]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (norm_nonneg _) (Real.abs_sin_le_one _)
    have h_fl_re : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (fourierLine w ξ).re =
        (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y := by
      intro ξ
      unfold fourierLine
      rw [← ofReal_inv, Complex.mul_re, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero,
          ← RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, ← integral_re (integrable_fourier_integrand w ξ)]
      congr 2 with y
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * y) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, h_exp, mul_comm (Complex.exp _), Complex.mul_re,
          ofReal_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, sub_zero, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_re,
          Real.cos_neg, mul_comm]
    have h_fl_im : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (fourierLine w ξ).im =
        -(Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y := by
      intro ξ
      unfold fourierLine
      rw [← ofReal_inv, Complex.mul_im, ofReal_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero,
          ← RCLike.im_eq_complex_im, ← integral_im (integrable_fourier_integrand w ξ),
          neg_mul, ← mul_neg, ← integral_neg]
      congr 2 with y
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * y) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [RCLike.im_eq_complex_im, h_exp, mul_comm (Complex.exp _), Complex.mul_im,
          ofReal_re, ofReal_im, zero_mul, add_zero, Complex.exp_ofReal_mul_I_im,
          Real.sin_neg]
      ring
    have h_pw_xi : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) =
        (2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * w y * w z := by
      intro ξ
      rw [Complex.sq_norm, Complex.normSq_apply, h_fl_re ξ, h_fl_im ξ]
      let Ic : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * z) * w z
      let Is : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, Real.sin (ξ * z) * w z
      have h_sq_sqrt : ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹) ^ 2 = (2 * π)⁻¹ := by
        rw [inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      have h_factor :
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Ic * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Ic) +
            -(Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Is * (-(Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Is)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) =
          (2 * π)⁻¹ * ((4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Ic * Ic + Is * Is)) := by
        calc ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Ic * ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Ic) +
              -(Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Is * (-(Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * Is)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
          _ = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹) ^ 2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Ic * Ic + Is * Is)) := by ring
          _ = (2 * π)⁻¹ * ((4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Ic * Ic + Is * Is)) := by rw [h_sq_sqrt]
      rw [h_factor]
      congr 1
      have h_comb_y : Ic * Ic + Is * Is =
          ∫ y : ℝ, ((Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * Ic + (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * Is) := by
        have h1 : Ic * Ic = ∫ y : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * Ic := by
          dsimp [Ic]
          rw [integral_mul_const]
        have h2 : Is * Is = ∫ y : ℝ, (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * Is := by
          dsimp [Is]
          rw [integral_mul_const]
        rw [h1, h2, ← integral_add ((h_cos_w_int ξ).mul_const Ic) ((h_sin_w_int ξ).mul_const Is)]
      rw [h_comb_y, ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1 with y
      have h_comb_z : (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * Ic + (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * Is =
          ∫ z : ℝ, ((Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * (Real.cos (ξ * z) * w z) +
            (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * (Real.sin (ξ * z) * w z)) := by
        have h1 : (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * Ic =
            ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y) * (Real.cos (ξ * z) * w z) := by
          dsimp [Ic]
          rw [integral_const_mul]
        have h2 : (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * Is =
            ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y) * (Real.sin (ξ * z) * w z) := by
          dsimp [Is]
          rw [integral_const_mul]
        rw [h1, h2, ← integral_add ((h_cos_w_int ξ).const_mul _) ((h_sin_w_int ξ).const_mul _)]
      rw [h_comb_z, ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1 with z
      have h_trig : Real.cos (ξ * y) * Real.cos (ξ * z) + Real.sin (ξ * y) * Real.sin (ξ * z) =
          Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) := by
        rw [← Real.cos_sub]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.cos (ξ * y) * w y * (Real.cos (ξ * z) * w z) +
            Real.sin (ξ * y) * w y * (Real.sin (ξ * z) * w z))
        _ = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * (Real.cos (ξ * y) * Real.cos (ξ * z) + Real.sin (ξ * y) * Real.sin (ξ * z)) * w y * w z := by ring
        _ = (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * w y * w z := by
          rw [h_trig]
          ring
    simp_rw [h_pw_xi]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    have h_dom_prod : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w p.2‖) (volume.prod volume) :=
      integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mul_prod hw_int.norm
    have h_ker_bound : ∀ ξ y z : ℝ,
        ‖(Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * w y * w z‖ ≤
          (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w y‖ * ‖w z‖ := by
      intro ξ y z
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs (Real.cos _ / _), abs_div,
          abs_of_pos (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) < 4 + ξ ^ 2)]
      have h_c : |Real.cos (ξ * (y - z))| / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        calc |Real.cos (ξ * (y - z))| / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
          _ ≤ 1 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by gcongr; exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
          _ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by rw [one_div]; exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by linarith)
      gcongr
    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ y => ∫ z : ℝ, (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * w y * w z
    have hK_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) := by
      have h_cont3 : Continuous (fun p : (ℝ × ℝ) × ℝ =>
          (Real.cos (p.1.1 * (p.1.2 - p.2)) / (4 + p.1.1 ^ 2)) * w p.1.2 * w p.2) :=
        Continuous.mul (Continuous.mul (Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun _ => by positivity))
          (hw_cont.comp (continuous_snd.comp continuous_fst))) (hw_cont.comp continuous_snd)
      have hK_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) :=
        h_cont3.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      let Cz : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, ‖w z‖
      refine (h_dom_prod.mul_const Cz).mono' hK_meas ?_
      filter_upwards with p
      dsimp [Function.uncurry, K, Cz]
      calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, (Real.cos (p.1 * (p.2 - z)) / (4 + p.1 ^ 2)) * w p.2 * w z‖
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖(Real.cos (p.1 * (p.2 - z)) / (4 + p.1 ^ 2)) * w p.2 * w z‖ :=
          norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ((1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w p.2‖) * ‖w z‖ := by
          refine integral_mono ?_ (hw_int.norm.const_mul ((1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w p.2‖))
            (fun z => h_ker_bound p.1 p.2 z)
          have h_cont_z : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => (Real.cos (p.1 * (p.2 - z)) / (4 + p.1 ^ 2)) * w p.2 * w z) :=
            Continuous.mul (Continuous.mul (Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun _ => by positivity))
              continuous_const) hw_cont
          refine (hw_int.norm.const_mul ((1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w p.2‖)).mono' h_cont_z.norm.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
          filter_upwards with z
          rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
          exact h_ker_bound p.1 p.2 z
        _ = ((1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w p.2‖) * ∫ z : ℝ, ‖w z‖ := integral_const_mul _ _
    have h_swap1 : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ y : ℝ, K ξ y) = ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, K ξ y :=
      integral_integral_swap hK_int
    change (1 / 8) * (∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w y * w z) =
      (1 / 2) * ((2 * π)⁻¹ * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ y : ℝ, K ξ y)
    rw [h_swap1]
    have h_inner_y : ∀ y : ℝ, (∫ ξ : ℝ, K ξ y) =
        (π / 2) * ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w y * w z := by
      intro y
      dsimp [K]
      have h_int_xz : Integrable (Function.uncurry fun ξ z : ℝ =>
          (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * w y * w z) (volume.prod volume) := by
        have h_cont_xz : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
            (Real.cos (p.1 * (y - p.2)) / (4 + p.1 ^ 2)) * w y * w p.2) :=
          Continuous.mul (Continuous.mul (Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun _ => by positivity))
            continuous_const) (hw_cont.comp continuous_snd)
        refine (h_dom_prod.mul_const ‖w y‖).mono' h_cont_xz.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with p
        dsimp [Function.uncurry]
        calc ‖(Real.cos (p.1 * (y - p.2)) / (4 + p.1 ^ 2)) * w y * w p.2‖
          _ ≤ (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w y‖ * ‖w p.2‖ := h_ker_bound p.1 y p.2
          _ = (1 + p.1 ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖w p.2‖ * ‖w y‖ := by ring
      rw [integral_integral_swap h_int_xz]
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1 with z
      have h_pull : (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * w y * w z) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => (Real.cos (ξ * (y - z)) / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) * (w y * w z)) := by
        ext ξ
        ring
      rw [h_pull, integral_mul_const, (s1 (y - z)).2]
      ring
    simp_rw [h_inner_y]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    have h_pi_ne : π ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    set J := ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w y * w z
    field_simp
    ring
  have s3 : ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    have h_mem : MemLp (hm1Profile w) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (w p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := w.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine w) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile w) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
        (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand w ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
      calc
        (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
    have h_toHm1 : toHm1 w = h_mem.toLp (hm1Profile w) := by
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos h_mem]
    rw [← Submodule.norm_coe, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [h_mem.coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
    rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    dsimp [ι]
    rw [h_toHm1, hξ]
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile w ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq, div_eq_inv_mul]
  rw [s2, s3]

informal_problem.statement:
(w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w (m + 2) x x|) ≤ ‖ι w‖ ^ (m + 2))

  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel 1 p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ x y : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel 1 x y| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * 1)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]

  have h_iter_cont_bound : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y| ≤ M := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨h_fg_cont, 1 / 2, by norm_num, h_fg_bound⟩
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bound⟩ := ih
      let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2

        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable

        filter_upwards with z

    (r : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (h_int : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      ‖fourierLine w (p.1 - p.2)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + p.1 ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2))))

    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have h_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine w) := by
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    refine continuous_const.mul ?_
    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun ζ x => Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)

      intro ζ
      have h_c : Continuous (K ζ) := by

        have := w.continuous

      exact h_c.aestronglyMeasurable

      filter_upwards with x
      exact le_of_eq (norm_fourier_integrand ζ x)
    have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => K ζ x) := by

      dsimp [K]
      fun_prop

          norm_integral_le_integral_norm _

  have h_hm1_eq : hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) = ∫ ζ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ζ ^ 2) := by

    have h_atan_top2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun η : ℝ => Real.arctan ((ζ + η) / κ)) Filter.atTop (nhds (π / 2)) :=

    have h_atan_bot2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun η : ℝ => Real.arctan ((ζ + η) / κ)) Filter.atBot (nhds (-(π / 2))) :=
      (Real.tendsto_arctan_atBot.mono_right nhdsWithin_le_nhds).comp

  let h0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => (κ ^ 2 + t ^ 2)⁻¹

  have h0_cont : Continuous h0 :=
    Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun t => by positivity)
  have h0_int : Integrable h0 volume := by

    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nn]
    have h_sq : ‖fourierLine w (p.1 - p.2)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h_fl_bound (p.1 - p.2)) 2

  let H : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun q =>

    intro η ζ

  have hH_z_int : ∀ η : ℝ, Integrable (fun ζ : ℝ => H (η, ζ)) volume := by

  have hH_int : Integrable H (volume.prod volume) := by
    rw [integrable_prod_iff hH_cont.aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine ⟨Filter.Eventually.of_forall hH_z_int, ?_⟩
    let I0 : ℝ := ∫ t : ℝ, h0 t
    have h_meas_eta : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun η : ℝ => ∫ ζ : ℝ, ‖H (η, ζ)‖) volume :=

    have h_dom_z : Integrable (fun ζ : ℝ => ((C ^ 2 / (2 * π)) * h0 η) * h0 (η + ζ)) volume :=
      (h0_int.comp_add_left η).const_mul ((C ^ 2 / (2 * π)) * h0 η)
    calc ∫ ζ : ℝ, ‖H (η, ζ)‖
      _ ≤ ∫ ζ : ℝ, ((C ^ 2 / (2 * π)) * h0 η) * h0 (η + ζ) :=
        integral_mono (hH_z_int η).norm h_dom_z (hH_bound η)
      _ = ((C ^ 2 / (2 * π)) * h0 η) * ∫ ζ : ℝ, h0 (η + ζ) := integral_const_mul _ _
      _ = ((C ^ 2 / (2 * π)) * h0 η) * I0 := by
        dsimp [I0]
        rw [integral_add_left_eq_self h0 η]
      _ = ((C ^ 2 / (2 * π)) * I0) * h0 η := by ring
  have h_swap2 : (∫ η : ℝ, ∫ ζ : ℝ, H (η, ζ)) = ∫ ζ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ, H (η, ζ) :=
    integral_integral_swap hH_int

  have h_factor : (fun η : ℝ => H (η, ζ)) =

by

  obtain ⟨h_pkt, h_iter_eq, h_diag_mod⟩ :=
    iterWavePacket_continuous_and_greenIterKernel_eq κ hκ w h_fg
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π := by positivity
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  have h_prod_int : ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ) (M_A M_B : ℝ),
      Continuous A → Continuous B → 0 ≤ M_A → 0 ≤ M_B →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, |A ξ| ≤ M_A) → (∀ ξ : ℝ, |B ξ| ≤ M_B) →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro A B M_A M_B hA_cont hB_cont hMA _hMB hA_le hB_le
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
      (hA_cont.mul hB_cont).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2))
        (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ))
    refine (h_inv_int.const_mul (M_A * M_B)).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (h_denom_pos ξ)]
    have h_ab : |A ξ| * |B ξ| ≤ M_A * M_B :=
      mul_le_mul (hA_le ξ) (hB_le ξ) (abs_nonneg _) hMA
    calc |A ξ| * |B ξ| / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
      _ ≤ (M_A * M_B) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_ab (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))
      _ = (M_A * M_B) * (1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by ring
  have h_sq_int : ∀ (A : ℝ → ℝ) (M_A : ℝ),
      Continuous A → 0 ≤ M_A → (∀ ξ : ℝ, |A ξ| ≤ M_A) →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro A M_A hA_cont hMA hA_le
    have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ * A ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      ext ξ; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_prod_int A A M_A M_A hA_cont hA_cont hMA hMA hA_le hA_le
  have h_wcs : ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ) (M_A M_B : ℝ),
      Continuous A → Continuous B → 0 ≤ M_A → 0 ≤ M_B →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, |A ξ| ≤ M_A) → (∀ ξ : ℝ, |B ξ| ≤ M_B) →
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≤

    intro A B M_A M_B hA_cont hB_cont hMA hMB hA_le hB_le
    have hIA_int := h_sq_int A M_A hA_cont hMA hA_le
    have hIB_int := h_sq_int B M_B hB_cont hMB hB_le
    have hIAB_int := h_prod_int A B M_A M_B hA_cont hB_cont hMA hMB hA_le hB_le
    set I_A := ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    set I_B := ∫ ξ : ℝ, B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    set I_AB := ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    have hIB_nn : 0 ≤ I_B :=
      integral_nonneg (fun ξ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))
    have h_quad : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ I_A - 2 * t * I_AB + t ^ 2 * I_B := by
      intro t
      have h_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ - t * B ξ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
        integral_nonneg (fun ξ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))
      have h_eq_int : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ - t * B ξ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          I_A - 2 * t * I_AB + t ^ 2 * I_B := by
        calc (∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ - t * B ξ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
          _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) - (2 * t) * (A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) +
                t ^ 2 * (B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
            congr 1; ext ξ; ring
          _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) - (2 * t) * (A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)))) +
              (∫ ξ : ℝ, t ^ 2 * (B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
            integral_add (hIA_int.sub (hIAB_int.const_mul (2 * t))) (hIB_int.const_mul (t ^ 2))
          _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) -
              (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * t) * (A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) +
              (∫ ξ : ℝ, t ^ 2 * (B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
            rw [integral_sub hIA_int (hIAB_int.const_mul (2 * t))]
          _ = I_A - 2 * t * I_AB + t ^ 2 * I_B := by
            rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
      linarith
    by_cases hIB_zero : I_B = 0
    · have hIAB_zero : I_AB = 0 := by
        by_contra h_ne
        have hq := h_quad ((I_A + 1) / (2 * I_AB))
        rw [hIB_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hq
        have h_cancel : 2 * ((I_A + 1) / (2 * I_AB)) * I_AB = I_A + 1 := by
          field_simp [h_ne]

      rw [hIAB_zero, hIB_zero]
      norm_num
    · have hIB_pos : 0 < I_B := lt_of_le_of_ne hIB_nn (Ne.symm hIB_zero)

  have h_fl_cont_bound : Continuous (fourierLine w) ∧

    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun ζ z => Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (w z : ℂ)

      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K, bound]
      rw [norm_mul, show -((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ζ * z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
      exact le_rfl
    have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => K ζ z) := by
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K]
      exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
        continuous_const
    have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, K ζ z) :=
      continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom hw_int hK_cont
    refine ⟨continuous_const.mul h_int_cont,
      ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ z : ℝ, bound z,
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg _)), ?_⟩
    intro ζ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    rw [norm_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, K ζ z‖
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖K ζ z‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (K ζ)
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z :=
        integral_mono_ae ((hw_int.mono' (hK_meas ζ) (hK_dom ζ)).norm) hw_int (hK_dom ζ)

    have h_den_ne : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    field_simp
  have s3 : ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume ∧
      ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 = (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
      ι (w₁ - w₂) = ι w₁ - ι w₂ := by
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
      intro q ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
      intro q ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
    have h_sq_profile : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      intro q ξ
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), div_eq_inv_mul]
    have h_mem_and_int : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      intro q
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
      have h_int_sq : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
        refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
          (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
        filter_upwards with ξ
        have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
          dsimp [fourierLine, C]
          rw [norm_mul]
          gcongr
          calc
            ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
              ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
                norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
            _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
                congr 1 with x
                exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _), h_sq_profile q ξ, div_eq_inv_mul]
        have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by linarith)
        have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
        calc
          (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
          _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
      have h_mem : MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) :=
        (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas).mpr h_int_sq
      have h_int_div : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
        rwa [← funext (h_sq_profile q)]
      exact ⟨h_mem, h_int_div⟩
    have hm1Profile_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        hm1Profile (q₁ - q₂) ξ = hm1Profile q₁ ξ - hm1Profile q₂ ξ := by
      intro q₁ q₂ ξ
      dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₁ x - q₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₁ x : ℂ) -
            Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₂ x : ℂ)) := by
        ext x
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand q₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand q₂ ξ)]
      ring
    have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem_and_int q).1.toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
      intro q
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos (h_mem_and_int q).1]
    intro w₁ w₂
    refine ⟨(h_mem_and_int w₁).2, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [← Submodule.norm_coe, ← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [(h_mem_and_int w₁).1.coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
      rw [real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      dsimp [ι]
      rw [h_toHm1 w₁, hξ, h_sq_profile w₁ ξ]
    · ext1
      show toHm1 (w₁ - w₂) = toHm1 w₁ - toHm1 w₂
      rw [h_toHm1 (w₁ - w₂), h_toHm1 w₁, h_toHm1 w₂,
          ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem_and_int w₁).1 (h_mem_and_int w₂).1]
      apply MemLp.toLp_congr
      filter_upwards with ξ
      exact hm1Profile_sub w₁ w₂ ξ
  have h_single : ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) = ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro w
    obtain ⟨h_cont, h_int, _⟩ := s1 w w
    obtain ⟨h_fl_int, h_iota_norm, _⟩ := s3 w w
    have h_pw : (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
      funext (fun ξ => (s2 w ξ).2)
    refine ⟨h_cont, h_int, ?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_pw]
      exact h_fl_int
    · unfold h1NormSq
      rw [h_pw, ← h_iota_norm]
  intro w₁ w₂
  obtain ⟨h1_cont, h1_int, h1_h1int, h1_norm⟩ := h_single w₁
  obtain ⟨hd_cont, hd_int, hd_h1int, hd_norm⟩ := h_single (w₁ - w₂)
  have h_sub_fn : (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x) =
      (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 ((w₁ - w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))) 1 x x) :=
    funext (s1 w₁ w₂).2.2
  have h_iota_sub : ι (w₁ - w₂) = ι w₁ - ι w₂ := (s3 w₁ w₂).2.2
  rw [h_sub_fn, ← h_iota_sub]
  exact ⟨h1_cont, h1_int, h1_h1int, h1_norm, hd_cont, hd_int, hd_h1int, hd_norm⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
    ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ →
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ ℓ) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (m + 2) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2)) ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ≤ (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2)
