proof.tactics:
by
  have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := le_rfl
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel 1 p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ x y : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel 1 x y| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / (2 * 1)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-1 * |x - y|) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by linarith [abs_nonneg (x - y)])
    linarith
  have h_cont_diag : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ),
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x x) := by
    intro w
    have h_iter_cont_bound : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
        Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
        ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ x y| ≤ M := by
      intro ℓ
      induction ℓ with
      | zero =>
        exact ⟨h_fg_cont, 1 / 2, by norm_num, h_fg_bound⟩
      | succ ℓ ih =>
        obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bound⟩ := ih
        let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2
        let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => M * (1 / 2) * ‖w z‖
        have h_w_int : Integrable (w : ℝ → ℝ) volume := w.integrable
        have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
          h_w_int.norm.const_mul (M * (1 / 2))
        have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
          intro p
          have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z) :=
            h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
          have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2) :=
            h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
          exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
        have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p z‖ ≤ bound z := by
          intro p
          filter_upwards with z
          dsimp [F, bound]
          rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
          have h_b1 := hM_bound p.1 z
          have h_b2 := h_fg_bound z p.2
          calc |greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2|
            _ = (|greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z| * |freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2|) * |w z| := by ring
            _ ≤ (M * (1 / 2)) * |w z| :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h_b1 h_b2 (abs_nonneg _) hM_nn) (abs_nonneg _)
        have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p z) := by
          filter_upwards with z
          dsimp [F]
          have h_c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w ℓ p.1 z) :=
            h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
          have h_c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel 1 z p.2) :=
            h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
          exact (h_c1.mul continuous_const).mul h_c2
        have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, F p z) :=
          continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont
        refine ⟨h_int_cont.neg, ∫ z : ℝ, bound z, integral_nonneg (fun z => by dsimp [bound]; positivity), ?_⟩
        intro x y
        dsimp [greenIterKernel]
        rw [abs_neg]
        have hF_int : Integrable (F (x, y)) volume :=
          h_bound_int.mono' (hF_meas (x, y)) (hF_dom (x, y))
        calc |∫ z : ℝ, F (x, y) z|
          _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖F (x, y) z‖ := by
            simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F (x, y))
          _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z := integral_mono_ae hF_int.norm h_bound_int (hF_dom (x, y))
    exact fun ℓ => (h_iter_cont_bound ℓ).1.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_id)
  have h_hm1_le : ∀ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), hm1KappaSq 1 (ι v) ≤ ‖ι v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    let f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := (ι v : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have h_base : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (Lp.memLp f).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
    have h_m_nonneg : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
      fun ξ => div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have h_m_le_one : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ
      exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by linarith) (by positivity)
    have h_cont_m : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
      Continuous.div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2))
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (by positivity))
    have h_int_w : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * 1 ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
      refine h_base.mono' (h_cont_m.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_base.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_m_nonneg ξ) (sq_nonneg _))]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one ξ)
    have h_norm_sq : ‖ι v‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      change ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq f, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def f f]
      congr 1
      ext ξ
      exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq ((f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
    rw [h_norm_sq]
    exact integral_mono h_int_w h_base (fun ξ => mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one ξ))
  have h_hs : ∀ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        ‖fourierLine v (p.1 - p.2)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + p.1 ^ 2) * (1 + p.2 ^ 2))) ∧
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ,
        ‖fourierLine v (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) ≤ ‖ι v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨h_int, h_eq⟩ := hilbertSchmidt_fourier_integral_eq_hm1KappaSq 1 h1 v
    have h_le := h_hm1_le v
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa [one_pow] using h_int
    · have h_eq' : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ,
          ‖fourierLine v (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) =
          (1 / 1) * hm1KappaSq 1 (ι v) := by
        simpa [one_pow] using h_eq
      linarith
  have h_h2 : ∀ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 v 2 x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, greenIterKernel 1 v 2 x x) ≤ ‖ι v‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro v
    obtain ⟨h_int, h_le⟩ := greenIterKernel_two_spatial_integral_le 1 h1 v
    have h_hm1 := h_hm1_le v
    exact ⟨h_int, by linarith⟩
  have h_iota_sub : ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ι (w₁ - w₂) = ι w₁ - ι w₂ := by
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
      intro q ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
      intro q ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
    have h_sq_profile : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by

        rw [← Real.sqrt_one]; exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h2pi
      exact inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ hsqrt
    have h_fl_F_le : ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ), ‖fourierLine (F m) ξ‖ ≤ A * ρ₁ ^ m := by
      intro m ξ; dsimp [fourierLine]
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      have h1 : ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F m x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |F m x| := by
        calc ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F m x : ℂ)‖
          _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F m x : ℂ)‖ :=
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, |F m x| := by
            congr 1; ext x
            have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
            rw [norm_mul, h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h2 : (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (F m x : ℂ)‖ ≤
          1 * (∫ x : ℝ, |F m x|) :=
        mul_le_mul h_sqrt_inv_le h1 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
      linarith [(hF_L1 m).2]
    set H : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2
    set g : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m ξ => 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (F m) ξ‖ ^ 2)
    have hH_cont : Continuous H := by
      dsimp [H]; fun_prop
    have h_pw_H : ∀ ξ : ℝ, H ξ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, g m ξ := by
      intro ξ
      set a : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => ‖fourierLine (F m) ξ‖
      have ha_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m := fun m => norm_nonneg _
      have ha_sum : Summable a :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le ha_nn (fun m => h_fl_F_le m ξ) h_sum_ρ₁
      have h4ρ₁_nn : 0 ≤ 4 * ρ₁ ^ 2 := by positivity
      have h4ρ₁_lt1 : 4 * ρ₁ ^ 2 < 1 := by nlinarith
      have h_sum_4ρ₁ : Summable (fun m : ℕ => A ^ 2 * (4 * ρ₁ ^ 2) ^ m) :=
        (summable_geometric_of_lt_one h4ρ₁_nn h4ρ₁_lt1).mul_left (A ^ 2)
      have ha2_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (4 : ℝ) ^ m * a m ^ 2) := by
        refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => by positivity) (fun m => ?_) h_sum_4ρ₁
        have h_sq : a m ^ 2 ≤ (A * ρ₁ ^ m) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (ha_nn m) (h_fl_F_le m ξ) 2
        have h_mul : (4 : ℝ) ^ m * a m ^ 2 ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ m * (A * ρ₁ ^ m) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq (by positivity)
        have h_alg : (4 : ℝ) ^ m * (A * ρ₁ ^ m) ^ 2 = A ^ 2 * (4 * ρ₁ ^ 2) ^ m := by
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_right_comm, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm ((4 : ℝ) ^ m), mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
        linarith
      have h_norm_le : ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, a m := by
        rw [h_fl_eq ξ]
        exact norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm ha_sum
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, (4 : ℝ) ^ m * a m ^ 2 := by
        calc ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2
          _ ≤ (∑' m : ℕ, a m) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_norm_le 2
          _ ≤ 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, (4 : ℝ) ^ m * a m ^ 2 := h_s2 a ha_nn ha_sum ha2_sum
      have h_mul_ξ : (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
          (4 + ξ ^ 2) * (2 * ∑' m : ℕ, (4 : ℝ) ^ m * a m ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq_le (by positivity)
      have h_eq_tsum : (4 + ξ ^ 2) * (2 * ∑' m : ℕ, (4 : ℝ) ^ m * a m ^ 2) = ∑' m : ℕ, g m ξ := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, ← tsum_mul_left]
        congr 1; ext m; dsimp [g, a]; ring
      linarith
    have hg_int : ∀ m : ℕ, Integrable (g m) :=
      fun m => ((hF_H1 m).1).const_mul (2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m)
    have hg_nn : ∀ (m : ℕ) (ξ : ℝ), 0 ≤ g m ξ := fun m ξ => by
      dsimp [g]; positivity
    have hg_norm_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖) = 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m * h1NormSq (F m) := by
      intro m
      have h_abs : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖g m ξ‖) = g m := by
        ext ξ; exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (hg_nn m ξ)
      rw [h_abs]
      dsimp [g, h1NormSq]
      exact integral_const_mul (2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m) _
    have h_g_le : ∀ m : ℕ, (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖) ≤ (2 * B) * (4 * ρ₂) ^ m := by
      intro m
      rw [hg_norm_eq m]
      have h1 : 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m * h1NormSq (F m) ≤ 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m * (B * ρ₂ ^ m) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF_H1 m).2 (by positivity)
      have h2 : 2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ m * (B * ρ₂ ^ m) = (2 * B) * (4 * ρ₂) ^ m := by
        rw [← mul_assoc, mul_right_comm (2 : ℝ) ((4 : ℝ) ^ m) B, mul_assoc, ← mul_pow]
      linarith
    have h_sum_4ρ₂ : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (2 * B) * (4 * ρ₂) ^ m) :=
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) (by linarith)).mul_left (2 * B)
    have h_sum_g : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)) h_g_le h_sum_4ρ₂
    have h_tsum_g_le : (∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖) ≤ 4 * B := by

        h_sum_g.tsum_le_tsum h_g_le h_sum_4ρ₂
      have h2 : (∑' m : ℕ, (2 * B) * (4 * ρ₂) ^ m) ≤ 4 * B := by
        rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by positivity) (by linarith)]
        have h_inv : (1 - 4 * ρ₂)⁻¹ ≤ 2 := by
          rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ (by linarith)]
          linarith
        nlinarith
      linarith
    have h_pw_enorm : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖H ξ‖ₑ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖g m ξ‖ₑ := by
      intro ξ
      have hH_nn : 0 ≤ H ξ := by dsimp [H]; positivity
      have h_g_eq : (fun m : ℕ => ‖g m ξ‖ₑ) = (fun m : ℕ => ENNReal.ofReal (g m ξ)) := by
        ext m; exact Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (hg_nn m ξ)
      rw [Real.enorm_eq_ofReal hH_nn, h_g_eq]
      calc ENNReal.ofReal (H ξ)
        _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (∑' m : ℕ, g m ξ) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal (h_pw_H ξ)
        _ = ‖∑' m : ℕ, g m ξ‖ₑ := (Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (tsum_nonneg (fun m => hg_nn m ξ))).symm
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖g m ξ‖ₑ := enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm
        _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (g m ξ) := by rw [h_g_eq]
    have h_lint_H : (∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ‖H ξ‖ₑ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * B) := calc
      (∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ‖H ξ‖ₑ) ≤ ∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ∑' m : ℕ, ‖g m ξ‖ₑ := lintegral_mono h_pw_enorm
      _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖ₑ :=
        lintegral_tsum (fun m => (hg_int m).aestronglyMeasurable.enorm)
      _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖) := by
        congr 1; ext m
        exact (ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (hg_int m)).symm
      _ = ENNReal.ofReal (∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖g m ξ‖) :=
        (ENNReal.ofReal_tsum_of_nonneg (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)) h_sum_g).symm
      _ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * B) := ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal h_tsum_g_le
    have hH_int : Integrable H :=
      ⟨hH_cont.aestronglyMeasurable, lt_of_le_of_lt h_lint_H ENNReal.ofReal_lt_top⟩
    have hH_bound : h1NormSq f ≤ 4 * B := by
      rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (by positivity)]
      change ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ξ : ℝ, H ξ) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (4 * B)
      rw [ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal hH_int (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun ξ => by dsimp [H]; positivity))]
      have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal (H ξ)) = (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖H ξ‖ₑ) := by
        ext ξ; exact (Real.enorm_eq_ofReal (by dsimp [H]; positivity)).symm
      rw [h_eq]
      exact h_lint_H
    exact ⟨hf_int, hH_int, hH_bound⟩
  intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ h_ℓ1 h_ℓ2 h_m
  obtain ⟨h_cont1, h_sum1, h_eq1, h_bd1⟩ := h_s1 w₁ hw₁ h_ℓ1
  obtain ⟨h_cont2, h_sum2, h_eq2, _⟩ := h_s1 w₂ hw₂ h_ℓ2
  have hw₁_sq_le : ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ 2 :=
    pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw₁ 2
  obtain ⟨h_int1, h_h1int1, h_h1norm1_le⟩ :=
    h_s3 (fun m x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x)
      (fun x => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x)
      (‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2) (‖ι w₁‖ ^ 4) ‖ι w₁‖ (‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2)
      (by positivity) (by positivity) (norm_nonneg _) (by linarith)
      (by positivity) (by linarith) h_cont1 h_eq1
      (fun m => ⟨(h_m m).1, by
        have h_b := (h_m m).2.1
        have h_pow : ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (m + 2) = ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ m := by rw [pow_add, mul_comm]
        linarith⟩)
      (fun m => ⟨(h_m m).2.2.1, by
        have h_b := (h_m m).2.2.2.1
        have h_pow : ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2)) = ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 4 * (‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2) ^ m := by
          rw [← pow_mul, mul_add, pow_add, mul_comm]
        linarith⟩)
  have h_h1norm1 : h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h_four : 4 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 4 ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 := by
      have h1 : 4 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 := by linarith
      have h2 : (4 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ 1 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (by positivity)
      linarith [ (by ring : (4 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 = 4 * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 4) ]
    linarith
  have h_cont_diff : Continuous (fun x : ℝ =>
      (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) -

    h_cont1.sub h_cont2
  have h_eq_diff : ∀ x : ℝ,
      (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) -

      (fun x => (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) -

      (2 * (1 / 256 : ℝ)) (4 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ 2)
      (by positivity) (by positivity) (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
      (by norm_num) (by norm_num) h_cont_diff h_eq_diff
      (fun m => ⟨(h_m m).2.2.2.2.1, by
        have h_b := (h_m m).2.2.2.2.2.1
        have h_pow : (2 * (1 / 256 : ℝ)) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ =

informal_problem.statement:
∀ u v : ℝ → ℝ,
    Continuous u → Continuous v → Integrable u → Integrable v →
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine u ξ‖ ^ 2) →
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine v ξ‖ ^ 2) →
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ∧
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ≤ h1NormSq u * h1NormSq v

by
  intro u v hu_cont hv_cont hu_int hv_int hu_h1 hv_h1
  have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by

      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)

  have h_fl_int_slice : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f → ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by
    intro f hf ξ

    rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  have h_fl_cont : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f → Continuous (fourierLine f) := by
    intro f hf

    have hW : (0 : ℝ) < 4 + ξ ^ 2 := by positivity
    have h_sq : 0 ≤ (1 - (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine u ξ‖) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _

    have h_div : ‖fourierLine u ξ‖ ≤ (1 + (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine u ξ‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (4 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      rw [le_div_iff₀ (by positivity)]
      linarith
    have h_rhs : (1 + (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * ‖fourierLine u ξ‖ ^ 2) / (2 * (4 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ((4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ + (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine u ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
      have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW

  have h_inv_u : ∀ x : ℝ, (u x : ℂ) = ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) *
      ∫ η : ℝ, Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η := by

  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => (4 + ζ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine v ζ‖ ^ 2

  have hG_cont : Continuous G := (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)).mul (hv_fl_cont.norm.pow 2)

      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), inv_mul_eq_div]

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ u v : ℝ → ℝ, Continuous u → Continuous v → Integrable u → Integrable v →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine u ξ‖ ^ 2) →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine v ξ‖ ^ 2) →
      Continuous (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) ≤ h1NormSq u * h1NormSq v) →
    ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 256 →
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2) →
    (∀ x : ℝ, |diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2| ≤ ‖ι w‖) →
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2) →
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2) ξ‖ ^ 2) →
    h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2) ≤ 4 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 →
    Continuous (recipGreenDiff w) ∧
    Integrable (recipGreenDiff w) ∧
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (recipGreenDiff w) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1NormSq (recipGreenDiff w) ≤ 64 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2

  have hG_norm_int_le : ∀ m : ℕ, (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖G m ξ‖) ≤ (2 * A) * (1 / 1024 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m; rw [hG_norm_int_eq m]; exact hG_int_le m
  have hG_norm_summable : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖G m ξ‖) :=
    Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun ξ => norm_nonneg _)) hG_norm_int_le
      ((summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 1024) (by norm_num)).mul_left (2 * A))
  have hG_tsum_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, G m ξ) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · refine aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop
        (fun N => ?_)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => (hG_summable_pt ξ).hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat)
      have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, G i ξ) = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range N, G i := by
        ext ξ; exact (Finset.sum_apply ξ (Finset.range N) G).symm
      rw [h_eq]
      exact Finset.aestronglyMeasurable_sum (Finset.range N) (fun m _ => (hG_int m).1)
    · rw [hasFiniteIntegral_def]
      calc ∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ‖∑' m : ℕ, G m ξ‖ₑ
        _ ≤ ∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ∑' m : ℕ, ‖G m ξ‖ₑ := lintegral_mono (fun ξ => enorm_tsum_le_tsum_enorm)
        _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ∫⁻ ξ : ℝ, ‖G m ξ‖ₑ := lintegral_tsum (fun m => (hG_int m).1.enorm)
        _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ENNReal.ofReal (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖G m ξ‖) := by
          congr 1; ext m; exact (ofReal_integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm (hG_int m)).symm
        _ < ⊤ := hG_norm_summable.tsum_ofReal_lt_top
  have hS_h1_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine S ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
    have h_fl : Continuous (fourierLine S) := h_fl_cont S h_S_int
    fun_prop
  have hS_h1int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine S ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
    refine hG_tsum_int.mono' hS_h1_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact h_pw_cs ξ
  have hS_norm_le : h1NormSq S ≤ 64 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := by
    have h_int_mono : h1NormSq S ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ∑' m : ℕ, G m ξ :=
      integral_mono hS_h1int hG_tsum_int h_pw_cs
    have h_tsum_int_eq := (integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hG_int hG_norm_summable).symm
    have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (2 * A) * (1 / 1024 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
      (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_left (2 * A)
    have h_G_int_summable : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, G m ξ) := by
      have h_eq : (fun m : ℕ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, G m ξ) = (fun m : ℕ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖G m ξ‖) := by
        ext m; rw [hG_int_eq m, hG_norm_int_eq m]
      rw [h_eq]; exact hG_norm_summable
    have h_tsum_le : (∑' m : ℕ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, G m ξ) ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (2 * A) * (1 / 1024 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) h_G_int_summable h_geom_sum
      rw [hG_int_eq m]
      exact hG_int_le m
    have h_geom_val : (∑' m : ℕ, (2 * A) * (1 / 1024 : ℝ) ^ m) ≤ 4 * A := by
      rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
      linarith
    have h_4A : 4 * A = 64 * ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 := by dsimp [A]; ring
    linarith
  obtain ⟨h_psi_h1int, h_psi_norm_eq⟩ := h_smul (-1) S hS_h1int
  rw [← h_psi_eq_neg_S] at h_psi_h1int h_psi_norm_eq
  refine ⟨h_psi_cont, h_psi_int, h_psi_h1int, ?_⟩
  linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
  have h_κ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have laplace_cos_integral_Ioi : ∀ c : ℝ,
      ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v) =
        κ / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
    intro c
    have h_den : 0 < κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2 := by positivity
    let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v =>
      Real.exp (-κ * v) * (-κ * Real.cos (c * v) + c * Real.sin (c * v)) / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
    have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
      dsimp [F]
      fun_prop
    have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) v := by
      intro v _
      dsimp [F]
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * x)) (Real.exp (-κ * v) * (-κ)) v := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) (-κ) v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-κ)
        exact h1.exp
      have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => c * x) c v := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul c
      have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (c * x)) (-Real.sin (c * v) * c) v := hd_lin.cos
      have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (c * x)) (Real.cos (c * v) * c) v := hd_lin.sin
      have hd_trig : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -κ * Real.cos (c * x) + c * Real.sin (c * x))
          (-κ * (-Real.sin (c * v) * c) + c * (Real.cos (c * v) * c)) v :=
        (hd_cos.const_mul (-κ)).add (hd_sin.const_mul c)
      have hd_prod := (hd_exp.mul hd_trig).div_const (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
      convert hd_prod using 1
      field_simp
      ring
    have hf_int : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) := by fun_prop
      refine (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hκ_pos).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v _
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc Real.exp (-κ * v) * |Real.cos (c * v)|
        _ ≤ Real.exp (-κ * v) * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
        _ = Real.exp (-κ * v) := mul_one _
    have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      let C : ℝ := (κ + |c|) / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2)
      apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * v) * C)
      · intro v
        dsimp [F, C]
        rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
            abs_of_pos h_den, mul_div_assoc]
        gcongr
        calc |-κ * Real.cos (c * v) + c * Real.sin (c * v)|
          _ ≤ |-κ * Real.cos (c * v)| + |c * Real.sin (c * v)| := abs_add_le _ _
          _ = κ * |Real.cos (c * v)| + |c| * |Real.sin (c * v)| := by
              rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos hκ_pos]
          _ ≤ κ * 1 + |c| * 1 := by
              gcongr
              · exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
              · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
          _ = κ + |c| := by ring
      · rw [show (0 : ℝ) = 0 * C by ring]
        apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_const
        apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
        have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => κ * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hκ_pos Filter.tendsto_id
        have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -(κ * x)) := by ext x; ring
        change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -κ * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
        rw [h_eq]
        exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
    have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv hf_int hF_lim
    rw [h_res]
    dsimp [F]
    rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
    ring
  have h_cos : ∀ u : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (Real.pi / κ) * Real.exp (-κ * |u|) := by
    intro u
    have h_int_cos : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
        Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)]
      calc |Real.cos (ξ * u)| / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
            gcongr
            exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
        _ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
            rw [one_div]
            apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
            nlinarith
    refine ⟨h_int_cos, ?_⟩
    let f_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-κ * |v|)
    let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => (f_R v : ℂ)
    have hf_R_Ici : IntegrableOn f_R (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
      have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hκ_pos).mono_set
        (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
      refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
      intro v hv
      dsimp [f_R]
      have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := hv
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hv_nn]
    have hf_R_Iic : IntegrableOn f_R (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h_neg := hf_R_Ici.comp_neg
      rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
      refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
      intro v _
      dsimp [f_R]
      rw [abs_neg]
    have hf_R_int : Integrable f_R volume := by
      rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
      exact hf_R_Iic.union (hf_R_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
    have hf_int : Integrable f volume := hf_R_int.ofReal
    have hf_cont : Continuous f := by dsimp [f, f_R]; fun_prop
    have h_fourier : ∀ w : ℝ, FourierTransform.fourier f w = ((2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro w
      set c : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * w
      rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul f w]
      let g_cos : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.cos (c * v)
      let g_sin : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.sin (c * v)
      have hg_cos_int : Integrable g_cos volume := by
        have h_cont : Continuous g_cos := by dsimp [g_cos, f_R]; fun_prop
        refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with v
        dsimp [g_cos]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
        calc f_R v * |Real.cos (c * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
        _ = f_R v := mul_one _
      have hg_sin_int : Integrable g_sin volume := by
        have h_cont : Continuous g_sin := by dsimp [g_sin, f_R]; fun_prop
        refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with v
        dsimp [g_sin]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
        calc f_R v * |Real.sin (c * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sin_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
        _ = f_R v := mul_one _
      have h_integrand : (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(-2 * Real.pi * v * w) * I) • f v) =
          (fun v : ℝ => (g_cos v : ℂ) - I * (g_sin v : ℂ)) := by
        ext v
        dsimp [f, g_cos, g_sin]
        have h_arg : (↑(-2 * Real.pi * v * w) : ℂ) * I = (↑(-(c * v)) : ℂ) * I := by
          dsimp [c]; push_cast; ring
        rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin,
            Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h_int_c1 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => (g_cos v : ℂ)) volume := hg_cos_int.ofReal
      have h_int_c2 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => I * (g_sin v : ℂ)) volume := hg_sin_int.ofReal.const_mul I
      have hc1 : (∫ v : ℝ, (g_cos v : ℂ)) = ((∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hg_cos_int
      have hc2 : (∫ v : ℝ, (g_sin v : ℂ)) = ((∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
        Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hg_sin_int
      rw [h_integrand, integral_sub h_int_c1 h_int_c2,
          integral_const_mul, hc1, hc2]
      have h_sin_zero : ∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v = 0 := by
        have h_odd : ∀ v : ℝ, g_sin (-v) = -g_sin v := by
          intro v
          dsimp [g_sin, f_R]
          rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.sin_neg]
          ring
        have h1 := integral_neg_eq_self g_sin volume
        have h2 : (∫ v : ℝ, g_sin (-v)) = -(∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v) := by
          rw [← integral_neg]
          congr 1 with v
          exact h_odd v
        linarith
      have h_cos_val : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = 2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + c ^ 2) := by
        have h_even : ∀ v : ℝ, g_cos (-v) = g_cos v := by
          intro v
          dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
          rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.cos_neg]
        have h_split0 : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) :=
          (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hg_cos_int.integrableOn hg_cos_int.integrableOn).symm
        have h_iic_eq_ioi : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v := by
          have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g_cos
          rw [neg_zero] at h_neg
          rw [← h_neg]
          congr 1 with v
          exact (h_even v).symm
        have h_ioi_eq : (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) =
            ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-κ * v) * Real.cos (c * v) := by
          refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
          intro v hv
          dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
          have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv
          rw [abs_of_pos hv_pos]
        rw [h_split0, h_iic_eq_ioi, h_ioi_eq, laplace_cos_integral_Ioi c]
        ring
      rw [h_sin_zero, h_cos_val]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_cont_F_R : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => 2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)) :=
      Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun w => by positivity)
    have hF_R_int : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => 2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)) volume := by
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (2 * κ)).mono' h_cont_F_R.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with w
      have h_nn : 0 ≤ 2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2) := by positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nn, div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h_pi : 1 ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
      have h_w2 : w ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2 := by
        calc w ^ 2 = 1 * w ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pi (sq_nonneg w)
        _ = (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2 := by ring
      have h_inv : (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + w ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv (by positivity)
    have hF_int : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier f) volume := by
      rw [funext h_fourier]
      exact hF_R_int.ofReal
    have h_inv := congr_fun (Continuous.fourierInv_fourier_eq hf_cont hf_int hF_int) u
    have h_re_eq : RCLike.re (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (FourierTransform.fourier f) u) = RCLike.re (f u) :=
      congr_arg RCLike.re h_inv
    rw [Real.fourierInv_eq'] at h_re_eq
    have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) := by
        rw [funext h_fourier]
        exact Continuous.smul (by fun_prop) (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_cont_F_R)
      refine hF_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with w
      rw [h_fourier w, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul,
          Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    rw [← integral_re h_inv_int] at h_re_eq
    have h_re_lhs :
        (fun w : ℝ => RCLike.re (Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w)) =
        (fun w : ℝ => (2 * κ) * (Real.cos ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u) / (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2))) := by
      ext w
      have h_inner : 2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u = (2 * Real.pi * w) * u := by
        change 2 * Real.pi * (u * w) = (2 * Real.pi * w) * u
        ring
      rw [h_fourier w, smul_eq_mul, h_inner, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
      set c_w : ℝ := Real.cos ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u)
      set s_w : ℝ := Real.sin ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u)
      set d_w : ℝ := 2 * κ / (κ ^ 2 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)
      have h_prod : ((c_w : ℂ) + (s_w : ℂ) * I) * (d_w : ℂ) = ((c_w * d_w : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((s_w * d_w : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_prod]
      simp only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
        Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero]
      dsimp [c_w, d_w]
      ring
    have h_re_rhs : RCLike.re (f u) = Real.exp (-κ * |u|) := by
      dsimp [f, f_R]
    rw [h_re_lhs, h_re_rhs, integral_const_mul] at h_re_eq
    let h_func : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    have h_cov := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left h_func (2 * Real.pi)
    have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h_2pi_pos), smul_eq_mul] at h_cov
    change (2 * κ) * ∫ w : ℝ, h_func (2 * Real.pi * w) = Real.exp (-κ * |u|) at h_re_eq
    rw [h_cov] at h_re_eq
    set I_val : ℝ := ∫ ξ : ℝ, h_func ξ
    calc I_val
      _ = (Real.pi / κ) * ((2 * κ) * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_val)) := by
          field_simp
      _ = (Real.pi / κ) * Real.exp (-κ * |u|) := by rw [h_re_eq]
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · obtain ⟨h_int0, h_eq0⟩ := h_cos 0
    have h_fn0 : (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * 0) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      ext ξ
      rw [mul_zero, Real.cos_zero]
    rw [h_fn0] at h_int0 h_eq0
    rw [abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one] at h_eq0
    refine ⟨h_int0, ?_⟩
    rw [h_eq0]
    field_simp
  · intro a b
    set u : ℝ := b - a
    obtain ⟨h_cos_int, h_cos_eq⟩ := h_cos u
    let g_cos : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    let g_sin : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.sin (ξ * u) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    have hg_sin_int : Integrable g_sin volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous g_sin := by
        dsimp [g_sin]
        exact Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      dsimp [g_sin]
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)]
      calc |Real.sin (ξ * u)| / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
            gcongr
            exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
        _ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
            rw [one_div]
            apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
            nlinarith
    have h_fn_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
          Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => (g_cos ξ : ℂ) + I * (g_sin ξ : ℂ)) := by
      ext ξ
      dsimp [g_cos, g_sin]
      have h_exp : Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) * Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) =
          Complex.exp (↑(ξ * u) * I) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        dsimp [u]
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_exp, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
      push_cast
      ring
    have h_c1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (g_cos ξ : ℂ)) volume := h_cos_int.ofReal
    have h_c2 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => I * (g_sin ξ : ℂ)) volume := hg_sin_int.ofReal.const_mul I
    have hc1 : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (g_cos ξ : ℂ)) = ((∫ ξ : ℝ, g_cos ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm h_cos_int
    have hc2 : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (g_sin ξ : ℂ)) = ((∫ ξ : ℝ, g_sin ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
      Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hg_sin_int
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [h_fn_eq]
      exact h_c1.add h_c2
    · rw [h_fn_eq, integral_add h_c1 h_c2, integral_const_mul, hc1, hc2]
      have h_sin_zero : ∫ ξ : ℝ, g_sin ξ = 0 := by
        have h_odd : ∀ ξ : ℝ, g_sin (-ξ) = -g_sin ξ := by
          intro ξ
          dsimp [g_sin]
          rw [neg_mul, Real.sin_neg, neg_sq, neg_div]
        have h1 := integral_neg_eq_self g_sin volume
        have h2 : (∫ ξ : ℝ, g_sin (-ξ)) = -(∫ ξ : ℝ, g_sin ξ) := by
          rw [← integral_neg]
          congr 1 with ξ
          exact h_odd ξ
        linarith
      have h_cos_eq' : ∫ ξ : ℝ, g_cos ξ = (Real.pi / κ) * Real.exp (-κ * |a - b|) := by
        dsimp [g_cos]
        rw [h_cos_eq]
        dsimp [u]
        rw [abs_sub_comm b a]
      rw [h_sin_zero, h_cos_eq']
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
      have h_pi_c : (Real.pi : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_pi_ne
      have h_κ_c : (κ : ℂ) ≠ 0 := Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr h_κ_ne
      push_cast
      field_simp
      ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π := by positivity
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ x y : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ x y| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (2 * κ)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * |x - y|) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (x - y)])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) h_exp_le
  have h_iter_cont_bound : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x y : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ M := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨h_fg_cont, 1 / (2 * κ), by positivity, h_fg_bound⟩
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bound⟩ := ih
      let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z p.2
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => M * (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖w z‖
      have h_w_int : Integrable (w : ℝ → ℝ) volume := w.integrable
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        h_w_int.norm.const_mul (M * (1 / (2 * κ)))
      have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
        intro p
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p z‖ ≤ bound z := by
        intro p
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h1 := hM_bound p.1 z
        have h2 := h_fg_bound z p.2
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|
          _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|) * |w z| := by ring
          _ ≤ (M * (1 / (2 * κ))) * |w z| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hM_nn) (abs_nonneg _)
      have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p z) := by
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F]
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
        exact (h_c1.mul continuous_const).mul h_c2
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, F p z) :=
        continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont
      refine ⟨h_int_cont.neg, ∫ z : ℝ, bound z, integral_nonneg (fun z => by dsimp [bound]; positivity), ?_⟩
      intro x y
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      rw [abs_neg]
      have hF_int : Integrable (F (x, y)) volume :=
        h_bound_int.mono' (hF_meas (x, y)) (hF_dom (x, y))
      calc |∫ z : ℝ, F (x, y) z|
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖F (x, y) z‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F (x, y))
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z := integral_mono_ae hF_int.norm h_bound_int (hF_dom (x, y))
  have h_fm_cont_int : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w m x z * w z) ∧
      Integrable (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w m x z * w z) volume := by
    intro m x
    obtain ⟨h_cont_m, B, _hB_nn, hB_bound⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound m
    have h_c : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w m x z * w z) :=
      (h_cont_m.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul w.continuous
    refine ⟨h_c, ?_⟩
    refine (w.integrable.norm.const_mul B).mono' h_c.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hB_bound x z) (abs_nonneg _)
  have h0_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) volume := by
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)).inv₀ (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ))
    refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))]
    exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
  have h_c1 : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ‖ ≤ M := by
    intro ℓ x
    rcases ℓ with _ | m
    · refine ⟨?_, 1, zero_le_one, ?_⟩
      · dsimp [iterWavePacket]
        fun_prop
      · intro ξ
        dsimp [iterWavePacket]
        rw [show -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    · obtain ⟨h_fm_cont, h_fm_int⟩ := h_fm_cont_int m x
      let f_m : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenIterKernel κ w m x z * w z
      let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun ξ z => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (f_m z : ℂ)
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ‖f_m z‖
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume := h_fm_int.norm
      have hK_meas : ∀ ξ : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (K ξ) volume := by
        intro ξ
        have hc : Continuous (K ξ) := by
          dsimp [K, f_m]
          exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
            (((continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
            (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_fm_cont)
        exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
      have hK_dom : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖K ξ z‖ ≤ bound z := by
        intro ξ
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [K, bound]
        rw [norm_mul, show -((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ξ * z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
        exact le_rfl
      have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => K ξ z) := by
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [K]
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
          continuous_const
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, K ξ z) :=
        continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom h_bound_int hK_cont
      refine ⟨h_int_cont.neg, ∫ z : ℝ, bound z, integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg _), ?_⟩
      intro ξ
      dsimp [iterWavePacket]
      rw [norm_neg]
      calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, K ξ z‖
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖K ξ z‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (K ξ)
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z :=
          integral_mono_ae ((h_bound_int.mono' (hK_meas ξ) (hK_dom ξ)).norm) h_bound_int (hK_dom ξ)
  have h_c2 : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x y : ℝ,
      (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y : ℂ) =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ ξ : ℝ,
            iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ *
              Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro ℓ x y
    rcases ℓ with _ | m
    · dsimp [greenIterKernel, iterWavePacket]
      exact (h_fg x y).2.symm
    · obtain ⟨h_fm_cont, h_fm_int⟩ := h_fm_cont_int m x
      let f_m : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenIterKernel κ w m x z * w z
      let H : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun z ξ =>
        (f_m z : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))
      have hH_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry H) := by
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, H, f_m]
        refine (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (h_fm_cont.comp continuous_fst)).mul ?_
        refine Continuous.div ?_ ?_ ?_
        · exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
            ((((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul
              (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_fst)).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
            (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
              (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp continuous_snd).mul continuous_const).mul continuous_const))
        · exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.add ((continuous_pow 2).comp continuous_snd))
        · intro p
          exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos p.2))
      have hH_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry H) (volume.prod volume) := by
        refine (h_fm_int.norm.mul_prod h0_int).mono' hH_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with p
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, H]
        rw [norm_mul, norm_div, norm_mul,
            show -((p.2 : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I = (((-(p.2 * p.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I,
            show ((p.2 : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I = (((p.2 * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
            Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I,
            one_mul, Complex.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos p.2)),
            Complex.norm_real, one_div]
        exact le_rfl
      have h_step1 : (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x y : ℂ) =
          -∫ z : ℝ, (f_m z : ℂ) * (freeGreenKernel κ z y : ℂ) := by
        dsimp [greenIterKernel, f_m]
        rw [Complex.ofReal_neg]
        congr 1
        refine integral_ofReal.symm.trans ?_
        congr 1; ext z
        push_cast; rfl
      have h_step2 : (∫ z : ℝ, (f_m z : ℂ) * (freeGreenKernel κ z y : ℂ)) =
          (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ := by
        calc (∫ z : ℝ, (f_m z : ℂ) * (freeGreenKernel κ z y : ℂ))
          _ = ∫ z : ℝ, (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ) := by
            congr 1; ext z
            rw [← (h_fg z y).2, ← mul_assoc, mul_comm (f_m z : ℂ) (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ), mul_assoc,
                ← integral_const_mul]
          _ = (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ := integral_const_mul _ _
      have h_inner : ∀ ξ : ℝ, -∫ z : ℝ, H z ξ =
          iterWavePacket κ w (m + 1) x ξ *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        intro ξ
        have h_rew : (fun z : ℝ => H z ξ) =
            fun z : ℝ => (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (f_m z : ℂ)) *
              (Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) := by
          ext z
          dsimp [H]
          ring
        rw [h_rew, integral_mul_const]
        dsimp [iterWavePacket, f_m]
        ring
      calc (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x y : ℂ)
        _ = -((1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ ξ : ℝ, H z ξ) := by
          rw [h_step1, h_step2]
        _ = (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * (-∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, H z ξ) := by
          rw [integral_integral_swap hH_int, mul_neg]
        _ = (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (-∫ z : ℝ, H z ξ) := by
          rw [← integral_neg]
        _ = (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
              ∫ ξ : ℝ,
                iterWavePacket κ w (m + 1) x ξ *
                  Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          congr 1; congr 1; ext ξ
          exact h_inner ξ
  have h_c3 : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,

      _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ‖ * ‖iterWavePacket κ w 1 x ξ‖ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
        dsimp only
        rw [norm_div, norm_mul, norm_star,
            Complex.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))]
  · intro ℓ ξ
    have h_id := congrArg norm (h_step_eq ℓ ξ)
    rw [norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_inv,
        Complex.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * π))] at h_id
    rw [h_id]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
    calc ‖∫ η : ℝ, iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x η * fourierLine w (ξ - η) / ((κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖
      _ ≤ ∫ η : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x η * fourierLine w (ξ - η) / ((κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ = ∫ η : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x η‖ * ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) := by
        refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun η => ?_)
        dsimp only
        rw [norm_div, norm_mul,
            Complex.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos η))]

proof.tactics:
by
  have h1_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 1 := zero_lt_one
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < 1 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
    simpa [one_div] using integrable_inv_one_add_sq
  have h_fg : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
          Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
        (∫ ξ : ℝ,
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (freeGreenKernel 1 a b : ℂ) := by
    have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    have laplace_cos_integral_Ioi : ∀ c : ℝ,
        ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-1 * v) * Real.cos (c * v) =
          1 / (1 + c ^ 2) := by
      intro c
      have h_den : 0 < 1 + c ^ 2 := by positivity
      let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v =>
        Real.exp (-1 * v) * (-1 * Real.cos (c * v) + c * Real.sin (c * v)) / (1 + c ^ 2)
      have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by
        dsimp [F]
        fun_prop
      have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-1 * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) v := by
        intro v _
        dsimp [F]
        have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * x)) (Real.exp (-1 * v) * (-1)) v := by
          have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -1 * x) (-1) v := by
            simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-1)
          exact h1.exp
        have hd_lin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => c * x) c v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul c
        have hd_cos : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.cos (c * x)) (-Real.sin (c * v) * c) v := hd_lin.cos
        have hd_sin : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (c * x)) (Real.cos (c * v) * c) v := hd_lin.sin
        have hd_trig : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -1 * Real.cos (c * x) + c * Real.sin (c * x))
            (-1 * (-Real.sin (c * v) * c) + c * (Real.cos (c * v) * c)) v :=
          (hd_cos.const_mul (-1)).add (hd_sin.const_mul c)
        have hd_prod := (hd_exp.mul hd_trig).div_const (1 + c ^ 2)
        convert hd_prod using 1
        field_simp
        ring
      have hf_int : IntegrableOn (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) (Set.Ioi 0) volume := by
        have h_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * v) * Real.cos (c * v)) := by fun_prop
        refine (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 h1_pos).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
        filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with v _
        rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le, Real.norm_eq_abs]
        calc Real.exp (-1 * v) * |Real.cos (c * v)|
          _ ≤ Real.exp (-1 * v) * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (Real.exp_pos _).le
          _ = Real.exp (-1 * v) := mul_one _
      have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        let C : ℝ := (1 + |c|) / (1 + c ^ 2)
        apply squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun v => Real.exp (-1 * v) * C)
        · intro v
          dsimp [F, C]
          rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _),
              abs_of_pos h_den, mul_div_assoc]
          gcongr
          calc |-1 * Real.cos (c * v) + c * Real.sin (c * v)|
            _ ≤ |-1 * Real.cos (c * v)| + |c * Real.sin (c * v)| := abs_add_le _ _
            _ = 1 * |Real.cos (c * v)| + |c| * |Real.sin (c * v)| := by
                rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_one]
            _ ≤ 1 * 1 + |c| * 1 := by
                gcongr
                · exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
                · exact Real.abs_sin_le_one _
            _ = 1 + |c| := by ring
        · rw [show (0 : ℝ) = 0 * C by ring]
          apply Filter.Tendsto.mul_const
          apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
          have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -1 * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -x) := by ext x; ring
          change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -1 * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
          rw [h_eq]
          exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot
      have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv hf_int hF_lim
      rw [h_res]
      dsimp [F]
      rw [mul_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, Real.cos_zero, Real.sin_zero]
      ring
    have h_cos : ∀ u : ℝ,
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, Real.cos (ξ * u) / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          Real.pi * Real.exp (-1 * |u|) := by
      intro u
      have h_int_cos : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
        have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
          Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => by positivity)
        refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with ξ
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 + ξ ^ 2)]
        calc |Real.cos (ξ * u)| / (1 + ξ ^ 2)
          _ ≤ 1 / (1 + ξ ^ 2) := by
              gcongr
              exact Real.abs_cos_le_one _
          _ = (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := one_div _
      refine ⟨h_int_cos, ?_⟩
      let f_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-1 * |v|)
      let f : ℝ → ℂ := fun v => (f_R v : ℂ)
      have hf_R_Ici : IntegrableOn f_R (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
        have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) h1_pos).mono_set
          (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
        refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
        intro v hv
        dsimp [f_R]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hv]
      have hf_R_Iic : IntegrableOn f_R (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
        have h_neg := hf_R_Ici.comp_neg
        rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
        refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
        intro v _
        dsimp [f_R]
        rw [abs_neg]
      have hf_R_int : Integrable f_R volume := by
        rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
        exact hf_R_Iic.union (hf_R_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
      have hf_int : Integrable f volume := hf_R_int.ofReal
      have hf_cont : Continuous f := by dsimp [f, f_R]; fun_prop
      have h_fourier : ∀ w : ℝ, FourierTransform.fourier f w = ((2 / (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2) : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        intro w
        set c : ℝ := 2 * Real.pi * w
        rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul f w]
        let g_cos : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.cos (c * v)
        let g_sin : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => f_R v * Real.sin (c * v)
        have hg_cos_int : Integrable g_cos volume := by
          have h_cont : Continuous g_cos := by dsimp [g_cos, f_R]; fun_prop
          refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
          filter_upwards with v
          dsimp [g_cos]
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
          calc f_R v * |Real.cos (c * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_cos_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
          _ = f_R v := mul_one _
        have hg_sin_int : Integrable g_sin volume := by
          have h_cont : Continuous g_sin := by dsimp [g_sin, f_R]; fun_prop
          refine hf_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
          filter_upwards with v
          dsimp [g_sin]
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)]
          calc f_R v * |Real.sin (c * v)| ≤ f_R v * 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.abs_sin_le_one _) (by dsimp [f_R]; positivity)
          _ = f_R v := mul_one _
        have h_integrand : (fun v : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(-2 * Real.pi * v * w) * I) • f v) =
            (fun v : ℝ => (g_cos v : ℂ) - I * (g_sin v : ℂ)) := by
          ext v
          dsimp [f, g_cos, g_sin]
          have h_arg : (↑(-2 * Real.pi * v * w) : ℂ) * I = (↑(-(c * v)) : ℂ) * I := by
            dsimp [c]; push_cast; ring
          rw [h_arg, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin,
              Real.cos_neg, Real.sin_neg]
          push_cast
          ring
        have h_int_c1 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => (g_cos v : ℂ)) volume := hg_cos_int.ofReal
        have h_int_c2 : Integrable (fun v : ℝ => I * (g_sin v : ℂ)) volume := hg_sin_int.ofReal.const_mul I
        have hc1 : (∫ v : ℝ, (g_cos v : ℂ)) = ((∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
          Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hg_cos_int
        have hc2 : (∫ v : ℝ, (g_sin v : ℂ)) = ((∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v : ℝ) : ℂ) :=
          Complex.ofRealCLM.integral_comp_comm hg_sin_int
        rw [h_integrand, integral_sub h_int_c1 h_int_c2,
            integral_const_mul, hc1, hc2]
        have h_sin_zero : ∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v = 0 := by
          have h_odd : ∀ v : ℝ, g_sin (-v) = -g_sin v := by
            intro v
            dsimp [g_sin, f_R]
            rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.sin_neg]
            ring
          have h1 := integral_neg_eq_self g_sin volume
          have h2 : (∫ v : ℝ, g_sin (-v)) = -(∫ v : ℝ, g_sin v) := by
            rw [← integral_neg]
            congr 1 with v
            exact h_odd v
          linarith
        have h_cos_val : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = 2 / (1 + c ^ 2) := by
          have h_even : ∀ v : ℝ, g_cos (-v) = g_cos v := by
            intro v
            dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
            rw [abs_neg, mul_neg, Real.cos_neg]
          have h_split0 : ∫ v : ℝ, g_cos v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) :=
            (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hg_cos_int.integrableOn hg_cos_int.integrableOn).symm
          have h_iic_eq_ioi : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, g_cos v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v := by
            have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) g_cos
            rw [neg_zero] at h_neg
            rw [← h_neg]
            congr 1 with v
            exact (h_even v).symm
          have h_ioi_eq : (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, g_cos v) =
              ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-1 * v) * Real.cos (c * v) := by
            refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
            intro v hv
            dsimp [g_cos, f_R]
            have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv
            rw [abs_of_pos hv_pos]
          rw [h_split0, h_iic_eq_ioi, h_ioi_eq, laplace_cos_integral_Ioi c]
          ring
        rw [h_sin_zero, h_cos_val]
        push_cast
        ring
      have h_cont_F_R : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => 2 / (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)) :=
        Continuous.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop) (fun w => by positivity)
      have hF_R_int : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => 2 / (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)) volume := by
        refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul 2).mono' h_cont_F_R.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with w
        have h_nn : 0 ≤ 2 / (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2) := by positivity
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg h_nn, div_eq_mul_inv]
        have h_pi : 1 ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [Real.pi_gt_three]
        have h_w2 : w ^ 2 ≤ (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2 := by
          calc w ^ 2 = 1 * w ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ (2 * Real.pi) ^ 2 * w ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_pi (sq_nonneg w)
          _ = (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2 := by ring
        have h_inv : (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + w ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_inv (by positivity)
      have hF_int : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier f) volume := by
        rw [funext h_fourier]
        exact hF_R_int.ofReal
      have h_inv := congr_fun (Continuous.fourierInv_fourier_eq hf_cont hf_int hF_int) u
      have h_re_eq : RCLike.re (FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (FourierTransform.fourier f) u) = RCLike.re (f u) :=
        congr_arg RCLike.re h_inv
      rw [Real.fourierInv_eq'] at h_re_eq
      have h_inv_int : Integrable (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) volume := by
        have h_cont : Continuous (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) := by
          rw [funext h_fourier]
          exact Continuous.smul (by fun_prop) (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp h_cont_F_R)
        refine hF_R_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with w
        rw [h_fourier w, smul_eq_mul, norm_mul, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul,
            Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      rw [← integral_re h_inv_int] at h_re_eq
      have h_re_lhs :
          (fun w : ℝ => RCLike.re (Complex.exp (↑(2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w)) =
          (fun w : ℝ => 2 * (Real.cos ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u) / (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2))) := by
        ext w
        have h_inner : 2 * Real.pi * inner ℝ w u = (2 * Real.pi * w) * u := by
          change 2 * Real.pi * (u * w) = (2 * Real.pi * w) * u
          ring
        rw [h_fourier w, smul_eq_mul, h_inner, Complex.exp_mul_I, ← Complex.ofReal_cos, ← Complex.ofReal_sin]
        set c_w : ℝ := Real.cos ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u)
        set s_w : ℝ := Real.sin ((2 * Real.pi * w) * u)
        set d_w : ℝ := 2 / (1 + (2 * Real.pi * w) ^ 2)
        have h_prod : ((c_w : ℂ) + (s_w : ℂ) * I) * (d_w : ℂ) = ((c_w * d_w : ℝ) : ℂ) + ((s_w * d_w : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
          push_cast; ring
        rw [h_prod]
        simp only [RCLike.re_eq_complex_re, Complex.add_re, Complex.ofReal_re, Complex.mul_re,
          Complex.ofReal_im, Complex.I_re, Complex.I_im, mul_zero]
        dsimp [c_w, d_w]
        ring
      have h_re_rhs : RCLike.re (f u) = Real.exp (-1 * |u|) := by
        dsimp [f, f_R]
      rw [h_re_lhs, h_re_rhs, integral_const_mul] at h_re_eq
      let h_func : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ => Real.cos (ξ * u) / (1 + ξ ^ 2)
      have h_cov := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left h_func (2 * Real.pi)
      have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
      rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h_2pi_pos), smul_eq_mul] at h_cov
      change 2 * ∫ w : ℝ, h_func (2 * Real.pi * w) = Real.exp (-1 * |u|) at h_re_eq
      rw [h_cov] at h_re_eq
      set I_val : ℝ := ∫ ξ : ℝ, h_func ξ
      calc I_val
        _ = Real.pi * (2 * ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_val)) := by
            field_simp

        have h_sq : (c * I₁) ^ 2 ≤ (α₁ + β₁) ^ 2 := by
          calc (c * I₁) ^ 2
            _ = (2 * (u * δ ^ m) * δ * r * I₁) ^ 2 := by
              dsimp [c]; rw [h_2δ_pow]
            _ = (4 * u ^ 2 * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2) * (δ ^ 2 * I₁ ^ 2) := by ring
            _ ≤ (4 * u ^ 2 * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2) * (α₁ * H₁) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_δI₁ (by positivity)
            _ = 4 * α₁ * β₁ := by dsimp [β₁]; ring
            _ ≤ (α₁ + β₁) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α₁ - β₁)]
        exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq (add_nonneg hα₁_nn hβ₁_nn)).2
      set α₂ := u * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2 * H₂
      set β₂ := u * δ ^ (2 * m + 2) * H_Δ
      have hα₂_nn : 0 ≤ α₂ := by positivity
      have hβ₂_nn : 0 ≤ β₂ := by positivity
      have h_cI₂ : c * I₂ ≤ α₂ + β₂ := by
        have h_I₂_bound : I₂ ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ (2 * m) * H₂ * H_Δ := by
          calc I₂ ^ 2
            _ ≤ E w₂ (m + 1) * H_Δ := hI₂_sq
            _ ≤ (δ ^ (2 * m) * H₂) * H_Δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hE_w2_pow m) hHΔ_nn
        have h_sq : (c * I₂) ^ 2 ≤ (α₂ + β₂) ^ 2 := by
          calc (c * I₂) ^ 2
            _ = (2 * (u * δ ^ m) * δ * r * I₂) ^ 2 := by
              dsimp [c]; rw [h_2δ_pow]
            _ = (4 * u ^ 2 * δ ^ (2 * m + 2) * r ^ 2) * I₂ ^ 2 := by ring
            _ ≤ (4 * u ^ 2 * δ ^ (2 * m + 2) * r ^ 2) * (δ ^ (2 * m) * H₂ * H_Δ) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_I₂_bound (by positivity)
            _ = 4 * α₂ * β₂ := by dsimp [α₂, β₂]; ring
            _ ≤ (α₂ + β₂) ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg (α₂ - β₂)]
        exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq (add_nonneg hα₂_nn hβ₂_nn)).2
      calc c * |Δh|
        _ ≤ c * (I₁ + I₂) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΔh_le hc_nn
        _ = c * I₁ + c * I₂ := mul_add c I₁ I₂
        _ ≤ (α₁ + β₁) + (α₂ + β₂) := add_le_add h_cI₁ h_cI₂
        _ = (2 * u * δ ^ (2 * m + 2)) * H_Δ +
            (u ^ 2 * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2) * H₁ +
            ((3 * u - 2) * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2) * H₂ := by
          dsimp [α₁, β₁, α₂, β₂]; ring
  set f : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x|
  by_cases h_zero : δ = 0 ∨ r = 0
  · have hf_zero : f = fun _ => 0 := by
      ext x
      exact (h_pt x).1 h_zero
    change (∫ x : ℝ, f x) ≤ (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * r
    rw [hf_zero, integral_zero]
    positivity
  · push_neg at h_zero
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := lt_of_le_of_ne hδ (Ne.symm h_zero.1)
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_of_le_of_ne hr_nn (Ne.symm h_zero.2)
    by_cases hf : Integrable f volume
    · set c := 2 * (2 * δ) ^ m * δ * r
      have hc_pos : 0 < c := by positivity
      set C_Δ := 2 * u * δ ^ (2 * m + 2)
      set C₁ := u ^ 2 * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2
      set C₂ := (3 * u - 2) * δ ^ (2 * m) * r ^ 2
      have hCΔ_nn : 0 ≤ C_Δ := by positivity
      have hC₁_nn : 0 ≤ C₁ := by positivity
      have hC₂_nn : 0 ≤ C₂ := by
        dsimp [C₂]
        have : 0 ≤ 3 * u - 2 := by linarith
        positivity
      have h_int_Δ := (h_h2 w_Δ).1.const_mul C_Δ
      have h_int_1 := (h_h2 w₁).1.const_mul C₁
      have h_int_2 := (h_h2 w₂).1.const_mul C₂
      have h_int_Δ1 :
          Integrable (fun x : ℝ => C_Δ * greenIterKernel 1 w_Δ 2 x x + C₁ * greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 2 x x) :=
        h_int_Δ.add h_int_1
      have h_mono :
          (∫ x : ℝ, c * f x) ≤
            ∫ x : ℝ,
              ((C_Δ * greenIterKernel 1 w_Δ 2 x x +
                C₁ * greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 2 x x) +
                C₂ * greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 2 x x) :=
        integral_mono (hf.const_mul c) (h_int_Δ1.add h_int_2) (fun x => (h_pt x).2)
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add h_int_Δ1 h_int_2,
          integral_add h_int_Δ h_int_1, integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
          integral_const_mul] at h_mono
      have h_w1_sq : ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw₁ 2
      have h_w2_sq : ‖ι w₂‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw₂ 2
      have h_bΔ : C_Δ * (∫ x : ℝ, greenIterKernel 1 w_Δ 2 x x) ≤ C_Δ * r ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_h2 w_Δ).2 hCΔ_nn
      have h_b1 : C₁ * (∫ x : ℝ, greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 2 x x) ≤ C₁ * δ ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans (h_h2 w₁).2 h_w1_sq) hC₁_nn
      have h_b2 : C₂ * (∫ x : ℝ, greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 2 x x) ≤ C₂ * δ ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans (h_h2 w₂).2 h_w2_sq) hC₂_nn
      have h_2δ_pow : (2 * δ) ^ m = u * δ ^ m := mul_pow 2 δ m
      have h_2δ_pow1 : (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) = (u * δ ^ m) * (2 * δ) := by
        rw [pow_succ, h_2δ_pow]
      have h_poly : C_Δ * r ^ 2 + C₁ * δ ^ 2 + C₂ * δ ^ 2 ≤ c * ((2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * r) := by
        have h_diff : c * ((2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * r) - (C_Δ * r ^ 2 + C₁ * δ ^ 2 + C₂ * δ ^ 2) =
            (u - 1) * (3 * u - 2) * δ ^ (2 * m + 2) * r ^ 2 := by
          dsimp [c, C_Δ, C₁, C₂]
          rw [h_2δ_pow, h_2δ_pow1]
          ring
        have h_nn : 0 ≤ (u - 1) * (3 * u - 2) * δ ^ (2 * m + 2) * r ^ 2 := by
          have : 0 ≤ u - 1 := by linarith
          have : 0 ≤ 3 * u - 2 := by linarith
          positivity
        linarith
      have h_c_int : c * (∫ x : ℝ, f x) ≤ c * ((2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * r) := by
        linarith
      exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_c_int hc_pos
    · change (∫ x : ℝ, f x) ≤ (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * r
      rw [integral_undef hf]
      positivity

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨h_wp_cont, _h_wp_0, h_wp_B, h_wp_xy, h_wp_step⟩ := h_pkt
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ = ‖w x‖ := by
    intro ξ x
    have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) volume := by
    intro ξ
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) := by
      have := w.continuous
      fun_prop
    refine w.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
  have h_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine w) := by
    have h_cont_int : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)) := by
      refine continuous_of_dominated (fun ξ => (integrable_fourier_integrand ξ).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (fun ξ => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun x => le_of_eq (norm_fourier_integrand ξ x)))
        w.integrable.norm (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      fun_prop
    exact continuous_const.mul h_cont_int
  let C_w : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖
  have h_fl_bound : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ξ‖ ≤ C_w := by
    intro ξ
    dsimp [fourierLine, C_w]
    rw [norm_mul]
    gcongr
    calc
      ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖
        ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (w x : ℂ)‖ :=
          norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖w x‖ := by
          congr 1 with x
          exact norm_fourier_integrand ξ x
  have h_c1 : ∀ k : ℕ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iterFreqPacketOne w k p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ α ξ : ℝ, ‖iterFreqPacketOne w k α ξ‖ ≤ M := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨B, _hB_cont, hB_int, _hB_bdd, h_dom⟩ := h_wp_B k
    let K : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun p x =>
      Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * iterWavePacketOne w (k + 1) x p.2
    have hK_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (K p) volume := by
      intro p
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by fun_prop
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => iterWavePacketOne w (k + 1) x p.2) :=
        (h_wp_cont (k + 1)).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact (hc1.mul hc2).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hK_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, ‖K p x‖ ≤ B x := by
      intro p
      filter_upwards with x
      dsimp [K]
      have h_exp : -((p.1 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(p.1 * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
      exact h_dom x p.2
    have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => K p x) := by
      filter_upwards with x
      dsimp [K]
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by fun_prop
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => iterWavePacketOne w (k + 1) x p.2) :=
        (h_wp_cont (k + 1)).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
      exact hc1.mul hc2
    have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, K p x) :=
      continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom hB_int hK_cont
    have hB_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ B x := fun x =>
      le_trans (norm_nonneg (iterWavePacketOne w (k + 1) x 0)) (h_dom x 0)
    let M : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, B x
    have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg hB_nn)
    refine ⟨continuous_const.mul h_int_cont, M, hM_nn, ?_⟩
    intro α ξ
    dsimp [iterFreqPacketOne, M]
    rw [norm_mul]
    gcongr
    have hK_int : Integrable (K (α, ξ)) volume :=
      hB_int.mono' (hK_meas (α, ξ)) (hK_dom (α, ξ))
    calc ‖∫ x : ℝ, K (α, ξ) x‖
      _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖K (α, ξ) x‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (K (α, ξ))
      _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, B x := integral_mono_ae hK_int.norm hB_int (hK_dom (α, ξ))
  have h_c2 : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ ζ : ℝ,
      fourierLine (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w (m + 2) x x) ζ =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ,
          iterFreqPacketOne w (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro m ζ
    obtain ⟨B, _hB_cont, hB_int, _hB_bdd, h_dom⟩ := h_wp_B (m + 1)
    let G : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun x ξ =>
      Complex.exp (-(((ζ - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
        iterWavePacketOne w (m + 2) x ξ / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)
    have hG_cont : Continuous (Function.uncurry G) := by
      dsimp [Function.uncurry, G]
      refine Continuous.div ?_ ?_ ?_
      · have hc1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => Complex.exp (-(((ζ - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I)) := by
          fun_prop
        exact hc1.mul (h_wp_cont (m + 2))
      · exact Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp (continuous_const.add ((continuous_pow 2).comp continuous_snd))
      · intro p
        exact Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity)
    have hG_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry G) (volume.prod volume) := by
      refine (hB_int.mul_prod integrable_inv_one_add_sq).mono' hG_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with p
      dsimp [Function.uncurry, G]
      have h_exp : -(((ζ - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I = ((-((ζ - p.2) * p.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul,
          Complex.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + p.2 ^ 2), div_eq_mul_inv]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_dom p.1 p.2) (by positivity)
    have h_x_eq : (fun x : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (greenIterKernel 1 w (m + 2) x x : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, G x ξ) := by
      ext x
      rw [h_wp_xy (m + 2) x x, ← mul_assoc,
          mul_comm (Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ),
          mul_assoc, ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1; congr 1 with ξ
      dsimp [G]
      have h_exp : Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) =
          Complex.exp (-(((ζ - ξ : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1; push_cast; ring
      rw [← h_exp]
      ring
    have h_inner_x : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * (∫ x : ℝ, G x ξ) =
          iterFreqPacketOne w (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
      intro ξ
      dsimp [G, iterFreqPacketOne]
      rw [integral_div, mul_div_assoc]
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    rw [h_x_eq, integral_const_mul, integral_integral_swap hG_int,
        ← mul_assoc, mul_comm ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ),
        mul_assoc, ← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1; congr 1 with ξ
    exact h_inner_x ξ
  have h_exp_abs_int : Integrable (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * |u|)) volume := by
    have h_Ici : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * |u|)) (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
      have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1)).mono_set
        (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
      refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
      intro u hu
      dsimp
      have hu_nn : 0 ≤ u := hu
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hu_nn]
    have h_Iic : IntegrableOn (fun u : ℝ => Real.exp (-1 * |u|)) (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
      have h_neg := h_Ici.comp_neg
      rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
      refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
      intro u _
      dsimp
      rw [abs_neg]
    rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
    exact h_Iic.union (h_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
  have laplace_cos_integral_Ioi : ∀ (b : ℝ),
      ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-1 * v) * Real.cos (b * v) = 1 / (1 + b ^ 2) := by
