      refine div_le_div_of_nonneg_right ?_ (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos η))
      calc ‖ΔΨ k α η * fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η) +
            P w₂ k α η * fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖
        _ ≤ ‖ΔΨ k α η * fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ +
            ‖P w₂ k α η * fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ := norm_add_le _ _
        _ = A_Δ k α η * ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ +
            A w₂ k α η * ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ := by
          dsimp only [A_Δ, A]; rw [norm_mul, norm_mul]
    have h_int_g1 : Integrable (fun η : ℝ => A_Δ k α η * ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)) := by
      refine h_prod_int (A_Δ k α) (fun η => ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖) M_Δ C₁
        (hAΔ_cont k α) (h_fl1_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).norm
        hM_Δ hC₁ (hA_Δ α) (fun η => ?_)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact h_fl1_le (ξ - η)
    have h_int_g2 : Integrable (fun η : ℝ => A w₂ k α η * ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)) := by
      obtain ⟨M_w2, hM_w2, hA_w2'⟩ := hA_bound w₂ k
      refine h_prod_int (A w₂ k α) (fun η => ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖) M_w2 C_Δ
        (hA_cont w₂ k α) (h_flΔ_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).norm
        hM_w2 hC_Δ (hA_w2' α) (fun η => ?_)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
      exact h_flΔ_le (ξ - η)
    dsimp only [A_Δ]
    rw [h_sub_eq, norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real,
        Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
    calc ‖∫ η : ℝ, (F₁ η / ((1 + η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) - F₂ η / ((1 + η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ))‖
      _ ≤ ∫ η : ℝ, ‖F₁ η / ((1 + η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) - F₂ η / ((1 + η ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ ≤ ∫ η : ℝ, (A_Δ k α η * ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2) +
            A w₂ k α η * ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)) :=
        integral_mono (hF₁_int.sub hF₂_int).norm (h_int_g1.add h_int_g2) h_pw_η
      _ = (∫ η : ℝ, A_Δ k α η * ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)) +
          (∫ η : ℝ, A w₂ k α η * ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)) :=
        integral_add h_int_g1 h_int_g2
  have hD_step : ∀ (k : ℕ) (α : ℝ), D (k + 1) α ≤ 2 * δ ^ 2 * D k α + 2 * r ^ 2 * E w₂ k α := by
    intro k α
    obtain ⟨M_Δ, hM_Δ, hA_Δ⟩ := hAΔ_bound k
    obtain ⟨M_Δ1, hM_Δ1, hA_Δ1⟩ := hAΔ_bound (k + 1)
    obtain ⟨M_w2, hM_w2, hA_w2⟩ := hA_bound w₂ k
    have h_pw_ξ : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        (1 / (2 * π)) * (A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
          (2 * D k α) * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) +
          (2 * E w₂ k α) * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) := by
      intro ξ
      set S₁ := (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ η : ℝ, A_Δ k α η * ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)
      set S₂ := (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ η : ℝ, A w₂ k α η * ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ / (1 + η ^ 2)
      have h_step_le : A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ≤ S₁ + S₂ := by
        simpa only [S₁, S₂, mul_add] using hΔ_step_norm k α ξ
      have h_sq_le : A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * S₁ ^ 2 + 2 * S₂ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 ≤ (S₁ + S₂) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_step_le 2
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (S₁ - S₂)]
      have h_div_le :
          (1 / (2 * π)) * (A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
            2 * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (S₁ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) +
            2 * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (S₂ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
        have h2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
          (div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sq_le (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))
          (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / (2 * π))
        linarith [ (by ring : (1 / (2 * π)) * ((2 * S₁ ^ 2 + 2 * S₂ ^ 2) / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          2 * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (S₁ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) + 2 * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (S₂ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2)))) ]
      have h_p1 := h_pw_step_gen w₁ (A_Δ k α) M_Δ (hAΔ_cont k α) hM_Δ (hA_Δ α) ξ
      have h_p2 := h_pw_step_gen w_Δ (A w₂ k α) M_w2 (hA_cont w₂ k α) hM_w2 (hA_w2 α) ξ
      calc (1 / (2 * π)) * (A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))
        _ ≤ 2 * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (S₁ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) +
            2 * ((1 / (2 * π)) * (S₂ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) := h_div_le
        _ ≤ 2 * (D k α * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2)))) +
            2 * (E w₂ k α * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2)))) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_p1 (by norm_num))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_p2 (by norm_num))
        _ = (2 * D k α) * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) +
            (2 * E w₂ k α) * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) := by
          ring
    have h_lhs_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / (2 * π)) * (A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
      (h_sq_int (A_Δ (k + 1) α) M_Δ1 (hAΔ_cont (k + 1) α) hM_Δ1 (hA_Δ1 α)).const_mul (1 / (2 * π))
    have h_rhs1_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        (2 * D k α) * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) :=
      ((h_hs w₁).1.integral_prod_left).const_mul (2 * D k α)
    have h_rhs2_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        (2 * E w₂ k α) * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) :=
      ((h_hs w_Δ).1.integral_prod_left).const_mul (2 * E w₂ k α)
    have h1_le : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * D k α) * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) ≤
        2 * δ ^ 2 * D k α := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      have h_hs1 := le_trans (h_hs w₁).2 h_w1_sq
      nlinarith [hD_nn k α, h_hs1]
    have h2_le : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * E w₂ k α) * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) ≤
        2 * r ^ 2 * E w₂ k α := by
      rw [integral_const_mul]
      have h_hsΔ : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) ≤ r ^ 2 :=
        (h_hs w_Δ).2
      nlinarith [hE_nn w₂ k α, h_hsΔ]
    calc D (k + 1) α
      _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 / (2 * π)) * (A_Δ (k + 1) α ξ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
        dsimp only [D]; rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ,
          ((2 * D k α) * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) +
            (2 * E w₂ k α) * (∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2)))) :=
        integral_mono h_lhs_int (h_rhs1_int.add h_rhs2_int) h_pw_ξ
      _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * D k α) * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w₁ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) +
          (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * E w₂ k α) * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w_Δ (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (1 + ξ ^ 2) * (1 + η ^ 2))) :=
        integral_add h_rhs1_int h_rhs2_int
      _ ≤ 2 * δ ^ 2 * D k α + 2 * r ^ 2 * E w₂ k α := add_le_add h1_le h2_le
  have hD_ind : ∀ k : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun α : ℝ => (1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) volume ∧
      (∫ α : ℝ, (1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) ≤ (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ k * r ^ 2 := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      have h_fn : (fun α : ℝ => (1 + α ^ 2) * D 0 α) =
          (fun α : ℝ => (1 + α ^ 2) * ((1 / (2 * π)) *
            ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖-fourierLine w_Δ (ξ + α) / ((1 + α ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
        ext α; dsimp only [D, A_Δ, ΔΨ]
        congr 2; congr 1 with ξ
        have h_sub : P w₁ 0 α ξ - P w₂ 0 α ξ =
            -fourierLine w_Δ (ξ + α) / ((1 + α ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
          rw [(h_freq w₁).2.2.1 α ξ, (h_freq w₂).2.2.1 α ξ, ← h_fl_sub (ξ + α)]
          ring
        rw [h_sub]
      rw [h_fn, pow_zero, one_mul]
      exact h_zero_energy w_Δ
    | succ k ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_int_Dk, h_le_Dk⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨h_int_Ek, h_le_Ek⟩ := hE_ind w₂ k
      obtain ⟨M_Δ1, hM_Δ1, h_b_Δ1⟩ := hΔΨ_bound (k + 1)
      have h_cont_Dk1 : Continuous (fun α : ℝ => (1 + α ^ 2) * D (k + 1) α) :=
        h_energy_cont (ΔΨ (k + 1)) M_Δ1 (hΔΨ_cont (k + 1)) hM_Δ1 h_b_Δ1
      have h_pw_α : ∀ α : ℝ,
          (1 + α ^ 2) * D (k + 1) α ≤
            (2 * δ ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) + (2 * r ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * E w₂ k α) := by
        intro α
        calc (1 + α ^ 2) * D (k + 1) α
          _ ≤ (1 + α ^ 2) * (2 * δ ^ 2 * D k α + 2 * r ^ 2 * E w₂ k α) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hD_step k α) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos α))
          _ = (2 * δ ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) + (2 * r ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * E w₂ k α) := by ring
      have h_rhs_int : Integrable (fun α : ℝ =>
          (2 * δ ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) + (2 * r ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * E w₂ k α)) volume :=
        (h_int_Dk.const_mul (2 * δ ^ 2)).add (h_int_Ek.const_mul (2 * r ^ 2))
      have h_int_Dk1 : Integrable (fun α : ℝ => (1 + α ^ 2) * D (k + 1) α) volume := by
        refine h_rhs_int.mono' h_cont_Dk1.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with α
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos α)) (hD_nn (k + 1) α))]
        exact h_pw_α α
      refine ⟨h_int_Dk1, ?_⟩
      have h_w2_pow : ‖ι w₂‖ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) ≤ δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw₂ (2 * (k + 1))
      have h_4k_ge1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (4 : ℝ) ^ k := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have h_pow_id : (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ k = (4 : ℝ) ^ k * δ ^ (2 * k) := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
      have h_pow_id1 : (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (k + 1) = 4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ k * δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) := by
        rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul]
        ring
      have h_comb : (2 * δ ^ 2) * ((4 * δ ^ 2) ^ k * r ^ 2) + (2 * r ^ 2) * δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) ≤
          (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (k + 1) * r ^ 2 := by
        rw [h_pow_id, h_pow_id1]
        have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) * r ^ 2 := by positivity
        calc (2 * δ ^ 2) * ((4 : ℝ) ^ k * δ ^ (2 * k) * r ^ 2) + (2 * r ^ 2) * δ ^ (2 * (k + 1))
          _ = (2 * (4 : ℝ) ^ k + 2) * (δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) * r ^ 2) := by ring
          _ ≤ (4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ k) * (δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) * r ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) h_nonneg
          _ = 4 * (4 : ℝ) ^ k * δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) * r ^ 2 := by ring
      calc (∫ α : ℝ, (1 + α ^ 2) * D (k + 1) α)
        _ ≤ ∫ α : ℝ, ((2 * δ ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) + (2 * r ^ 2) * ((1 + α ^ 2) * E w₂ k α)) :=
          integral_mono h_int_Dk1 h_rhs_int h_pw_α
        _ = (2 * δ ^ 2) * (∫ α : ℝ, (1 + α ^ 2) * D k α) + (2 * r ^ 2) * (∫ α : ℝ, (1 + α ^ 2) * E w₂ k α) := by
          rw [integral_add (h_int_Dk.const_mul (2 * δ ^ 2)) (h_int_Ek.const_mul (2 * r ^ 2)),
              integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
        _ ≤ (2 * δ ^ 2) * ((4 * δ ^ 2) ^ k * r ^ 2) + (2 * r ^ 2) * δ ^ (2 * (k + 1)) :=
          add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_le_Dk (by positivity))
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_trans h_le_Ek h_w2_pow) (by positivity))
        _ ≤ (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (k + 1) * r ^ 2 := h_comb
  obtain ⟨hE1_int, hE1_le⟩ := hE_ind w₁ (m + 1)
  obtain ⟨hD_int, hD_le⟩ := hD_ind (m + 1)
  obtain ⟨h_h1_int1, h_h1_le1⟩ :=
    h_crux (fun x => diagK w₁ m x) (h_int_diag w₁ m)
      (P w₁ (m + 1)) ((h_freq w₁).1 (m + 1)).1 ((h_freq w₁).1 (m + 1)).2
      ((h_freq w₁).2.1 m) (‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2))) hE1_int hE1_le
  have hf_Δ_int : Integrable (fun x => diagK w₁ m x - diagK w₂ m x) volume :=
    (h_int_diag w₁ m).sub (h_int_diag w₂ m)
  have h_fl_Δ_eq : ∀ ζ : ℝ,
      fourierLine (fun x => diagK w₁ m x - diagK w₂ m x) ζ =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ΔΨ (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
    intro ζ
    have h_fl_diff :=
      h_fl_sub_fn (fun x => diagK w₁ m x) (fun x => diagK w₂ m x)
        (h_int_diag w₁ m) (h_int_diag w₂ m) ζ
    obtain ⟨h_c1, M₁, hM₁, h_b1⟩ := (h_freq w₁).1 (m + 1)
    obtain ⟨h_c2, M₂, hM₂, h_b2⟩ := (h_freq w₂).1 (m + 1)
    have h_ξ_int1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        P w₁ (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      h_cpx_int (fun ξ => P w₁ (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ) M₁
        (h_c1.comp ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).prodMk continuous_id)) hM₁
        (fun ξ => h_b1 (ζ - ξ) ξ)
    have h_ξ_int2 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        P w₂ (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ / ((1 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) :=
      h_cpx_int (fun ξ => P w₂ (m + 1) (ζ - ξ) ξ) M₂
        (h_c2.comp ((continuous_const.sub continuous_id).prodMk continuous_id)) hM₂
        (fun ξ => h_b2 (ζ - ξ) ξ)
    rw [h_fl_diff, (h_freq w₁).2.1 m ζ, (h_freq w₂).2.1 m ζ, ← mul_sub,
        ← integral_sub h_ξ_int1 h_ξ_int2]
    congr 1; congr 1 with ξ
    dsimp only [ΔΨ]
    ring
  obtain ⟨h_h1_int_diff, h_h1_le_diff⟩ :=
    h_crux (fun x => diagK w₁ m x - diagK w₂ m x)
      hf_Δ_int (ΔΨ (m + 1)) (hΔΨ_cont (m + 1)) (hΔΨ_bound (m + 1))
      h_fl_Δ_eq ((4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * r ^ 2) hD_int hD_le
  exact ⟨h_h1_int1, h_h1_le1, h_h1_int_diff, h_h1_le_diff⟩

signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_2pi_pos : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * π := by positivity
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  set r := ‖ι w‖
  have hr : 0 ≤ r := norm_nonneg _
  have h_hm1_nn : 0 ≤ hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
    dsimp [hm1KappaSq]
    exact integral_nonneg (fun ξ => by positivity)
  have h_hm1_le : hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    let f : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := (ι w : Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ))
    have h_base : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (Lp.memLp f).integrable_norm_pow (by norm_num)
    have h_m_nonneg : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 ≤ (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
      fun ξ => div_nonneg (by positivity) (by positivity)
    have h_m_le_one : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
      intro ξ
      exact div_le_one_of_le₀ (by nlinarith) (by positivity)
    have h_cont_m : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
      Continuous.div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2))
        (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (by positivity))
    have h_int_w : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((4 + ξ ^ 2) / (4 * κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
      refine h_base.mono' (h_cont_m.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_base.aestronglyMeasurable) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (h_m_nonneg ξ) (sq_nonneg _))]
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one ξ)
    have h_norm_sq : r ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      change ‖f‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ‖ ^ 2
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq f, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def f f]
      congr 1
      ext ξ
      exact real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq ((f : ℝ → ℂ) ξ)
    rw [h_norm_sq]
    exact integral_mono h_int_w h_base (fun ξ => mul_le_of_le_one_left (sq_nonneg _) (h_m_le_one ξ))
  obtain ⟨h_int, h_hs_eq⟩ := hilbertSchmidt_fourier_integral_eq_hm1KappaSq κ hκ w
  have h_hs : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ,
      ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) ≤ r ^ 2 := by
    rw [h_hs_eq]
    have h_inv_le : 1 / κ ≤ 1 := div_le_one_of_le₀ hκ (le_of_lt hκ_pos)
    calc (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)
      _ ≤ 1 * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_le h_hm1_nn
      _ ≤ r ^ 2 := by linarith
  obtain ⟨⟨h_inv_int, h_inv_eq⟩, h_fg⟩ := freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq κ hκ
  obtain ⟨h_pkt, h_iter_eq, _⟩ :=
    iterWavePacket_continuous_and_greenIterKernel_eq κ hκ w h_fg
  obtain ⟨_, _, h_step_le⟩ :=
    iterWavePacket_diag_shift_and_step_le κ hκ w x (fun m => h_pkt m x) (fun m z => h_iter_eq m x z)
  have h_prod_int : ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ) (M_A M_B : ℝ),
      Continuous A → Continuous B → 0 ≤ M_A → 0 ≤ M_B →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, |A ξ| ≤ M_A) → (∀ ξ : ℝ, |B ξ| ≤ M_B) →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro A B M_A M_B hA_cont hB_cont hMA _hMB hA_le hB_le
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
      (hA_cont.mul hB_cont).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2))
        (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ))
    refine (h_inv_int.const_mul (M_A * M_B)).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (h_denom_pos ξ)]
    have h_ab : |A ξ| * |B ξ| ≤ M_A * M_B :=
      mul_le_mul (hA_le ξ) (hB_le ξ) (abs_nonneg _) hMA
    calc |A ξ| * |B ξ| / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
      _ ≤ (M_A * M_B) / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_ab (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))
      _ = (M_A * M_B) * (1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by ring
  have h_sq_int : ∀ (A : ℝ → ℝ) (M_A : ℝ),
      Continuous A → 0 ≤ M_A → (∀ ξ : ℝ, |A ξ| ≤ M_A) →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro A M_A hA_cont hMA hA_le
    have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => A ξ * A ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
      ext ξ; ring
    rw [h_eq]
    exact h_prod_int A A M_A M_A hA_cont hA_cont hMA hMA hA_le hA_le
  have h_wcs : ∀ (A B : ℝ → ℝ) (M_A M_B : ℝ),
      Continuous A → Continuous B → 0 ≤ M_A → 0 ≤ M_B →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, |A ξ| ≤ M_A) → (∀ ξ : ℝ, |B ξ| ≤ M_B) →
      (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 ≤
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    intro A B M_A M_B hA_cont hB_cont hMA hMB hA_le hB_le
    have hIA_int := h_sq_int A M_A hA_cont hMA hA_le
    have hIB_int := h_sq_int B M_B hB_cont hMB hB_le
    have hIAB_int := h_prod_int A B M_A M_B hA_cont hB_cont hMA hMB hA_le hB_le
    set I_A := ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    set I_B := ∫ ξ : ℝ, B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    set I_AB := ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
    have hIB_nn : 0 ≤ I_B :=
      integral_nonneg (fun ξ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))
    have h_quad : ∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ I_A - 2 * t * I_AB + t ^ 2 * I_B := by
      intro t
      have h_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ - t * B ξ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) :=
        integral_nonneg (fun ξ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)))
      have h_eq_int : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ - t * B ξ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          I_A - 2 * t * I_AB + t ^ 2 * I_B := by
        calc (∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ - t * B ξ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
          _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) - (2 * t) * (A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) +
                t ^ 2 * (B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
            congr 1; ext ξ; ring
          _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, (A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) - (2 * t) * (A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)))) +
              (∫ ξ : ℝ, t ^ 2 * (B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
            integral_add (hIA_int.sub (hIAB_int.const_mul (2 * t))) (hIB_int.const_mul (t ^ 2))
          _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) -
              (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * t) * (A ξ * B ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) +
              (∫ ξ : ℝ, t ^ 2 * (B ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) := by
            rw [integral_sub hIA_int (hIAB_int.const_mul (2 * t))]
          _ = I_A - 2 * t * I_AB + t ^ 2 * I_B := by
            rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
      linarith
    by_cases hIB_zero : I_B = 0
    · have hIAB_zero : I_AB = 0 := by
        by_contra h_ne
        have hq := h_quad ((I_A + 1) / (2 * I_AB))
        rw [hIB_zero, mul_zero, add_zero] at hq
        have h_cancel : 2 * ((I_A + 1) / (2 * I_AB)) * I_AB = I_A + 1 := by
          field_simp [h_ne]
        linarith
      rw [hIAB_zero, hIB_zero]
      norm_num
    · have hIB_pos : 0 < I_B := lt_of_le_of_ne hIB_nn (Ne.symm hIB_zero)
      have hq := h_quad (I_AB / I_B)
      have hq_mul := mul_nonneg (le_of_lt hIB_pos) hq
      have h_id : I_B * (I_A - 2 * (I_AB / I_B) * I_AB + (I_AB / I_B) ^ 2 * I_B) =
          I_A * I_B - I_AB ^ 2 := by
        field_simp [hIB_zero]
        ring
      linarith
  have h_fl_cont_bound : Continuous (fourierLine w) ∧
      ∃ C_w : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_w ∧ ∀ ζ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w ζ‖ ≤ C_w := by
    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun ζ z => Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (w z : ℂ)
    let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ‖w z‖
    have hw_int : Integrable bound volume := w.integrable.norm
    have hK_meas : ∀ ζ : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (K ζ) volume := by
      intro ζ
      have hc : Continuous (K ζ) := by
        dsimp [K]
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (((continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp w.continuous)
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hK_dom : ∀ ζ : ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖K ζ z‖ ≤ bound z := by
      intro ζ
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K, bound]
      rw [norm_mul, show -((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ζ * z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
      exact le_rfl
    have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => K ζ z) := by
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K]
      exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
        continuous_const
    have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, K ζ z) :=
      continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom hw_int hK_cont
    refine ⟨continuous_const.mul h_int_cont,
      ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ z : ℝ, bound z,
      mul_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) (integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg _)), ?_⟩
    intro ζ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    rw [norm_mul]
    refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (norm_nonneg _)
    calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, K ζ z‖
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖K ζ z‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm (K ζ)
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z :=
        integral_mono_ae ((hw_int.mono' (hK_meas ζ) (hK_dom ζ)).norm) hw_int (hK_dom ζ)
  obtain ⟨h_fl_cont, C_w, hC_w, h_fl_le⟩ := h_fl_cont_bound
  let A : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m ξ => ‖iterWavePacket κ w m x ξ‖
  let E : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => (1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, A m ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)
  have hA_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (A m) := fun m => (h_pkt m x).1.norm
  have hA_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ : ℝ, |A m ξ| ≤ M := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨M, hM, hM_le⟩ := (h_pkt m x).2
    refine ⟨M, hM, fun ξ => ?_⟩
    dsimp [A]
    rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
    exact hM_le ξ
  have hE_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ E m := by
    intro m
    dsimp [E]
    exact mul_nonneg (by positivity)
      (integral_nonneg (fun ξ => div_nonneg (sq_nonneg _) (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))))
  have hE0 : E 0 = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    dsimp [E, A, iterWavePacket]
    have h_norm0 : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)‖ ^ 2 = 1 := by
      intro ξ
      rw [show -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_pow]
    simp_rw [h_norm0]
    exact h_inv_eq
  have hE_step : ∀ m : ℕ, E (m + 1) ≤ r ^ 2 * E m := by
    intro m
    obtain ⟨M_m, hM_m, hA_m⟩ := hA_bound m
    obtain ⟨M_m1, hM_m1, hA_m1⟩ := hA_bound (m + 1)
    have h_pw_ξ : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ≤
          E m * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) := by
      intro ξ
      let B_ξ : ℝ → ℝ := fun η => ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖
      have hB_cont : Continuous B_ξ := (h_fl_cont.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id)).norm
      have hB_le : ∀ η : ℝ, |B_ξ η| ≤ C_w := by
        intro η
        dsimp [B_ξ]
        rw [abs_of_nonneg (norm_nonneg _)]
        exact h_fl_le (ξ - η)
      have h_sq_ξ : A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 ≤
          E m * ∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) := by
        calc A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2
          _ ≤ ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ η : ℝ, A m η * B_ξ η / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h_step_le m ξ) 2
          _ = (1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ η : ℝ, A m η * B_ξ η / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
            rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt h_2pi_pos), one_div]
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) *
              ((∫ η : ℝ, A m η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) * (∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
              (h_wcs (A m) B_ξ M_m C_w (hA_cont m) hB_cont hM_m hC_w hA_m hB_le) (by positivity)
          _ = E m * ∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2) := by
            dsimp [E]; ring
      have h_inner_eq :
          (1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * (∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) =
            ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) := by
        rw [← integral_const_mul]
        congr 1
        ext η
        dsimp [B_ξ]
        have h1 : (2 * π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_2pi_pos
        have h2 : κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ)
        have h3 : κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos η)
        field_simp
      have h_lhs_eq :
          (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
            (1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 := by
        have h1 : (2 * π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_2pi_pos
        have h2 : κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (h_denom_pos ξ)
        field_simp
      calc (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))
        _ = (1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 := h_lhs_eq
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * (E m * ∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq_ξ (by positivity)
        _ = E m * ((1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * ∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) := by ring
        _ = E m * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) := by
          rw [h_inner_eq]
    have h_lhs_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
      (h_sq_int (A (m + 1)) M_m1 (hA_cont (m + 1)) hM_m1 hA_m1).const_mul (1 / (2 * π))
    have h_rhs_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        E m * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) :=
      (h_int.integral_prod_left).const_mul (E m)
    calc E (m + 1)
      _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
        dsimp [E]
        rw [integral_const_mul]
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, E m * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) :=
        integral_mono h_lhs_int h_rhs_int h_pw_ξ
      _ = E m * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) :=
        integral_const_mul _ _
      _ ≤ E m * r ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_hs (hE_nn m)
      _ = r ^ 2 * E m := by ring
  have hE_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, E m ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ m) ^ 2 := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      rw [hE0, pow_zero, one_pow, mul_one]
    | succ m ih =>
      calc E (m + 1)
        _ ≤ r ^ 2 * E m := hE_step m
        _ ≤ r ^ 2 * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ m) ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (sq_nonneg r)
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ (m + 1)) ^ 2 := by ring
  have h_offdiag_mod : |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤
      (1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    have h_eq := h_iter_eq ℓ x y
    have h_norm := congr_arg norm h_eq
    have h_lhs : ‖(greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y : ℂ)‖ = |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| := by
      rw [Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_2pi_norm : ‖(1 / (2 * π) : ℂ)‖ = 1 / (2 * π) := by
      rw [show (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) = (((1 / (2 * π) : ℝ) : ℂ)) by push_cast; rfl,
          Complex.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have h_integrand_norm : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ * Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ =
          A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
      intro ξ
      rw [norm_div, norm_mul,
          show ((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I = (((ξ * y : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, mul_one,
          Complex.norm_of_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))]
    calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y|
      _ = ‖(greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y : ℂ)‖ := h_lhs.symm
      _ = ‖(1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
            ∫ ξ : ℝ,
              iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ *
                Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := h_norm
      _ = (1 / (2 * π)) *
          ‖∫ ξ : ℝ,
            iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ *
              Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ := by
        rw [norm_mul, h_2pi_norm]
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) *
          ∫ ξ : ℝ,
            ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ *
              Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)‖ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) (by positivity)
      _ = (1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) := by
        simp_rw [h_integrand_norm]
  obtain ⟨M_ℓ, hM_ℓ, hA_ℓ⟩ := hA_bound ℓ
  have h_eq1 : (fun ξ : ℝ => A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
      (fun ξ : ℝ => A ℓ ξ * 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    ext ξ; ring
  have h_eq_one : (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
      (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    ext ξ; ring
  have h_cs := h_wcs (A ℓ) (fun _ => 1) M_ℓ 1 (hA_cont ℓ) continuous_const hM_ℓ zero_le_one
    hA_ℓ (fun _ => by norm_num)
  rw [← h_eq1, h_eq_one] at h_cs
  have h_offdiag_sq : (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * E ℓ := by
    calc (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y) ^ 2
      _ = |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
      _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h_offdiag_mod 2
      _ = (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by ring
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 *
          ((∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (by positivity)
      _ = ((1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * E ℓ := by
        dsimp [E]; ring
      _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * E ℓ := by rw [h_inv_eq]
  have h_sq : (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y) ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / (2 * κ)) * r ^ ℓ) ^ 2 := by
    calc (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y) ^ 2
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * E ℓ := h_offdiag_sq
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ ℓ) ^ 2) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hE_pow ℓ) (by positivity)
      _ = ((1 / (2 * κ)) * r ^ ℓ) ^ 2 := by ring
  exact abs_le.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq (by positivity))

subgoal_signatures.name: hilbertSchmidt_fourier_integral_eq_hm1KappaSq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      ‖fourierLine w (p.1 - p.2)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + p.1 ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2))) ∧
    (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ,
      ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) =
      (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
      (1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) = 1 / (2 * κ)) ∧
    ∀ a b : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
          Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
        (∫ ξ : ℝ,
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (freeGreenKernel κ a b : ℂ)

subgoal_signatures.name: iterWavePacket_continuous_and_greenIterKernel_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    (h_fg : ∀ a b : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
          Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
        (∫ ξ : ℝ,
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (freeGreenKernel κ a b : ℂ)) :
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ‖ ≤ M) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x y : ℝ,
      (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y : ℂ) =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ ξ : ℝ,
            iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ *
              Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x| ≤
        (1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ‖ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))

subgoal_signatures.name: iterWavePacket_diag_shift_and_step_le
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ)
    (h_pkt : ∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ‖ ≤ M)
    (h_iter_eq : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ y : ℝ,
      (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y : ℂ) =
        (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          ∫ ξ : ℝ,
            iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ *
              Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) :
    greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x =
      (1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w 1 x ξ‖ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ,
      |greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) x x| ≤
        (1 / (2 * π)) *
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x ξ‖ * ‖iterWavePacket κ w 1 x ξ‖ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      ‖iterWavePacket κ w (ℓ + 1) x ξ‖ ≤
        (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ *
          ∫ η : ℝ,
            ‖iterWavePacket κ w ℓ x η‖ * ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
      -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z)

signature.name: greenIterKernel_sub_eq_sum_antidiagonal
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
      -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z)

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ a b| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro a b
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (2 * κ)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * |a - b|) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a - b)])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) h_exp_le
  have h_iter_cont_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ),
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b| ≤ M := by
    intro w ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨h_fg_cont, 1 / (2 * κ), by positivity, h_fg_bound⟩
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bound⟩ := ih
      let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z p.2
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => M * (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖w z‖
      have h_w_int : Integrable (w : ℝ → ℝ) volume := w.integrable
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        h_w_int.norm.const_mul (M * (1 / (2 * κ)))
      have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
        intro p
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p z‖ ≤ bound z := by
        intro p
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h1 := hM_bound p.1 z
        have h2 := h_fg_bound z p.2
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|
          _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|) * |w z| := by ring
          _ ≤ (M * (1 / (2 * κ))) * |w z| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hM_nn) (abs_nonneg _)
      have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p z) := by
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F]
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
        exact (h_c1.mul continuous_const).mul h_c2
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, F p z) :=
        continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont
      refine ⟨h_int_cont.neg, ∫ z : ℝ, bound z, integral_nonneg (fun z => by dsimp [bound]; positivity), ?_⟩
      intro a b
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      rw [abs_neg]
      have hF_int : Integrable (F (a, b)) volume :=
        h_bound_int.mono' (hF_meas (a, b)) (hF_dom (a, b))
      calc |∫ z : ℝ, F (a, b) z|
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖F (a, b) z‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F (a, b))
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z := integral_mono_ae hF_int.norm h_bound_int (hF_dom (a, b))
  let Φ : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun i j a b z =>
    greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ j z b * (w₁ z - w₂ z)
  have h_step_int : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z b) volume := by
    intro w ℓ a b
    obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bound⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound w ℓ
    have h_bound_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (M * (1 / (2 * κ))) * ‖w z‖) volume :=
      w.integrable.norm.const_mul (M * (1 / (2 * κ)))
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z b) volume := by
      have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a z) :=
        h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z b) :=
        h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
    refine h_bound_int.mono' h_meas ?_
    filter_upwards with z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h1 := hM_bound a z
    have h2 := h_fg_bound z b
    calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z b|
      _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z b|) * |w z| := by ring
      _ ≤ (M * (1 / (2 * κ))) * |w z| :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hM_nn) (abs_nonneg _)
  have h_phi_int : ∀ (i j : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), Integrable (Φ i j a b) volume := by
    intro i j a b
    obtain ⟨h_c1, M₁, hM₁, h_b1⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound w₁ i
    obtain ⟨h_c2, M₂, _hM₂, h_b2⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound w₂ j
    have h_bound_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (M₁ * M₂) * ‖w₁ z - w₂ z‖) volume :=
      (w₁.integrable.sub w₂.integrable).norm.const_mul (M₁ * M₂)
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Φ i j a b) volume := by
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a z) :=
        h_c1.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₂ j z b) :=
        h_c2.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact ((hc1.mul hc2).mul (w₁.continuous.sub w₂.continuous)).aestronglyMeasurable
    refine h_bound_int.mono' h_meas ?_
    filter_upwards with z
    dsimp [Φ]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (mul_le_mul (h_b1 a z) (h_b2 z b) (abs_nonneg _) hM₁) (abs_nonneg _)
  have h_fub : ∀ (i j : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun u : ℝ => (∫ z : ℝ, Φ i j a u z) * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b) volume ∧
      (∫ u : ℝ, (∫ z : ℝ, Φ i j a u z) * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b) =
        -∫ z : ℝ, Φ i (j + 1) a b z := by
    intro i j a b
    obtain ⟨h_c1, M₁, hM₁, h_b1⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound w₁ i
    obtain ⟨h_c2, M₂, hM₂, h_b2⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound w₂ j
    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u z => Φ i j a u z * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b
    let g₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (M₂ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * ‖w₂ u‖
    let g₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => M₁ * ‖w₁ z - w₂ z‖
    have hg₁_int : Integrable g₁ volume := w₂.integrable.norm.const_mul (M₂ * (1 / (2 * κ)))
    have hg₂_int : Integrable g₂ volume := (w₁.integrable.sub w₂.integrable).norm.const_mul M₁
    have hg_prod : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g₁ p.1 * g₂ p.2) (volume.prod volume) :=
      hg₁_int.mul_prod hg₂_int
    have hK_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) := by
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a p.2) :=
        h_c1.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₂ j p.2 p.1) :=
        h_c2.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst)
      have hcw12 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w₁ p.2 - w₂ p.2) :=
        (w₁.continuous.comp continuous_snd).sub (w₂.continuous.comp continuous_snd)
      have hcw2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w₂ p.1) :=
        w₂.continuous.comp continuous_fst
      have hcfg : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 b) :=
        h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact ((((hc1.mul hc2).mul hcw12).mul hcw2).mul hcfg).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hK_dom : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂(volume.prod volume), ‖Function.uncurry K p‖ ≤ g₁ p.1 * g₂ p.2 := by
      filter_upwards with p
      dsimp [Function.uncurry, K, Φ, g₁, g₂]
      repeat rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 := h_b1 a p.2
      have h2 := h_b2 p.2 p.1
      have h0 := h_fg_bound p.1 b
      have h20 : |greenIterKernel κ w₂ j p.2 p.1| * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 b| ≤
          M₂ * (1 / (2 * κ)) :=
        mul_le_mul h2 h0 (abs_nonneg _) hM₂
      have h120 : (|greenIterKernel κ w₂ j p.2 p.1| * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 b|) *
          |greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a p.2| ≤ (M₂ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * M₁ :=
        mul_le_mul h20 h1 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      have h_w_nn : 0 ≤ |w₂ p.1| * |w₁ p.2 - w₂ p.2| := by positivity
      calc |greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a p.2| * |greenIterKernel κ w₂ j p.2 p.1| *
            |w₁ p.2 - w₂ p.2| * |w₂ p.1| * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 b|
        _ = ((|greenIterKernel κ w₂ j p.2 p.1| * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 b|) *
              |greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a p.2|) * (|w₂ p.1| * |w₁ p.2 - w₂ p.2|) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((M₂ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * M₁) * (|w₂ p.1| * |w₁ p.2 - w₂ p.2|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h120 h_w_nn
        _ = (M₂ * (1 / (2 * κ)) * |w₂ p.1|) * (M₁ * |w₁ p.2 - w₂ p.2|) := by ring
    have hK_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) :=
      hg_prod.mono' hK_meas hK_dom
    have h_pull_in : ∀ u : ℝ,
        (∫ z : ℝ, Φ i j a u z) * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b = ∫ z : ℝ, K u z := by
      intro u
      dsimp [K]
      rw [← integral_mul_const, ← integral_mul_const]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · simpa only [h_pull_in] using hK_int.integral_prod_left
    · calc ∫ u : ℝ, (∫ z : ℝ, Φ i j a u z) * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b
        _ = ∫ u : ℝ, ∫ z : ℝ, K u z := by simp_rw [h_pull_in]
        _ = ∫ z : ℝ, ∫ u : ℝ, K u z := integral_integral_swap hK_int
        _ = ∫ z : ℝ, -(Φ i (j + 1) a b z) := by
          refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
          dsimp [K, Φ, greenIterKernel]
          have h_rearr : (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ j z u *
              (w₁ z - w₂ z) * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b) =
            (fun u : ℝ => (greenIterKernel κ w₁ i a z * (w₁ z - w₂ z)) *
              (greenIterKernel κ w₂ j z u * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u b)) := by
            ext u; ring
          rw [h_rearr, integral_const_mul]
          ring
        _ = -∫ z : ℝ, Φ i (j + 1) a b z := integral_neg _
  have h_rhs_eq : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℝ),
      -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b) * (w₁ z - w₂ z) =
      -∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, ∫ z : ℝ, Φ p.1 p.2 a b z := by
    intro n a b
    congr 1
    have h_dist : (fun z : ℝ => (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b) * (w₁ z - w₂ z)) =
      (fun z : ℝ => ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n, Φ p.1 p.2 a b z) := by
      ext z
      exact Finset.sum_mul _ _ _
    rw [h_dist, integral_finset_sum _ (fun p _ => h_phi_int p.1 p.2 a b)]
  rw [h_rhs_eq m x y]
  induction m generalizing x y with
  | zero =>
    rw [Finset.Nat.antidiagonal_zero, Finset.sum_singleton]
    have h_sub : greenIterKernel κ w₁ 1 x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ 1 x y =
        -((∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₁ 0 x z * w₁ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y) -
          (∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ 0 x z * w₂ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y)) := by
      change (-∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₁ 0 x z * w₁ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y) -
          (-∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ 0 x z * w₂ z * freeGreenKernel κ z y) = _
      ring
    rw [h_sub, ← integral_sub (h_step_int w₁ 0 x y) (h_step_int w₂ 0 x y)]
    congr 1
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
    dsimp [Φ, greenIterKernel]
    ring
  | succ m ih =>
    have h_step1 : greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 2) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 2) x y =
        -((∫ u : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u * w₁ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) -
          (∫ u : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y)) := by
      change (-∫ u : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u * w₁ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) -
          (-∫ u : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) = _
      ring
    rw [h_step1, ← integral_sub (h_step_int w₁ (m + 1) x y) (h_step_int w₂ (m + 1) x y)]
    have h_rem_eq : (fun u : ℝ =>
        (greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u) *
          w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
      (fun u : ℝ =>
        -∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          (∫ z : ℝ, Φ p.1 p.2 x u z) * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) := by
      ext u
      rw [ih x u]
      simp only [neg_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    have h_rem_int : Integrable (fun u : ℝ =>
        (greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u) *
          w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) volume := by
      rw [h_rem_eq]
      exact (integrable_finset_sum _ (fun p _ => (h_fub p.1 p.2 x y).1)).neg
    have h_split : (fun u : ℝ =>
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u * w₁ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y -
        greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u * w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
      (fun u : ℝ => Φ (m + 1) 0 x y u +
        (greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u) *
          w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) := by
      ext u
      dsimp [Φ, greenIterKernel]
      ring
    rw [h_split, integral_add (h_phi_int (m + 1) 0 x y) h_rem_int]
    have h_rem_int_eq : (∫ u : ℝ,
        (greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x u - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x u) *
          w₂ u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, ∫ z : ℝ, Φ p.1 (p.2 + 1) x y z := by
      rw [h_rem_eq, integral_neg, integral_finset_sum _ (fun p _ => (h_fub p.1 p.2 x y).1)]
      simp_rw [(h_fub _ _ x y).2, Finset.sum_neg_distrib, neg_neg]
    rw [h_rem_int_eq]
    congr 1
    exact (Finset.Nat.sum_antidiagonal_succ' (f := fun p => ∫ z : ℝ, Φ p.1 p.2 x y z) (n := m)).symm

informal_problem.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ)
    (h_cont : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2))
    (h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ)
    (h_tele : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
        -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z))
    (w₁ w₂ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hw₁ : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (hw₂ : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (h x : ℝ) :
    diagGreen κ w₂ x ≠ 0 ∧
    |diagGreen κ w₁ x - diagGreen κ w₂ x -
      h * (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x)| ≤
      (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y|) ^ 2

signature.name: diagGreen_sub_and_linearization_bound
signature.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ)
    (h_cont : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2))
    (h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ)
    (h_tele : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
        -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z))
    (w₁ w₂ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hw₁ : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (hw₂ : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (h x : ℝ) :
    diagGreen κ w₂ x ≠ 0 ∧
    |diagGreen κ w₁ x - diagGreen κ w₂ x -
      h * (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x)| ≤
      (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y|) ^ 2

proof.tactics:
by
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_geom_tsum : (∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) = 4 / 3 := by
    rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have h_u_sum : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) :=
    h_geom_sum.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_single : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ w p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ a b : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b‖)) ∧
      (∀ a b : ℝ, |greenKernel κ w a b| ≤ 1) := by
    intro w hw
    have h_cont_G : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenKernel κ w p.1 p.2) := by
      dsimp [greenKernel]
      refine continuous_tsum (fun ℓ => h_cont w ℓ) h_u_sum (fun ℓ p => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h_bound w hw ℓ p.1 p.2
    have h_sum_norm : ∀ a b : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b‖) := by
      intro a b
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun ℓ => norm_nonneg _) (fun ℓ => ?_) h_u_sum
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact h_bound w hw ℓ a b
    refine ⟨h_cont_G, h_sum_norm, ?_⟩
    intro a b
    dsimp [greenKernel]
    rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    calc ‖∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b‖
      _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (h_sum_norm a b)
      _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ :=
        Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun ℓ => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_bound w hw ℓ a b)
          (h_sum_norm a b) h_u_sum
      _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := tsum_mul_left
      _ = 2 / (3 * κ) := by rw [h_geom_tsum]; ring
      _ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
        linarith
  obtain ⟨hG₁_cont, hG₁_sum_norm, hG₁_le⟩ := h_single w₁ hw₁
  obtain ⟨hG₂_cont, hG₂_sum_norm, hG₂_le⟩ := h_single w₂ hw₂
  have hg₂_ne : diagGreen κ w₂ x ≠ 0 := by
    have h_sum_xx : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₂ ℓ x x) :=
      (hG₂_sum_norm x x).of_norm
    have h_peel : diagGreen κ w₂ x =
        greenIterKernel κ w₂ 0 x x + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x :=
      h_sum_xx.tsum_eq_zero_add
    have h0_eq : greenIterKernel κ w₂ 0 x x = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      dsimp [greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
      simp
    have h_tail_sum_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x‖) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (hG₂_sum_norm x x)
    have h_tail_major : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
      h_geom_sum.mul_left (1 / (8 * κ))
    have h_tail_bound : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x‖ ≤ (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      intro m
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc |greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x|
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := h_bound w₂ hw₂ (m + 1) x x
        _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
    have h_tail_le : |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x| ≤ 1 / (6 * κ) := by
      rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc ‖∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x‖
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_tail_sum_norm
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_tail_bound h_tail_sum_norm h_tail_major
        _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
        _ = 1 / (6 * κ) := by rw [h_geom_tsum]; ring
    have h_lower : -(1 / (6 * κ)) ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x x :=
      (abs_le.mp h_tail_le).1
    have h_pos : 0 < diagGreen κ w₂ x := by
      have h_alg : 1 / (2 * κ) - 1 / (6 * κ) = 1 / (3 * κ) := by ring
      have : 1 / (3 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w₂ x := by linarith [h_peel, h0_eq, h_lower, h_alg]
      exact lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) this
    exact ne_of_gt h_pos
  have hm_le_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, ((m : ℝ) + 1) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero => norm_num
    | succ m ih =>
      have h1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
      have h_pow : (2 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) = 2 * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
      push_cast
      linarith
  have h4κ_le : 1 / (4 * κ ^ 2) ≤ 1 := by
    rw [div_le_iff₀ (by positivity)]
    nlinarith
  have hΔ_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |w₁ z - w₂ z|) volume := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (w₁ - w₂).integrable.norm
  have h_res : ∀ a b : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₁ a b - greenKernel κ w₂ a b =
      -∫ z : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₁ a z * greenKernel κ w₂ z b * (w₁ z - w₂ z) := by
    intro a b
    have h1_sum : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ ℓ a b) := (hG₁_sum_norm a b).of_norm
    have h2_sum : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₂ ℓ a b) := (hG₂_sum_norm a b).of_norm
    have h1_shift : Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) a b) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h1_sum
    have h2_shift : Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) a b) :=
      (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h2_sum
    let S : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m z =>
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b
    let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m z => S m z * (w₁ z - w₂ z)
    have h_peel_sub : greenKernel κ w₁ a b - greenKernel κ w₂ a b =
        -∑' m : ℕ, ∫ z : ℝ, F m z := by
      dsimp [greenKernel]
      rw [h1_sum.tsum_eq_zero_add, h2_sum.tsum_eq_zero_add]
      have h0 : greenIterKernel κ w₁ 0 a b = greenIterKernel κ w₂ 0 a b := rfl
      rw [h0, add_sub_add_left_eq_sub, ← h1_shift.tsum_sub h2_shift]
      have h_congr : (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) a b - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) a b) =
          (fun m : ℕ => -∫ z : ℝ, F m z) := by
        funext m
        exact h_tele w₁ w₂ m a b
      rw [h_congr, tsum_neg]
    have hS_bound : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), |S m z| ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      intro m z
      dsimp [S]
      have h_term : ∀ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          |greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b| ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        intro p hp
        have hp_eq : p.1 + p.2 = m := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hp
        rw [abs_mul]
        have hb1 := h_bound w₁ hw₁ p.1 a z
        have hb2 := h_bound w₂ hw₂ p.2 z b
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z| * |greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b|
          _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1) * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2) :=
            mul_le_mul hb1 hb2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = (1 / (4 * κ ^ 2)) * ((1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.1 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ p.2) := by ring
          _ = (1 / (4 * κ ^ 2)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (p.1 + p.2) := by rw [← pow_add]
          _ = (1 / (4 * κ ^ 2)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by rw [hp_eq]
          _ ≤ 1 * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h4κ_le (by positivity)
          _ = (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := one_mul _
      calc |∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b|
        _ ≤ ∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m, |greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b| :=
          Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
        _ ≤ (Finset.antidiagonal m).card • (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m :=
          Finset.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ _ h_term
        _ = ((m : ℝ) + 1) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
          rw [Finset.Nat.card_antidiagonal, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        _ ≤ (2 : ℝ) ^ m * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hm_le_pow m) (by positivity)
        _ = (2 * (1 / 4 : ℝ)) ^ m := by rw [← mul_pow]
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by norm_num
    have hF_cont : ∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (F m) := by
      intro m
      dsimp [F, S]
      refine (continuous_finset_sum _ fun p _ => ?_).mul (w₁.continuous.sub w₂.continuous)
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 a z) :=
        (h_cont w₁ p.1).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z b) :=
        (h_cont w₂ p.2).comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact hc1.mul hc2
    have hF_dom : ∀ (m : ℕ) (z : ℝ), ‖F m z‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * |w₁ z - w₂ z| := by
      intro m z
      dsimp [F]
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hS_bound m z) (abs_nonneg _)
    have hF_int : ∀ m : ℕ, Integrable (F m) volume := by
      intro m
      refine (hΔ_int.const_mul ((1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)).mono' (hF_cont m).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (hF_dom m)
    have h_sum_int : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ∫ z : ℝ, ‖F m z‖) := by
      have h_half_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * ∫ z : ℝ, |w₁ z - w₂ z|) :=
        (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_right _
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => integral_nonneg (fun z => norm_nonneg _)) (fun m => ?_) h_half_sum
      rw [← integral_const_mul]
      exact integral_mono (hF_int m).norm (hΔ_int.const_mul _) (hF_dom m)
    rw [h_peel_sub, MeasureTheory.integral_tsum_of_summable_integral_norm hF_int h_sum_int]
    congr 1
    refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
    dsimp [F, S, greenKernel]
    rw [tsum_mul_right, ← tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal_of_summable_norm (hG₁_sum_norm a z) (hG₂_sum_norm z b)]
  refine ⟨hg₂_ne, ?_⟩
  let I_Δ : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, |w₁ z - w₂ z|
  have hI_Δ_nn : 0 ≤ I_Δ := integral_nonneg (fun z => abs_nonneg _)
  have hG_lip : ∀ a b : ℝ, |greenKernel κ w₁ a b - greenKernel κ w₂ a b| ≤ I_Δ := by
    intro a b
    let K : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenKernel κ w₁ a z * greenKernel κ w₂ z b * (w₁ z - w₂ z)
    have hK_cont : Continuous K := by
      dsimp [K]
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₁ a z) :=
        hG₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₂ z b) :=
        hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul (w₁.continuous.sub w₂.continuous)
    have hK_dom : ∀ z : ℝ, ‖K z‖ ≤ |w₁ z - w₂ z| := by
      intro z
      dsimp [K]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have h1 := hG₁_le a z
      have h2 := hG₂_le z b
      have h12 : |greenKernel κ w₁ a z| * |greenKernel κ w₂ z b| ≤ 1 := by
        calc |greenKernel κ w₁ a z| * |greenKernel κ w₂ z b|
          _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := one_mul 1
      calc |greenKernel κ w₁ a z| * |greenKernel κ w₂ z b| * |w₁ z - w₂ z|
        _ ≤ 1 * |w₁ z - w₂ z| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h12 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = |w₁ z - w₂ z| := one_mul _
    have hK_int : Integrable K volume :=
      hΔ_int.mono' hK_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hK_dom)
    rw [h_res a b, abs_neg]
    calc |∫ z : ℝ, K z|
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖K z‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm K
      _ ≤ I_Δ := integral_mono hK_int.norm hΔ_int hK_dom
  let A : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenKernel κ w₁ x y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x * (w₁ y - w₂ y)
  let B : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenKernel κ w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x
  have hA_cont : Continuous A := by
    dsimp [A]
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₁ x y) :=
      hG₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₂ y x) :=
      hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul (w₁.continuous.sub w₂.continuous)
  have hA_int : Integrable A volume := by
    refine hΔ_int.mono' hA_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    dsimp [A]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h12 : |greenKernel κ w₁ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x| ≤ 1 := by
      calc |greenKernel κ w₁ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x|
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hG₁_le x y) (hG₂_le y x) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    calc |greenKernel κ w₁ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x| * |w₁ y - w₂ y|
      _ ≤ 1 * |w₁ y - w₂ y| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h12 (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |w₁ y - w₂ y| := one_mul _
  have hv_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |v y|) volume := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using v.integrable.norm
  have hB_cont : Continuous B := by
    dsimp [B]
    have hc1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₂ x y) :=
      hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
    have hc2 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel κ w₂ y x) :=
      hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
    exact (hc1.mul v.continuous).mul hc2
  have hB_int : Integrable B volume := by
    refine hv_int.mono' hB_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
    dsimp [B]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have h12 : |greenKernel κ w₂ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x| ≤ 1 := by
      calc |greenKernel κ w₂ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x|
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hG₂_le x y) (hG₂_le y x) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    calc |greenKernel κ w₂ x y| * |v y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x|
      _ = (|greenKernel κ w₂ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x|) * |v y| := by ring
      _ ≤ 1 * |v y| := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h12 (abs_nonneg _)
      _ = |v y| := one_mul _
  have h_lin_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) volume := by
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (w₁ - w₂ - h • v).integrable.norm
  have h_comb_eq : diagGreen κ w₁ x - diagGreen κ w₂ x - h * (-∫ y : ℝ, B y) =
      -∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y) := by
    dsimp [diagGreen]
    rw [h_res x x]
    change -(∫ y : ℝ, A y) - h * (-∫ y : ℝ, B y) = -∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y)
    have h_sub_int : ∫ y : ℝ, (A y - h * B y) = (∫ y : ℝ, A y) - h * (∫ y : ℝ, B y) := by
      rw [integral_sub hA_int (hB_int.const_mul h), integral_const_mul]
    linarith
  have h_pt_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖A y - h * B y‖ ≤ |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y| + I_Δ * |w₁ y - w₂ y| := by
    intro y
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_alg : A y - h * B y =
        (greenKernel κ w₂ x y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x) * (w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y) +
        ((greenKernel κ w₁ x y - greenKernel κ w₂ x y) * greenKernel κ w₂ y x) * (w₁ y - w₂ y) := by
      dsimp [A, B]
      ring
    rw [h_alg]
    have h12 : |greenKernel κ w₂ x y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x| ≤ 1 := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |greenKernel κ w₂ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x|
        _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hG₂_le x y) (hG₂_le y x) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 1 := one_mul 1
    have h_diff : |(greenKernel κ w₁ x y - greenKernel κ w₂ x y) * greenKernel κ w₂ y x| ≤ I_Δ := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      calc |greenKernel κ w₁ x y - greenKernel κ w₂ x y| * |greenKernel κ w₂ y x|
        _ ≤ I_Δ * 1 := mul_le_mul (hG_lip x y) (hG₂_le y x) (abs_nonneg _) hI_Δ_nn

      rw [abs_mul]

        I_Δ * |w₁ y - w₂ y| := by
      rw [abs_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_diff (abs_nonneg _)
    calc |(greenKernel κ w₂ x y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x) * (w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y) +
          ((greenKernel κ w₁ x y - greenKernel κ w₂ x y) * greenKernel κ w₂ y x) * (w₁ y - w₂ y)|

        abs_add_le _ _

      (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + I_Δ ^ 2

      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (fun y => A y - h * B y)

      integral_mono (hA_int.sub (hB_int.const_mul h)).norm (h_lin_int.add (hΔ_int.const_mul I_Δ)) h_pt_bound
    _ = (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + I_Δ * I_Δ := by
      rw [integral_add h_lin_int (hΔ_int.const_mul I_Δ), integral_const_mul]
    _ = (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + I_Δ ^ 2 := by ring

by
  let L := SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)

    intro q
    simp_rw [← Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm q.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable,
        ← eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm,

    intro τ
    exact h_L1 (u τ - u s - (τ - s) • v)

      (∫ y : ℝ, |u τ y - u s y|) = ‖L (u τ - u s)‖ := by
    intro τ

    h_deriv.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul

    have h_rem_eq : ‖L (u τ - u s - (τ - s) • v)‖ = ‖τ - s‖ * Q₁ τ := by
      dsimp [Q₁]

      _ = ‖τ - s‖ * Q₁ τ + ‖τ - s‖ * ‖L v‖ := by rw [h_rem_eq]

      intro n x
      obtain ⟨M_n, hMn_nn, hMn⟩ := hF_bound n
      have h_eq : (fun u => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x) =
          (fun u => -∫ y : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' (u + y)) x * freeGreenKernel κ y 0) := by
        ext u
        rw [h_deriv_G n x u, hI_shift n x u]
      rw [h_eq]
      refine Continuous.neg ?_
      refine MeasureTheory.continuous_of_dominated
        (bound := fun y => M_n * freeGreenKernel κ y 0) ?_ ?_ ?_ ?_
      · intro u
        exact (((hF_cont n x).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).mul (h_fg_cont 0)).aestronglyMeasurable
      · intro u
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
        dsimp
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg y 0)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x (u + y)) (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
      · exact (h_fg_int 0).const_mul M_n
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
        exact ((hF_cont n x).comp (continuous_id.add continuous_const)).mul continuous_const
    have h_bound_G : ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ B : ℝ, 0 ≤ B ∧ ∀ x u : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, F x' v * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x| ≤ B := by
      intro n
      obtain ⟨M_n, hMn_nn, hMn⟩ := hF_bound n
      let B : ℝ := ∫ y : ℝ, M_n * freeGreenKernel κ y 0
      have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B := by
        refine MeasureTheory.integral_nonneg fun y => ?_
        exact mul_nonneg hMn_nn (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
      refine ⟨B, hB_nn, fun x u => ?_⟩
      rw [h_deriv_G n x u, hI_shift n x u, abs_neg, ← Real.norm_eq_abs]
      refine le_trans (MeasureTheory.norm_integral_le_integral_norm _) ?_
      have h_int_lhs : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => F x' (u + y)) x * freeGreenKernel κ y 0‖) volume := by
        refine ((h_fg_int 0).const_mul M_n).mono'
          ((((hF_cont n x).comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)).mul (h_fg_cont 0)).norm.aestronglyMeasurable)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
        dsimp
        rw [abs_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg y 0)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x (u + y)) (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
      refine MeasureTheory.integral_mono_ae h_int_lhs ((h_fg_int 0).const_mul M_n)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_)
      dsimp
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg y 0)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hMn x (u + y)) (h_fg_nonneg y 0)
    exact ⟨h_smooth_G, h_deriv_G, h_cont_G, h_bound_G⟩
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun f => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f
  have h_w_iter : ∀ (k : ℕ) (x v : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv k (fun x' : ℝ => w (x' + v)) x = (D^[k] w) (x + v) := by
    intro k
    induction k with
    | zero =>
      intro x v
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
    | succ k ih =>
      intro x v
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have h_fn : iteratedDeriv k (fun x' : ℝ => w (x' + v)) = fun x' : ℝ => (D^[k] w) (x' + v) :=
        funext fun x' => ih x' v
      rw [h_fn]
      have h_comp : deriv (fun x' : ℝ => (D^[k] w) (x' + v)) x = deriv (D^[k] w) (x + v) :=
        deriv_comp_add_const (D^[k] w) v x
      rw [h_comp, ← SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ (D^[k] w) (x + v)]
      change D (D^[k] w) (x + v) = (D^[k + 1] w) (x + v)
      rw [← Function.iterate_succ_apply' D k w]
  have hW_bound : ∀ k : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, |(D^[k] w) y| ≤ C := by
    intro k
    obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := (D^[k] w).toBoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range.exists_norm_le
    refine ⟨max C 0, le_max_right C 0, fun y => ?_⟩
    have hy := hC ((D^[k] w) y) ⟨y, rfl⟩
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at hy
    exact le_trans hy (le_max_left C 0)
  let C_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => Classical.choose (hW_bound k)
  have hC_seq_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_seq k := fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hW_bound k)).1
  have hC_seq : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : ℝ), |(D^[k] w) y| ≤ C_seq k :=
    fun k => (Classical.choose_spec (hW_bound k)).2
  have s3_step : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => g x v)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v) x)) →
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v) x| ≤ M) →
      (∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => g x v * w (x + v))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M' : ℝ, 0 ≤ M' ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x| ≤ M') ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
        -∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x *
              ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) := by
    intro g hg_smooth hg_cont hg_bound
    have h_smooth_prod : ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => g x v * w (x + v)) := by
      intro v
      have hw_sm : ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x : ℝ => w (x + v)) :=
        w.smooth'.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)
      exact (hg_smooth v).mul hw_sm
    have h_leibniz : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x v : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x * (D^[n - j] w) (x + v) := by
      intro n x v
      have hg_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (n : ℕ∞) (fun x' : ℝ => g x' v) x :=
        (hg_smooth v).contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      have hw_cd : ContDiffAt ℝ (n : ℕ∞) (fun x' : ℝ => w (x' + v)) x :=
        (w.smooth'.comp (contDiff_id.add contDiff_const)).contDiffAt.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      have h_mul := iteratedDeriv_mul hg_cd hw_cd
      change iteratedDeriv n ((fun x' => g x' v) * (fun x' => w (x' + v))) x = _
      rw [h_mul]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [h_w_iter (n - j) x v]
    have h_cont_prod : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Continuous (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x) := by
      intro n x
      have h_eq : (fun v => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x) =
          fun v => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x * (D^[n - j] w) (x + v) :=
        funext fun v => h_leibniz n x v
      rw [h_eq]
      refine continuous_finset_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
      have hw_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => (D^[n - j] w) (x + v)) :=
        (D^[n - j] w).continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
      exact (continuous_const.mul (hg_cont j x)).mul hw_cont
    let M_seq : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => Classical.choose (hg_bound j)
    have hM_seq_nn : ∀ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ M_seq j := fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hg_bound j)).1
    have hM_seq : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x v : ℝ), |iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x| ≤ M_seq j :=
      fun j => (Classical.choose_spec (hg_bound j)).2
    have h_bound_prod : ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M' : ℝ, 0 ≤ M' ∧ ∀ x v : ℝ,
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x| ≤ M' := by
      intro n
      let M' : ℝ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * M_seq j * C_seq (n - j)
      have hM'_nn : 0 ≤ M' := by
        refine Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => ?_
        have h1 : 0 ≤ (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) := Nat.cast_nonneg _
        exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg h1 (hM_seq_nn j)) (hC_seq_nn (n - j))
      refine ⟨M', hM'_nn, fun x v => ?_⟩
      rw [h_leibniz n x v]
      refine le_trans (Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _) ?_
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ => ?_
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
      have h1 : (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * |iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x| ≤
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * M_seq j :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM_seq j x v) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
      exact mul_le_mul h1 (hC_seq (n - j) (x + v)) (abs_nonneg _)
        (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (hM_seq_nn j))
    have h_int_sum : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x u : ℝ),
        -∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u =
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x *
              (D^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) := by
      intro n x u
      let h_term : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j v =>
        iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x * (D^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u
      have h_term_int : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          Integrable (fun v : ℝ => (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * h_term j v) volume := by
        intro j _
        refine Integrable.const_mul ?_ (Nat.choose n j : ℝ)
        have hw_cont : Continuous (fun v : ℝ => (D^[n - j] w) (x + v)) :=
          (D^[n - j] w).continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
        refine ((h_fg_int u).const_mul (M_seq j * C_seq (n - j))).mono'
          (((hg_cont j x).mul hw_cont).mul (h_fg_cont u)).aestronglyMeasurable
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun v => ?_)
        dsimp [h_term]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (h_fg_nonneg v u)]
        have h_prod : |iteratedDeriv j (fun x' => g x' v) x| * |(D^[n - j] w) (x + v)| ≤
            M_seq j * C_seq (n - j) :=
          mul_le_mul (hM_seq j x v) (hC_seq (n - j) (x + v)) (abs_nonneg _) (hM_seq_nn j)
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod (h_fg_nonneg v u)
      have h_eq : (fun v : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => g x' v * w (x' + v)) x * freeGreenKernel κ v u) =
          fun v : ℝ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * h_term j v := by
        ext v
        rw [h_leibniz n x v, Finset.sum_mul]
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        dsimp [h_term]
        ring
      rw [h_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_finset_sum _ h_term_int, ← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      rw [MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, mul_neg]
    exact ⟨h_smooth_prod, h_cont_prod, h_bound_prod, h_int_sum⟩
  have h_inv : ∀ m : ℕ,
      (∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x u)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, Continuous (fun u => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x' u) x)) ∧
      (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ x u : ℝ, |iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x' u) x| ≤ M) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ => shiftedGreenIter κ w 0 x u) = fun _ : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ 0 u :=
          funext fun x => h_shift0 x u
        rw [h_fn]
        exact contDiff_const
      · intro n x
        rcases n with _ | n
        · have h_fn : (fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv 0 (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w 0 x' u) x) =
              fun u : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ 0 u :=
            funext fun u => h_base0 x u
          rw [h_fn]
          unfold freeGreenKernel
          fun_prop
        · have h_fn : (fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w 0 x' u) x) =
              fun _ : ℝ => 0 :=
            funext fun u => h_base_succ n x u
          rw [h_fn]
          exact continuous_const
      · intro n
        rcases n with _ | n
        · refine ⟨1 / (2 * κ), by positivity, fun x u => ?_⟩
          change |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 0 x u| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ)
          rw [h_base0 x u]
          unfold freeGreenKernel
          rw [abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * |0 - u|) ≤ 1 := by
            rw [Real.exp_le_one_iff]
            exact mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (by linarith) (abs_nonneg _)
          calc (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |0 - u|)
            _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp (by positivity)
            _ = 1 / (2 * κ) := mul_one _
        · refine ⟨0, le_rfl, fun x u => ?_⟩
          change |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 (n + 1) x u| ≤ 0
          rw [h_base_succ n x u, abs_zero]
    | succ m ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_sm_m, h_cont_m, h_bd_m⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨hF_sm, hF_cont, hF_bd, _⟩ :=
        s3_step (shiftedGreenIter κ w m) h_sm_m h_cont_m h_bd_m
      obtain ⟨hG_sm, _, hG_cont, hG_bd⟩ :=
        s2_step (fun x v => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x v * w (x + v)) hF_sm hF_cont hF_bd
      have h_eq_fn : ∀ u : ℝ, (fun x : ℝ => shiftedGreenIter κ w (m + 1) x u) =
          fun x : ℝ => -∫ v : ℝ, (shiftedGreenIter κ w m x v * w (x + v)) * freeGreenKernel κ v u :=
        fun u => funext fun x => h_shift_succ m x u
      refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
      · intro u
        rw [h_eq_fn u]
        exact hG_sm u
      · intro n x
        have h_eq_u : (fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w (m + 1) x' u) x) =
            fun u : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (fun x' => -∫ v : ℝ, (shiftedGreenIter κ w m x' v * w (x' + v)) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) x := by
          ext u
          rw [h_eq_fn u]
        rw [h_eq_u]
        exact hG_cont n x
      · intro n
        obtain ⟨B, hB_nn, hB⟩ := hG_bd n
        refine ⟨B, hB_nn, fun x u => ?_⟩
        rw [h_eq_fn u]
        exact hB x u
  refine ⟨fun m u => (h_inv m).1 u, h_base0, h_base_succ, ?_⟩
  intro m n x u
  obtain ⟨h_sm_m, h_cont_m, h_bd_m⟩ := h_inv m
  obtain ⟨hF_sm, hF_cont, hF_bd, h_int_sum⟩ :=
    s3_step (shiftedGreenIter κ w m) h_sm_m h_cont_m h_bd_m
  obtain ⟨_, hG_deriv, _, _⟩ :=
    s2_step (fun x v => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x v * w (x + v)) hF_sm hF_cont hF_bd
  have h_eq_fn : (fun x' : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x' (x' + u)) =
      fun x' : ℝ => -∫ v : ℝ, (shiftedGreenIter κ w m x' v * w (x' + v)) * freeGreenKernel κ v u :=
    funext fun x' => h_shift_succ m x' u
  change iteratedDeriv n (fun x' : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x' (x' + u)) x = _
  rw [h_eq_fn, hG_deriv n x u, h_int_sum n x u]
  rfl

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))
