proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_κ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_pi_pos : 0 < Real.pi := Real.pi_pos
  have h_2pi_pos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi := by positivity
  have h_denom_pos : ∀ ξ : ℝ, 0 < κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 := fun ξ => by positivity
  obtain ⟨⟨h_inv_int, h_inv_eq⟩, _⟩ := freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq κ hκ
  have h_fl_cont_bound : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous f → Integrable f volume →
      Continuous (fourierLine f) ∧ ∃ C_f : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_f ∧ ∀ ζ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine f ζ‖ ≤ C_f := by
    intro f hf_cont hf_int
    let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℂ := fun ζ z => Complex.exp (-((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I) * (f z : ℂ)
    let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ‖f z‖
    have hw_int : Integrable bound volume := hf_int.norm
    have hK_meas : ∀ ζ : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (K ζ) volume := by
      intro ζ
      have hc : Continuous (K ζ) := by
        dsimp [K]
        exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
          (((continuous_const.mul Complex.continuous_ofReal).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
          (Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp hf_cont)
      exact hc.aestronglyMeasurable
    have hK_dom : ∀ ζ : ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖K ζ z‖ ≤ bound z := by
      intro ζ
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K, bound]
      rw [norm_mul, show -((ζ : ℂ) * (z : ℂ)) * I = (((-(ζ * z) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I) by push_cast; ring,
          Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun ζ : ℝ => K ζ z) := by
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp [K]
      exact (Complex.continuous_exp.comp
        (((Complex.continuous_ofReal.mul continuous_const).neg).mul continuous_const)).mul
        continuous_const

      have hA₁_sq_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A₁ ξ ^ 2) volume := by
        rw [funext hA₁_sq]; exact hf₁_h1
      have hA₂_sq_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A₂ ξ ^ 2) volume := by
        rw [funext hA₂_sq]; exact hf₂_h1
      have hA₁₂_sq_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A₁ ξ ^ 2 + A₂ ξ ^ 2) volume :=
        hA₁_sq_int.add hA₂_sq_int
      have hA₁₂_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ) volume := by
        refine (hA₁₂_sq_int.const_mul (1 / 2)).mono'
          (hA₁_cont.mul hA₂_cont).aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with ξ
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hA₁_nn ξ) (hA₂_nn ξ))]
        have h_sq : 0 ≤ (A₁ ξ - A₂ ξ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
        linarith
      have h_pw_g : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
          (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
            A₁ ξ ^ 2 + A₂ ξ ^ 2 + 2 * (A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ) := by
        intro ξ
        rw [h_fl_add ξ]
        have h_tri : ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ + fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ≤ ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ :=
          norm_add_le _ _
        have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ + fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
            (‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_tri 2
        have h_s : Real.sqrt (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 = κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 :=
          Real.sq_sqrt (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))
        calc (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ + fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2
          _ ≤ (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖) ^ 2 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq_le (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ))
          _ = Real.sqrt (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 * (‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖) ^ 2 := by
            rw [h_s]
          _ = A₁ ξ ^ 2 + A₂ ξ ^ 2 + 2 * (A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ) := by
            dsimp [A₁, A₂]
            ring
      have hg_h1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2) volume := by
        have hg_fl_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2) :=
          (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)).mul ((h_fl_cont_bound g hg_cont hg_int).1.norm.pow 2)
        refine (hA₁₂_sq_int.add (hA₁₂_int.const_mul 2)).mono'
          hg_fl_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
        filter_upwards with ξ
        rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)) (sq_nonneg _))]
        exact h_pw_g ξ
      refine ⟨⟨hg_cont, hg_int, hg_h1⟩, ?_⟩
      set E₁ : ℝ := h1KappaNormSq κ f₁
      set E₂ : ℝ := h1KappaNormSq κ f₂
      set M : ℝ := ∫ ξ : ℝ, A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ
      have hE₁_nn : 0 ≤ E₁ :=
        integral_nonneg (fun ξ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)) (sq_nonneg _))
      have hE₂_nn : 0 ≤ E₂ :=
        integral_nonneg (fun ξ => mul_nonneg (le_of_lt (h_denom_pos ξ)) (sq_nonneg _))
      have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M :=
        integral_nonneg (fun ξ => mul_nonneg (hA₁_nn ξ) (hA₂_nn ξ))
      have h_E₁_eq : (∫ ξ : ℝ, A₁ ξ ^ 2) = E₁ := by
        dsimp [E₁, h1KappaNormSq]; rw [funext hA₁_sq]
      have h_E₂_eq : (∫ ξ : ℝ, A₂ ξ ^ 2) = E₂ := by
        dsimp [E₂, h1KappaNormSq]; rw [funext hA₂_sq]
      have h_g_le : h1KappaNormSq κ g ≤ E₁ + E₂ + 2 * M := by
        have h_mono : h1KappaNormSq κ g ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((A₁ ξ ^ 2 + A₂ ξ ^ 2) + 2 * (A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ)) :=
          integral_mono hg_h1 (hA₁₂_sq_int.add (hA₁₂_int.const_mul 2)) h_pw_g
        rw [integral_add hA₁₂_sq_int (hA₁₂_int.const_mul 2),
            integral_add hA₁_sq_int hA₂_sq_int, integral_const_mul,
            h_E₁_eq, h_E₂_eq] at h_mono
        exact h_mono
      have h_quad : ∀ (a b : ℝ), 2 * a * b * M ≤ a ^ 2 * E₁ + b ^ 2 * E₂ := by
        intro a b
        have h_pw_ab : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (2 * a * b) * (A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ) ≤ a ^ 2 * A₁ ξ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * A₂ ξ ^ 2 := by
          intro ξ
          have : 0 ≤ (a * A₁ ξ - b * A₂ ξ) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
          linarith
        have h_mono : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * a * b) * (A₁ ξ * A₂ ξ)) ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, (a ^ 2 * A₁ ξ ^ 2 + b ^ 2 * A₂ ξ ^ 2) :=
          integral_mono (hA₁₂_int.const_mul (2 * a * b))
            ((hA₁_sq_int.const_mul (a ^ 2)).add (hA₂_sq_int.const_mul (b ^ 2))) h_pw_ab
        rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (hA₁_sq_int.const_mul (a ^ 2)) (hA₂_sq_int.const_mul (b ^ 2)),
            integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul, h_E₁_eq, h_E₂_eq] at h_mono
        exact h_mono
      have h_M_sq : M ^ 2 ≤ E₁ * E₂ := by
        rcases lt_or_eq_of_le hE₁_nn with hE₁_pos | hE₁_zero
        · have hq := h_quad M E₁
          have h_le : E₁ * M ^ 2 ≤ E₁ * (E₁ * E₂) := by linarith
          exact le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_le hE₁_pos
        · have hq := h_quad (E₂ + 1) M
          rw [← hE₁_zero] at hq ⊢
          nlinarith
      have h_M_le : M ≤ Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂ := by
        rw [← Real.sqrt_mul hE₁_nn]
        exact Real.le_sqrt_of_sq_le h_M_sq
      have h_g_sq : h1KappaNormSq κ g ≤ (Real.sqrt E₁ + Real.sqrt E₂) ^ 2 := by
        have h_expand : (Real.sqrt E₁ + Real.sqrt E₂) ^ 2 =
            E₁ + E₂ + 2 * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂) := by
          calc (Real.sqrt E₁ + Real.sqrt E₂) ^ 2
            _ = Real.sqrt E₁ ^ 2 + Real.sqrt E₂ ^ 2 + 2 * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂) := by ring
            _ = E₁ + E₂ + 2 * (Real.sqrt E₁ * Real.sqrt E₂) := by
              rw [Real.sq_sqrt hE₁_nn, Real.sq_sqrt hE₂_nn]
        linarith
      exact Real.sqrt_le_iff.mpr ⟨by positivity, h_g_sq⟩
    intro n c F h_mem
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      obtain ⟨hc0, hF0⟩ := h_mem 0 (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      obtain ⟨h_good0, h_norm0⟩ := h_smul (c 0) (F 0) hc0 hF0
      have h_fn_eq : (fun u : ℝ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 1, c j * F j u) =
          (fun u : ℝ => c 0 * F 0 u) := by
        ext u
        rw [Finset.sum_range_one]
      rw [h_fn_eq, Finset.sum_range_one, h_norm0]
      exact ⟨h_good0, le_rfl⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      have h_mem_m : ∀ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) := by
        intro j hj
        exact h_mem j (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by have := Finset.mem_range.mp hj; omega))
      obtain ⟨h_good_m, h_le_m⟩ := ih h_mem_m
      obtain ⟨hcm1, hFm1⟩ := h_mem (m + 1) (Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega))
      obtain ⟨h_good_last, h_eq_last⟩ := h_smul (c (m + 1)) (F (m + 1)) hcm1 hFm1
      obtain ⟨h_good_sum, h_le_sum⟩ :=
        h_add (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), c j * F j u) (fun u => c (m + 1) * F (m + 1) u)
          h_good_m h_good_last
      have h_fn_eq : (fun u : ℝ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1 + 1), c j * F j u) =
          (fun u : ℝ => (∑ j ∈ Finset.range (m + 1), c j * F j u) + c (m + 1) * F (m + 1) u) := by
        ext u
        exact Finset.sum_range_succ (fun j => c j * F j u) (m + 1)
      rw [h_fn_eq, Finset.sum_range_succ]
      refine ⟨h_good_sum, ?_⟩
      linarith
  exact ⟨h_good_fg0, h_good_zero, fun f hf => (h_s2 f hf).2.2.2, h_s3, h_s4⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: hilbertSchmidt_fourier_integral_eq_hm1KappaSq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) :
    Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
      ‖fourierLine w (p.1 - p.2)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + p.1 ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + p.2 ^ 2))) ∧
    (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ,
      ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) =
      (1 / κ) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_fourier_integral_eq
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) :
    (Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ∧
      (1 / (2 * π)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) = 1 / (2 * κ)) ∧
    ∀ a b : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
          Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) ∧
      (1 / (2 * π) : ℂ) *
        (∫ ξ : ℝ,
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (a : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((ξ : ℂ) * (b : ℂ)) * I) / ((κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (freeGreenKernel κ a b : ℂ)

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) →
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) →
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x v *
            ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) →
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) →
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j))) →
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, Summable B ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m n x u| ≤ B m

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ _hκ w hw h_base0 h_base_succ h_rec h_good0 h_good_zero h_sob h_step h_comb
  have h_step_sum : ∀ (a R : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ R m) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * a m + R m) →
      Summable R →
      Summable a := by
    intro a R ha_nn hR_nn h_le hR_sum
    refine summable_of_sum_range_le ha_nn (c := 2 * a 0 + 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, R m) ?_
    intro N
    have h_shift : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m + a N = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1) + a 0 := by
      rw [← Finset.sum_range_succ, ← Finset.sum_range_succ']
    have haN : 0 ≤ a N := ha_nn N
    have h_sum_step : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1) ≤
        (1 / 2) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m := by
      calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1)
        _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ((1 / 2) * a m + R m) :=
          Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => h_le m)
        _ = (1 / 2) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m := by
          rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
    have hR_bound : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, R m :=
      hR_sum.sum_le_tsum (Finset.range N) (fun m _ => hR_nn m)
    linarith
  let r : ℕ → ℝ := fun k => ‖ι (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[k]) w)‖
  have hr_nn : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 ≤ r k := fun _ => norm_nonneg _
  have hr0 : r 0 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    simpa [r] using hw
  have h_nn : ∀ m n : ℕ, 0 ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro n
      rcases n with _ | n
      · exact zero_le_one
      · exact le_rfl
    | succ m ih =>
      intro n
      change 0 ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j)
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ =>
        mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hr_nn _) (ih j)))
  have h_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n) := by
    intro n
    induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h n ih =>
      let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n
      let R : ℕ → ℝ := fun m =>
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range n,
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j)
      have ha_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m := fun m => h_nn m n
      have hR_nn : ∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ R m := fun m =>
        Finset.sum_nonneg (fun j _ =>
          mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hr_nn _) (h_nn m j)))
      have h_le : ∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * a m + R m := by
        intro m
        have h_eq : a (m + 1) = R m + (Nat.choose n n : ℝ) * (r (n - n) * a m) := by
          change ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j) =
            R m + (Nat.choose n n : ℝ) * (r (n - n) * a m)
          exact Finset.sum_range_succ _ n
        rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_self] at h_eq
        have hr0_mul : r 0 * a m ≤ (1 / 2) * a m :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hr0 (ha_nn m)
        linarith
      have hR_sum : Summable R := by
        refine summable_sum (fun j hj => ?_)
        exact ((ih j (Finset.mem_range.mp hj)).mul_left (r (n - j))).mul_left (Nat.choose n j : ℝ)
      exact h_step_sum a R ha_nn hR_nn h_le hR_sum
  have h_prof : ∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m n x) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m n x)) ≤
        shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro n x
      rcases n with _ | n
      · have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 0 x = freeGreenKernel κ 0 :=
          funext (h_base0 x)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact h_good0
      · have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 (n + 1) x = fun _ : ℝ => 0 :=
          funext (h_base_succ n x)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact ⟨h_good_zero.1, le_of_eq h_good_zero.2⟩
    | succ m ih =>
      intro n x
      let c : ℕ → ℝ := fun j => (Nat.choose n j : ℝ)
      let F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun j u =>
        -∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x v *
          ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u
      have hF : ∀ j : ℕ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j) ∧
          Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)) ≤ r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j := by
        intro j
        have h_st := h_step (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j]) w) x
          (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x) (ih j x).1
        refine ⟨h_st.1, le_trans h_st.2 ?_⟩
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih j x).2 (hr_nn (n - j))
      have h_cb := h_comb n c F (fun j _ => ⟨Nat.cast_nonneg _, (hF j).1⟩)
      have h_eq : shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x =
          fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u :=
        funext (h_rec m n x)
      rw [h_eq]
      refine ⟨h_cb.1, le_trans h_cb.2 ?_⟩
      change ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * (r (n - j) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m j)
      exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun j _ =>
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hF j).2 (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
  intro n
  refine ⟨fun m => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r m n, h_sum n, ?_⟩
  intro m x u
  exact le_trans (h_sob (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m n x) (h_prof m n x).1 u) (h_prof m n x).2

shiftedGreenIterDeriv_summable_sup_bound.definitions:
def shiftedGreenBoundSeq (r : ℕ → ℝ) : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ
  | 0, 0 => 1
  | 0, _ + 1 => 0
  | m + 1, n =>
      ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),

by
  intro κ hκ w ℓ x
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_fg :
      (∀ x y : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x y = freeGreenKernel κ y x) ∧
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) ∧
      (∀ z : ℝ, Measurable (fun y : ℝ => freeGreenDerivY κ z y)) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, Measurable (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenDerivY κ z x)) ∧

      (∀ z y : ℝ, |freeGreenDerivY κ z y| ≤ 1 / 2) ∧
      (∀ z y₁ y₂ : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ z y₁ - freeGreenKernel κ z y₂| ≤ (1 / 2) * |y₁ - y₂|) ∧
      (∀ z x : ℝ, z ≠ x → HasDerivAt (fun y => freeGreenKernel κ z y) (freeGreenDerivY κ z x) x) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro x y

      fun_prop

      unfold freeGreenDerivY
      refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const) ?_ ?_
      · exact (by fun_prop : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - z)))).measurable

        linarith

        have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * (z - y)) ≤ 1 := Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr h_nonpos

          (f := Real.exp) (f' := Real.exp) (s := Set.Iic (0 : ℝ)) (C := 1)

          (fun t ht => by
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos t), Real.exp_le_one_iff]

        have h1 : |κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) z y + w y * greenIterKernel κ w m z y| ≤ M_d2 :=
          h_d2_bd z y
        have h2 : |freeGreenDerivY κ z x| ≤ 1 / 2 := h_fgd_bd z x
        calc |κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) z y + w y * greenIterKernel κ w m z y| *
              |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
          _ = (|κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) z y + w y * greenIterKernel κ w m z y| *
                |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) * |w z| := by ring
          _ ≤ (M_d2 * (1 / 2)) * |w z| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hMd2_nonneg) (abs_nonneg _)
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        w.integrable.norm.const_mul (M_d2 * (1 / 2))
      have hF_deriv : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ∀ y ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun y' => J y' x z) (F' y z) y := by
        filter_upwards with z y _
        exact ((h_off_deriv2 z y).mul_const (w z)).mul_const (freeGreenDerivY κ z x)
      have h_main := (hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le Filter.univ_mem
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hJ_meas y x)
        (hJ_int x x) hF'_meas hF'_dom h_bound_int hF_deriv).2.neg
      refine h_main.congr_deriv ?_
      let g1 : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z * w z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x
      let g2 : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenIterKernel κ w m x z * w z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x
      have hg1_int : Integrable g1 volume := by
        have h_dom : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (B (m + 1) * (1 / 2)) * ‖w z‖) volume :=
          w.integrable.norm.const_mul (B (m + 1) * (1 / 2))
        have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable g1 volume :=
          (((h_cont (m + 1)).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul w.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
            (h_fgd_meas_z x).aestronglyMeasurable
        refine h_dom.mono' hm ?_
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [g1]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, ← Real.norm_eq_abs (w z)]
        have h1 := h_iter_bd (m + 1) x z
        have h2 := h_fgd_bd z x
        have := hB_nonneg (m + 1)
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z| * ‖w z‖ * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
          _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) * ‖w z‖ := by ring
          _ ≤ (B (m + 1) * (1 / 2)) * ‖w z‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) this) (norm_nonneg _)
      have hg2_int : Integrable g2 volume := by
        have h_dom : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (B m * (1 / 2)) * ‖w z‖) volume :=
          w.integrable.norm.const_mul (B m * (1 / 2))
        have hm : AEStronglyMeasurable g2 volume :=
          (((h_cont m).comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul w.continuous).aestronglyMeasurable.mul
            (h_fgd_meas_z x).aestronglyMeasurable
        refine h_dom.mono' hm ?_
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [g2]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, ← Real.norm_eq_abs (w z)]
        have h1 := h_iter_bd m x z
        have h2 := h_fgd_bd z x
        have := hB_nonneg m
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w m x z| * ‖w z‖ * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
          _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w m x z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) * ‖w z‖ := by ring
          _ ≤ (B m * (1 / 2)) * ‖w z‖ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) this) (norm_nonneg _)
      have hF'_eq : F' x = fun z => κ ^ 2 * g1 z + w x * g2 z := by
        ext z
        dsimp [F', g1, g2]
        rw [h_symm (m + 1) z x, h_symm m z x]
        ring
      rw [hF'_eq, MeasureTheory.integral_add (hg1_int.const_mul (κ ^ 2)) (hg2_int.const_mul (w x)),
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      dsimp [greenIterDerivY, g1, g2]
      ring
    have hd_p2 : HasDerivAt (fun y => -∫ z : ℝ, J x y z)
        (κ ^ 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 2) x x + w x * greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) x x) x := by
      rw [funext h_fub_mixed]
      exact hd_p1
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      greenIterMixedDiag κ w (m + 1) y - (-∫ z : ℝ, J y x z) - (-∫ z : ℝ, J x y z)
    have hd_rem : HasDerivAt Φ 0 x := by
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      let H : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun y z =>
        ‖w z‖ * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
      let I_diff : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∫ z : ℝ, H y z
      have hH_meas : ∀ y : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (H y) volume := by
        intro y
        exact w.continuous.norm.aestronglyMeasurable.mul
          (((h_fgd_meas_z y).sub (h_fgd_meas_z x)).abs.aestronglyMeasurable)
      have hH_dom : ∀ y : ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖H y z‖ ≤ ‖w z‖ := by
        intro y
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [H]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_abs, abs_abs]
        have h_fgd_diff : |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x| ≤ 1 := by
          have h1 := h_fgd_bd z y
          have h2 := h_fgd_bd z x
          have h3 := abs_sub (freeGreenDerivY κ z y) (freeGreenDerivY κ z x)
          linarith
        exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (abs_nonneg _) h_fgd_diff
      have hH_int : ∀ y : ℝ, Integrable (H y) volume :=
        fun y => w.integrable.norm.mono' (hH_meas y) (hH_dom y)
      have h_R_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖Φ y - Φ x‖ ≤ M_d2 * ‖y - x‖ * I_diff y := by
        intro y
        have h_Phi_diff : Φ y - Φ x =
            -∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z x) *
              w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x) := by
          dsimp [Φ, greenIterMixedDiag]
          have h1 := MeasureTheory.integral_sub (hJ_int y y) (hJ_int y x)
          have h2 := MeasureTheory.integral_sub ((hJ_int y y).sub (hJ_int y x)) (hJ_int x y)
          have h3 := MeasureTheory.integral_add (((hJ_int y y).sub (hJ_int y x)).sub (hJ_int x y)) (hJ_int x x)
          simp only [Pi.sub_apply] at h1 h2 h3
          have h_comb : (∫ z : ℝ, J y y z) - (∫ z : ℝ, J y x z) - (∫ z : ℝ, J x y z) + (∫ z : ℝ, J x x z) =
              ∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z x) *
                w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x) := by
            rw [← h1, ← h2, ← h3]
            congr 1; ext z; dsimp [J]; ring
          linarith [h_comb]
        rw [h_Phi_diff, norm_neg]
        calc ‖∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z x) *
                w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x)‖
          _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖(greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z x) *
                w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x)‖ :=
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, (M_d2 * ‖y - x‖) * H y z := by
            refine integral_mono_of_nonneg (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => norm_nonneg _)
              ((hH_int y).const_mul (M_d2 * ‖y - x‖))
              (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
            dsimp only [H]
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul, ← Real.norm_eq_abs (w z)]
            have h_lip := h_d1_lip z y x
            calc |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z x| *
                  ‖w z‖ * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
              _ = |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) z x| *
                    (‖w z‖ * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) := by ring
              _ ≤ (M_d2 * |y - x|) * (‖w z‖ * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) :=
                mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_lip (by positivity)
          _ = M_d2 * ‖y - x‖ * I_diff y := by
            rw [integral_const_mul]
      have h_I_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto I_diff (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
        have h_zero : (0 : ℝ) = ∫ z : ℝ, (0 : ℝ) := by simp
        rw [h_zero]
        refine MeasureTheory.tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence (fun z => ‖w z‖)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hH_meas)
          (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hH_dom)
          w.integrable.norm ?_
        have h_ae_ne : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, z ≠ x := by
          rw [MeasureTheory.ae_iff]
          have h_set : {z : ℝ | ¬z ≠ x} = {x} := by ext z; simp
          rw [h_set]
          exact MeasureTheory.measure_singleton x
        filter_upwards [h_ae_ne] with z hzx
        have h_cont_at : ContinuousAt (fun y => freeGreenDerivY κ z y) x := by
          rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzx with hlt | hgt
          · have h_eq : (fun y => freeGreenDerivY κ z y) =ᶠ[nhds x]
                (fun y => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z))) := by
              filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds hlt] with y hy
              change z < y at hy
              dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
              rw [if_pos hy]
            exact ContinuousAt.congr ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun y => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)))).continuousAt) h_eq.symm
          · have h_eq : (fun y => freeGreenDerivY κ z y) =ᶠ[nhds x]
                (fun y => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y))) := by
              filter_upwards [isOpen_Iio.mem_nhds hgt] with y hy
              change y < z at hy
              dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
              rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hy)), if_pos hy]
            exact ContinuousAt.congr ((by fun_prop : Continuous (fun y => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y)))).continuousAt) h_eq.symm
        have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
          have hc : ContinuousAt (fun y => |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) x :=
            (h_cont_at.sub (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ => freeGreenDerivY κ z x) x)).abs
          have h_t := hc.tendsto
          simpa using h_t
        simpa [H] using h_lim.const_mul ‖w z‖
      have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => M_d2 * I_diff y) (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_I_tendsto.const_mul M_d2
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h_upper_tendsto ?_ ?_
      · intro y
        dsimp only
        positivity
      · intro y
        dsimp only
        rw [smul_zero, sub_zero]
        have hI_nonneg : 0 ≤ I_diff y :=
          integral_nonneg (fun z => by dsimp [H]; positivity)
        rcases eq_or_ne ‖y - x‖ 0 with h_eq0 | h_ne0
        · rw [h_eq0, inv_zero, zero_mul]
          positivity
        · have h_pos : 0 < ‖y - x‖ := lt_of_le_of_ne (norm_nonneg _) (Ne.symm h_ne0)
          calc ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖Φ y - Φ x‖
            _ ≤ ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * (M_d2 * ‖y - x‖ * I_diff y) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_R_bound y) (by positivity)
            _ = M_d2 * I_diff y := by
              field_simp
    have hd_comb := (hd_p1.add hd_p2).add hd_rem
    have h_fun_eq : (fun y => (-∫ z : ℝ, J y x z) + (-∫ z : ℝ, J x y z) + Φ y) =
        fun y => greenIterMixedDiag κ w (m + 1) y := by
      ext y
      dsimp [Φ]
      ring
    change HasDerivAt (fun y => (-∫ z : ℝ, J y x z) + (-∫ z : ℝ, J x y z) + Φ y) _ x at hd_comb
    rw [h_fun_eq] at hd_comb
    refine hd_comb.congr_deriv ?_
    rw [(h_diag_deriv (m + 1)).deriv, (h_diag_deriv m).deriv]
    ring

      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_ode →

            ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y y) x ∧

          iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
            ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x

proof.tactics:
by
  refine ⟨1 / 2, by norm_num, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ w hw x
  obtain ⟨h_contDiff, h_base0, h_base_succ, h_rec⟩ :=
    shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrence κ hκ w
  obtain ⟨h_good0, h_good_zero, h_sob, h_step, h_comb⟩ :=
    freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds κ hκ
  have h_sup :=
    shiftedGreenIterDeriv_summable_sup_bound κ hκ w hw
      h_base0 h_base_succ h_rec h_good0 h_good_zero h_sob h_step h_comb
  have h_weighted :=
    diagGreen_iterates_weighted_deriv_summable κ hκ w h_rec h_sup
  let h : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun ℓ y => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y y
  let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m y => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y y
  have hf_eq : ∀ m : ℕ, f m = fun y => shiftedGreenIter κ w (m + 1) y 0 := by
    intro m
    ext y
    simp [f, shiftedGreenIter]
  have hf_smooth : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (f m) := by
    intro m
    rw [hf_eq m]
    exact h_contDiff (m + 1) 0
  let v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun n => Classical.choose (h_weighted 0 n)
  have hv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) → Summable (v n) := by
    intro n _
    exact (Classical.choose_spec (h_weighted 0 n)).1
  have hv_bound : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (y : ℝ), (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) →
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) y‖ ≤ v n m := by
    intro n m y _
    have h_bd := (Classical.choose_spec (h_weighted 0 n)).2 m y
    simpa [f] using h_bd
  have hh0_eq : h 0 = fun _ => 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    ext y
    simp [h, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
  have hh0_deriv : deriv (h 0) x = 0 := by
    rw [hh0_eq]
    exact deriv_const x (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_sum_shift : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => f m y) := by
    intro y
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum 0 le_top) ?_
    intro m
    have h0 := hv_bound 0 m y le_top
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_zero] at h0
    exact h0
  have h_sum_all : ∀ y : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => h ℓ y) :=
    fun y => (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp (h_sum_shift y)
  let g_tilde_fun : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∑' m : ℕ, f m y
  have h_sub_eq : (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) = g_tilde_fun := by
    ext y
    have h_split : diagGreen κ w y = h 0 y + g_tilde_fun y :=
      (h_sum_all y).tsum_eq_zero_add
    have h0_y : h 0 y = 1 / (2 * κ) := congr_fun hh0_eq y
    linarith
  have h_fderiv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x) := by
    intro n
    exact Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum n le_top) (fun m => hv_bound n m x le_top)
  have h_iterDeriv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (f m) x) := by
    intro n
    refine Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum n le_top) ?_
    intro m
    rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
    exact hv_bound n m x le_top
  have h_iterDeriv_tsum : ∀ n : ℕ,
      iteratedDeriv n g_tilde_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (f m) x := by
    intro n
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have h_fd := iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤) x
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ n g_tilde_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x at h_fd
    rw [h_fd, ContinuousMultilinearMap.tsum_eval (h_fderiv_sum n) (fun _ => 1)]
    simp_rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
  have h_sum_d1_shift : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (f ℓ) x) := by
    have hs := h_iterDeriv_sum 1
    simpa [iteratedDeriv_one] using hs
  have h_sum_d1_all : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (h ℓ) x) :=
    (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mp h_sum_d1_shift
  have h_d1_shift_eq :
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (f ℓ) x := by
    rw [h_sub_eq, ← iteratedDeriv_one, h_iterDeriv_tsum 1]
    simp_rw [iteratedDeriv_one]
  have h_d1_all_eq :
      deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x = ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (h ℓ) x := by
    rw [h_d1_shift_eq, h_sum_d1_all.tsum_eq_zero_add, hh0_deriv, zero_add]
  have h_d3_shift_eq :
      iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
        ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (f ℓ) x := by
    rw [h_sub_eq, h_iterDeriv_tsum 3]
  exact ⟨h_sum_all x, h_sum_d1_all, h_sum_d1_shift, h_d1_all_eq, h_d1_shift_eq, h_d3_shift_eq⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrence
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x u)) ∧
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x v *
            ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u))

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

subgoal_signatures.name: shiftedGreenIterDeriv_summable_sup_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 2 →
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) →
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) →
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x v *
            ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) →
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) →
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) →
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j))) →
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, Summable B ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m n x u| ≤ B m

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_iterates_weighted_deriv_summable
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ w
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) := by
    unfold freeGreenKernel
    fun_prop
  have h_fg_symm : ∀ x y : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x y = freeGreenKernel κ y x := by
    intro x y
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_sub_comm]
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ a b| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro a b
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (2 * κ)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * |a - b|) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a - b)])
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity) h_exp_le
  have h_fgd_bd : ∀ z x' : ℝ, |freeGreenDerivY κ z x'| ≤ 1 / 2 := by
    intro z x'
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
    split_ifs with h1 h2
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * (x' - z)) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by norm_num) h_exp_le
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-κ * (z - x')) ≤ 1 :=
        Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith)
      exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by norm_num) h_exp_le
    · rw [abs_zero]; norm_num
  have h_fgd_meas : ∀ x' : ℝ, Measurable (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenDerivY κ z x') := by
    intro x'
    unfold freeGreenDerivY
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const) (by fun_prop) ?_
    exact Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_id) (by fun_prop) measurable_const
  have h_iter_cont_bound : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ),
      Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2) ∧
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ a b : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b| ≤ M := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      exact ⟨h_fg_cont, 1 / (2 * κ), by positivity, h_fg_bound⟩
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      obtain ⟨h_cont_ℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bound⟩ := ih
      let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z p.2
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => M * (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖w z‖
      have h_w_int : Integrable (w : ℝ → ℝ) volume := w.integrable
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
        h_w_int.norm.const_mul (M * (1 / (2 * κ)))
      have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
        intro p
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p z‖ ≤ bound z := by
        intro p
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h1 := hM_bound p.1 z
        have h2 := h_fg_bound z p.2
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|
          _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|) * |w z| := by ring
          _ ≤ (M * (1 / (2 * κ))) * |w z| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) hM_nn) (abs_nonneg _)
      have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p z) := by
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F]
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          h_cont_ℓ.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
        exact (h_c1.mul continuous_const).mul h_c2
      have h_int_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, F p z) :=
        continuous_of_dominated hF_meas hF_dom h_bound_int hF_cont
      refine ⟨h_int_cont.neg, ∫ z : ℝ, bound z, integral_nonneg (fun z => by dsimp [bound]; positivity), ?_⟩
      intro a b
      dsimp [greenIterKernel]
      rw [abs_neg]
      have hF_int : Integrable (F (a, b)) volume :=
        h_bound_int.mono' (hF_meas (a, b)) (hF_dom (a, b))
      calc |∫ z : ℝ, F (a, b) z|
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖F (a, b) z‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (F (a, b))
        _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z := integral_mono_ae hF_int.norm h_bound_int (hF_dom (a, b))
  have h_left_peel : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) x y =
        -∫ z : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x z * w z * greenIterKernel κ w ℓ z y := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      rfl
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro x y
      obtain ⟨h_cℓ, M, hM_nn, hM_bd⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound ℓ
      let K : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun u z =>
        freeGreenKernel κ x z * w z * greenIterKernel κ w ℓ z u * w u * freeGreenKernel κ u y
      let g₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun u => (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖w u‖
      let g₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ((1 / (2 * κ)) * M) * ‖w z‖
      have hg₁_int : Integrable g₁ volume := w.integrable.norm.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
      have hg₂_int : Integrable g₂ volume := w.integrable.norm.const_mul ((1 / (2 * κ)) * M)
      have hg_prod : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => g₁ p.1 * g₂ p.2) (volume.prod volume) :=
        hg₁_int.mul_prod hg₂_int
      have hK_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) := by
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_snd)
        have hcwz : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w p.2) :=
          w.continuous.comp continuous_snd
        have hc2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.2 p.1) :=
          h_cℓ.comp (continuous_snd.prodMk continuous_fst)
        have hcwu : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => w p.1) :=
          w.continuous.comp continuous_fst
        have hc3 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_fst.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((((hc1.mul hcwz).mul hc2).mul hcwu).mul hc3).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hK_dom : ∀ᵐ p : ℝ × ℝ ∂(volume.prod volume), ‖Function.uncurry K p‖ ≤ g₁ p.1 * g₂ p.2 := by
        filter_upwards with p
        dsimp [Function.uncurry, K, g₁, g₂]
        repeat rw [abs_mul]
        have h1 := h_fg_bound x p.2
        have h2 := hM_bd p.2 p.1
        have h3 := h_fg_bound p.1 y
        have h12 : |freeGreenKernel κ x p.2| * |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.2 p.1| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * M :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        have h123 : (|freeGreenKernel κ x p.2| * |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.2 p.1|) * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y| ≤
            ((1 / (2 * κ)) * M) * (1 / (2 * κ)) :=
          mul_le_mul h12 h3 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        have hw_nn : 0 ≤ |w p.2| * |w p.1| := by positivity
        calc |freeGreenKernel κ x p.2| * |w p.2| * |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.2 p.1| *
              |w p.1| * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y|
          _ = ((|freeGreenKernel κ x p.2| * |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.2 p.1|) * |freeGreenKernel κ p.1 y|) *
                (|w p.2| * |w p.1|) := by ring
          _ ≤ (((1 / (2 * κ)) * M) * (1 / (2 * κ))) * (|w p.2| * |w p.1|) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h123 hw_nn
          _ = (1 / (2 * κ) * |w p.1|) * (1 / (2 * κ) * M * |w p.2|) := by ring
      have hK_int : Integrable (Function.uncurry K) (volume.prod volume) :=
        hg_prod.mono' hK_meas hK_dom
      change -∫ u : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) x u * w u * freeGreenKernel κ u y = _
      have h_lhs : (fun u : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) x u * w u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
          (fun u : ℝ => -∫ z : ℝ, K u z) := by
        ext u
        rw [ih x u]
        dsimp [K]
        rw [neg_mul, neg_mul, ← integral_mul_const, ← integral_mul_const]
      rw [h_lhs, integral_neg, neg_neg, integral_integral_swap hK_int]
      have h_rhs : (fun z : ℝ => ∫ u : ℝ, K u z) =
          (fun z : ℝ => -(freeGreenKernel κ x z * w z * greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) z y)) := by
        ext z
        dsimp [K, greenIterKernel]
        have h_rearr : (fun u : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x z * w z * greenIterKernel κ w ℓ z u *
            w u * freeGreenKernel κ u y) =
          (fun u : ℝ => (freeGreenKernel κ x z * w z) *
            (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ z u * w u * freeGreenKernel κ u y)) := by
          ext u; ring
        rw [h_rearr, integral_const_mul]
        ring
      rw [h_rhs, integral_neg]
  have h_symm : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y x := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero =>
      intro x y
      exact h_fg_symm x y
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      intro x y
      rw [h_left_peel ℓ y x]
      change -∫ z : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z y = _
      congr 1
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
      dsimp only
      rw [ih x z, h_fg_symm z y]
      ring
  have h_ftc_Iic : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → ∀ (x : ℝ),
      (∀ x' : ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Set.Iic x') volume) →
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Iic x', g z) (g x) x := by
    intro g hg x hg_Iic
    have h_eq : (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Iic x', g z) =
        (fun x' => (∫ z in Set.Iic x, g z) + ∫ z in x..x', g z) := by
      ext x'
      exact sub_eq_iff_eq_add'.mp (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hg_Iic x) (hg_Iic x'))
    rw [h_eq]
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in x..x', g z) (g x) x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hg.intervalIntegrable x x)
        (hg.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (nhds x)) hg.continuousAt
    exact hd.const_add (∫ z in Set.Iic x, g z)
  have h_ftc_Ioi : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g → ∀ (x : ℝ),
      (∀ x' : ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioi x') volume) →
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Ioi x', g z) (-g x) x := by
    intro g hg x hg_Ioi
    have h_eq : (fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Ioi x', g z) =
        (fun x' => (∫ z in Set.Ioi x, g z) - ∫ z in x..x', g z) := by
      ext x'
      rcases le_total x x' with hx | hx'
      · have h_un : Set.Ioc x x' ∪ Set.Ioi x' = Set.Ioi x := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx
        have h_disj : Disjoint (Set.Ioc x x') (Set.Ioi x') := Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
        have h_int_Ioc : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc x x') volume := (hg.intervalIntegrable x x').1
        have h_sum := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Ioc (hg_Ioi x')
        rw [h_un, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx] at h_sum
        linarith
      · have h_un : Set.Ioc x' x ∪ Set.Ioi x = Set.Ioi x' := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hx'
        have h_disj : Disjoint (Set.Ioc x' x) (Set.Ioi x) := Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
        have h_int_Ioc : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc x' x) volume := (hg.intervalIntegrable x' x).1
        have h_sum := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Ioc (hg_Ioi x)
        rw [h_un, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hx', intervalIntegral.integral_symm x x'] at h_sum
        linarith
    rw [h_eq]
    have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x' => ∫ z in x..x', g z) (g x) x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hg.intervalIntegrable x x)
        (hg.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (nhds x)) hg.continuousAt
    exact hd.const_sub (∫ z in Set.Ioi x, g z)
  have h_conv_deriv : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous F → Integrable F volume → ∀ (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x')
        (-∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (fun x' => -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x')
        (κ ^ 2 * (-∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x) + F x) x := by
    intro F hF_cont hF_int x
    let g_L : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => F z * Real.exp (κ * z)
    let g_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => F z * Real.exp (-κ * z)
    let I_L : ℝ → ℝ := fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Iic x', g_L z
    let I_R : ℝ → ℝ := fun x' => ∫ z in Set.Ioi x', g_R z
    have hg_L_cont : Continuous g_L := hF_cont.mul (by fun_prop)
    have hg_R_cont : Continuous g_R := hF_cont.mul (by fun_prop)
    have hg_L_int : ∀ x' : ℝ, IntegrableOn g_L (Set.Iic x') volume := by
      intro x'
      have h_dom : IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.exp (κ * x') * ‖F z‖) (Set.Iic x') volume :=
        (hF_int.norm.const_mul (Real.exp (κ * x'))).integrableOn
      refine h_dom.mono' hg_L_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Iic] with z hz
      change z ≤ x' at hz
      dsimp [g_L]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_comm]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (le_of_lt hκ_pos))
    have hg_R_int : ∀ x' : ℝ, IntegrableOn g_R (Set.Ioi x') volume := by
      intro x'
      have h_dom : IntegrableOn (fun z => Real.exp (-κ * x') * ‖F z‖) (Set.Ioi x') volume :=
        (hF_int.norm.const_mul (Real.exp (-κ * x'))).integrableOn
      refine h_dom.mono' hg_R_cont.aestronglyMeasurable.restrict ?_
      filter_upwards [ae_restrict_mem measurableSet_Ioi] with z hz
      change x' < z at hz
      dsimp [g_R]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_comm]
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (abs_nonneg _)
      exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (by nlinarith)
    have h_int_fg : ∀ x' : ℝ, Integrable (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') volume := by
      intro x'
      have h_dom : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖F z‖) volume :=
        hF_int.norm.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
      have h_c : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') := by
        dsimp [freeGreenKernel]; fun_prop
      refine h_dom.mono' h_c.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with z
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_fg_bound z x') (abs_nonneg _)
    have h_int_fgd : ∀ x' : ℝ, Integrable (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') volume := by
      intro x'
      have h_dom : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (1 / 2) * ‖F z‖) volume :=
        hF_int.norm.const_mul (1 / 2)
      have h_m : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') volume :=
        (hF_cont.aestronglyMeasurable).mul (h_fgd_meas x').aestronglyMeasurable
      refine h_dom.mono' h_m ?_
      filter_upwards with z
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, mul_comm]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_fgd_bd z x') (abs_nonneg _)
    have h_conv_fg : ∀ x' : ℝ,
        -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x' =
          -(1 / (2 * κ)) * (Real.exp (-κ * x') * I_L x') -
          (1 / (2 * κ)) * (Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x') := by
      intro x'
      have h_split : (∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') =
          (∫ z in Set.Iic x', F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') +
          (∫ z in Set.Ioi x', F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') := by
        rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
        exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic (h_int_fg x')).symm
      have h_L : (∫ z in Set.Iic x', F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') =
          ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * x')) * I_L x' := by
        have h_congr : ∀ z ∈ Set.Iic x',
            F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x' = ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * x')) * g_L z := by
          intro z hz
          change z ≤ x' at hz
          dsimp [freeGreenKernel, g_L]
          rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hz)]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(z - x')) = Real.exp (-κ * x') * Real.exp (κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic h_congr,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      have h_R : (∫ z in Set.Ioi x', F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') =
          ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * I_R x' := by
        have h_congr : ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioi x',
            F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x' = ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * g_R z := by
          intro z hz
          change x' < z at hz
          dsimp [freeGreenKernel, g_R]
          rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hz)]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (z - x')) = Real.exp (κ * x') * Real.exp (-κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h_congr,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      rw [h_split, h_L, h_R]
      ring
    have h_conv_fgd : ∀ x' : ℝ,
        -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x' =
          (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-κ * x') * I_L x') -
          (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x') := by
      intro x'
      have h_split : (∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =
          (∫ z in Set.Iic x', F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') +
          (∫ z in Set.Ioi x', F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') := by
        rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
        exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic (h_int_fgd x')).symm
      have h_L : (∫ z in Set.Iic x', F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =
          (-(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * x')) * I_L x' := by
        rw [MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio]
        have h_congr : ∀ z ∈ Set.Iio x',
            F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x' = (-(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * x')) * g_L z := by
          intro z hz
          change z < x' at hz
          dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, g_L]
          rw [if_pos hz]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (x' - z)) = Real.exp (-κ * x') * Real.exp (κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iio h_congr,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, ← MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_eq_integral_Iio]
      have h_R : (∫ z in Set.Ioi x', F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =
          ((1 / 2) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * I_R x' := by
        have h_congr : ∀ z ∈ Set.Ioi x',
            F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x' = ((1 / 2) * Real.exp (κ * x')) * g_R z := by
          intro z hz
          change x' < z at hz
          have h_not_lt : ¬ (z < x') := not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hz)
          dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, g_R]
          rw [if_neg h_not_lt, if_pos hz]
          have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (z - x')) = Real.exp (κ * x') * Real.exp (-κ * z) := by
            rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
          rw [h_exp]; ring
        rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h_congr,
            MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
      rw [h_split, h_L, h_R]
      ring
    have hd_IL : HasDerivAt I_L (F x * Real.exp (κ * x)) x :=
      h_ftc_Iic g_L hg_L_cont x hg_L_int
    have hd_IR : HasDerivAt I_R (-(F x * Real.exp (-κ * x))) x :=
      h_ftc_Ioi g_R hg_R_cont x hg_R_int
    have hd_exp_neg : HasDerivAt (fun x' => Real.exp (-κ * x')) (-κ * Real.exp (-κ * x)) x := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul (-κ)).exp
    have hd_exp_pos : HasDerivAt (fun x' => Real.exp (κ * x')) (κ * Real.exp (κ * x)) x := by
      simpa [mul_comm] using ((hasDerivAt_id x).const_mul κ).exp
    have hd_prod_L : HasDerivAt (fun x' => Real.exp (-κ * x') * I_L x')
        (-κ * Real.exp (-κ * x) * I_L x + Real.exp (-κ * x) * (F x * Real.exp (κ * x))) x :=
      hd_exp_neg.mul hd_IL
    have hd_prod_R : HasDerivAt (fun x' => Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x')
        (κ * Real.exp (κ * x) * I_R x + Real.exp (κ * x) * -(F x * Real.exp (-κ * x))) x :=
      hd_exp_pos.mul hd_IR
    have h_exp_cancel1 : Real.exp (-κ * x) * (F x * Real.exp (κ * x)) = F x := by
      calc Real.exp (-κ * x) * (F x * Real.exp (κ * x))
        _ = F x * (Real.exp (-κ * x) * Real.exp (κ * x)) := by ring
        _ = F x * Real.exp (-κ * x + κ * x) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
        _ = F x := by ring_nf; rw [Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have h_exp_cancel2 : Real.exp (κ * x) * -(F x * Real.exp (-κ * x)) = -F x := by
      calc Real.exp (κ * x) * -(F x * Real.exp (-κ * x))
        _ = -F x * (Real.exp (κ * x) * Real.exp (-κ * x)) := by ring
        _ = -F x * Real.exp (κ * x + -κ * x) := by rw [← Real.exp_add]
        _ = -F x := by ring_nf; rw [Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h_fun_eq : (fun x' => -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenKernel κ z x') =
          (fun x' => -(1 / (2 * κ)) * (Real.exp (-κ * x') * I_L x') -
            (1 / (2 * κ)) * (Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x')) := funext h_conv_fg
      rw [h_fun_eq]
      refine ((hd_prod_L.const_mul (-(1 / (2 * κ)))).sub
        (hd_prod_R.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ)))).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [h_exp_cancel1, h_exp_cancel2, h_conv_fgd x]
      field_simp
      ring
    · have h_fun_eq : (fun x' => -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x') =
          (fun x' => (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (-κ * x') * I_L x') -
            (1 / 2) * (Real.exp (κ * x') * I_R x')) := funext h_conv_fgd
      rw [h_fun_eq]
      refine ((hd_prod_L.const_mul (1 / 2)).sub
        (hd_prod_R.const_mul (1 / 2))).congr_deriv ?_
      rw [h_exp_cancel1, h_exp_cancel2, h_conv_fg x]
      field_simp
      ring
  have hF_cont_int : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a : ℝ),
      Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w m a z * w z) ∧
      Integrable (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w m a z * w z) volume := by
    intro m a
    obtain ⟨h_cm, M, _hM_nn, hM_bd⟩ := h_iter_cont_bound m
    have hc : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w m a z * w z) :=
      (h_cm.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)).mul w.continuous
    refine ⟨hc, ?_⟩
    have h_dom : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => M * ‖w z‖) volume := w.integrable.norm.const_mul M
    refine h_dom.mono' hc.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with z
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hM_bd a z) (abs_nonneg _)
  refine ⟨h_symm, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro m a x
    exact (h_conv_deriv (fun z => greenIterKernel κ w m a z * w z)
      (hF_cont_int m a).1 (hF_cont_int m a).2 x).1
  · intro m a x
    have hd := (h_conv_deriv (fun z => greenIterKernel κ w m a z * w z)
      (hF_cont_int m a).1 (hF_cont_int m a).2 x).2
    refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
    dsimp [greenIterKernel]
    ring
  · intro m a x
    dsimp [greenIterDerivY]
    rw [abs_neg]
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => greenIterKernel κ w m a z * w z * freeGreenDerivY κ z x
    let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ((1 / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) * ‖w z‖
    have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume :=
      w.integrable.norm.const_mul ((1 / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m)
    have hg_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable g volume :=
      ((hF_cont_int m a).1.aestronglyMeasurable).mul (h_fgd_meas x).aestronglyMeasurable
    have hg_dom : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖g z‖ ≤ bound z := by
      filter_upwards with z
      dsimp only [g, bound]
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have h1 := greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound κ hκ w m a z
      have h2 := h_fgd_bd z x
      have h12 : |greenIterKernel κ w m a z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x| ≤
          ((1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) * (1 / 2) :=
        mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      calc |greenIterKernel κ w m a z| * |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
        _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w m a z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) * |w z| := by ring
        _ ≤ (((1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) * (1 / 2)) * |w z| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h12 (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = (1 / (4 * κ) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) * |w z| := by ring
    have hg_int : Integrable g volume := h_bound_int.mono' hg_meas hg_dom
    calc |∫ z : ℝ, g z|
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, ‖g z‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm g
      _ ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, bound z := integral_mono_ae hg_int.norm h_bound_int hg_dom
      _ = ((1 / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) * ∫ z : ℝ, ‖w z‖ := integral_const_mul _ _
      _ = ((∫ z : ℝ, |w z|) / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m := by
        simp_rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        ring

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y)
          (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) x x) x) →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ ((∫ z : ℝ, |w z|) / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w x ∧ HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ w) (diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → greenKernelLeft κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → greenKernelRight κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        greenDerivLeft κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a + 1) / 2 ∧
        greenDerivRight κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a - 1) / 2) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelLeft κ w a) (greenDerivLeft κ w a x) x ∧
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelRight κ w a) (greenDerivRight κ w a x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → HasDerivAt (greenDerivLeft κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelLeft κ w a x) x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → HasDerivAt (greenDerivRight κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelRight κ w a x) x))

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ w hw h_diag_d h_symm h_off_d1 h_off_d2 h_off_bd
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
    summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_geom_tsum : (∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) = 4 / 3 := by
    rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
    norm_num
  have h_pow_le : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ :=
    fun ℓ => pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw ℓ
  have h_G_bd : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (a x : ℝ), |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a x| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
    intro ℓ a x
    exact le_trans (greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound κ hκ w ℓ a x)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_pow_le ℓ) (by positivity))
  have h_G1_bd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m a x
    calc |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x|
      _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ (m + 1) := h_G_bd (m + 1) a x
      _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
  set I_w : ℝ := ∫ z : ℝ, |w z|
  have hIw_nn : 0 ≤ I_w := integral_nonneg (fun z => abs_nonneg _)
  have h_dG_bd : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
      |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ (I_w / (4 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
    intro m a x
    exact le_trans (h_off_bd m a x)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_pow_le m) (by positivity))
  have h_sum_G_norm : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a x‖) := by
    intro a x
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun ℓ => ?_)
      (h_geom_sum.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ)))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h_G_bd ℓ a x
  have h_sum_G : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a x) :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_G_norm a x).of_norm
  have h_sum_G1_norm : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x‖) :=
    fun a x => (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr (h_sum_G_norm a x)
  have h_sum_G1 : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x) :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_G1_norm a x).of_norm
  have h_sum_dG1_norm : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x‖) := by
    intro a x
    refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_)
      (h_geom_sum.mul_left (I_w / (4 * κ)))
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    exact h_dG_bd m a x
  have h_sum_dG1 : ∀ a x : ℝ, Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_dG1_norm a x).of_norm
  have h_peel_G : ∀ a x : ℝ,
      greenKernel κ w a x = freeGreenKernel κ a x + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x :=
    fun a x => (h_sum_G a x).tsum_eq_zero_add
  have h_fg_diag : ∀ x : ℝ, freeGreenKernel κ x x = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro x
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have h_peel_diag : ∀ x : ℝ,
      diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x := by
    intro x
    change greenKernel κ w x x = 1 / (2 * κ) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x
    rw [h_peel_G x x, h_fg_diag x]
  have h_G_symm : ∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x := by
    intro x y

    exact tsum_congr (fun ℓ => h_symm ℓ x y)
  have h_diag : ∀ x : ℝ,
      1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w x ∧ HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ w) (diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x := by
    intro x

    · have h_tail_abs : |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x| ≤ 1 / (6 * κ) := by
        calc |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x|
          _ = ‖∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x‖ :=
            norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm (h_sum_G1_norm x x)
          _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
            refine Summable.tsum_le_tsum (fun m => ?_) (h_sum_G1_norm x x)
              (h_geom_sum.mul_left (1 / (8 * κ)))
            rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
            exact h_G1_bd m x x
          _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * ∑' m : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := tsum_mul_left
          _ = (1 / (8 * κ)) * (4 / 3) := by rw [h_geom_tsum]
          _ = 1 / (6 * κ) := by ring
      have h_low := (abs_le.mp h_tail_abs).1
      have h_diff : 1 / (2 * κ) - 1 / (6 * κ) - 1 / (4 * κ) = 1 / (12 * κ) := by
        field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
      have : 0 ≤ 1 / (12 * κ) := by positivity
      linarith [h_peel_diag x]
    · have h_tsum_d : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y y)
          (diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x := by
        refine hasDerivAt_tsum (u := fun m : ℕ => (I_w / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m)
          (g := fun m y => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y y)
          (g' := fun m y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) y y)
          (y₀ := x)
          (h_geom_sum.mul_left (I_w / (2 * κ)))
          (fun m y => h_diag_d m y)
          (fun m y => ?_)
          (h_sum_G1 x x)
          x
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul, abs_of_pos two_pos]
        calc 2 * |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) y y|
          _ ≤ 2 * ((I_w / (4 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_dG_bd m y y) zero_le_two
          _ = (I_w / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
      have h_add_d := h_tsum_d.const_add (1 / (2 * κ))
      have h_fn_eq : (fun y : ℝ => 1 / (2 * κ) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y y) =
          diagGreen κ w := by
        ext y
        exact (h_peel_diag y).symm
      rwa [h_fn_eq] at h_add_d
  have h_eq_LR : ∀ a x : ℝ,
      (x ≤ a → greenKernelLeft κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x) ∧
      (a ≤ x → greenKernelRight κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x) := by
    intro a x
    refine ⟨fun hxa => ?_, fun hax => ?_⟩
    · rw [h_peel_G a x]
      dsimp [greenKernelLeft, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hxa)]
    · rw [h_peel_G a x]
      dsimp [greenKernelRight, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hax), neg_sub]
  have h_jump_LR : ∀ a : ℝ,
      greenDerivLeft κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a + 1) / 2 ∧
      greenDerivRight κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a - 1) / 2 := by
    intro a
    have h_dgd : diagGreenDeriv κ w a = 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a a := by
      dsimp [diagGreenDeriv]
      exact tsum_mul_left
    have h_exp_aa : Real.exp (-κ * (a - a)) = 1 := by
      rw [sub_self, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · dsimp [greenDerivLeft]
      rw [h_exp_aa, mul_one]
      linarith
    · dsimp [greenDerivRight]
      rw [h_exp_aa, mul_one]
      linarith
  have h_d1_LR : ∀ a x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (greenKernelLeft κ w a) (greenDerivLeft κ w a x) x ∧
      HasDerivAt (greenKernelRight κ w a) (greenDerivRight κ w a x) x := by
    intro a x
    have h_tail_d1 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) x := by
      refine hasDerivAt_tsum (u := fun m : ℕ => (I_w / (4 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m)
        (g := fun m x' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (g' := fun m x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (y₀ := x)
        (h_geom_sum.mul_left (I_w / (4 * κ)))
        (fun m x' => h_off_d1 m a x')
        (fun m x' => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_dG_bd m a x')
        (h_sum_G1 a x)
        x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (a - x')))
          ((1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (a - x))) x := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => -κ * (a - x')) (-κ * (0 - 1)) x :=
          ((hasDerivAt_const x a).sub (hasDerivAt_id x)).const_mul (-κ)
        refine (h1.exp.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))).congr_deriv ?_
        field_simp [hκ_ne]
        ring
      exact h0.add h_tail_d1
    · have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (x' - a)))
          (-(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - a))) x := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => -κ * (x' - a)) (-κ * 1) x :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const a).const_mul (-κ)
        refine (h1.exp.const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))).congr_deriv ?_
        field_simp [hκ_ne]
      exact h0.add h_tail_d1
  have h_d2_LR : ∀ a x : ℝ,
      (x ≤ a → HasDerivAt (greenDerivLeft κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelLeft κ w a x) x) ∧
      (a ≤ x → HasDerivAt (greenDerivRight κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelRight κ w a x) x) := by
    intro a x
    set C_w : ℝ := (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) w
    have hCw_bd : ∀ x' : ℝ, |w x'| ≤ C_w := by
      intro x'
      have h := w.norm_le_seminorm ℝ x'
      rwa [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h
    have hCw_nn : 0 ≤ C_w := le_trans (abs_nonneg (w 0)) (hCw_bd 0)
    have h_G1_le_G0 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (x' : ℝ),
        |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x'| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      intro m x'
      have h1 := h_G1_bd m a x'
      have h_diff : (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m - (1 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m =
          (3 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
      have : 0 ≤ (3 / (8 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by positivity
      linarith
    have h_tail_d2 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (∑' m : ℕ, (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x)) x := by
      refine hasDerivAt_tsum (u := fun m : ℕ => ((κ ^ 2 + C_w) / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m)
        (g := fun m x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (g' := fun m x' => κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x' + w x' * greenIterKernel κ w m a x')
        (y₀ := x)
        (h_geom_sum.mul_left ((κ ^ 2 + C_w) / (2 * κ)))
        (fun m x' => h_off_d2 m a x')
        (fun m x' => ?_)
        (h_sum_dG1 a x)
        x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_tri := abs_add_le (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (w x' * greenIterKernel κ w m a x')
      have h_t1 : |κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x'| ≤
          κ ^ 2 * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) := by
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < κ ^ 2)]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_G1_le_G0 m x') (by positivity)
      have h_t2 : |w x' * greenIterKernel κ w m a x'| ≤
          C_w * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) := by
        rw [abs_mul]
        exact mul_le_mul (hCw_bd x') (h_G_bd m a x') (abs_nonneg _) hCw_nn
      calc |κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x' + w x' * greenIterKernel κ w m a x'|
        _ ≤ |κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x'| + |w x' * greenIterKernel κ w m a x'| := h_tri
        _ ≤ κ ^ 2 * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) + C_w * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
          add_le_add h_t1 h_t2
        _ = ((κ ^ 2 + C_w) / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ m := by ring
    have h_tsum_split :
        (∑' m : ℕ, (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x)) =
          κ ^ 2 * (∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x) + w x * greenKernel κ w a x := by
      rw [Summable.tsum_add ((h_sum_G1 a x).mul_left (κ ^ 2)) ((h_sum_G a x).mul_left (w x)),
        tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left]
      rfl
    have h_tail_d2' : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
        (κ ^ 2 * (∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x) + w x * greenKernel κ w a x) x :=
      h_tail_d2.congr_deriv h_tsum_split
    refine ⟨fun hxa => ?_, fun hax => ?_⟩
    · have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (a - x')))
          (κ ^ 2 * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (a - x)))) x := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => -κ * (a - x')) (-κ * (0 - 1)) x :=
          ((hasDerivAt_const x a).sub (hasDerivAt_id x)).const_mul (-κ)
        refine (h1.exp.const_mul (1 / 2)).congr_deriv ?_
        field_simp [hκ_ne]
        ring
      refine (h0.add h_tail_d2').congr_deriv ?_
      rw [← (h_eq_LR a x).1 hxa]
      dsimp [greenKernelLeft]
      ring
    · have h0 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (x' - a)))
          (κ ^ 2 * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - a)))) x := by
        have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun x' : ℝ => -κ * (x' - a)) (-κ * 1) x :=
          ((hasDerivAt_id x).sub_const a).const_mul (-κ)
        refine (h1.exp.const_mul (-(1 / 2))).congr_deriv ?_
        field_simp [hκ_ne]
      refine (h0.add h_tail_d2').congr_deriv ?_
      rw [← (h_eq_LR a x).2 hax]
      dsimp [greenKernelRight]
      ring
  exact ⟨h_G_symm, h_diag, h_eq_LR, h_jump_LR, h_d1_LR, h_d2_LR⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 →
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (greenKernelLeft κ w a) Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (greenDerivLeft κ w a) Filter.atBot (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (greenKernelRight κ w a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (greenDerivRight κ w a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x))
          Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
        Filter.Tendsto (fun x => -((greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)) ∧
      (∀ y : ℝ,
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2))
          volume)
