proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ w hw
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h_schwartz_bound : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      ∃ M : ℝ, 0 ≤ M ∧ ∀ y : ℝ, |f y| ≤ M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    intro f
    let M : ℝ := 2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) f + (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0) f)
    have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := by
      dsimp [M]
      have h0 : 0 ≤ (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) f := apply_nonneg _ _
      have h4 : 0 ≤ (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0) f := apply_nonneg _ _
      linarith
    refine ⟨M, hM_nn, fun y => ?_⟩
    set D : ℝ := |f y|
    have hD_nn : 0 ≤ D := abs_nonneg _
    have h0 := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 0 f y
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, iteratedDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h0
    have h4 := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 4 0 f y
    have hy4 : |y| ^ 4 = y ^ 4 := by
      calc |y| ^ 4 = (|y| ^ 2) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ = (y ^ 2) ^ 2 := by rw [sq_abs]
        _ = y ^ 4 := by ring
    rw [hy4, iteratedDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h4
    have h_poly : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 4) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (1 - y ^ 2)]
    have h_mul : (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D ≤ M := by
      calc (1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D
        _ ≤ (2 * (1 + y ^ 4)) * D := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_poly hD_nn
        _ = 2 * (D + y ^ 4 * D) := by ring
        _ ≤ 2 * ((SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) f + (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 4 0) f) := by
          linarith [h0, h4]
        _ = M := rfl
    have h_ne : 1 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
    calc D = ((1 + y ^ 2) ^ 2 * D) * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp [h_ne]
      _ ≤ M * ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_mul (by positivity)
  obtain ⟨M_w, hMw, hw_decay⟩ := h_schwartz_bound w
  have h_pt : ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (a b : ℝ), |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ a b| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ := by
    intro ℓ a b
    exact le_trans (greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound κ hκ w ℓ a b)
      (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw ℓ) (by positivity))
  have h_exp_peetre : ∀ x y : ℝ,
      Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) ≤ 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro x y
    set t : ℝ := |y - x|
    have ht_nn : 0 ≤ t := abs_nonneg _
    have ht_sq : t ^ 2 = (y - x) ^ 2 := sq_abs (y - x)
    have h_exp_half : 1 + t / 2 ≤ Real.exp (t / 2) := by
      linarith [Real.add_one_le_exp (t / 2)]
    have h_exp_sq : (1 + t / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (κ * t) := by
      have h1 : (1 + t / 2) ^ 2 ≤ Real.exp (t / 2) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) h_exp_half 2
      have h2 : Real.exp (t / 2) ^ 2 = Real.exp t := by
        rw [sq, ← Real.exp_add, add_halves]
      have h3 : Real.exp t ≤ Real.exp (κ * t) :=
        Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (le_mul_of_one_le_left ht_nn hκ)
      linarith
    have h_t_sq : 1 + t ^ 2 ≤ 4 * Real.exp (κ * t) := by
      have h_alg : 1 + t ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (1 + t / 2) ^ 2 := by nlinarith
      linarith
    have h_x_sq : 1 + x ^ 2 ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2) := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * y - x), sq_nonneg (y - x), sq_nonneg (y * (y - x)), ht_sq]
    have h_x_exp : 1 + x ^ 2 ≤ 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * Real.exp (κ * t) := by
      calc 1 + x ^ 2
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + t ^ 2) := h_x_sq
        _ ≤ 2 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (4 * Real.exp (κ * t)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_t_sq (by positivity)
        _ = 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * Real.exp (κ * t) := by ring
    have h_prod_exp : (1 + x ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * t) ≤ 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) := by
      have h_cancel : Real.exp (κ * t) * Real.exp (-κ * t) = 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add, show κ * t + -κ * t = 0 by ring, Real.exp_zero]
      calc (1 + x ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * t)
        _ ≤ (8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * Real.exp (κ * t)) * Real.exp (-κ * t) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_x_exp (Real.exp_nonneg _)
        _ = 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (Real.exp (κ * t) * Real.exp (-κ * t)) := by ring
        _ = 8 * (1 + y ^ 2) := by rw [h_cancel, mul_one]
    have hx_ne : 1 + x ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
    calc Real.exp (-κ * t)
      _ = ((1 + x ^ 2) * Real.exp (-κ * t)) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [hx_ne]
      _ ≤ (8 * (1 + y ^ 2)) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_prod_exp (by positivity)
  have h_peetre : ∀ x y : ℝ,
      ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) ≤ 8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro x y
    have hy_ne : 1 + y ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (by positivity)
    calc ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|)
      _ ≤ ((1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ 2 * (8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_peetre x y) (by positivity)
      _ = 8 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [hy_ne]
  have h_fg_cont : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ p.1 p.2) := by
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]; fun_prop
  have h_fg_pos : ∀ a b : ℝ, 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel κ a b := by
    intro a b; dsimp [freeGreenKernel]; positivity
  have h_fg_bound : ∀ a b : ℝ, |freeGreenKernel κ a b| ≤ 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    intro a b
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 1 / (2 * κ)), abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
    exact mul_le_of_le_one_right (by positivity)
      (Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [abs_nonneg (a - b)]))
  have h_iter_cont : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2) := by
    intro ℓ
    induction ℓ with
    | zero => exact h_fg_cont
    | succ ℓ ih =>
      let F : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun p z => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z p.2
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * ‖w z‖
      have h_bound_int : Integrable bound volume := w.integrable.norm.const_mul _
      have hF_meas : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable (F p) volume := by
        intro p
        have h_c1 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z) :=
          ih.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
        have h_c2 : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ z p.2) :=
          h_fg_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
        exact ((h_c1.mul w.continuous).mul h_c2).aestronglyMeasurable
      have hF_dom : ∀ p : ℝ × ℝ, ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, ‖F p z‖ ≤ bound z := by
        intro p
        filter_upwards with z
        dsimp [F, bound]
        rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
        have h1 := h_pt ℓ p.1 z
        have h2 := h_fg_bound z p.2
        calc |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |w z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|
          _ = (|greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 z| * |freeGreenKernel κ z p.2|) * |w z| := by ring
          _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ * (1 / (2 * κ))) * |w z| :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)) (abs_nonneg _)
      have hF_cont : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => F p z) := by

        (h_exp_left a).const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
      rw [mul_zero] at h0
      have h_add := h0.add h_tsum_G
      rwa [add_zero] at h_add
    · change Filter.Tendsto
          (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (a - x)) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x)
          Filter.atBot (nhds 0)
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (a - x)))
          Filter.atBot (nhds ((1 / 2) * 0)) :=
        (h_exp_left a).const_mul (1 / 2)
      rw [mul_zero] at h0
      have h_add := h0.add h_tsum_dG
      rwa [add_zero] at h_add
  have h_tend_R : ∀ a : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (greenKernelRight κ w a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (greenDerivRight κ w a) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro a
    have h_tsum_G : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹)
        (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_tail_G a x)
        (by simpa using h_inv_top.const_mul (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2))
    have h_tsum_dG : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x)
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => (4 * π * M_w / κ) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹)
        (fun x => by rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]; exact h_tail_dG a x)
        (by simpa using h_inv_top.const_mul (4 * π * M_w / κ))
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · change Filter.Tendsto
          (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - a)) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - a)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds ((1 / (2 * κ)) * 0)) :=
        (h_exp_right a).const_mul (1 / (2 * κ))
      rw [mul_zero] at h0
      have h_add := h0.add h_tsum_G
      rwa [add_zero] at h_add
    · change Filter.Tendsto
          (fun x : ℝ => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - a)) + ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - a)))
          Filter.atTop (nhds (-(1 / 2) * 0)) :=
        (h_exp_right a).const_mul (-(1 / 2))
      rw [mul_zero] at h0
      have h_add := h0.add h_tsum_dG
      rwa [add_zero] at h_add
  have hg_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < diagGreen κ w x :=
    fun x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by positivity) (hg_ge x)
  have h_inv_2g : ∀ x : ℝ, (2 * diagGreen κ w x)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * κ := by
    intro x
    have h1 : (2 * κ)⁻¹ ≤ 2 * diagGreen κ w x := by
      calc (2 * κ)⁻¹ = 2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) := by field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
        _ ≤ 2 * diagGreen κ w x := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hg_ge x) zero_le_two
    have h2 : (2 * diagGreen κ w x)⁻¹ ≤ ((2 * κ)⁻¹)⁻¹ :=
      inv_anti₀ (by positivity) h1
    rwa [inv_inv] at h2
  have h_tend_F : ∀ y : ℝ,
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x => (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x))
        Filter.atBot (nhds 0) ∧
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x => -((greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 / (2 * diagGreen κ w x)))
        Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
    intro y
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · refine squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => 2 * κ * (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2) (fun x => ?_) ?_
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
          abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (hg_pos x)), div_eq_mul_inv]
        calc (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreen κ w x)⁻¹
          _ ≤ (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 * (2 * κ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_inv_2g x) (sq_nonneg _)
          _ = 2 * κ * (greenKernelLeft κ w y x) ^ 2 := by ring
      · simpa using ((h_tend_L y).1.pow 2).const_mul (2 * κ)
    · refine squeeze_zero_norm (a := fun x => 2 * κ * (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2) (fun x => ?_) ?_
      · rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg, abs_div, abs_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _),
          abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (hg_pos x)), div_eq_mul_inv]
        calc (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 * (2 * diagGreen κ w x)⁻¹
          _ ≤ (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 * (2 * κ) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_inv_2g x) (sq_nonneg _)
          _ = 2 * κ * (greenKernelRight κ w y x) ^ 2 := by ring
      · simpa using ((h_tend_R y).1.pow 2).const_mul (2 * κ)
  have h2gsq_ne : ∀ x : ℝ, 2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2 ≠ 0 :=
    fun x => ne_of_gt (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x)))
  have h_int : ∀ y : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2))
        volume := by
    intro y
    let f_y : ℝ → ℝ := fun x =>
      (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)
    have hf_cont : Continuous f_y := by
      dsimp [f_y]
      have hG1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenKernel κ w x y) :=
        hG_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      have hG2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenKernel κ w y x) :=
        hG_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hg2 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) :=
        continuous_const.mul (hg_cont.pow 2)
      exact (hG1.mul hG2).div hg2 h2gsq_ne
    set C_y : ℝ := 32 * (1 + y ^ 2) + 32 * π * M_w / κ
    have hf_pw : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖f_y x‖ ≤ C_y * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro x
      dsimp [f_y]
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (mul_pos two_pos (sq_pos_of_pos (hg_pos x)))]
      have h_denom : 1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) ≤ 8 * κ ^ 2 := by
        have h_sq : (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2 ≤ (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (by positivity) (hg_ge x) 2
        have h1 : 1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) ≤ 1 / (2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2) :=
          one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by positivity) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq zero_le_two)
        have h2 : 1 / (2 * (1 / (4 * κ)) ^ 2) = 8 * κ ^ 2 := by field_simp [hκ_ne]; ring
        linarith
      have h_Gyx : |greenKernel κ w y x| ≤
          (4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ + 4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        have h_fg : (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) ≤
            (4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          calc (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|)
            _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (8 * (1 + y ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_peetre x y) (by positivity)
            _ = (4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
        calc |greenKernel κ w y x|
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |y - x|) + (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
            hG_peel x y
          _ ≤ (4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ + (4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
            by linarith [h_fg]
          _ = (4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ + 4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
      have h_G_prod : |greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x| ≤
          (1 / κ) * ((4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ + 4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
        mul_le_mul (hG_le x y) h_Gyx (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      calc (|greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)
        _ = (|greenKernel κ w x y| * |greenKernel κ w y x|) * (1 / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2)) := by ring
        _ ≤ ((1 / κ) * ((4 * (1 + y ^ 2) / κ + 4 * π * M_w / κ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹)) * (8 * κ ^ 2) :=
          mul_le_mul h_G_prod h_denom (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = C_y * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          dsimp [C_y]
          field_simp [hκ_ne]
          ring
    exact (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul C_y).mono' hf_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf_pw)
  exact ⟨h_tend_L, h_tend_R, h_tend_F, h_int⟩

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w 1 y y)
        (2 * κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x +
          2 * w x * greenIterKernel κ w 0 x x +
          2 * greenIterMixedDiag κ w 0 x) x

signature.name: greenIterDerivY_one_diag_hasDerivAt
signature.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w 1 y y)
        (2 * κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x +
          2 * w x * greenIterKernel κ w 0 x x +
          2 * greenIterMixedDiag κ w 0 x) x

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ w x
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hκ_pos
  have h2κ_pos : 0 < 2 * κ := by linarith
  have hG0 : greenIterKernel κ w 0 x x = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
    dsimp [greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
    rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
  have hG1 : greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x =
      (1 / κ) * (-∫ z : ℝ, w z * freeGreenKernel (2 * κ) z x) := by
    dsimp [greenIterKernel]
    have h_pt : (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x z * w z * freeGreenKernel κ z x) =
        fun z : ℝ => (1 / κ) * (w z * freeGreenKernel (2 * κ) z x) := by
      ext z
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_sub_comm x z]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * |z - x|) * Real.exp (-κ * |z - x|) =
          Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * |z - x|) := by
        rw [← Real.exp_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      calc (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |z - x|) * w z * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * |z - x|))
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / (2 * κ)) * w z * (Real.exp (-κ * |z - x|) * Real.exp (-κ * |z - x|)) := by ring
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / (2 * κ)) * w z * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * |z - x|) := by rw [h_exp]
        _ = (1 / κ) * (w z * (1 / (2 * (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * |z - x|))) := by field_simp
    rw [h_pt, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, mul_neg]
  have hM0 : greenIterMixedDiag κ w 0 x = κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x := by
    dsimp [greenIterMixedDiag, greenIterDerivY, greenIterKernel]
    rw [mul_neg, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    congr 1
    have h_ae : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, z ≠ x :=
      MeasureTheory.compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr (MeasureTheory.measure_singleton x)
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [h_ae] with z hz
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, freeGreenKernel]
    rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hz with hzx | hxz
    · rw [if_pos hzx, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hzx), abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hzx)]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(z - x)) = Real.exp (-κ * (x - z)) := by
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [h_exp]
      field_simp
    · have h1 : ¬ z < x := not_lt_of_gt hxz
      rw [if_neg h1, if_pos hxz, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hxz), abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hxz)]
      have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(x - z)) = Real.exp (-κ * (z - x)) := by
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [h_exp]
      field_simp
  have hD1 : ∀ y : ℝ, 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w 1 y y =
      (1 / κ) * (-∫ z : ℝ, w z * freeGreenDerivY (2 * κ) z y) := by
    intro y
    dsimp [greenIterDerivY, greenIterKernel]
    have h_pt : (fun z : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ y z * w z * freeGreenDerivY κ z y) =
        fun z : ℝ => (1 / (2 * κ)) * (w z * freeGreenDerivY (2 * κ) z y) := by
      ext z
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel, freeGreenDerivY]
      rcases lt_trichotomy z y with hzy | rfl | hyz
      · simp only [hzy, ↓reduceIte, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hzy)]
        have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)) =
            Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - z)) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
        calc (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)) * w z * (-(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)))
          _ = -(1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 2) * w z * (Real.exp (-κ * (y - z)) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z))) := by ring
          _ = -(1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 2) * w z * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - z)) := by rw [h_exp]
          _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (w z * (-(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (y - z)))) := by ring
      · have h1 : ¬ z < z := lt_irrefl z
        simp only [h1, ↓reduceIte]
        ring
      · have h1 : ¬ z < y := not_lt_of_gt hyz
        simp only [h1, hyz, ↓reduceIte, abs_of_neg (sub_neg.mpr hyz)]
        have h_exp : Real.exp (-κ * -(y - z)) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y)) =
            Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (z - y)) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]
          congr 1
          ring
        calc (1 / (2 * κ)) * Real.exp (-κ * -(y - z)) * w z * ((1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y)))
          _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 2) * w z * (Real.exp (-κ * -(y - z)) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y))) := by ring
          _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 2) * w z * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (z - y)) := by rw [h_exp]
          _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (w z * ((1 / 2) * Real.exp (-(2 * κ) * (z - y)))) := by ring
    rw [h_pt, MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    field_simp
  have h_ftc : ∀ (g : ℝ → ℝ), Continuous g →
      ((∀ y : ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Set.Iic y) volume) →
        HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ z in Set.Iic y, g z) (g x) x) ∧
      ((∀ y : ℝ, IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioi y) volume) →
        HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ z in Set.Ioi y, g z) (-g x) x) := by
    intro g hg
    have hd_int : HasDerivAt (fun y => ∫ z in x..y, g z) (g x) x :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_hasDerivAt_right (hg.intervalIntegrable x x)
        (hg.stronglyMeasurableAtFilter volume (nhds x)) hg.continuousAt
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro hg_Iic
      have h_eq : (fun y => ∫ z in Set.Iic y, g z) =
          fun y => (∫ z in Set.Iic x, g z) + ∫ z in x..y, g z := by
        ext y
        have h_sub := intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_sub_Iic (hg_Iic x) (hg_Iic y)
        linarith
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hd_int.const_add (∫ z in Set.Iic x, g z)
    · intro hg_Ioi
      have h_eq : (fun y => ∫ z in Set.Ioi y, g z) =
          fun y => (∫ z in Set.Ioi x, g z) - ∫ z in x..y, g z := by
        ext y
        rcases le_total x y with hxy | hyx
        · have h_union := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hxy
          have h_disj : Disjoint (Set.Ioc x y) (Set.Ioi y) := Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
          have h_int_Ioc : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc x y) volume := (hg.intervalIntegrable x y).1
          have h_add := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Ioc (hg_Ioi y)
          rw [h_union, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hxy] at h_add
          linarith
        · have h_union := Set.Ioc_union_Ioi_eq_Ioi hyx
          have h_disj : Disjoint (Set.Ioc y x) (Set.Ioi x) := Set.Ioc_disjoint_Ioi le_rfl
          have h_int_Ioc : IntegrableOn g (Set.Ioc y x) volume := (hg.intervalIntegrable y x).1
          have h_add := MeasureTheory.setIntegral_union h_disj measurableSet_Ioi h_int_Ioc (hg_Ioi x)
          rw [h_union, ← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le hyx, intervalIntegral.integral_symm x y] at h_add
          linarith
      rw [h_eq]
      exact hd_int.const_sub (∫ z in Set.Ioi x, g z)
  set μ : ℝ := 2 * κ
  have hμ : 0 < μ := h2κ_pos
  have hμ_ne : μ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hμ
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := w
  have hF_cont : Continuous F := w.continuous
  have hF_int : Integrable F volume := w.integrable
  let gL : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => F z * Real.exp (μ * z)
  let gR : ℝ → ℝ := fun z => F z * Real.exp (-μ * z)
  have hgL_cont : Continuous gL := hF_cont.mul (by fun_prop)
  have hgR_cont : Continuous gR := hF_cont.mul (by fun_prop)
  have hgL_int : ∀ y : ℝ, IntegrableOn gL (Set.Iic y) volume := by
    intro y
    refine (hF_int.norm.const_mul (Real.exp (μ * y))).integrableOn.mono'
      hgL_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Iic]
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z (hz : z ≤ y) => ?_
    dsimp [gL]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_comm]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right
      (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hz (le_of_lt hμ))) (abs_nonneg _)
  have hgR_int : ∀ y : ℝ, IntegrableOn gR (Set.Ioi y) volume := by
    intro y
    refine (hF_int.norm.const_mul (Real.exp (-μ * y))).integrableOn.mono'
      hgR_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    rw [MeasureTheory.ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioi]
    refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z (hz : y < z) => ?_
    dsimp [gR]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _), mul_comm]
    have h_le : -μ * z ≤ -μ * y := by nlinarith
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr h_le) (abs_nonneg _)
  let IL : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∫ z in Set.Iic y, gL z
  let IR : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∫ z in Set.Ioi y, gR z
  have hK_eq : ∀ y : ℝ, -∫ z : ℝ, F z * freeGreenKernel μ z y =
      -(1 / (2 * μ)) * Real.exp (-μ * y) * IL y - (1 / (2 * μ)) * Real.exp (μ * y) * IR y := by
    intro y
    have h_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenKernel μ z y) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenKernel μ z y) := by
        dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
        fun_prop
      refine (hF_int.norm.const_mul (1 / (2 * μ))).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_
      dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, abs_of_pos (show 0 < 1 / (2 * μ) by positivity),
        abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      have h_exp_le : Real.exp (-μ * |z - y|) ≤ 1 := by
        rw [← Real.exp_zero]
        apply Real.exp_le_exp.mpr
        have : 0 ≤ |z - y| := abs_nonneg _
        nlinarith
      calc |F z| * (1 / (2 * μ) * Real.exp (-μ * |z - y|))
        _ ≤ |F z| * (1 / (2 * μ) * 1) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
            (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_le (by positivity)) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = 1 / (2 * μ) * |F z| := by ring
    rw [← MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic h_int, Set.compl_Iic]
    have hL : (∫ z in Set.Iic y, F z * freeGreenKernel μ z y) =
        ((1 / (2 * μ)) * Real.exp (-μ * y)) * IL y := by
      have h_congr : Set.EqOn (fun z : ℝ => F z * freeGreenKernel μ z y)
          (fun z : ℝ => ((1 / (2 * μ)) * Real.exp (-μ * y)) * gL z) (Set.Iic y) := by
        intro z (hz : z ≤ y)
        dsimp [freeGreenKernel, gL]
        rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr hz)]
        have h_exp : Real.exp (-μ * -(z - y)) = Real.exp (-μ * y) * Real.exp (μ * z) := by
          rw [← Real.exp_add]

    have h_dom_int : Integrable (fun z : ℝ => (C₀ * ‖w z‖ + B * (‖z‖ ^ 1 * ‖w z‖)) * (1 / 2)) volume :=
      (((w.integrable.norm.const_mul C₀).add
        ((w.integrable_pow_mul volume 1).const_mul B)).mul_const (1 / 2))
    refine h_dom_int.mono' h_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
    dsimp [K, C₀]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
    have hG_le : |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ z| ≤ |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ 0| + B * |z| := by
      have h1 : |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ z| ≤
          |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ 0| +
            |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ z - greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ 0| := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using
          norm_le_norm_add_norm_sub' (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ z) (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ 0)
      have h2 := h_mvt_second y₁ z 0
      rw [sub_zero] at h2
      linarith
    have h_prod1 : |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ z| * |w z| ≤
        |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y₁ 0| * |w z| + B * (|z| ^ 1 * |w z|) := by
      have h3 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hG_le (abs_nonneg (w z))
      simpa [add_mul, mul_assoc] using h3
    exact mul_le_mul h_prod1 (h_fg_bd z y₂) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
  let I : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => ∫ z : ℝ, |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|
  have hI_int : ∀ y : ℝ, Integrable (fun z : ℝ => |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) volume := by
    intro y
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun z : ℝ => |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) volume :=
      (w.continuous.norm.measurable.mul ((h_fg_meas y).sub (h_fg_meas x)).norm).aestronglyMeasurable
    refine w.integrable.norm.mono' h_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    have h_diff_le : |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x| ≤ 1 := by
      have h1 := abs_sub (freeGreenDerivY κ z y) (freeGreenDerivY κ z x)
      linarith [h_fg_bd z y, h_fg_bd z x]
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_le (abs_nonneg (w z))
  let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
    greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 2) y y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 2) x y - greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 2) y x
  have hΦ_sub_le : ∀ y : ℝ, |Φ y - Φ x| ≤ B * |y - x| * I y := by
    intro y
    have hΦ_eq : Φ y - Φ x =
        -∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y z - greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z) *
          w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x) := by
      have h_lin :
          (∫ z : ℝ, (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y z - greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z) *
            w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x)) =
          (∫ z : ℝ, K y y z) - (∫ z : ℝ, K x y z) - (∫ z : ℝ, K y x z) + (∫ z : ℝ, K x x z) := by
        have h_fn :
            (fun z : ℝ => (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y z - greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z) *
              w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x)) =
            fun z : ℝ => K y y z - K x y z - K y x z + K x x z := by
          ext z
          dsimp [K]
          ring
        have h1 := integral_sub (hK_int y y) (hK_int x y)
        have h2 := integral_sub ((hK_int y y).sub (hK_int x y)) (hK_int y x)
        have h3 := integral_add (((hK_int y y).sub (hK_int x y)).sub (hK_int y x)) (hK_int x x)
        dsimp only [Pi.sub_apply] at h2 h3
        rw [h_fn, h3, h2, h1]
      dsimp [Φ, greenIterDerivY, K] at h_lin ⊢
      linarith
    rw [hΦ_eq, abs_neg]
    let D : ℝ → ℝ := fun z =>
      (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y z - greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x z) *
        w z * (freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x)
    have hD_int : Integrable D volume := by
      have h_fn : D = (K y y - K x y - K y x) + K x x := by
        ext z; simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply, D, K]; ring
      rw [h_fn]
      exact (((hK_int y y).sub (hK_int x y)).sub (hK_int y x)).add (hK_int x x)
    have h_norm_le : |∫ z : ℝ, D z| ≤ ∫ z : ℝ, |D z| := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm D
    have h_mono : (∫ z : ℝ, |D z|) ≤
        ∫ z : ℝ, (B * |y - x|) * (|w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|) := by
      refine integral_mono hD_int.norm ((hI_int y).const_mul (B * |y - x|)) (fun z => ?_)
      dsimp [D]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul, mul_assoc]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_lip_first y z) (by positivity)
    rw [integral_const_mul] at h_mono
    exact le_trans h_norm_le h_mono
  have hI_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto I (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
    have h_ae_ne : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume, z ≠ x := by
      rw [ae_iff]
      simp [measure_singleton]
    have h_ae_tendsto : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume,
        Filter.Tendsto (fun y => |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|)
          (nhds x) (nhds (0 : ℝ)) := by
      filter_upwards [h_ae_ne] with z hzx
      have h_fg_tend : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => freeGreenDerivY κ z y)
          (nhds x) (nhds (freeGreenDerivY κ z x)) := by
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne hzx with hlt | hgt
        · have h_ev : (fun y => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z))) =ᶠ[nhds x]
              (fun y => freeGreenDerivY κ z y) := by
            filter_upwards [Ioi_mem_nhds hlt] with y hy
            have hy' : z < y := hy
            dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
            rw [if_pos hy']
          have h_cont_at : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ => -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (y - z))) x := by
            fun_prop
          have h_val : freeGreenDerivY κ z x = -(1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (x - z)) := by
            dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
            rw [if_pos hlt]
          rw [h_val]
          exact h_cont_at.tendsto.congr' h_ev
        · have h_ev : (fun y => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y))) =ᶠ[nhds x]
              (fun y => freeGreenDerivY κ z y) := by
            filter_upwards [Iio_mem_nhds hgt] with y hy
            have hy' : y < z := hy
            dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
            rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_gt hy'), if_pos hy']
          have h_cont_at : ContinuousAt (fun y : ℝ => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - y))) x := by
            fun_prop
          have h_val : freeGreenDerivY κ z x = (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-κ * (z - x)) := by
            dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
            rw [if_neg (not_lt_of_gt hgt), if_pos hgt]
          rw [h_val]
          exact h_cont_at.tendsto.congr' h_ev
      have h_sub : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|)
          (nhds x) (nhds 0) := by
        have h1 := (h_fg_tend.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := freeGreenDerivY κ z x))).abs
        simpa using h1
      simpa using h_sub.const_mul |w z|
    have h_dct := tendsto_integral_filter_of_dominated_convergence
      (bound := fun z : ℝ => ‖w z‖)
      (F := fun y z => |w z| * |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x|)
      (f := fun _ => (0 : ℝ))
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => (hI_int y).aestronglyMeasurable)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun z => by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
        have h_diff_le : |freeGreenDerivY κ z y - freeGreenDerivY κ z x| ≤ 1 := by
          have h1 := abs_sub (freeGreenDerivY κ z y) (freeGreenDerivY κ z x)
          linarith [h_fg_bd z y, h_fg_bd z x]
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_le (abs_nonneg (w z)))
      w.integrable.norm
      h_ae_tendsto
    simpa [I] using h_dct
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
  refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le
    tendsto_const_nhds
    (by simpa [mul_zero] using hI_tendsto.const_mul B)
    (fun y => by positivity)
    (fun y => ?_)
  rcases eq_or_ne y x with rfl | hyx
  · have hI_nonneg : 0 ≤ I y :=
      integral_nonneg (fun z => by positivity)
    simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, inv_zero, zero_mul]
    positivity
  · have hyx_pos : 0 < |y - x| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hyx)
    have h_step : ‖y - x‖⁻¹ * ‖Φ y - Φ x - (y - x) • (0 : ℝ)‖ ≤ |y - x|⁻¹ * (B * |y - x| * I y) := by
      simp only [smul_zero, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hΦ_sub_le y) (by positivity)
    have h_cancel : |y - x|⁻¹ * (B * |y - x| * I y) = B * I y := by
      have : |y - x| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hyx_pos
      field_simp
    linarith

proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ₁, c₁, c₂, hδ₁, hc₁, hc₁₂, h_quad⟩ := alphaFunctional_one_quadratic_bounds
  obtain ⟨δ₂, hδ₂, h_deriv⟩ := alphaFunctional_hasDerivAt_regFlow
  obtain ⟨δ₃, hδ₃, h_ortho⟩ := regFlowRHS_orthogonality_diagGreen
  have hc₂ : 0 < c₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le hc₁ hc₁₂
  set δ' : ℝ := min δ (min δ₁ (min δ₂ δ₃))
  have hδ' : 0 < δ' := by positivity
  have hδ'_le_δ : δ' ≤ δ := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ'_le_δ₁ : δ' ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
  have hδ'_le_δ₂ : δ' ≤ δ₂ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hδ'_le_δ₃ : δ' ≤ δ₃ :=
    le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  set δ₀ : ℝ := (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ'
  have hδ₀_pos : 0 < δ₀ := by positivity
  have hδ₀_le_half : δ₀ ≤ δ' / 2 := by
    have h_div_le : c₁ / (2 * c₂) ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (by positivity) (by positivity)]
      linarith
    calc δ₀ = (c₁ / (2 * c₂)) * δ' := rfl
      _ ≤ (1 / 2) * δ' := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_div_le (le_of_lt hδ')
      _ = δ' / 2 := by ring
  have hδ₀_le_δ : δ₀ ≤ δ := by linarith
  refine ⟨δ₀, hδ₀_pos, hδ₀_le_δ, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ w hw hw0
  have h_local_cons : ∀ (t : ℝ), (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, ‖ι (w s)‖ ≤ δ') →
      ∀ (M : ℝ), 1 ≤ M → alphaFunctional M (w t) = alphaFunctional M (w 0) := by
    intro t h_ball M hM
    let g : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => alphaFunctional M (w τ)
    have hg_deriv : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, HasDerivAt g 0 s := by
      intro s hs
      obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_eq⟩ := hw s
      have hs_δ₂ : ‖ι (w s)‖ ≤ δ₂ := le_trans (h_ball s hs) hδ'_le_δ₂
      have hs_δ₃ : ‖ι (w s)‖ ≤ δ₃ := le_trans (h_ball s hs) hδ'_le_δ₃
      have hd := h_deriv κ hκ M hM w v s hv_deriv hv_eq hs_δ₂
      rw [h_ortho κ hκ M hM (w s) hs_δ₃] at hd
      exact hd
    have h_mvt : ∀ (a b : ℝ), a < b → Set.Icc a b ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 t → g b = g a := by
      intro a b hab h_sub
      have h_cont_ab : ContinuousOn g (Set.Icc a b) :=
        fun x hx => (hg_deriv x (h_sub hx)).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      have h_deriv_ab : ∀ x ∈ Set.Ioo a b, HasDerivAt g 0 x :=
        fun x hx => hg_deriv x (h_sub (Set.Ioo_subset_Icc_self hx))
      obtain ⟨c, _, hc_slope⟩ :=
        exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope g (fun _ => 0) hab h_cont_ab h_deriv_ab
      have h_ne : b - a ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hab)
      have h_sub_zero : g b - g a = 0 := (div_eq_zero_iff.mp hc_slope.symm).resolve_right h_ne
      exact sub_eq_zero.mp h_sub_zero
    rcases lt_trichotomy 0 t with ht_pos | rfl | ht_neg
    · exact h_mvt 0 t ht_pos Set.Icc_subset_uIcc
    · rfl
    · exact (h_mvt t 0 ht_neg Set.Icc_subset_uIcc').symm
  have hf_step : ∀ (t : ℝ), (∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, ‖ι (w s)‖ ≤ δ') → ‖ι (w t)‖ ≤ δ' / 2 := by
    intro t h_ball
    have hw0_δ₁ : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (h_ball 0 Set.left_mem_uIcc) hδ'_le_δ₁
    have hwt_δ₁ : ‖ι (w t)‖ ≤ δ₁ := le_trans (h_ball t Set.right_mem_uIcc) hδ'_le_δ₁
    have h_cons_1 : alphaFunctional 1 (w t) = alphaFunctional 1 (w 0) :=
      h_local_cons t h_ball 1 le_rfl
    have h_wt_lower : c₁ * ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ alphaFunctional 1 (w t) :=
      (h_quad (w t) hwt_δ₁).1
    have h_w0_upper : alphaFunctional 1 (w 0) ≤ c₂ * ‖ι (w 0)‖ ^ 2 :=
      (h_quad (w 0) hw0_δ₁).2
    have h_w0_sq : ‖ι (w 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ δ₀ ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw0 2
    have h_c2_le : c₂ * ‖ι (w 0)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_w0_sq (le_of_lt hc₂)
    have h_alg : c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 := by
      have h_diff : c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 - c₂ * δ₀ ^ 2 =
          c₁ * (c₂ - c₁) * δ' ^ 2 / (4 * c₂) := by
        dsimp [δ₀]
        have : c₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc₂
        field_simp
        ring
      have h_nonneg : 0 ≤ c₁ * (c₂ - c₁) * δ' ^ 2 / (4 * c₂) := by
        have : 0 ≤ c₂ - c₁ := sub_nonneg.mpr hc₁₂
        positivity
      linarith
    have h_c1_sq : c₁ * ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ c₁ * (δ' / 2) ^ 2 := by linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖ι (w t)‖ ^ 2 ≤ (δ' / 2) ^ 2 :=
      le_of_mul_le_mul_left h_c1_sq hc₁
    exact (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq_le (by positivity)).2
  have h_abs_uIcc : ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a ∈ Set.uIcc 0 b → |a| ≤ |b| ∧ (|a| = |b| → a = b) := by
    intro a b h
    rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at h
    rcases h with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · have hb : 0 ≤ b := le_trans h1 h2
      rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg hb]
      exact ⟨h2, id⟩
    · have hb : b ≤ 0 := le_trans h1 h2
      rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos hb]
      exact ⟨by linarith, fun h_eq => by linarith⟩
  have h_cont_w_hm1 : Continuous (fun t => ι (w t)) := by
    have h_cont_w : Continuous w := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro t
      obtain ⟨v, h_deriv_w, _⟩ := hw t
      have h_littleO := h_deriv_w.isLittleOTVS
      have h_inv_smul := h_littleO.tendsto_inv_smul
      have h_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => t' - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [sub_self] using
          (continuousAt_id.sub (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => t) t)).tendsto
      have h_smul_zero : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ • (w t' - w t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t))))
          (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_sub_tendsto.smul h_inv_smul
      have h_rem_eq : (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ • (w t' - w t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t)))) =
          (fun t' : ℝ => w t' - w t - (t' - t) • v) := by
        ext t' : 1
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
        by_cases h_eq : t' = t
        · subst h_eq
          simp
        · have h_ne : t' - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_ne, one_smul]
      rw [h_rem_eq] at h_smul_zero
      have h_lin : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => w t + (t' - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds (w t)) := by
        simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := w t)).add (h_sub_tendsto.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v)))
      have h_sum := h_smul_zero.add h_lin
      have h_sum_eq : (fun t' : ℝ => (w t' - w t - (t' - t) • v) + (w t + (t' - t) • v)) = w := by
        ext t' : 1
        abel
      simpa [h_sum_eq, zero_add] using h_sum
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
      intro q ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
      intro q ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
    have h_bound_pw : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro q ξ
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by

      have hs_sub : Set.uIcc 0 s ⊆ Set.uIcc 0 s₀ := Set.uIcc_subset_uIcc_left hs

            have h_inv2 : (t - s)⁻¹ * (c * (t - s)) = c := by
              rw [mul_left_comm, inv_mul_cancel₀ h_ne, mul_one]
            have h_inv3 : (t - s)⁻¹ * ((t - s) * c) = c := by
              rw [← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ h_ne, one_mul]
            simp only [h_inv1, h_inv2, h_inv3, one_smul]
            abel
        rw [h_decomp]
        have h_small : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds s, |c * (t - s)| ≤ 1 := by
          have h_cont : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => |c * (t - s)|) := by fun_prop
          have h_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => |c * (t - s)|) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
            simpa using h_cont.tendsto s
          exact h_lim.eventually (ge_mem_nhds zero_lt_one)
        have h_Δ_lim : Filter.Tendsto Δ (nhds s) (nhds 0) :=
          hw.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
        have h_Δ_sem : ∀ (j n : ℕ),
            Filter.Tendsto (fun t => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ j n (Δ t)) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
          intro j n
          have h_cont_sem : Continuous (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ j n) :=
            ((schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (j, n))
          simpa using (h_cont_sem.tendsto 0).comp h_Δ_lim
        have h_Q1 : Filter.Tendsto Q₁ (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
          apply h_tendsto_zero_iff
          intro k n
          let B₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t =>
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (Nat.choose k j : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ j n (Δ t)
          have hB₁_lim : Filter.Tendsto B₁ (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
            have h_sum_zero : (0 : ℝ) = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (Nat.choose k j : ℝ) * 0 := by simp
            rw [h_sum_zero]
            refine tendsto_finset_sum _ (fun j _ => ?_)
            exact (h_Δ_sem j n).const_mul _
          refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hB₁_lim
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => apply_nonneg _ _))
            (h_small.mono (fun t ht => h_sem_trans k n (Δ t) (c * (t - s)) ht))
        have h_Q2 : Filter.Tendsto Q₂ (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
          apply h_tendsto_zero_iff
          intro k n
          let C₂ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (Nat.choose k j : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ j (n + 1) v_tilde
          let B₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |c * (t - s)| * C₂
          have hB₂_lim : Filter.Tendsto B₂ (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
            have h_cont : Continuous B₂ := by dsimp [B₂]; fun_prop
            simpa [B₂] using h_cont.tendsto s
          refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hB₂_lim
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => apply_nonneg _ _))
            (h_small.mono (fun t ht => h_sem_sub k n v_tilde (c * (t - s)) ht))
        have h_Q3 : Filter.Tendsto Q₃ (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
          apply h_tendsto_zero_iff
          intro k n
          let C₃ := ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), (Nat.choose k j : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ j (n + 2) (w_tilde s)
          have hC₃_nn : 0 ≤ C₃ := h_sum_nonneg k (n + 2) (w_tilde s)
          let B₃ : ℝ → ℝ := fun t => |c| ^ 2 * |t - s| * C₃
          have hB₃_lim : Filter.Tendsto B₃ (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
            have h_cont : Continuous B₃ := by dsimp [B₃]; fun_prop
            simpa [B₃] using h_cont.tendsto s
          refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds hB₃_lim
            (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t => apply_nonneg _ _))
            (h_small.mono (fun t ht => ?_))
          dsimp [Q₃]
          rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv]
          have h_tay := h_sem_taylor k n (w_tilde s) (c * (t - s)) ht
          have h_mul := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tay (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg (t - s)))
          have h_alg : |t - s|⁻¹ * (|c * (t - s)| ^ 2 * C₃) = B₃ t := by
            dsimp [B₃]
            rw [abs_mul, mul_pow, sq]
            by_cases hts : |t - s| = 0
            · simp [hts]
            · field_simp [hts]
          linarith
        have h_sum_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun t => Q₁ t + Q₂ t + Q₃ t) (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using (h_Q1.add h_Q2).add h_Q3
        have h_T_lim := ((T (c * s)).continuous.tendsto 0).comp h_sum_lim
        simpa using h_T_lim
      · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun t ht => ?_)
        rw [sub_eq_zero.mp ht]
        simp
    · intro x
      dsimp [v]
      rfl
  · intro u hu
    have h_cont_u : Continuous u := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro t
      obtain ⟨v, h_deriv⟩ := hu t
      have h_littleO := h_deriv.isLittleOTVS
      have h_inv_smul := h_littleO.tendsto_inv_smul
      have h_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => t' - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [sub_self] using (continuousAt_id.sub (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => t) t)).tendsto
      have h_smul_zero : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ • (u t' - u t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t))))
          (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_sub_tendsto.smul h_inv_smul
      have h_rem_eq : (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ • (u t' - u t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t)))) =
          (fun t' : ℝ => u t' - u t - (t' - t) • v) := by
        ext t' : 1
        rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
        by_cases h_eq : t' = t
        · subst h_eq
          simp
        · have h_ne : t' - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq
          rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_ne, one_smul]
      rw [h_rem_eq] at h_smul_zero
      have h_lin : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => u t + (t' - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds (u t)) := by
        simpa using (tendsto_const_nhds (x := u t)).add (h_sub_tendsto.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v)))
      have h_sum := h_smul_zero.add h_lin
      have h_sum_eq : (fun t' : ℝ => (u t' - u t - (t' - t) • v) + (u t + (t' - t) • v)) = u := by
        ext t' : 1
        abel
      simpa [h_sum_eq, zero_add] using h_sum
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
      intro q ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
      intro q ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      filter_upwards with x
      rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
    have h_bound_pw : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro q ξ
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
      calc
        (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
    have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      intro q
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := q.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
        (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact h_bound_pw q ξ
    have hm1Profile_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
        hm1Profile (q₁ - q₂) ξ = hm1Profile q₁ ξ - hm1Profile q₂ ξ := by
      intro q₁ q₂ ξ
      dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₁ x - q₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₁ x : ℂ) -
            Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₂ x : ℂ)) := by
        ext x
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand q₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand q₂ ξ)]
      ring
    have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
      intro q
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
    have h_sub : ∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 (q₁ - q₂) = toHm1 q₁ - toHm1 q₂ := by
      intro q₁ q₂
      rw [h_toHm1 (q₁ - q₂), h_toHm1 q₁, h_toHm1 q₂, ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem q₁) (h_mem q₂)]
      apply MemLp.toLp_congr
      filter_upwards with ξ
      exact hm1Profile_sub q₁ q₂ ξ
    have h_norm_le : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖toHm1 q‖ ≤ ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖ := by
      intro q
      let I_q : ℝ := ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(q : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
      let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * I_q
      have h_norm_sq : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
        apply integral_congr_ae
        filter_upwards [(h_mem q).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
        rw [h_toHm1 q, hξ, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
      have h_int_hm1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
        (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm (h_mem q).1).mp (h_mem q)
      have h_int_le : ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * Real.pi := by
        calc
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2
            ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
              integral_mono h_int_hm1 (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)) (h_bound_pw q)
          _ = C ^ 2 * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul (C ^ 2) _
          _ = C ^ 2 * Real.pi := by rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
      have h_C_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_C_sq : C ^ 2 * Real.pi ≤ I_q ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [C]
        rw [h_C_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
        have h_pi : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_q ^ 2 * Real.pi = (1 / 2) * I_q ^ 2 := by
          have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
          field_simp
        rw [h_pi]
        have : 0 ≤ I_q ^ 2 := sq_nonneg I_q
        linarith
      have h_Iq_eq : I_q = ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖ := by
        change ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(q : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ = ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖
        rw [integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm q.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable,
            ← eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm,
            eLpNorm_congr_ae (q.coeFn_toLp 1 volume).symm,
            ← Lp.norm_def,
            SchwartzMap.toLpCLM_apply]
      have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖(SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)) q‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← h_Iq_eq]
        linarith [h_norm_sq, h_int_le, h_C_sq]
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt
    let L := SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)
    have h_cont_toHm1 : Continuous toHm1 := by
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro q₀
      rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
      intro ε hε
      have hL : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₀, dist (L q) (L q₀) < ε :=
        Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp L.continuous.continuousAt ε hε
      refine hL.mono (fun q hq => ?_)
      have h_dist_le : dist (toHm1 q) (toHm1 q₀) ≤ dist (L q) (L q₀) := by
        rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← h_sub q q₀, ← map_sub L q q₀]
        exact h_norm_le (q - q₀)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_dist_le hq
    have h_cont_iota : Continuous ι := h_cont_toHm1.subtype_mk _
    exact (h_cont_iota.comp h_cont_u).norm

      ∀ (δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ' → δ' ≤ δ_loc →
        ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ → ∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 : ∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w G : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Continuous G →
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (w t) x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) →
      w 0 = w₀ ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (G s) s := by
    intro w₀ w G hG h_int
    have h_iter_sub : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (f - g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = iteratedDeriv n f x - iteratedDeriv n g x := by
      intro f g n x
      exact iteratedDeriv_sub ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) ((g.smooth n).contDiffAt)
    have h_iter_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (c • f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = c * iteratedDeriv n f x := by
      intro c f n x
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using iteratedDeriv_const_smul ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) c
    have h_semi_cont : ∀ (k n : ℕ), Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n f) := by
      intro k n
      change Continuous (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
      rw [← SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
      exact (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, n)
    have h_eval_cont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => iteratedDeriv n f x) := by
      intro n x
      rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
      intro f
      rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
      have h_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (g - f)) (nhds f) (nhds 0) := by
        have h_c : Continuous (fun g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (g - f)) :=
          (h_semi_cont 0 n).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
        simpa [sub_self, map_zero] using (h_c.continuousAt (x := f)).tendsto
      refine squeeze_zero (fun g => dist_nonneg) (fun g => ?_) h_zero
      rw [Real.dist_eq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← h_iter_sub g f n x]
      simpa [pow_zero, one_mul] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 n (g - f) x
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · ext x
      have h0 := h_int 0 0 x
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_same, add_zero] at h0
      exact h0
    · intro s
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      apply HasFDerivAtFilter.of_isLittleOTVS
      have h_ev : ∀ᶠ s' : ℝ in nhds s,
          s' - s = 0 →
          w s' - w s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (G s)) (s' - s) = 0 := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s' hs' => ?_)
        have h_eq : s' = s := sub_eq_zero.mp hs'
        subst h_eq
        simp
      rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul h_ev]
      let R : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s' =>
        (s' - s)⁻¹ • (w s' - w s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (G s)) (s' - s))
      change Filter.Tendsto R (nhds s) (nhds 0)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_K_ring : ∀ (κ q0y q1y q2y q3y Gy DGy : ℝ),
      (-q3y + 2 * (2 * q0y ^ 1 * q1y) - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q1y) * Gy ^ 2 +
        (-q2y + 2 * q0y ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0y - 4 * κ ^ 4) * (2 * Gy ^ 1 * DGy) +
        ((2 * q2y * Gy + 2 * q1y * DGy) * DGy +
          (2 * q1y * Gy) * ((κ ^ 2 + q0y) * Gy)) -
        (2 * q1y * DGy ^ 2 +
          2 * (q0y - 2 * κ ^ 2) * (2 * DGy ^ 1 * ((κ ^ 2 + q0y) * Gy))) =
      Gy * (-q3y + 6 * q0y * q1y) * Gy := by
    intros
    ring
  have h_jump_ode_ring : ∀ (κ q0z q1z q2z gz k1z : ℝ),
      -((((-q2z + 2 * q0z ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0z - 4 * κ ^ 4) * gz ^ 2 +
            2 * q1z * gz * ((k1z + 1) / 2) -
            2 * (q0z - 2 * κ ^ 2) * ((k1z + 1) / 2) ^ 2) - 0) +
        (0 - ((-q2z + 2 * q0z ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0z - 4 * κ ^ 4) * gz ^ 2 +
            2 * q1z * gz * ((k1z - 1) / 2) -
            2 * (q0z - 2 * κ ^ 2) * ((k1z - 1) / 2) ^ 2))) =
      -(2 * q1z * gz + 4 * q0z * k1z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * k1z) + 6 * q0z * k1z := by
    intros
    ring
  have h_comm_ring : ∀ (κ q0x q1x q2x q4x k1x k2x k4x : ℝ),
      16 * κ ^ 5 * (-k4x + 6 * (q1x * k1x + q0x * k2x)) +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * (-q4x + 6 * (q1x * q1x + q0x * q2x)) =
      -(16 * κ ^ 5 * k4x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q4x) +
        6 * (q1x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k1x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q1x) +
          q0x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k2x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q2x)) := by
    intros
    ring
  obtain ⟨δ_reg, hδ_reg, h_reg⟩ := diagGreen_sub_const_mem_schwartz
  obtain ⟨δ_ode, hδ_ode, h_ode⟩ := diagGreen_third_order_ode
  set δ_brack := min (min δ_reg δ_ode) (1 / 4 : ℝ)
  have hδ_brack : 0 < δ_brack := by positivity
  refine ⟨δ_brack, hδ_brack, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ q hq
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hq_reg : ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ_reg := le_trans hq (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_left _ _))
  have hq_ode : ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ_ode := le_trans hq (le_trans (min_le_left _ _) (min_le_right _ _))
  have hq_quarter : ‖ι q‖ ≤ 1 / 4 := le_trans hq (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨g_tilde, hg_eq⟩ := h_reg κ hκ1 q hq_reg
  have h_diag_d := greenIterKernel_diag_hasDerivAt κ hκ1 q
  obtain ⟨h_symm, h_off_d1, h_off_d2, h_off_bd⟩ :=
    greenIterKernel_offDiag_hasDerivAt_and_symm κ hκ1 q
  obtain ⟨h_G_symm, h_diag, h_eq_LR, h_jump_LR, h_d1_LR, h_d2_LR⟩ :=
    greenKernel_halfLine_ode_and_jump κ hκ1 q hq_quarter h_diag_d h_symm h_off_d1 h_off_d2 h_off_bd
  obtain ⟨h_tend_L, h_tend_R, _, _⟩ :=
    greenKernel_halfLine_tendsto_and_integrable κ hκ1 q hq_quarter
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun f => SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f
  have hD_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), D f y = deriv f y :=
    fun f y => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ f y
  have hD2_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), D (D f) y = iteratedDeriv 2 f y := by
    intro f y
    rw [hD_apply]
    have h : (D f : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv 1 f := by
      ext z
      rw [hD_apply, iteratedDeriv_one]
    rw [h, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have hD3_apply : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), D (D (D f)) y = iteratedDeriv 3 f y := by
    intro f y
    rw [hD_apply]
    have h : (D (D f) : ℝ → ℝ) = iteratedDeriv 2 f := funext (hD2_apply f)
    rw [h, ← iteratedDeriv_succ]
  have h_hasDerivAt : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ), HasDerivAt f (D f y) y := by
    intro f y
    rw [hD_apply]
    exact (f.smooth'.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
  let q0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := q
  let q1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D q0
  let q2 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D q1
  let q3 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D q2
  let q4 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D q3
  let k0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := g_tilde
  let k1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k0
  let k2 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k1
  let k3 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k2
  let k4 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := D k3
  have h_sub_κ : (fun y => diagGreen κ q y - 1 / (2 * κ)) = (k0 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    ext y
    dsimp [k0]
    rw [hg_eq y]
    ring
  have h_hasDerivAt_diag : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ q) (k1 y) y := by
    intro y
    have h_eq : diagGreen κ q = fun z => 1 / (2 * κ) + k0 z := funext hg_eq
    rw [h_eq]
    exact (h_hasDerivAt k0 y).const_add (1 / (2 * κ))
  have h_deriv_diag : ∀ y : ℝ, deriv (diagGreen κ q) y = k1 y :=
    fun y => (h_hasDerivAt_diag y).deriv
  have h_dgd_eq : ∀ y : ℝ, diagGreenDeriv κ q y = k1 y :=
    fun y => (h_diag y).2.unique (h_hasDerivAt_diag y)
  have h_iter1_diag : iteratedDeriv 1 (diagGreen κ q) = (k1 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    ext y
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one, h_deriv_diag y]
  have h_iter2_diag : iteratedDeriv 2 (diagGreen κ q) = (k2 : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    ext y
    rw [show (2 : ℕ) = 1 + 1 by rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ, h_iter1_diag, ← hD_apply k1 y]
  have h_iter3_diag : ∀ y : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 (diagGreen κ q) y = k3 y := by
    intro y
    rw [show (3 : ℕ) = 2 + 1 by rfl, iteratedDeriv_succ, h_iter2_diag, ← hD_apply k2 y]
  have hg_ode : ∀ y : ℝ,
      k3 y = 2 * q1 y * diagGreen κ q y + 4 * q0 y * k1 y + 4 * κ ^ 2 * k1 y := by
    intro y
    have hy := h_ode κ hκ1 q hq_ode y
    rw [h_sub_κ, ← hD3_apply k0 y, ← hD_apply q0 y, ← hD_apply k0 y] at hy
    exact hy
  let K : (ℝ → ℝ) → (ℝ → ℝ) → ℝ → ℝ := fun G DG y =>
    (-q2 y + 2 * (q0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0 y - 4 * κ ^ 4) * (G y) ^ 2 +
      2 * q1 y * G y * DG y -
      2 * (q0 y - 2 * κ ^ 2) * (DG y) ^ 2
  have hK_deriv : ∀ (G DG : ℝ → ℝ) (y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt G (DG y) y →
      HasDerivAt DG ((κ ^ 2 + q y) * G y) y →
      HasDerivAt (K G DG) (G y * kdvRHS q y * G y) y := by
    intro G DG y hG hDG
    have hq0 := h_hasDerivAt q0 y
    have hq1 := h_hasDerivAt q1 y
    have hq2 := h_hasDerivAt q2 y
    have h_coeff1 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => -q2 y' + 2 * (q0 y') ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0 y' - 4 * κ ^ 4)
        (-q3 y + 2 * (2 * q0 y ^ 1 * q1 y) - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q1 y) y :=
      (((hq2.neg).add ((hq0.pow 2).const_mul 2)).sub (hq0.const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2))).sub_const (4 * κ ^ 4)
    have h_G2 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => (G y') ^ 2) (2 * G y ^ 1 * DG y) y :=
      hG.pow 2
    have h_term1 : HasDerivAt
        (fun y' => (-q2 y' + 2 * (q0 y') ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0 y' - 4 * κ ^ 4) * (G y') ^ 2)
        ((-q3 y + 2 * (2 * q0 y ^ 1 * q1 y) - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q1 y) * (G y) ^ 2 +
          (-q2 y + 2 * (q0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0 y - 4 * κ ^ 4) * (2 * G y ^ 1 * DG y)) y :=
      h_coeff1.mul h_G2
    have h_term2 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => 2 * q1 y' * G y' * DG y')
        ((2 * q2 y * G y + 2 * q1 y * DG y) * DG y +
          (2 * q1 y * G y) * ((κ ^ 2 + q0 y) * G y)) y :=
      ((hq1.const_mul 2).mul hG).mul hDG
    have h_coeff3 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => 2 * (q0 y' - 2 * κ ^ 2)) (2 * q1 y) y :=
      (hq0.sub_const (2 * κ ^ 2)).const_mul 2
    have h_DG2 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => (DG y') ^ 2)
        (2 * DG y ^ 1 * ((κ ^ 2 + q0 y) * G y)) y :=
      hDG.pow 2
    have h_term3 : HasDerivAt (fun y' => 2 * (q0 y' - 2 * κ ^ 2) * (DG y') ^ 2)
        (2 * q1 y * (DG y) ^ 2 +
          2 * (q0 y - 2 * κ ^ 2) * (2 * DG y ^ 1 * ((κ ^ 2 + q0 y) * G y))) y :=
      h_coeff3.mul h_DG2
    refine ((h_term1.add h_term2).sub h_term3).congr_deriv ?_
    dsimp only [kdvRHS]
    rw [← hD3_apply q0 y, ← hD_apply q0 y]
    exact h_K_ring κ (q0 y) (q1 y) (q2 y) (q3 y) (G y) (DG y)
  have hK_tendsto : ∀ (G DG : ℝ → ℝ) (l : Filter ℝ),
      l ≤ Filter.cocompact ℝ →
      Filter.Tendsto G l (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto DG l (nhds 0) →
      Filter.Tendsto (K G DG) l (nhds 0) := by
    intro G DG l hl hG hDG
    have hz : ∀ g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), Filter.Tendsto g l (nhds 0) := fun g =>
      (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty g).mono_left hl
    have h_coeff1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun y => -q2 y + 2 * (q0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0 y - 4 * κ ^ 4) l (nhds (-4 * κ ^ 4)) := by
      have ht := ((((hz q2).neg).add (((hz q0).pow 2).const_mul 2)).sub
        ((hz q0).const_mul (2 * κ ^ 2))).sub
        (tendsto_const_nhds : Filter.Tendsto (fun _ : ℝ => 4 * κ ^ 4) l (nhds (4 * κ ^ 4)))
      simpa using ht
    have h_G2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (G y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hG.pow 2
    have h_DG2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => (DG y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hDG.pow 2
    have ht1 : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun y => (-q2 y + 2 * (q0 y) ^ 2 - 2 * κ ^ 2 * q0 y - 4 * κ ^ 4) * (G y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_coeff1.mul h_G2
    have ht2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 2 * q1 y * G y * DG y) l (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (((hz q1).const_mul 2).mul hG).mul hDG
    have ht3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 2 * (q0 y - 2 * κ ^ 2) * (DG y) ^ 2) l (nhds 0) := by
      have hc3 : Filter.Tendsto (fun y => 2 * (q0 y - 2 * κ ^ 2)) l (nhds (2 * (0 - 2 * κ ^ 2))) :=
        ((hz q0).sub tendsto_const_nhds).const_mul 2
      simpa using hc3.mul h_DG2
    simpa [K] using (ht1.add ht2).sub ht3
  have h_kdv_eq : kdvRHS q = fun y => -q3 y + 6 * (q0 y * q1 y) := by
    ext y
    dsimp only [kdvRHS, q0, q1, q2, q3]
    rw [hD3_apply q y, hD_apply q y]
    ring
  have h_kdv_int : Integrable (kdvRHS q) volume := by
    rw [h_kdv_eq]
    obtain ⟨C0, hC0⟩ := q0.toBoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range.exists_norm_le
    have hq01 : Integrable (fun y => q0 y * q1 y) volume :=
      q1.integrable.bdd_mul q0.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => hC0 (q0 y) ⟨y, rfl⟩)
    exact q3.integrable.neg.add (hq01.const_mul 6)
  have h_conj1_k : ∀ z : ℝ,
      -∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ q z y * kdvRHS q y * greenKernel κ q y z =
        -k3 z + 6 * (q0 z * k1 z) := by
    intro z
    let f_z : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenKernel κ q z y * kdvRHS q y * greenKernel κ q y z
    let F_L : ℝ → ℝ := K (greenKernelLeft κ q z) (greenDerivLeft κ q z)
    let F_R : ℝ → ℝ := K (greenKernelRight κ q z) (greenDerivRight κ q z)
    have hF_L_deriv : ∀ y ∈ Set.Iic z, HasDerivAt F_L (f_z y) y := by
      intro y hy
      have hd := hK_deriv (greenKernelLeft κ q z) (greenDerivLeft κ q z) y
        (h_d1_LR z y).1 ((h_d2_LR z y).1 hy)
      refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [f_z]
      rw [(h_eq_LR z y).1 hy, h_G_symm y z]
    have hF_R_deriv : ∀ y ∈ Set.Ici z, HasDerivAt F_R (f_z y) y := by
      intro y hy
      have hd := hK_deriv (greenKernelRight κ q z) (greenDerivRight κ q z) y
        (h_d1_LR z y).2 ((h_d2_LR z y).2 hy)
      refine hd.congr_deriv ?_
      dsimp [f_z]
      rw [(h_eq_LR z y).2 hy, h_G_symm y z]
    have hF_L_tend : Filter.Tendsto F_L Filter.atBot (nhds 0) :=
      hK_tendsto (greenKernelLeft κ q z) (greenDerivLeft κ q z) Filter.atBot
        atBot_le_cocompact (h_tend_L z).1 (h_tend_L z).2
    have hF_R_tend : Filter.Tendsto F_R Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      hK_tendsto (greenKernelRight κ q z) (greenDerivRight κ q z) Filter.atTop
        atTop_le_cocompact (h_tend_R z).1 (h_tend_R z).2
    have h_G_cont : Continuous (fun y => greenKernel κ q z y) := by
      have hL_cont : Continuous (greenKernelLeft κ q z) :=
        continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (h_d1_LR z y).1.continuousAt
      have hR_cont : Continuous (greenKernelRight κ q z) :=
        continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr fun y => (h_d1_LR z y).2.continuousAt
      have h_if : (fun y => greenKernel κ q z y) =
          fun y => if y ≤ z then greenKernelLeft κ q z y else greenKernelRight κ q z y := by
        ext y
        split_ifs with hy
        · exact ((h_eq_LR z y).1 hy).symm
        · exact ((h_eq_LR z y).2 (le_of_not_ge hy)).symm
      rw [h_if]
      refine Continuous.if_le hL_cont hR_cont continuous_id continuous_const ?_
      intro y hy
      have hyz : y = z := hy
      rw [hyz, (h_eq_LR z z).1 le_rfl, (h_eq_LR z z).2 le_rfl]
    have h_inv_2κ : 1 / (2 * κ) ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) :=
      one_div_le_one_div_of_le (by norm_num) (by linarith)
    have h_G_bd : ∀ y : ℝ, |greenKernel κ q z y| ≤ 1 := by
      intro y
      have h_geom : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ) :=
        (summable_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)).mul_left (1 / 2)
      have h_term : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ q ℓ z y‖ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := by
        intro ℓ
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        have hp : ‖ι q‖ ^ ℓ ≤ (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hq_quarter ℓ
        calc |greenIterKernel κ q ℓ z y|
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι q‖ ^ ℓ := greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound κ hκ1 q ℓ z y
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι q‖ ^ ℓ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_inv_2κ (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg _) ℓ)
          _ ≤ (1 / 2) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hp (by norm_num)
      have h_sum_norm : Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ q ℓ z y‖) :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_term h_geom
      calc |greenKernel κ q z y|
        _ = ‖∑' ℓ : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ q ℓ z y‖ := (Real.norm_eq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ q ℓ z y‖ := norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_norm
        _ ≤ ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_term h_sum_norm h_geom
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, (1 / 4 : ℝ) ^ ℓ := tsum_mul_left
        _ = (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (1 - 1 / 4)⁻¹ := by
          rw [tsum_geometric_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)]
        _ ≤ 1 := by norm_num
    have h_int_f : Integrable f_z volume := by
      have h_f_eq : f_z = fun y => (greenKernel κ q z y * greenKernel κ q z y) * kdvRHS q y := by
        ext y
        dsimp [f_z]
        rw [h_G_symm y z]
        ring
      rw [h_f_eq]
      have h_G2_bd : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖greenKernel κ q z y * greenKernel κ q z y‖ ≤ 1 := by
        intro y
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_mul]
        calc |greenKernel κ q z y| * |greenKernel κ q z y|
          _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (h_G_bd y) (h_G_bd y) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := mul_one 1
      exact h_kdv_int.bdd_mul (h_G_cont.mul h_G_cont).aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_G2_bd)
    have h_int_L : ∫ y in Set.Iic z, f_z y = F_L z - 0 := by
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_Iic_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      · exact (hF_L_deriv z Set.self_mem_Iic).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · exact fun y hy => hF_L_deriv y (Set.Iio_subset_Iic_self hy)
      · exact h_int_f.integrableOn
      · exact hF_L_tend
    have h_int_R : ∫ y in Set.Ioi z, f_z y = 0 - F_R z := by
      apply MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto
      · exact (hF_R_deriv z Set.self_mem_Ici).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
      · exact fun y hy => hF_R_deriv y (Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self hy)
      · exact h_int_f.integrableOn
      · exact hF_R_tend
    have h_split : (∫ y : ℝ, f_z y) = (∫ y in Set.Iic z, f_z y) + (∫ y in Set.Ioi z, f_z y) := by
      rw [← Set.compl_Iic]
      exact (MeasureTheory.integral_add_compl measurableSet_Iic h_int_f).symm
    change -(∫ y : ℝ, f_z y) = -k3 z + 6 * (q0 z * k1 z)
    rw [h_split, h_int_L, h_int_R]
    dsimp [F_L, F_R, K]
    have h_gz_L : greenKernelLeft κ q z z = diagGreen κ q z := (h_eq_LR z z).1 le_rfl
    have h_gz_R : greenKernelRight κ q z z = diagGreen κ q z := (h_eq_LR z z).2 le_rfl
    have h_dgz_L : greenDerivLeft κ q z z = (k1 z + 1) / 2 := by
      rw [(h_jump_LR z).1, h_dgd_eq z]
    have h_dgz_R : greenDerivRight κ q z z = (k1 z - 1) / 2 := by
      rw [(h_jump_LR z).2, h_dgd_eq z]
    rw [h_gz_L, h_gz_R, h_dgz_L, h_dgz_R,
      h_jump_ode_ring κ (q0 z) (q1 z) (q2 z) (diagGreen κ q z) (k1 z),
      ← hg_ode z, mul_assoc]
  intro x
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [h_conj1_k x, ← h_iter3_diag x, ← h_deriv_diag x, ← mul_assoc]
  · have h_deriv_int :
        deriv (fun z => -∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ q z y * kdvRHS q y * greenKernel κ q y z) x =
          -k4 x + 6 * (q1 x * k1 x + q0 x * k2 x) := by
      rw [funext h_conj1_k]
      exact (((h_hasDerivAt k3 x).neg).add
        (((h_hasDerivAt q0 x).mul (h_hasDerivAt k1 x)).const_mul 6)).deriv
    have h_deriv_kdv :
        deriv (kdvRHS q) x = -q4 x + 6 * (q1 x * q1 x + q0 x * q2 x) := by
      rw [h_kdv_eq]
      exact (((h_hasDerivAt q3 x).neg).add
        (((h_hasDerivAt q0 x).mul (h_hasDerivAt q1 x)).const_mul 6)).deriv
    have h_reg_eq : regFlowRHS κ q = fun z => 16 * κ ^ 5 * k1 z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q1 z := by
      ext z
      dsimp [regFlowRHS, q0, q1, k1]
      rw [h_deriv_diag z, hD_apply q z]
    have h_reg_iter1 :
        iteratedDeriv 1 (regFlowRHS κ q) = fun z => 16 * κ ^ 5 * k2 z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q2 z := by
      ext z
      rw [iteratedDeriv_one, h_reg_eq]
      exact (((h_hasDerivAt k1 z).const_mul (16 * κ ^ 5)).add
        ((h_hasDerivAt q1 z).const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2))).deriv
    have h_reg_iter2 :
        iteratedDeriv 2 (regFlowRHS κ q) = fun z => 16 * κ ^ 5 * k3 z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q3 z := by
      ext z
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, h_reg_iter1]
      exact (((h_hasDerivAt k2 z).const_mul (16 * κ ^ 5)).add
        ((h_hasDerivAt q2 z).const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2))).deriv
    have h_reg_iter3 :
        iteratedDeriv 3 (regFlowRHS κ q) x = 16 * κ ^ 5 * k4 x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q4 x := by
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, h_reg_iter2]
      exact (((h_hasDerivAt k3 x).const_mul (16 * κ ^ 5)).add
        ((h_hasDerivAt q3 x).const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2))).deriv
    have h_deriv_q_reg :
        deriv (fun z => q z * regFlowRHS κ q z) x =
          q1 x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k1 x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q1 x) +
            q0 x * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k2 x + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q2 x) := by
      have h_prod_eq :
          (fun z => q z * regFlowRHS κ q z) =
            fun z => q0 z * (16 * κ ^ 5 * k1 z + 4 * κ ^ 2 * q1 z) := by
        ext z
        rw [congr_fun h_reg_eq z]
      rw [h_prod_eq]
      exact ((h_hasDerivAt q0 x).mul
        (((h_hasDerivAt k1 x).const_mul (16 * κ ^ 5)).add
          ((h_hasDerivAt q1 x).const_mul (4 * κ ^ 2)))).deriv
    rw [h_deriv_int, h_deriv_kdv, h_reg_iter3, h_deriv_q_reg]
    exact h_comm_ring κ (q0 x) (q1 x) (q2 x) (q4 x) (k1 x) (k2 x) (k4 x)
