proof.tactics:
by
  obtain ⟨δ_diag, hδ_diag, h_static⟩ := diagGreen_sub_const_schwartz_seminorm_step
  obtain ⟨δ_hm1, hδ_hm1_pos, hδ_hm1_le_brack, h_hm1⟩ :=
    reg_flow_kdv_taylor_remainder_hm1_sq_bound δ_brack hδ_brack
  set δ_prop : ℝ := min δ_diag δ_hm1
  have hδ_prop_pos : 0 < δ_prop := lt_min hδ_diag hδ_hm1_pos
  have hδ_prop_le_diag : δ_prop ≤ δ_diag := min_le_left _ _
  have hδ_prop_le_hm1 : δ_prop ≤ δ_hm1 := min_le_right _ _
  have hδ_prop_le_brack : δ_prop ≤ δ_brack := le_trans hδ_prop_le_hm1 hδ_hm1_le_brack
  refine ⟨δ_prop, hδ_prop_pos, hδ_prop_le_brack, ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ h_brack V hV_reg hV_kdv0 hV_ball τ s₀
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ
  let q₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := V s₀ τ
  let v₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) :=
    -(D (D (D q₀))) + (6 : ℝ) • SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ q₀ (D q₀)
  have hv₀_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, v₀ x = kdvRHS (V s₀ τ) x := by
    intro x
    change -(D (D (D q₀)) x) + 6 * (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ q₀ (D q₀) x) =
      -iteratedDeriv 3 q₀ x + 6 * q₀ x * deriv q₀ x
    have hD3 : D (D (D q₀)) x = iteratedDeriv 3 q₀ x := by
      have h1 : (D (D (D q₀)) : ℝ → ℝ) = deriv (deriv (deriv q₀)) := rfl
      rw [h1, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have h_mul : SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ q₀ (D q₀) x = q₀ x * deriv q₀ x := by
      have h_smul := SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply q₀.hasTemperateGrowth (D q₀) x
      simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h_smul
    rw [hD3, h_mul]
    ring
  refine ⟨v₀, ?_, hv₀_eq⟩
  obtain ⟨C, η₁, hC_nn, hη₁_pos, h_cube⟩ :=
    h_hm1 κ hκ h_brack V hV_reg hV_kdv0
      (fun s' τ' => le_trans (hV_ball s' τ') hδ_prop_le_hm1) s₀ τ v₀ hv₀_eq
  have h_cont_V0 : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => V s 0) := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t
    obtain ⟨v, h_deriv, _⟩ := hV_kdv0 t
    have h_inv_smul := h_deriv.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
    have h_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => t' - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [sub_self] using
        (continuousAt_id.sub (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => t) t)).tendsto
    have h_smul_zero : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ •
          (V t' 0 - V t 0 - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t))))
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using h_sub_tendsto.smul h_inv_smul
    have h_rem_eq :
        (fun t' : ℝ => (t' - t) • ((t' - t)⁻¹ •
          (V t' 0 - V t 0 - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (t' - t)))) =
        (fun t' : ℝ => V t' 0 - V t 0 - (t' - t) • v) := by
      ext t' : 1
      rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
      by_cases h_eq : t' = t
      · subst h_eq
        simp
      · have h_ne : t' - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq
        rw [smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_ne, one_smul]
    rw [h_rem_eq] at h_smul_zero
    have h_lin : Filter.Tendsto (fun t' : ℝ => V t 0 + (t' - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds (V t 0)) := by
      simpa using
        (tendsto_const_nhds (x := V t 0)).add (h_sub_tendsto.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v)))
    have h_sum := h_smul_zero.add h_lin
    have h_sum_eq :
        (fun t' : ℝ => (V t' 0 - V t 0 - (t' - t) • v) + (V t 0 + (t' - t) • v)) =
        (fun t' : ℝ => V t' 0) := by
      ext t' : 1
      abel
    simpa [h_sum_eq, zero_add] using h_sum
  apply schwartz_hasDerivAt_of_hm1_sq_cube_and_seminorm_bound (fun s => V s τ) v₀ s₀ C η₁
    hC_nn hη₁_pos h_cube
  intro k n
  let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
    ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (V s 0)
  have hF_cont : Continuous F := by
    apply continuous_finset_sum
    intro p _
    apply continuous_finset_sum
    intro d _
    exact ((schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (p, d)).comp h_cont_V0
  have hI_nonempty : (Set.Icc (s₀ - η₁) (s₀ + η₁)).Nonempty := by
    refine ⟨s₀, ?_⟩
    constructor <;> linarith
  obtain ⟨s_max, hs_max_mem, hs_max⟩ :=
    isCompact_Icc.exists_isMaxOn hI_nonempty hF_cont.continuousOn
  set R₀ : ℝ := max 0 (F s_max)
  have hR₀_nn : 0 ≤ R₀ := le_max_left 0 (F s_max)
  obtain ⟨B, hB_nn, hB_bound⟩ :=
    reg_flow_compact_time_schwartz_seminorm_bound δ_diag κ hκ (h_static κ hκ)
      k n |τ| R₀ (abs_nonneg τ) hR₀_nn
  refine ⟨B, hB_nn, ?_⟩
  intro s hs
  apply hB_bound (fun τ' => V s τ') (hV_reg s)
    (fun τ' => le_trans (hV_ball s τ') hδ_prop_le_diag)
  · intro p hp d hd
    have hs_mem : s ∈ Set.Icc (s₀ - η₁) (s₀ + η₁) := by
      rw [abs_le] at hs
      exact ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    have h_le_F : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (V s 0) ≤ F s := by
      dsimp [F]
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hp)
      have hd_mem : d ∈ Finset.range (n + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hd)
      have h1 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (V s 0) ≤
          ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d' (V s 0) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d') (V s 0)) hd_mem
      have h2 : ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d' (V s 0) ≤
          ∑ p' ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p' d' (V s 0) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum
          (fun p' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg (fun d' _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p' d') (V s 0)))
          hp_mem
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    have hF_le : F s ≤ F s_max := isMaxOn_iff.mp hs_max s hs_mem
    exact le_trans h_le_F (le_trans hF_le (le_max_right 0 (F s_max)))
  · exact le_rfl

          dsimp [B₃]
          linarith
        have hg_q2 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q 2 g_tilde ≤ 2 * B_max + B₃ := by
          have h_mvt := h_s4 g_tilde q
          linarith [h_g_q.2]
        rcases m with _ | _ | _ | _ | m'
        · linarith [h_g_q.1]
        · linarith [h_g_q.2]
        · linarith [hg_q2]
        · linarith [hg_q3]
        · omega
      | succ j_idx ih =>
        obtain ⟨B_prev, hB_prev_nn, hB_prev⟩ := ih
        let S_ch : ℝ := ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ)
        have hS_ch_nn : 0 ≤ S_ch := Finset.sum_nonneg fun i _ => Nat.cast_nonneg _
        let B_next : ℝ := B_prev + ((1 / κ) * R + 2 * (S_ch * R * B_prev) +
            4 * (S_ch * R * B_prev) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * B_prev)
        have hB_next_nn : 0 ≤ B_next := by
          dsimp [B_next]
          positivity
        refine ⟨B_next, hB_next_nn, ?_⟩
        intro w g_tilde hw hg hw_d q hq m hm
        have hw_d_prev : ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ j_idx + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d w ≤ R :=
          fun p hp d hd => hw_d p hp d (by omega)
        have h_prev_bound : ∀ q' ≤ k, ∀ m' ≤ j_idx + 3, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q' m' g_tilde ≤ B_prev :=
          hB_prev w g_tilde hw hg hw_d_prev
        rcases le_or_gt m (j_idx + 3) with hm_le | hm_gt
        · have hb := h_prev_bound q hq m hm_le
          have h_add_nn : 0 ≤ (1 / κ) * R + 2 * (S_ch * R * B_prev) +
              4 * (S_ch * R * B_prev) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * B_prev := by positivity
          dsimp [B_next]
          linarith
        · have hm_eq : m = (j_idx + 1) + 3 := by omega
          rw [hm_eq]
          have h_ode_step := (h_bridge w g_tilde hw hg).2 q (j_idx + 1)
          have ht1 : (1 / κ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (j_idx + 2) w ≤ (1 / κ) * R :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hw_d q hq (j_idx + 2) le_rfl) (by positivity)
          have ht4 : 4 * κ ^ 2 * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (j_idx + 2) g_tilde ≤ 4 * κ ^ 2 * B_prev :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_prev_bound q hq (j_idx + 2) (by omega)) (by positivity)
          have ht2 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) *
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (i + 1) w * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (j_idx + 1 - i) g_tilde ≤
              S_ch * R * B_prev := by
            calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) *
                  SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (i + 1) w * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (j_idx + 1 - i) g_tilde
              _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) * R * B_prev := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
                have hi_lt : i < j_idx + 2 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
                have hw_i : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (i + 1) w ≤ R :=
                  hw_d q hq (i + 1) (by omega)
                have hg_i : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (j_idx + 1 - i) g_tilde ≤ B_prev :=
                  h_prev_bound 0 (Nat.zero_le k) (j_idx + 1 - i) (by omega)
                have h_cw : (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (i + 1) w ≤
                    (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) * R :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_i (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul h_cw hg_i (apply_nonneg _ _)
                  (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hR)
              _ = S_ch * R * B_prev := by
                dsimp [S_ch]
                rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
          have ht3 : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) *
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i w * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (j_idx + 1 - i + 1) g_tilde ≤
              S_ch * R * B_prev := by
            calc ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) *
                  SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i w * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (j_idx + 1 - i + 1) g_tilde
              _ ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j_idx + 2), (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) * R * B_prev := by
                refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi => ?_
                have hi_lt : i < j_idx + 2 := Finset.mem_range.mp hi
                have hw_i : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i w ≤ R :=
                  hw_d 0 (Nat.zero_le k) i (by omega)
                have hg_i : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q (j_idx + 1 - i + 1) g_tilde ≤ B_prev :=
                  h_prev_bound q hq (j_idx + 1 - i + 1) (by omega)
                have h_cw : (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 i w ≤
                    (Nat.choose (j_idx + 1) i : ℝ) * R :=
                  mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hw_i (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
                exact mul_le_mul h_cw hg_i (apply_nonneg _ _)
                  (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) hR)
              _ = S_ch * R * B_prev := by
                dsimp [S_ch]
                rw [Finset.sum_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
          dsimp [B_next]
          linarith
    obtain ⟨B, hB_nn, hB⟩ := h_ind j
    refine ⟨0, B, le_rfl, hB_nn, ?_⟩
    intro w hw hw_d _hw_p
    obtain ⟨g_tilde, hg⟩ := h_reg κ hκ₁ w (le_trans hw hδ_le_reg)
    refine ⟨g_tilde, hg, ?_⟩
    rw [zero_mul, zero_add]
    refine hB w g_tilde hw hg ?_ k le_rfl (j + 3) le_rfl
    intro p hp d hd
    exact hw_d p hp d (by omega)

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_const_mem_schwartz
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_reg : ℝ, 0 < δ_reg ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_reg →
        ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_third_order_ode
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_ode : ℝ, 0 < δ_ode ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_ode →
        ∀ x : ℝ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
          2 * deriv w x * diagGreen κ w x +
          4 * w x * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x +
          4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_diag_hasDerivAt
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y)
        (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) x x) x

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_offDiag_pointwise_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ) (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ) :
    |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ ℓ

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_const_deriv_and_iteratedDeriv_three_tsum
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_ode : ℝ, 0 < δ_ode ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_ode →
        ∀ x : ℝ,
          Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x) ∧
          Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y y) x) ∧
          Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x) ∧
          deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
            ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y y) x ∧
          deriv (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
            ∑' ℓ : ℕ, deriv (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x ∧
          iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => diagGreen κ w y - 1 / (2 * κ)) x =
            ∑' ℓ : ℕ, iteratedDeriv 3 (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (δ_diag κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
        ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧
          ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_diag →
            (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d < n, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d w ≤ R) →
            (∀ p < k, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n w ≤ R) →
            ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
              (∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x) ∧
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 1) g_tilde ≤ C₁ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n w + C₂) →
      ∀ (k n : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ R₀ →
        ∃ σ₀ M : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧
          ∀ w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsRegFlowSolution κ w →
            (∀ τ : ℝ, ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ δ_diag) →
            ∀ τ₀ : ℝ,
              (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ₀) ≤ R₀) →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₀ →
                SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w τ - w τ₀) ≤ M * |τ - τ₀|

signature.name: reg_flow_short_time_schwartz_seminorm_lipschitz
signature.statement:
∀ (δ_diag κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
        ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧
          ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_diag →
            (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d < n, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d w ≤ R) →
            (∀ p < k, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n w ≤ R) →
            ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
              (∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x) ∧
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 1) g_tilde ≤ C₁ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n w + C₂) →
      ∀ (k n : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ R₀ →
        ∃ σ₀ M : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧
          ∀ w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), IsRegFlowSolution κ w →
            (∀ τ : ℝ, ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ δ_diag) →
            ∀ τ₀ : ℝ,
              (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ₀) ≤ R₀) →
              ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₀ →
                SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w τ - w τ₀) ≤ M * |τ - τ₀|

proof.tactics:
by
  intro δ_diag κ hκ h_static
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  have h_iter_derivCLM : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f) x = iteratedDeriv (n + 1) f x := by
    intro n f
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, iteratedDeriv_one, SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
    | succ n ih =>
      intro x
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ]
      have h_eq : iteratedDeriv n (⇑(SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f)) = iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (⇑f) := by
        ext y
        exact ih y
      rw [h_eq]
  have h_iter_add : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (⇑(f + g)) x = iteratedDeriv n f x + iteratedDeriv n g x := by
    intro n f g x
    have h_coe : (⇑(f + g) : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑f + ⇑g := rfl
    rw [h_coe]
    exact iteratedDeriv_add ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) ((g.smooth n).contDiffAt)
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (⇑(f - g)) x = iteratedDeriv n f x - iteratedDeriv n g x := by
    intro n f g x
    have h_coe : (⇑(f - g) : ℝ → ℝ) = ⇑f - ⇑g := rfl
    rw [h_coe]
    exact iteratedDeriv_sub ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) ((g.smooth n).contDiffAt)
  have h_iter_smul : ∀ (n : ℕ) (a : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (⇑(a • f)) x = a * iteratedDeriv n f x := by
    intro n a f x
    have h_coe : (⇑(a • f) : ℝ → ℝ) = a • ⇑f := rfl
    rw [h_coe, iteratedDeriv_const_smul ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) a, smul_eq_mul]
  have h_s1 : ∀ (w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), IsRegFlowSolution κ w →
      (∀ (p d : ℕ), Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ))) ∧
      (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ)) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde y) →
        HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ')) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
          (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) g_tilde (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (τ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w τ) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde y) →
        HasDerivAt (fun τ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (w τ') x)
          (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g_tilde x +
            4 * κ ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (w τ) x) τ) := by
    intro w hw_reg
    have h_scalar_chain : ∀ (d : ℕ) (t₀ σ x c : ℝ) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        HasDerivAt w v (t₀ + σ) →
        HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ'))
          (iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ) + c * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w (t₀ + σ)) (x + c * σ)) σ := by
      intro d t₀ σ x c v hv_deriv
      let δ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' => iteratedDeriv d (⇑(w (t₀ + σ') - w (t₀ + σ))) (x + c * σ')
      let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' => iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ)) (x + c * σ')
      have hψ : HasDerivAt ψ (c * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w (t₀ + σ)) (x + c * σ)) σ := by
        have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ))) (x + c * σ) :=
          (((w (t₀ + σ)).smooth (d + 1)).differentiable_iteratedDeriv d (by norm_cast; omega)).differentiableAt
        have hd := h_diff.hasDerivAt
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at hd
        have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => x + c * σ') c σ := by
          simpa using ((hasDerivAt_id σ).const_mul c).const_add x
        have h_comp := hd.comp σ h_lin
        rw [mul_comm] at h_comp
        exact h_comp
      have hδ : HasDerivAt δ (iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ)) σ := by
        rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
        let Δ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s =>
          (s - (t₀ + σ))⁻¹ • (w s - w (t₀ + σ) - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (s - (t₀ + σ)))
        have h_Δ_lim : Filter.Tendsto Δ (nhds (t₀ + σ)) (nhds 0) :=
          hv_deriv.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
        have h_shift_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun σ' : ℝ => t₀ + σ') (nhds σ) (nhds (t₀ + σ)) :=
          (continuous_const.add continuous_id).tendsto σ
        have h_cont_sem : Continuous (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 d) :=
          ((schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (0, d))
        let U₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 d (Δ (t₀ + σ'))
        have hU₁_lim : Filter.Tendsto U₁ (nhds σ) (nhds 0) := by
          simpa [U₁] using (h_cont_sem.tendsto 0).comp (h_Δ_lim.comp h_shift_lim)
        let U₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun σ' => ‖iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ') - iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ)‖
        have hU₂_lim : Filter.Tendsto U₂ (nhds σ) (nhds 0) := by
          have h_cont_vd : Continuous (iteratedDeriv d v) :=
            (v.smooth d).continuous_iteratedDeriv d le_rfl
          have h_cont_U₂ : Continuous U₂ := by
            dsimp [U₂]
            exact ((h_cont_vd.comp (continuous_const.add (continuous_const.mul continuous_id))).sub continuous_const).norm
          simpa [U₂] using h_cont_U₂.tendsto σ
        have h_sum_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun σ' => U₁ σ' + U₂ σ') (nhds σ) (nhds 0) := by
          simpa using hU₁_lim.add hU₂_lim
        refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le tendsto_const_nhds h_sum_lim
          (fun σ' => mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (norm_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _)) (fun σ' => ?_)
        have hδ_sigma : δ σ = 0 := by
          dsimp [δ]
          rw [h_iter_sub d, sub_self]
        by_cases h_eq : σ' = σ
        · subst h_eq
          simp only [sub_self, norm_zero, inv_zero, zero_mul]
          exact add_nonneg (apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 d) _) (norm_nonneg _)
        · have h_ne : σ' - σ ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq
          have h_t_sub : (t₀ + σ') - (t₀ + σ) = σ' - σ := by ring
          have h_Δ_eq : w (t₀ + σ') - w (t₀ + σ) = (σ' - σ) • Δ (t₀ + σ') + (σ' - σ) • v := by
            dsimp [Δ]
            rw [h_t_sub, smul_smul, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_ne, one_smul, sub_add_cancel]
          have h_num_eq : δ σ' - δ σ - (σ' - σ) • iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ) =
              (σ' - σ) * (iteratedDeriv d (Δ (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ') +
                (iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ') - iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ))) := by
            rw [hδ_sigma, sub_zero]
            change iteratedDeriv d (⇑(w (t₀ + σ') - w (t₀ + σ))) (x + c * σ') -
                (σ' - σ) • iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ) = _
            rw [h_Δ_eq,
                h_iter_add d ((σ' - σ) • Δ (t₀ + σ')) ((σ' - σ) • v) (x + c * σ'),
                h_iter_smul d (σ' - σ) (Δ (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ'),
                h_iter_smul d (σ' - σ) v (x + c * σ'),
                smul_eq_mul]
            ring
          rw [h_num_eq, norm_mul, ← mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel₀ (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr h_ne), one_mul]
          have h_tri : ‖iteratedDeriv d (Δ (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ') +
              (iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ') - iteratedDeriv d v (x + c * σ))‖ ≤
              ‖iteratedDeriv d (Δ (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ')‖ + U₂ σ' :=
            norm_add_le _ _
          have h_sem : ‖iteratedDeriv d (Δ (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ')‖ ≤ U₁ σ' := by
            have := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 d (Δ (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ')
            simpa [pow_zero, one_mul, U₁] using this
          linarith
      have h_add := hδ.add hψ
      have h_fn_eq : δ + ψ = fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (t₀ + σ')) (x + c * σ') := by
        ext σ'
        change δ σ' + ψ σ' = _
        dsimp [δ, ψ]
        rw [h_iter_sub d (w (t₀ + σ')) (w (t₀ + σ)) (x + c * σ'), sub_add_cancel]
      rwa [h_fn_eq] at h_add
    have h_v_iter : ∀ (d : ℕ) (t y : ℝ) (v g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        (∀ z : ℝ, v z = regFlowRHS κ (w t) z) →
        (∀ z : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w t) z = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde z) →
        iteratedDeriv d v y =
          16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) g_tilde y +
            4 * κ ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) (w t) y := by
      intro d t y v g_tilde hv_eq hg
      have h_diag_eq : diagGreen κ (w t) = fun z : ℝ => 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde z := funext hg
      have hv_schwartz : v = (16 * κ ^ 5) • SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g_tilde +
          (4 * κ ^ 2) • SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (w t) := by
        ext z
        rw [hv_eq z]
        dsimp [regFlowRHS]
        rw [h_diag_eq, deriv_const_add]
      rw [hv_schwartz, h_iter_add d, h_iter_smul d, h_iter_smul d, h_iter_derivCLM d, h_iter_derivCLM d]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro p d
      have h_cont_w : Continuous w := by
        rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
        intro t

              (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) g_tilde (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ δ_diag) →
          ∀ τ₀ : ℝ,
            (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ₀) ≤ R₀) →
            ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₀ →
              ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ) ≤ B := by
    intro D
    induction D with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro R₀ hR₀
        obtain ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, hσ₂_le1, hR₀_le, h_step⟩ :=
          h_single_step 0 0 1 R₀ one_pos le_rfl hR₀
        refine ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, hσ₂_le1, hR₀_le, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀ hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have hp0 : p = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hp
        have hd0 : d = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hd
        subst hp0 hd0
        refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀ (fun q hq => hw_init q hq 0 le_rfl) ?_ τ hτ
        intro τ' _
        exact ⟨fun _ _ d' hd' => (Nat.not_lt_zero d' hd').elim,
               fun q' hq' => (Nat.not_lt_zero q' hq').elim⟩
      | succ k ihk =>
        intro R₀ hR₀
        obtain ⟨σ₁, R₁, hσ₁_pos, hσ₁_le1, hR₀_le_R₁, h_ihk⟩ := ihk R₀ hR₀
        have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
        obtain ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, hσ₂_le_σ₁, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ :=
          h_single_step (k + 1) 0 σ₁ R₁ hσ₁_pos hσ₁_le1 hR₁_nn
        refine ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, le_trans hσ₂_le_σ₁ hσ₁_le1, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀ hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have hd0 : d = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hd
        subst hd0
        have h_low : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ₁ → ∀ q ≤ k, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q 0 (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' q hq
          exact h_ihk w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
            (fun q' hq' d' hd' => hw_init q' (le_trans hq' (Nat.le_succ k)) d' hd')
            τ' hτ' q hq 0 le_rfl
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hp with hp_le_k | rfl
        · exact le_trans (h_low τ (le_trans hτ hσ₂_le_σ₁) p hp_le_k) hR₁_le_B₂
        · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
            (fun q hq => le_trans (hw_init q hq 0 le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
          intro τ' hτ'
          exact ⟨fun _ _ d' hd' => (Nat.not_lt_zero d' hd').elim,
                 fun q hq => h_low τ' hτ' q (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hq)⟩
    | succ D ihD =>
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro R₀ hR₀
        obtain ⟨σ₁, R₁, hσ₁_pos, hσ₁_le1, hR₀_le_R₁, h_ihD⟩ := ihD 0 R₀ hR₀
        have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
        obtain ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, hσ₂_le_σ₁, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ :=
          h_single_step 0 (D + 1) σ₁ R₁ hσ₁_pos hσ₁_le1 hR₁_nn
        refine ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, le_trans hσ₂_le_σ₁ hσ₁_le1, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀ hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have hp0 : p = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hp
        subst hp0
        have h_low : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ₁ → ∀ d' ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 d' (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' d' hd'
          exact h_ihD w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
            (fun q' hq' d'' hd'' => hw_init q' hq' d'' (le_trans hd'' (Nat.le_succ D)))
            τ' hτ' 0 le_rfl d' hd'
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hd with hd_le_D | rfl
        · exact le_trans (h_low τ (le_trans hτ hσ₂_le_σ₁) d hd_le_D) hR₁_le_B₂
        · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
            (fun q hq => le_trans (hw_init q hq (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
          intro τ' hτ'
          refine ⟨fun q hq d' hd' => ?_, fun q hq => (Nat.not_lt_zero q hq).elim⟩
          have hq0 : q = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hq
          subst hq0
          exact h_low τ' hτ' d' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hd')
      | succ k ihk =>
        intro R₀ hR₀
        obtain ⟨σ_a, R_a, hσ_a_pos, hσ_a_le1, hR₀_le_Ra, h_ihD⟩ := ihD (k + 1) R₀ hR₀
        obtain ⟨σ_b, R_b, hσ_b_pos, _hσ_b_le1, hR₀_le_Rb, h_ihk⟩ := ihk R₀ hR₀
        let σ₁ : ℝ := min σ_a σ_b
        let R₁ : ℝ := max R_a R_b
        have hσ₁_pos : 0 < σ₁ := lt_min hσ_a_pos hσ_b_pos
        have hσ₁_le1 : σ₁ ≤ 1 := le_trans (min_le_left _ _) hσ_a_le1
        have hR₀_le_R₁ : R₀ ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀_le_Ra (le_max_left _ _)
        have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
        obtain ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, hσ₂_le_σ₁, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ :=
          h_single_step (k + 1) (D + 1) σ₁ R₁ hσ₁_pos hσ₁_le1 hR₁_nn
        refine ⟨σ₂, B₂, hσ₂_pos, le_trans hσ₂_le_σ₁ hσ₁_le1, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀ hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have h_low_D : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ₁ →
            ∀ q ≤ k + 1, ∀ d' ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q d' (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' q hq d' hd'
          have hτ'_a : |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ_a := le_trans hτ' (min_le_left _ _)
          exact le_trans
            (h_ihD w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
              (fun q' hq' d'' hd'' => hw_init q' hq' d'' (le_trans hd'' (Nat.le_succ D)))
              τ' hτ'_a q hq d' hd')
            (le_max_left _ _)
        have h_low_k : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ₁ →
            ∀ q ≤ k, ∀ d' ≤ D + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q d' (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' q hq d' hd'
          have hτ'_b : |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ_b := le_trans hτ' (min_le_right _ _)
          exact le_trans
            (h_ihk w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
              (fun q' hq' d'' hd'' => hw_init q' (le_trans hq' (Nat.le_succ k)) d'' hd'')
              τ' hτ'_b q hq d' hd')
            (le_max_right _ _)
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hd with hd_le_D | rfl
        · exact le_trans (h_low_D τ (le_trans hτ hσ₂_le_σ₁) p hp d hd_le_D) hR₁_le_B₂
        · rcases Nat.of_le_succ hp with hp_le_k | rfl
          · exact le_trans (h_low_k τ (le_trans hτ hσ₂_le_σ₁) p hp_le_k (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₁_le_B₂
          · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀
              (fun q hq => le_trans (hw_init q hq (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
            intro τ' hτ'
            exact ⟨fun q hq d' hd' => h_low_D τ' hτ' q hq d' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hd'),
                   fun q hq => h_low_k τ' hτ' q (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hq) (D + 1) le_rfl⟩
  intro k n R₀ hR₀
  obtain ⟨σ₀, B, hσ₀_pos, _hσ₀_le1, hR₀_le_B, h_bound⟩ := h_ind (n + 1) k R₀ hR₀
  have hB_nn : 0 ≤ B := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_B
  obtain ⟨C₁, C₂, hC₁_nn, hC₂_nn, h_g⟩ := h_static k n B hB_nn
  let M : ℝ := 16 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ * B + C₂) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * B
  have hM_nn : 0 ≤ M := by positivity
  refine ⟨σ₀, M, hσ₀_pos, hM_nn, ?_⟩
  intro w hw_reg hw_ball τ₀ hw_init τ hτ
  obtain ⟨hw_cont, hw_mov, hw_fix⟩ := h_s1 w hw_reg
  have h_w_bound : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ₀ →
      ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ') ≤ B :=
    h_bound w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball τ₀ hw_init
  refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound' ℝ k n (w τ - w τ₀) (mul_nonneg hM_nn (abs_nonneg _)) (fun x => ?_)
  rw [h_iter_sub n (w τ) (w τ₀) x]
  let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ' => |x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv n (w τ') x
  have h_uIcc_sub : ∀ τ' ∈ Set.uIcc τ₀ τ, |τ' - τ₀| ≤ |τ - τ₀| := by
    intro τ' hτ'
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hτ' with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr h1), abs_of_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_trans h1 h2))]
      linarith
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr h2), abs_of_nonpos (sub_nonpos.mpr (le_trans h1 h2))]
      linarith
  have h_step_τ' : ∀ τ' ∈ Set.uIcc τ₀ τ,
      ∃ d_val : ℝ, HasDerivAt ψ d_val τ' ∧ ‖d_val‖ ≤ M := by
    intro τ' hτ'
    have hτ'_σ₀ : |τ' - τ₀| ≤ σ₀ := le_trans (h_uIcc_sub τ' hτ') hτ
    have h_low_d : ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d < n, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ') ≤ B :=
      fun p hp d hd => h_w_bound τ' hτ'_σ₀ p hp d (le_trans (le_of_lt hd) (Nat.le_succ n))
    have h_low_p : ∀ p < k, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n (w τ') ≤ B :=
      fun p hp => h_w_bound τ' hτ'_σ₀ p (le_of_lt hp) n (Nat.le_succ n)
    obtain ⟨g_tilde, hg_eq, hg_sem⟩ := h_g (w τ') (hw_ball τ') h_low_d h_low_p
    have h_w_kn : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w τ') ≤ B :=
      h_w_bound τ' hτ'_σ₀ k le_rfl n (Nat.le_succ n)
    have h_w_kn1 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 1) (w τ') ≤ B :=
      h_w_bound τ' hτ'_σ₀ k le_rfl (n + 1) le_rfl
    have hg_bound : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 1) g_tilde ≤ C₁ * B + C₂ := by
      have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_w_kn hC₁_nn
      linarith
    let d_val : ℝ := |x| ^ k * (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g_tilde x +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (w τ') x)
    refine ⟨d_val, (hw_fix n τ' x g_tilde hg_eq).const_mul (|x| ^ k), ?_⟩
    have h_split : d_val = 16 * κ ^ 5 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g_tilde x) +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (w τ') x) := by
      dsimp [d_val]
      ring
    rw [h_split]
    have h_tri : ‖16 * κ ^ 5 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g_tilde x) +
        4 * κ ^ 2 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (w τ') x)‖ ≤
        ‖16 * κ ^ 5 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g_tilde x)‖ +
        ‖4 * κ ^ 2 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (w τ') x)‖ :=
      norm_add_le _ _
    have h_t1 : ‖16 * κ ^ 5 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g_tilde x)‖ ≤
        16 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ * B + C₂) := by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),
          norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) k)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (le_trans (SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ k (n + 1) g_tilde x) hg_bound) (by positivity)
    have h_t2 : ‖4 * κ ^ 2 * (|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (w τ') x)‖ ≤
        4 * κ ^ 2 * B := by
      rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity),
          norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) k)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (le_trans (SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ k (n + 1) (w τ') x) h_w_kn1) (by positivity)
    change _ ≤ 16 * κ ^ 5 * (C₁ * B + C₂) + 4 * κ ^ 2 * B
    linarith
  have h_hasDeriv : ∀ τ' ∈ Set.uIcc τ₀ τ, HasDerivWithinAt ψ (deriv ψ τ') (Set.uIcc τ₀ τ) τ' := by
    intro τ' hτ'
    obtain ⟨d_val, hd, _⟩ := h_step_τ' τ' hτ'
    rw [hd.deriv]
    exact hd.hasDerivWithinAt
  have h_deriv_le : ∀ τ' ∈ Set.uIcc τ₀ τ, ‖deriv ψ τ'‖ ≤ M := by
    intro τ' hτ'
    obtain ⟨d_val, hd, hb⟩ := h_step_τ' τ' hτ'
    rw [hd.deriv]
    exact hb
  have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
    h_hasDeriv h_deriv_le (convex_uIcc τ₀ τ) Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
  have h_lhs : ‖ψ τ - ψ τ₀‖ = |x| ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n (w τ) x - iteratedDeriv n (w τ₀) x‖ := by
    change ‖|x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv n (w τ) x - |x| ^ k * iteratedDeriv n (w τ₀) x‖ = _
    rw [← mul_sub, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (abs_nonneg x) k)]
  have h_rhs : M * ‖τ - τ₀‖ = M * |τ - τ₀| := by
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  linarith

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (U : ℝ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t s₀ : ℝ) (v₁ v₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ τ : ℝ, IsSchwartzSolution (fun s => U s τ)) →
      (HasDerivAt (fun s => U s (t - s₀)) v₁ s₀ ∧ ∀ x : ℝ, v₁ x = kdvRHS (U s₀ (t - s₀)) x) →
      HasDerivAt (fun τ => U s₀ τ) v₂ (t - s₀) →
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ R₀ →
        ∃ σ₀ M : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧
          ∀ s' : ℝ,
            (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' (t - s₀)) ≤ R₀) →
            ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - (t - s₀)| ≤ σ₀ →
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' τ - U s' (t - s₀)) ≤ M * |τ - (t - s₀)|) →
      HasDerivAt (fun s => U s (t - s)) (v₁ - v₂) s₀

  have h_s3 : ∀ (U : ℝ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t s₀ : ℝ),
      ContinuousAt (fun s' => U s' (t - s₀)) s₀ →
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ R₀ →
        ∃ σ₀ M : ℝ, 0 < σ₀ ∧ 0 ≤ M ∧
          ∀ s' : ℝ,
            (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' (t - s₀)) ≤ R₀) →
            ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ - (t - s₀)| ≤ σ₀ →
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' τ - U s' (t - s₀)) ≤ M * |τ - (t - s₀)|) →
      ∀ (k n : ℕ) (η : ℝ), 0 < η →
        ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in nhds s₀, ∀ s' ∈ Set.uIcc s₀ s,
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' (t - s) - U s₀ (t - s₀)) ≤ η := by
    intro U t s₀ h_cont h_lip k n η hη
    set τ₀ : ℝ := t - s₀
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun s' =>
      ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 2),
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀)
    let R₀ : ℝ := 1 + ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 2),
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s₀ τ₀)
    have hR₀_nn : 0 ≤ R₀ := by
      dsimp [R₀]
      have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 2),
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s₀ τ₀) :=
        Finset.sum_nonneg fun p _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d _ => apply_nonneg _ _
      linarith
    obtain ⟨σ₀, M, hσ₀, hM, h_lip_kn⟩ := h_lip k n R₀ hR₀_nn
    have hΦ_lim : Filter.Tendsto Φ (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_sub_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun s' : ℝ => U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [sub_self] using h_cont.tendsto.sub (tendsto_const_nhds (x := U s₀ τ₀))
      have h_zero : (0 : ℝ) = ∑ p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), (0 : ℝ) := by simp
      rw [h_zero]
      refine tendsto_finset_sum _ fun p _ => tendsto_finset_sum _ fun d _ => ?_
      have h_cont_sem : Continuous (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d) :=
        (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (p, d)
      simpa using (h_cont_sem.tendsto 0).comp h_sub_lim
    let r : ℝ := min 1 (η / 2)
    have hr_pos : 0 < r := lt_min zero_lt_one (half_pos hη)
    obtain ⟨δ₁, hδ₁_pos, hδ₁⟩ := Metric.tendsto_nhds_nhds.mp hΦ_lim r hr_pos
    let δ : ℝ := min δ₁ (min σ₀ ((η / 2) / (M + 1)))
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ :=
      lt_min hδ₁_pos (lt_min hσ₀ (div_pos (half_pos hη) (by linarith)))
    have hδ_le_δ₁ : δ ≤ δ₁ := min_le_left _ _
    have hδ_le_σ₀ : δ ≤ σ₀ := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hδ_le_M : δ ≤ (η / 2) / (M + 1) := le_trans (min_le_right _ _) (min_le_right _ _)
    refine Filter.eventually_of_mem (Metric.ball_mem_nhds s₀ hδ_pos) (fun s hs s' hs' => ?_)
    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at hs
    have hs'_lt : |s' - s₀| < δ₁ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt (h_uIcc_sub_abs s₀ s s' hs') (lt_of_lt_of_le hs hδ_le_δ₁)
    have hΦ_lt : Φ s' < r := by
      have h1 := hδ₁ (by rwa [Real.dist_eq] : dist s' s₀ < δ₁)
      rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero] at h1
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (le_abs_self _) h1
    have hΦ_le1 : Φ s' ≤ 1 := le_trans (le_of_lt hΦ_lt) (min_le_left _ _)
    have hΦ_le_half : Φ s' ≤ η / 2 := le_trans (le_of_lt hΦ_lt) (min_le_right _ _)
    have h_single_Φ : ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1,
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) ≤ Φ s' := by
      intro p hp d hd
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have hd_mem : d ∈ Finset.range (n + 2) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have h1 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) ≤
          ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d' (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => apply_nonneg _ _) hd_mem
      have h2 : ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d' (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) ≤ Φ s' :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun p' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d' _ => apply_nonneg _ _) hp_mem
      exact le_trans h1 h2
    have h_single_R₀ : ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1,
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s₀ τ₀) ≤ R₀ - 1 := by
      intro p hp d hd
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Finset.range (k + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have hd_mem : d ∈ Finset.range (n + 2) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (by omega)
      have h1 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s₀ τ₀) ≤
          ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d' (U s₀ τ₀) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun d' _ => apply_nonneg _ _) hd_mem
      have h2 : ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d' (U s₀ τ₀) ≤
          ∑ p' ∈ Finset.range (k + 1), ∑ d' ∈ Finset.range (n + 2), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p' d' (U s₀ τ₀) :=
        Finset.single_le_sum (fun p' _ => Finset.sum_nonneg fun d' _ => apply_nonneg _ _) hp_mem
      dsimp [R₀]
      linarith
    have h_init : ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' τ₀) ≤ R₀ := by
      intro p hp d hd
      have h_add : U s' τ₀ = (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) + U s₀ τ₀ := (sub_add_cancel _ _).symm
      have h_tri : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' τ₀) ≤
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s₀ τ₀) := by
        conv_lhs => rw [h_add]
        exact map_add_le_add (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d) _ _
      have h1 := h_single_Φ p hp d hd
      have h2 := h_single_R₀ p hp d hd
      linarith
    have h_tau_diff : (t - s) - τ₀ = -(s - s₀) := by
      dsimp [τ₀]
      ring
    have h_tau_abs : |(t - s) - τ₀| = |s - s₀| := by
      rw [h_tau_diff, abs_neg]
    have h_tau_σ₀ : |(t - s) - τ₀| ≤ σ₀ := by
      rw [h_tau_abs]
      exact le_trans (le_of_lt hs) hδ_le_σ₀
    have h_lip_step := h_lip_kn s' h_init (t - s) h_tau_σ₀
    have h_lip_half : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' (t - s) - U s' τ₀) ≤ η / 2 := by
      rw [h_tau_abs] at h_lip_step
      have h1 : M * |s - s₀| ≤ (M + 1) * δ := by
        calc M * |s - s₀| ≤ M * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_of_lt hs) hM
          _ ≤ (M + 1) * δ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (by linarith) (le_of_lt hδ_pos)
      have h2 : (M + 1) * δ ≤ η / 2 := by
        calc (M + 1) * δ ≤ (M + 1) * ((η / 2) / (M + 1)) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hδ_le_M (by linarith)
          _ = η / 2 := mul_div_cancel₀ (η / 2) (by linarith)
      linarith
    have h_vert_half : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) ≤ η / 2 :=
      le_trans (h_single_Φ k le_rfl n (Nat.le_succ n)) hΦ_le_half
    have h_decomp : U s' (t - s) - U s₀ τ₀ = (U s' (t - s) - U s' τ₀) + (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) :=
      (sub_add_sub_cancel _ _ _).symm
    have h_tri : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' (t - s) - U s₀ τ₀) ≤
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' (t - s) - U s' τ₀) +
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (U s' τ₀ - U s₀ τ₀) := by
      conv_lhs => rw [h_decomp]
      exact map_add_le_add (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n) _ _
    linarith
  intro U t s₀ v₁ v₂ hU_kdv ⟨hv₁_deriv, hv₁_eq⟩ hv₂_deriv h_lip
  have h_cont_s₀ : ContinuousAt (fun s' => U s' (t - s₀)) s₀ :=
    h_contAt_of_hasDerivAt (fun s' => U s' (t - s₀)) v₁ s₀ hv₁_deriv
  let Q₁ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s =>
    (s - s₀)⁻¹ • (U s (t - s) - U s₀ (t - s) - (s - s₀) • v₁)
  let Q₂ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s =>
    (s - s₀)⁻¹ • (U s₀ (t - s) - U s₀ (t - s₀) + (s - s₀) • v₂)
  have hQ₂_lim : Filter.Tendsto Q₂ (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) :=
    h_rev_quot (fun τ => U s₀ τ) v₂ t s₀ hv₂_deriv
  have hQ₁_lim : Filter.Tendsto Q₁ (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) := by
    rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds]
    rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
    rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply]
    obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, h_mvt⟩ :=
      h_s2 (U s₀ (t - s₀)) v₁ hv₁_eq k n (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
    let S : Finset (ℕ × ℕ) := Finset.Iic k ×ˢ Finset.Iic (n + 3)
    have h_ev_all : ∀ᶠ s : ℝ in nhds s₀, ∀ pd ∈ S, ∀ s' ∈ Set.uIcc s₀ s,
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ pd.1 pd.2 (U s' (t - s) - U s₀ (t - s₀)) ≤ η := by
      rw [Finset.eventually_all]
      intro pd _
      exact h_s3 U t s₀ h_cont_s₀ h_lip pd.1 pd.2 η hη_pos
    refine h_ev_all.mono fun s hs => ?_
    have h_uIcc : ∀ s' ∈ Set.uIcc s₀ s, ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ n + 3,
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (U s' (t - s) - U s₀ (t - s₀)) ≤ η := by
      intro s' hs' p hp d hd
      have h_mem : (p, d) ∈ S := Finset.mem_product.mpr ⟨Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hp, Finset.mem_Iic.mpr hd⟩
      exact hs (p, d) h_mem s' hs'
    have h_bound := h_mvt (fun s' => U s' (t - s)) (hU_kdv (t - s)) s₀ s h_uIcc
    rw [sub_zero]
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_bound (half_lt_self hε)
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt, HasFDerivAt, hasFDerivAtFilter_iff_isLittleOTVS]
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul]
  · have h_sum_lim : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => Q₁ s + Q₂ s) (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using hQ₁_lim.add hQ₂_lim
    have h_eq : (fun s : ℝ => (s - s₀)⁻¹ •
        (U s (t - s) - U s₀ (t - s₀) -
          (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (v₁ - v₂)) (s - s₀))) =
        (fun s : ℝ => Q₁ s + Q₂ s) := by
      ext s : 1
      dsimp [Q₁, Q₂]
      rw [← smul_add]
      congr 1
      rw [smul_sub]
      abel
    rwa [h_eq]
  · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hs]
    simp

    ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ → ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ₁ →

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_alg0 : ∀ (a b : ℂ), b * a = a * b := fun a b => mul_comm b a
  have h_alg1 : ∀ (a b c d : ℂ), (a * b) * c + b * d = a * (b * c) + b * d :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => by ring
  have h_alg2 : ∀ (z I1 I2 : ℂ), -z * I1 + I2 = 0 → I2 = z * I1 :=
    fun z I1 I2 h => by linear_combination h
  have h_alg3 : ∀ (c z I1 : ℂ), c * (z * I1) = z * (c * I1) :=
    fun _ _ _ => by ring
  have h_alg4 : ∀ (g m1x Bx B1x : ℝ),
      (-m1x / g ^ 2) * Bx + g⁻¹ * B1x = (g ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-m1x * Bx) + g⁻¹ * B1x :=
    fun _ _ _ _ => by ring
  have hm2NormSq_deriv_le_hm1NormSq_of_hasDerivAt :
      ∀ (J : ℝ → ℝ),
        (∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt J (deriv J x) x) →
        Integrable J volume →
        Integrable (deriv J) volume →
        Filter.Tendsto J Filter.atBot (nhds 0) →
        Filter.Tendsto J Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        hm2NormSq (deriv J) ≤ hm1NormSq J := by
    intro J hJ_deriv hJ_int hdJ_int hJ_bot hJ_top
    have h_exp_norm : ∀ (ξ x : ℝ), ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)‖ = 1 := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    have h_fl_int : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f volume → ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) volume := by
      intro f hf ξ
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by
        fun_prop
      refine (Integrable.ofReal hf).bdd_mul (c := 1) h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      rw [h_exp_norm ξ x]
    have h_fl_cont : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f volume → Continuous (fourierLine f) := by
      intro f hf

        rw [norm_mul, h_exp_norm ξ x, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      have h_cont_int : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by

            ext y; ring
          rw [h_eq]
          simpa using h1.const_mul (-((ξ : ℂ) * I))
        have h_exp_d : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I))

      have hf1_bot : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (J x : ℂ))
          Filter.atBot (nhds 0) := by

      ((h_fl_cont J hJ_int).norm.pow 2).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) (fun ξ => by positivity)
    have h_hm2_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (deriv J) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) :=
      ((h_fl_cont (deriv J) hdJ_int).norm.pow 2).div ((continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)).pow 2)
        (fun ξ => by positivity)
    have h_dom_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => C_J ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) volume :=
      integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C_J ^ 2)
    have h_hm1_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine J ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      refine h_dom_int.mono' h_hm1_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      calc ‖fourierLine J ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ C_J ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (h_fl_bd ξ) 2) (by positivity)
        _ ≤ C_J ^ 2 / (1 + ξ ^ 2) :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (sq_nonneg C_J) (by positivity) (by linarith)
        _ = C_J ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := div_eq_mul_inv _ _
    have h_hm2_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (deriv J) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) volume := by
      refine h_hm1_int.mono' h_hm2_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact h_pw ξ
    exact integral_mono h_hm2_int h_hm1_int h_pw
  obtain ⟨δ_reg, hδ_reg, h_reg⟩ := diagGreen_sub_const_mem_schwartz
  refine ⟨min δ_reg (1 / 256 : ℝ), lt_min hδ_reg (by norm_num), ?_⟩
  intro κ hκ w hw
  have h1_le : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 1 := le_rfl
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have hw_reg : ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_reg := le_trans hw (min_le_left _ _)
  have hw256 : ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 256 := le_trans hw (min_le_right _ _)
  obtain ⟨m0, hm0_eq⟩ := h_reg 1 h1_le w hw_reg
  obtain ⟨k0, hk0_eq⟩ := h_reg κ hκ1 w hw_reg
  have hm0_eq' : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen 1 w x = 1 / 2 + m0 x := fun x => by linarith [hm0_eq x]
  have hm0_sub : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2 = m0 x := fun x => by linarith [hm0_eq x]
  have hk0_sub : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ) = k0 x := fun x => by linarith [hk0_eq x]
  obtain ⟨h_all_ℓ, h_all_m⟩ :=
    greenIterKernel_one_higher_diff_bounds (1 / 256) (by norm_num) w w hw256 hw256
  obtain ⟨_, h_r2_bd, _, _, _, _, _, _, _⟩ :=
    diagGreen_one_tail_diff_h1_bounds w w hw256 hw256 h_all_ℓ h_all_ℓ h_all_m
  have hm0_abs : ∀ x : ℝ, |m0 x| ≤ 1 / 256 := by
    intro x
    have h_split : m0 x =
        greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x + (diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) := by
      linarith [hm0_sub x]
    have h_tri := abs_add_le (greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x) (diagGreen 1 w x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w 1 x x)
    rw [← h_split] at h_tri
    have h_b1 := (h_all_ℓ 1).2 x
    rw [pow_one] at h_b1
    have h_b2 := h_r2_bd x
    linarith
  have hg1_ge : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 4 ≤ 1 / 2 + m0 x := by
    intro x
    have h := (abs_le.mp (hm0_abs x)).1
    linarith
  have hg1_pos : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 < 1 / 2 + m0 x :=
    fun x => lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) (hg1_ge x)
  have hg1_ne : ∀ x : ℝ, 1 / 2 + m0 x ≠ 0 :=
    fun x => ne_of_gt (hg1_pos x)
  have hg1_inv_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖(1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹‖ ≤ 4 := by
    intro x
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt (hg1_pos x))),
      inv_le_comm₀ (hg1_pos x) (by norm_num)]
    linarith [hg1_ge x]
  have hg1_inv_sq_bd : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖((1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2)⁻¹‖ ≤ 16 := by
    intro x
    have h_sq_ge : (1 / 16 : ℝ) ≤ (1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2 := by
      have h := hg1_ge x
      nlinarith
    have h_sq_pos : 0 < (1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos (hg1_pos x)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (le_of_lt h_sq_pos)),
      inv_le_comm₀ h_sq_pos (by norm_num)]
    linarith [h_sq_ge]
  have h_hasDerivAt : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), HasDerivAt f (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f x) x := by
    intro f x
    rw [SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
    exact (f.smooth'.contDiffAt.differentiableAt (by norm_num)).hasDerivAt
  obtain ⟨B, hB_def⟩ : ∃ B : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      B = w + (4 * κ ^ 5 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)) • k0 - (4 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)) • m0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨m1, hm1_def⟩ : ∃ m1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), m1 = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ m0 := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  obtain ⟨B1, hB1_def⟩ : ∃ B1 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), B1 = SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ B := ⟨_, rfl⟩
  have hB_apply : ∀ x : ℝ,
      B x = w x + (4 * κ ^ 5 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)) * k0 x - (4 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)) * m0 x := by
    intro x; rw [hB_def]; simp
  have hm0_d : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt m0 (m1 x) x := by
    intro x; rw [hm1_def]; exact h_hasDerivAt m0 x
  have hB_d : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt B (B1 x) x := by
    intro x; rw [hB1_def]; exact h_hasDerivAt B x
  have hJ_eq : recipGreenFlux κ w = fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹ * B x := by
    ext x
    dsimp [recipGreenFlux]
    rw [hm0_sub x, hk0_sub x, hm0_eq' x, hB_apply x, one_div]
  have hJ_hasDerivAt_explicit : ∀ x : ℝ,
      HasDerivAt (recipGreenFlux κ w)
        (((1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-m1 x * B x) + (1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹ * B1 x) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hJ_eq]
    have hd_inv : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (1 / 2 + m0 y)⁻¹) (-m1 x / (1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2) x :=
      ((hm0_d x).const_add (1 / 2)).inv (hg1_ne x)
    exact (hd_inv.mul (hB_d x)).congr_deriv (h_alg4 _ _ _ _)
  have hdJ_eq : deriv (recipGreenFlux κ w) =
      fun x : ℝ => ((1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-m1 x * B x) + (1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹ * B1 x := by
    ext x
    exact (hJ_hasDerivAt_explicit x).deriv
  have hJ_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt (recipGreenFlux κ w) (deriv (recipGreenFlux κ w) x) x := by
    intro x
    rw [hdJ_eq]
    exact hJ_hasDerivAt_explicit x
  have hg1_inv_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹) :=
    (continuous_const.add m0.continuous).inv₀ hg1_ne
  have hg1_inv_sq_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => ((1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
    ((continuous_const.add m0.continuous).pow 2).inv₀ (fun x => pow_ne_zero 2 (hg1_ne x))
  have hJ_int : Integrable (recipGreenFlux κ w) volume := by
    rw [hJ_eq]
    exact B.integrable.bdd_mul hg1_inv_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg1_inv_bd)
  have hdJ_int : Integrable (deriv (recipGreenFlux κ w)) volume := by
    rw [hdJ_eq]
    obtain ⟨C_m1, hC_m1⟩ := m1.toBoundedContinuousFunction.isBounded_range.exists_norm_le
    have hm1B_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => -m1 x * B x) volume :=
      B.integrable.bdd_mul m1.continuous.neg.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => by
          rw [norm_neg]
          exact hC_m1 (m1 x) ⟨x, rfl⟩)
    have h_term1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ((1 / 2 + m0 x) ^ 2)⁻¹ * (-m1 x * B x)) volume :=
      hm1B_int.bdd_mul hg1_inv_sq_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg1_inv_sq_bd)
    have h_term2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹ * B1 x) volume :=
      B1.integrable.bdd_mul hg1_inv_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hg1_inv_bd)
    exact h_term1.add h_term2
  have hJ_tendsto : ∀ (l : Filter ℝ), l ≤ Filter.cocompact ℝ →
      Filter.Tendsto (recipGreenFlux κ w) l (nhds 0) := by
    intro l hl
    have hB_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 4 * ‖B x‖) l (nhds 0) := by
      have h0 : Filter.Tendsto B l (nhds 0) :=
        (ZeroAtInftyContinuousMapClass.zero_at_infty B).mono_left hl
      simpa using h0.norm.const_mul 4
    refine squeeze_zero_norm (fun x => ?_) hB_t
    have hx : recipGreenFlux κ w x = (1 / 2 + m0 x)⁻¹ * B x := congr_fun hJ_eq x
    rw [hx, norm_mul]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hg1_inv_bd x) (norm_nonneg _)
  exact hm2NormSq_deriv_le_hm1NormSq_of_hasDerivAt (recipGreenFlux κ w) hJ_deriv hJ_int hdJ_int
    (hJ_tendsto Filter.atBot atBot_le_cocompact)
    (hJ_tendsto Filter.atTop atTop_le_cocompact)

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_const_mem_schwartz
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_reg : ℝ, 0 < δ_reg ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_reg →
        ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_one_higher_diff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
    ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ →
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ ℓ) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (m + 2) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2)) ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ≤ (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_one_tail_diff_h1_bounds

    ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 256 → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 256 →
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ ℓ) →

      ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₂ ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₂‖ ^ ℓ) →
    (∀ m : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (m + 2) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2)) ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ (2 * (1 / 256 : ℝ)) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ≤ (4 * (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2) →
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ∧
    (∀ x : ℝ, |diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖) ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ∧
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ 2 ∧
    Continuous (fun x : ℝ => (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) - (diagGreen 1 w₂ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x)) ∧
    Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) - (diagGreen 1 w₂ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x)) ∧
    Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) - (diagGreen 1 w₂ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x)) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
    h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) - (diagGreen 1 w₂ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x)) ≤ (1 / 32) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2

    have h_fourier_eq : ∀ w : ℝ, FourierTransform.fourier f w =
        (Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℂ) * fourierLine u (2 * π * w) := by
      intro w
      rw [Real.fourier_real_eq_integral_exp_smul]
      dsimp [fourierLine, f]
      have h_sqrt_ne : (Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℂ) ≠ 0 := by
        exact_mod_cast ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr (by positivity))
      rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ h_sqrt_ne, one_mul]
      congr 1; ext y
      congr 2
      push_cast
      ring
    have hF_int : Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier f) := by
      have h_eq : FourierTransform.fourier f =
          fun w : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℂ) * fourierLine u ((2 * π) * w) :=
        funext h_fourier_eq
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (hu_fl_int.comp_mul_left' (by positivity)).const_mul _
    have h_inv := congr_fun (Continuous.fourierInv_fourier_eq hf_cont hf_int hF_int) x
    have h_inv_def : FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (FourierTransform.fourier f) x =
        ∫ w : ℝ, Complex.exp (2 * π * (w : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w := by
      rw [Real.fourierInv_eq']
      congr 1; ext w
      congr 2
      have h_in : inner ℝ w x = x * w := rfl
      rw [h_in]
      push_cast
      ring
    change f x = _
    rw [← h_inv, h_inv_def]
    have h_integrand : (fun w : ℝ => Complex.exp (2 * π * (w : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * I) • FourierTransform.fourier f w) =
        (fun w : ℝ => (Real.sqrt (2 * π) : ℂ) *
          (Complex.exp ((((2 * π * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u (2 * π * w))) := by
      ext w

      have h_exp : 2 * π * (w : ℂ) * (x : ℂ) * I = (((2 * π * w : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [h_exp]
      ring
    rw [h_integrand, integral_const_mul]
    let G : ℝ → ℂ := fun η => Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η
    have h_comp := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left G (a := 2 * π)
    dsimp [G] at h_comp
    rw [h_comp, ← mul_assoc]
    congr 1
    have h_pos : 0 < 2 * π := by positivity
    rw [abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr h_pos)]
    have h_sq : Real.sqrt (2 * π) * (2 * π)⁻¹ = (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ := by
      have h_ne : Real.sqrt (2 * π) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr h_pos)
      have h_sq2 : Real.sqrt (2 * π) * Real.sqrt (2 * π) = 2 * π := Real.mul_self_sqrt (le_of_lt h_pos)
      calc Real.sqrt (2 * π) * (2 * π)⁻¹
        _ = Real.sqrt (2 * π) * (Real.sqrt (2 * π) * Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ := by rw [h_sq2]
        _ = (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ := by field_simp
    exact_mod_cast h_sq
  have h_uv_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) := hu_cont.mul hv_cont
  have h_uv_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => u x * v x) := by
    refine hv_int.bdd_mul (c := (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine u η‖)
      hu_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    have h_norm : ‖u x‖ = ‖(u x : ℂ)‖ := (Complex.norm_real (u x)).symm
    rw [h_norm, h_inv_u x, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    gcongr
    calc ‖∫ η : ℝ, Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η‖
      _ ≤ ∫ η : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η‖ :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ = ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine u η‖ := by
        congr 1; ext η
        have h_eq : ((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((η * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
        rw [norm_mul, h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul]
  have huv_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x)) := h_fl_cont _ h_uv_int
  have h_conv : ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ =
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ η : ℝ, fourierLine u η * fourierLine v (ξ - η) := by
    intro ξ
    set H : ℝ × ℝ → ℂ := fun p =>
      fourierLine u p.2 * (Complex.exp (-(((ξ - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I) * (v p.1 : ℂ))
    have hH_cont : Continuous H := by
      dsimp [H]
      fun_prop
    have hH_int : Integrable H (volume.prod volume) := by
      have h_dom : Integrable (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => ‖v p.1‖ * ‖fourierLine u p.2‖) (volume.prod volume) :=
        hv_int.norm.mul_prod hu_fl_int.norm
      refine h_dom.mono' hH_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun p => ?_)
      dsimp [H]
      have h_eq : -(((ξ - p.2 : ℝ) : ℂ) * (p.1 : ℂ)) * I = ((-((ξ - p.2) * p.1) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, norm_mul, h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, mul_comm]
      simp [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_outer : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((u x * v x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ η : ℝ, H (x, η)) := by
      ext x
      push_cast
      rw [h_inv_u x]
      have h_pull : Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
          ((((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ η : ℝ, Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η) * (v x : ℂ)) =
          ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) *
          ((Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (v x : ℂ)) *
            ∫ η : ℝ, Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η) := by ring
      rw [h_pull, ← integral_const_mul]
      congr 1; congr 1; ext η
      dsimp [H]
      have h_exp : Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) =
          Complex.exp (-(((ξ - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) := by
        rw [← Complex.exp_add]
        congr 1
        push_cast
        ring
      calc (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (v x : ℂ)) *
            (Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * fourierLine u η)
        _ = fourierLine u η * ((Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) *
            Complex.exp (((η : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) * (v x : ℂ)) := by ring
        _ = fourierLine u η * (Complex.exp (-(((ξ - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (v x : ℂ)) := by
            rw [h_exp]
    change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((u x * v x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
      ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ η : ℝ, fourierLine u η * fourierLine v (ξ - η)
    rw [h_outer, integral_const_mul, integral_integral_swap hH_int]
    congr 1
    rw [← integral_const_mul]
    congr 1; ext η
    dsimp [H]
    rw [integral_const_mul]
    change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * (fourierLine u η *
        ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(((ξ - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (v x : ℂ)) =
      fourierLine u η * (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) *
        ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-(((ξ - η : ℝ) : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (v x : ℂ))
    ring
  set h0 : ℝ → ℝ := fun η => (4 + η ^ 2)⁻¹
  set F : ℝ → ℝ := fun η => (4 + η ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine u η‖ ^ 2
  set G : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => ‖fourierLine v ζ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ζ ^ 2)
  have hh0_cont : Continuous h0 :=
    Continuous.inv₀ (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)) (fun η => by positivity)
  have hF_cont : Continuous F := (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)).mul (hu_fl_cont.norm.pow 2)
  have hG_cont : Continuous G :=
    (hv_fl_cont.norm.pow 2).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)) (fun ζ => by positivity)
  have hh0_nn : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ h0 η := fun η => by dsimp [h0]; positivity
  have hF_nn : ∀ η : ℝ, 0 ≤ F η := fun η => by dsimp [F]; positivity
  have hG_nn : ∀ ζ : ℝ, 0 ≤ G ζ := fun ζ => by dsimp [G]; positivity
  set Φ₁ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => h0 p.1 * G (p.2 - p.1)
  have hΦ₁_cont : Continuous Φ₁ :=
    (hh0_cont.comp continuous_fst).mul (hG_cont.comp (continuous_snd.sub continuous_fst))
  have hΦ₁_int : Integrable Φ₁ (volume.prod volume) := by
    rw [integrable_prod_iff hΦ₁_cont.aestronglyMeasurable]
    refine ⟨Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun η => (hv_hm1.comp_sub_right η).const_mul (h0 η), ?_⟩
    have h_norm_eq : (fun η : ℝ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖Φ₁ (η, ξ)‖) =
        (fun η : ℝ => h0 η * ∫ ξ : ℝ, G ξ) := by
      ext η
      have h_inner : (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖Φ₁ (η, ξ)‖) = (fun ξ : ℝ => h0 η * G (ξ - η)) := by
        ext ξ
        dsimp [Φ₁]
        exact Real.norm_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (hh0_nn η) (hG_nn (ξ - η)))
      rw [h_inner, integral_const_mul, integral_sub_right_eq_self G]
    rw [h_norm_eq]
    exact h_inv_int.mul_const _
  set Φ₂ : ℝ × ℝ → ℝ := fun p => h0 p.2 * G (p.1 - p.2)
  have hΦ₂_int : Integrable Φ₂ (volume.prod volume) := hΦ₁_int.swap
  have h_ae_slice : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume, Integrable (fun η : ℝ => h0 η * G (ξ - η)) volume :=
    (integrable_prod_iff hΦ₂_int.aestronglyMeasurable).mp hΦ₂_int |>.1
  have h_I_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ η : ℝ, h0 η * G (ξ - η)) volume :=
    hΦ₂_int.integral_prod_left
  have h_I_integral : (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ, h0 η * G (ξ - η)) = (π / 2) * hm1NormSq v := by
    change (∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ, Φ₂ (ξ, η)) = (π / 2) * hm1NormSq v
    rw [integral_integral_swap hΦ₂_int]
    have h_inner : (fun η : ℝ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, Φ₂ (ξ, η)) = (fun η : ℝ => h0 η * hm1NormSq v) := by
      ext η
      dsimp [Φ₂, hm1NormSq]
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_sub_right_eq_self G]
    rw [h_inner, integral_mul_const, show (∫ η : ℝ, h0 η) = π / 2 from h_inv_val]
  set M : ℝ → ℝ := fun ξ =>
    (h1NormSq u / (2 * π)) * (2 * (∫ η : ℝ, h0 η * G (ξ - η)) + 2 * h0 ξ * hm1NormSq v)
  have hM_inner_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => 2 * (∫ η : ℝ, h0 η * G (ξ - η)) + 2 * h0 ξ * hm1NormSq v) volume :=
    (h_I_int.const_mul 2).add ((h_inv_int.const_mul 2).mul_const (hm1NormSq v))
  have hM_int : Integrable M volume :=
    hM_inner_int.const_mul (h1NormSq u / (2 * π))
  have hM_integral : (∫ ξ : ℝ, M ξ) = h1NormSq u * hm1NormSq v := by
    dsimp [M]
    rw [integral_const_mul,
      integral_add (h_I_int.const_mul 2) ((h_inv_int.const_mul 2).mul_const (hm1NormSq v)),
      integral_const_mul, integral_mul_const, integral_const_mul,
      h_I_integral, show (∫ ξ : ℝ, h0 ξ) = π / 2 from h_inv_val]
    have hpi : (π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
    field_simp
    ring
  have h_slice_bound : ∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable (fun η : ℝ => h0 η * G (ξ - η)) volume →
      ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ M ξ := by
    intro ξ h_slice
    set W : ℝ := 4 + ξ ^ 2
    have hW_pos : 0 < W := by dsimp [W]; positivity
    set X : ℝ → ℝ := fun η => ‖fourierLine u η‖ * ‖fourierLine v (ξ - η)‖
    set K : ℝ → ℝ := fun η => 2 * (h0 η * G (ξ - η)) + (2 * h0 ξ) * G (ξ - η)
    have hK_int : Integrable K volume :=
      (h_slice.const_mul 2).add ((hv_hm1.comp_sub_left ξ).const_mul (2 * h0 ξ))
    have hK_val : (∫ η : ℝ, K η) = 2 * (∫ η : ℝ, h0 η * G (ξ - η)) + 2 * h0 ξ * hm1NormSq v := by
      dsimp [K]
      rw [integral_add (h_slice.const_mul 2) ((hv_hm1.comp_sub_left ξ).const_mul (2 * h0 ξ)),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul,
        integral_sub_left_eq_self G volume ξ]
      rfl
    have h_quad : ∀ (t η : ℝ), 2 * t * X η ≤ t ^ 2 * F η + W * K η := by
      intro t η
      set W₁ : ℝ := 4 + η ^ 2
      set W₂ : ℝ := 4 + (ξ - η) ^ 2
      have hW₁_pos : 0 < W₁ := by dsimp [W₁]; positivity
      have hW₂_pos : 0 < W₂ := by dsimp [W₂]; positivity
      set A : ℝ := ‖fourierLine u η‖
      set B : ℝ := ‖fourierLine v (ξ - η)‖
      have h_sq1 : 0 ≤ (t * W₁ * A - B) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
      have h_amgm : 2 * t * X η ≤ t ^ 2 * F η + B ^ 2 / W₁ := by
        have h_rhs : t ^ 2 * F η + B ^ 2 / W₁ =
            (t ^ 2 * W₁ ^ 2 * A ^ 2 + B ^ 2) / W₁ := by
          dsimp [F, W₁, A]
          have : 4 + η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW₁_pos
          field_simp
        rw [h_rhs, le_div_iff₀ hW₁_pos]
        dsimp [X, A, B]
        nlinarith [h_sq1]
      have h_W_bound : B ^ 2 / W₁ ≤ W * K η := by
        have h_lhs_eq : B ^ 2 / W₁ = W₂ * (B ^ 2 / (W₁ * W₂)) := by
          have : W₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW₁_pos
          have : W₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW₂_pos
          field_simp
        have h_rhs_eq : W * K η = (2 * W + 2 * W₁) * (B ^ 2 / (W₁ * W₂)) := by
          dsimp [K, h0, G, W, W₁, W₂, B]
          have : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW_pos
          have : 4 + η ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW₁_pos
          have : 4 + (ξ - η) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW₂_pos
          field_simp
        rw [h_lhs_eq, h_rhs_eq]
        have h_poly : W₂ ≤ 2 * W + 2 * W₁ := by
          have h_id : 2 * W + 2 * W₁ - W₂ = 12 + (ξ + η) ^ 2 := by
            dsimp [W, W₁, W₂]; ring
          have h_nn : 0 ≤ 12 + (ξ + η) ^ 2 := by positivity
          linarith
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_poly (by positivity)
      linarith
    have hX_cont : Continuous X :=
      hu_fl_cont.norm.mul (hv_fl_cont.norm.comp (continuous_const.sub continuous_id))
    have hX_int : Integrable X volume := by
      have h_dom : Integrable (fun η : ℝ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (F η + W * K η)) volume :=
        (hu_h1.add (hK_int.const_mul W)).const_mul (1 / 2)
      refine h_dom.mono' hX_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun η => ?_)
      have hX_nn : 0 ≤ X η := by dsimp [X]; positivity
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg hX_nn]
      have hq1 := h_quad 1 η
      linarith
    set J : ℝ := ∫ η : ℝ, X η
    set U : ℝ := h1NormSq u
    set I_K : ℝ := ∫ η : ℝ, K η
    have hJ_nn : 0 ≤ J := integral_nonneg (fun η => by dsimp [X]; positivity)
    have hU_nn : 0 ≤ U := integral_nonneg hF_nn
    have h_int_quad : ∀ t : ℝ, 2 * t * J ≤ t ^ 2 * U + W * I_K := by
      intro t
      have h_lhs_int : Integrable (fun η : ℝ => 2 * t * X η) volume :=
        hX_int.const_mul (2 * t)
      have h_rhs_int : Integrable (fun η : ℝ => t ^ 2 * F η + W * K η) volume :=
        (hu_h1.const_mul (t ^ 2)).add (hK_int.const_mul W)
      have h_mono := integral_mono h_lhs_int h_rhs_int (h_quad t)
      rw [integral_const_mul, integral_add (hu_h1.const_mul (t ^ 2)) (hK_int.const_mul W),
        integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul] at h_mono
      exact h_mono
    have h_J_sq : J ^ 2 ≤ U * (W * I_K) := by
      rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hU_nn with hU_zero | hU_pos
      · rcases eq_or_lt_of_le hJ_nn with hJ_zero | hJ_pos
        · rw [← hJ_zero, ← hU_zero]; norm_num
        · exfalso
          have h_spec := h_int_quad ((W * I_K + 1) / (2 * J))
          rw [← hU_zero, mul_zero, zero_add] at h_spec
          have h_alg : 2 * ((W * I_K + 1) / (2 * J)) * J = W * I_K + 1 := by
            have : J ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hJ_pos
            field_simp
          linarith
      · have h_spec := h_int_quad (J / U)
        have h_alg : 2 * (J / U) * J - (J / U) ^ 2 * U = J ^ 2 / U := by
          have : U ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hU_pos
          field_simp; ring
        have h_div : J ^ 2 / U ≤ W * I_K := by linarith
        rw [div_le_iff₀ hU_pos] at h_div
        linarith
    have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * J := by
      rw [h_conv ξ, norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      gcongr
      calc ‖∫ η : ℝ, fourierLine u η * fourierLine v (ξ - η)‖
        _ ≤ ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine u η * fourierLine v (ξ - η)‖ := norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ = J := by
          dsimp [J, X]
          congr 1; ext η; exact norm_mul _ _
    have h_sq_bound : ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * J) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    have h_rhs_sq : ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * J) ^ 2 = J ^ 2 / (2 * π) := by
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), inv_mul_eq_div]
    calc ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
      _ ≤ (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * J) ^ 2) / W :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_sq_bound (le_of_lt hW_pos)
      _ = J ^ 2 / (2 * π * W) := by
        rw [h_rhs_sq, div_div]
      _ ≤ (U * (W * I_K)) / (2 * π * W) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_J_sq (by positivity)
      _ = (U / (2 * π)) * I_K := by
        have : W ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hW_pos
        have : (π : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt Real.pi_pos
        field_simp
      _ = M ξ := by
        dsimp [M, U]
        rw [hK_val]
  have h_lhs_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
    (huv_fl_cont.norm.pow 2).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_id.pow 2)) (fun ξ => by positivity)
  have h_ae_le : ∀ᵐ ξ : ℝ ∂volume,
      ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤ M ξ :=
    h_ae_slice.mono h_slice_bound
  have h_uv_hm1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
    refine hM_int.mono' h_lhs_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (h_ae_le.mono fun ξ hξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact hξ
  refine ⟨h_uv_cont, h_uv_int, h_uv_hm1, ?_⟩
  calc hm1NormSq (fun x => u x * v x)
    _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine (fun x => u x * v x) ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, M ξ := integral_mono_ae h_uv_hm1 hM_int h_ae_le
    _ = h1NormSq u * hm1NormSq v := hM_integral
