          _ = (1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * A (ℓ + 1) ξ ^ 2 := h_lhs_eq
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * (E ℓ * ∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sq_ξ (by positivity)
          _ = E ℓ * ((1 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) * ∫ η : ℝ, B_ξ η ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) := by ring
          _ = E ℓ * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) := by
            rw [h_inner_eq]
      have h_lhs_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (ℓ + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
        (h_sq_int (A (ℓ + 1)) M_ℓ1 (hA_cont (ℓ + 1)) hM_ℓ1 hA_ℓ1).const_mul (1 / (2 * π))
      have h_rhs_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
          E ℓ * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2))) :=
        (h_hs.1.integral_prod_left).const_mul (E ℓ)
      calc E (ℓ + 1)
        _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 / (2 * π)) * (A (ℓ + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
          dsimp [E]
          rw [integral_const_mul]
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, E ℓ * ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) :=
          integral_mono h_lhs_int h_rhs_int h_pw_ξ
        _ = E ℓ * ∫ ξ : ℝ, ∫ η : ℝ, ‖fourierLine w (ξ - η)‖ ^ 2 / (2 * π * (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2) * (κ ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) :=
          integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = E ℓ * r ^ 2 := by rw [h_hs.2, hr_sq]
        _ = r ^ 2 * E ℓ := by ring
    have hE_pow : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, E ℓ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ ℓ) ^ 2 := by
      intro ℓ
      induction ℓ with
      | zero =>
        rw [hE0, pow_zero, one_pow, mul_one]
      | succ ℓ ih =>
        calc E (ℓ + 1)
          _ ≤ r ^ 2 * E ℓ := hE_step ℓ
          _ ≤ r ^ 2 * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ ℓ) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (sq_nonneg r)
          _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ (ℓ + 1)) ^ 2 := by ring
    have hE_shift_pow : ∀ m : ℕ, E (m + 1) ≤ (r ^ m) ^ 2 * E 1 := by
      intro m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        rw [pow_zero, one_pow, one_mul]
      | succ m ih =>
        calc E (m + 2)
          _ ≤ r ^ 2 * E (m + 1) := hE_step (m + 1)
          _ ≤ r ^ 2 * ((r ^ m) ^ 2 * E 1) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (sq_nonneg r)
          _ = (r ^ (m + 1)) ^ 2 * E 1 := by ring
    have h_diag_sq : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x) ^ 2 ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * E ℓ := by
      intro ℓ
      obtain ⟨M_ℓ, hM_ℓ, hA_ℓ⟩ := hA_bound ℓ
      have h_mod := h_diag_mod ℓ x
      have h_eq1 : (fun ξ : ℝ => A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => A ℓ ξ * 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
        ext ξ; ring
      have h_eq_one : (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 : ℝ) ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) =
          (fun ξ : ℝ => 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
        ext ξ; ring
      have h_cs := h_wcs (A ℓ) (fun _ => 1) M_ℓ 1 (hA_cont ℓ) continuous_const hM_ℓ zero_le_one
        hA_ℓ (fun _ => by norm_num)
      rw [← h_eq1, h_eq_one] at h_cs
      calc (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x) ^ 2
        _ = |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
        _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 :=
          pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) h_mod 2
        _ = (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by ring
        _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 *
            ((∫ ξ : ℝ, A ℓ ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (by positivity)
        _ = ((1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, 1 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) * E ℓ := by
          dsimp [E]; ring
        _ = (1 / (2 * κ)) * E ℓ := by rw [h_inv_eq]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro ℓ
      have h_sq : (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x) ^ 2 ≤ ((1 / (2 * κ)) * r ^ ℓ) ^ 2 := by
        calc (greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x) ^ 2
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * E ℓ := h_diag_sq ℓ
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * ((1 / (2 * κ)) * (r ^ ℓ) ^ 2) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hE_pow ℓ) (by positivity)
          _ = ((1 / (2 * κ)) * r ^ ℓ) ^ 2 := by ring
      exact abs_le.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq (by positivity))
    · intro m
      obtain ⟨M_m1, hM_m1, hA_m1⟩ := hA_bound (m + 1)
      obtain ⟨M_1, hM_1, hA_1⟩ := hA_bound 1
      have h_cs := h_wcs (A (m + 1)) (A 1) M_m1 M_1 (hA_cont (m + 1)) (hA_cont 1)
        hM_m1 hM_1 hA_m1 hA_1
      have h_sq : (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x) ^ 2 ≤ (r ^ m * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x) ^ 2 := by
        calc (greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x) ^ 2
          _ = |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x| ^ 2 := (sq_abs _).symm
          _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * π)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, A (m + 1) ξ * A 1 ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 :=
            pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (h_shift_le (m + 1)) 2
          _ = (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 * (∫ ξ : ℝ, A (m + 1) ξ * A 1 ξ / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ ≤ (1 / (2 * π)) ^ 2 *
              ((∫ ξ : ℝ, A (m + 1) ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2)) *
                (∫ ξ : ℝ, A 1 ξ ^ 2 / (κ ^ 2 + ξ ^ 2))) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_cs (by positivity)
          _ = E (m + 1) * E 1 := by
            dsimp [E]; ring
          _ ≤ ((r ^ m) ^ 2 * E 1) * E 1 :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hE_shift_pow m) (hE_nn 1)
          _ = (r ^ m * E 1) ^ 2 := by ring
          _ = (r ^ m * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x) ^ 2 := by rw [hE1]
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ r ^ m * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x := by
        rw [← hE1]
        exact mul_nonneg (pow_nonneg hr_nn m) (hE_nn 1)
      exact abs_le.mpr (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' h_sq h_rhs_nn)
  have h_pt : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * r ^ ℓ :=
    fun ℓ x => (h_pt_and_dom x).1 ℓ
  have h_dom : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x| ≤ r ^ m * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x :=
    fun m x => (h_pt_and_dom x).2 m
  have h_h2_nn : ∀ x : ℝ, 0 ≤ greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x := by
    intro x
    have h0 := h_dom 0 x
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul] at h0
    exact le_trans (abs_nonneg _) h0
  have h_g_cont : Continuous (diagGreen κ w) := by
    dsimp [diagGreen, greenKernel]
    refine continuous_tsum h_cont (h_geom.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ))) ?_
    intro n x
    simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_pt n x
  have h_peel1 : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ) = ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x x := by
    intro x
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x
    have hf0 : f 0 = 1 / (2 * κ) := by
      dsimp [f, greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one]
    have h_sum0 : Summable f :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ))) (fun ℓ => by simpa [f, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_pt ℓ x)
    have h_eq0 : diagGreen κ w x = f 0 + ∑' m, f (m + 1) := h_sum0.tsum_eq_zero_add
    linarith
  have h_peel2 : ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ) - greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x =
      ∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x := by
    intro x
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x x
    have h_sum0 : Summable f :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (h_geom.mul_left (1 / (2 * κ))) (fun ℓ => by simpa [f, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_pt ℓ x)
    have h_sum1 : Summable (fun m => f (m + 1)) := (summable_nat_add_iff 1).mpr h_sum0
    have h_eq1 : (∑' m, f (m + 1)) = f 1 + ∑' m, f (m + 2) := h_sum1.tsum_eq_zero_add
    linarith [h_peel1 x]
  have h_r2_h2 : ∀ x : ℝ, |diagGreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ) - greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x| ≤ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x := by
    intro x
    rw [h_peel2 x]
    have h2_x := h_h2_nn x
    have h_dom_s : Summable (fun m : ℕ => greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x * r ^ m) := h_geom.mul_left (greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x)
    have h_le : ∀ m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x‖ ≤ greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x * r ^ m := by
      intro m
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, mul_comm (greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x) (r ^ m)]
      exact h_dom m x
    have h_sum_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x‖) :=
      Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun _ => norm_nonneg _) h_le h_dom_s
    calc |∑' m : ℕ, greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x|
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖greenIterKernel κ w (m + 2) x x‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_sum_norm
      _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, (greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x * r ^ m) := Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_le h_sum_norm h_dom_s
      _ = greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x * ∑' m : ℕ, r ^ m := tsum_mul_left
      _ ≤ greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x * 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_geom_le h2_x
      _ = 2 * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x := by ring
  set R₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => diagGreen κ w x - 1 / (2 * κ) - greenIterKernel κ w 1 x x
  have hR₂_cont : Continuous R₂ := (h_g_cont.sub continuous_const).sub (h_cont 1)
  have hR₂_int : Integrable R₂ := by
    refine (h_h2.1.const_mul 2).mono' hR₂_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    simpa [R₂, Real.norm_eq_abs] using h_r2_h2 x
  have hR₂_l1 : (∫ x : ℝ, |R₂ x|) ≤ (2 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
    calc ∫ x : ℝ, |R₂ x|
      _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, 2 * greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x :=
        integral_mono hR₂_int.abs (h_h2.1.const_mul 2) h_r2_h2
      _ = 2 * ∫ x : ℝ, greenIterKernel κ w 2 x x := integral_const_mul 2 _
      _ ≤ 2 * ((1 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_h2.2 (by positivity)
      _ = (2 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by ring
  set c_κ : ℝ := 4 * κ ^ 5 / (κ ^ 2 - 1)
  set T₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => c_κ * R₂ x
  have hκ_sq_sub_pos : 0 < κ ^ 2 - 1 := by nlinarith
  have hc_κ_nn : 0 ≤ c_κ := by dsimp [c_κ]; positivity
  have hc_κ_le : c_κ ≤ (16 / 3) * κ ^ 3 := by
    dsimp [c_κ]
    rw [div_le_iff₀ hκ_sq_sub_pos]
    have h_alg : (16 / 3) * κ ^ 3 * (κ ^ 2 - 1) - 4 * κ ^ 5 =
        (4 / 3) * κ ^ 3 * ((κ - 2) * (κ + 2)) := by ring
    have h_nn : 0 ≤ (4 / 3) * κ ^ 3 * ((κ - 2) * (κ + 2)) := by
      have : 0 ≤ κ - 2 := by linarith
      positivity
    linarith
  have hT₂_cont : Continuous T₂ := continuous_const.mul hR₂_cont
  have hT₂_int : Integrable T₂ := hR₂_int.const_mul c_κ
  have hT₂_abs_eq : (fun x : ℝ => |T₂ x|) = (fun x : ℝ => c_κ * |R₂ x|) := by
    ext x
    dsimp [T₂]
    rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg hc_κ_nn]
  have hR₂_l1_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |R₂ x| := integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
  have hT₂_l1_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x| := integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
  have hT₂_l1_le : (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ≤ (32 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
    rw [hT₂_abs_eq, integral_const_mul]
    calc c_κ * (∫ x : ℝ, |R₂ x|)
      _ ≤ ((16 / 3) * κ ^ 3) * ((2 / κ ^ 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) :=
        mul_le_mul hc_κ_le hR₂_l1 hR₂_l1_nn (by positivity)
      _ = (32 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
        field_simp
        ring
  have h_inv4_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
    have h_cont4 : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
      Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => by positivity)
    refine integrable_inv_one_add_sq.mono' h_cont4.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by linarith)
  have h_inv4_val : (∫ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) = π / 2 := by
    have h_eq : (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) =
        (fun ξ : ℝ => (1 / 4 : ℝ) * (1 + ((1 / 2 : ℝ) * ξ) ^ 2)⁻¹) := by
      ext ξ
      have h1 : 4 + ξ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      have h2 : 1 + (1 / 2 * ξ) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
      ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_const_mul]
    have h_comp := Measure.integral_comp_mul_left (fun x : ℝ => (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) (a := (1 / 2 : ℝ))
    dsimp at h_comp
    rw [h_comp, integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
    norm_num
    ring
  have hT₂_fl_slice : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (T₂ x : ℂ)) := by
    intro ξ
    have h_cont_exp : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by
      fun_prop
    refine (Integrable.ofReal hT₂_int).bdd_mul (c := 1) h_cont_exp.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  have hT₂_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine T₂) := by
    have h_bound : ∀ ξ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (T₂ x : ℂ)‖ ≤ |T₂ x| := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_cont_int : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (T₂ x : ℂ)) := by
      refine continuous_of_dominated (fun ξ => (hT₂_fl_slice ξ).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (fun ξ => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (h_bound ξ)) hT₂_int.abs (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      fun_prop
    exact continuous_const.mul h_cont_int
  have hT₂_fl_le : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine T₂ ξ‖ ≤ (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) := by
    intro ξ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    gcongr
    calc ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (T₂ x : ℂ)‖
      _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (T₂ x : ℂ)‖ :=
        norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
      _ = ∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x| := by
        congr 1; ext x
        have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
        rw [norm_mul, h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hT₂_pw : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine T₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ≤
      ((2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro ξ
    have h_sq := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hT₂_fl_le ξ) 2
    have h_rhs : ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|)) ^ 2 =
        (2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_rhs] at h_sq
    rw [div_eq_mul_inv]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sq (by positivity)
  have hT₂_hm1_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine T₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) :=
    (hT₂_fl_cont.norm.pow 2).div (continuous_const.add (continuous_pow 2)) (fun ξ => by positivity)
  have hT₂_hm1_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine T₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
    refine (h_inv4_int.const_mul ((2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2)).mono'
      hT₂_hm1_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
    exact hT₂_pw ξ
  have hT₂_hm1_le : hm1NormSq T₂ ≤ 32 * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
    have h1 : hm1NormSq T₂ ≤ (1 / 4) * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2 := by
      calc hm1NormSq T₂
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2) * (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          integral_mono hT₂_hm1_int (h_inv4_int.const_mul _) hT₂_pw
        _ = ((2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
          integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = ((2 * π)⁻¹ * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2) * (π / 2) := by rw [h_inv4_val]
        _ = (1 / 4) * (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2 := by
          field_simp
          ring
    have h2 : (∫ x : ℝ, |T₂ x|) ^ 2 ≤ ((32 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ hT₂_l1_nn hT₂_l1_le 2
    have h_hm1_le1 : hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) ≤ 1 := by
      have h_w_sq : ‖ι w‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 / 256 : ℝ) ^ 2 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) hw 2
      linarith
    have h_quad : (1 / 4) * ((32 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) ^ 2 ≤ 32 * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by
      have h_diff : 32 * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) - (1 / 4) * ((32 / 3) * hm1KappaSq κ (ι w)) ^ 2 =
          hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) * ((32 / 9) + (256 / 9) * (1 - hm1KappaSq κ (ι w))) := by ring
      have h_sub_nn : 0 ≤ 1 - hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) := by linarith
      have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ hm1KappaSq κ (ι w) * ((32 / 9) + (256 / 9) * (1 - hm1KappaSq κ (ι w))) := by positivity
      linarith
    linarith
  exact ⟨hT₂_cont, hT₂_int, hT₂_hm1_int, hT₂_hm1_le⟩

informal_problem.statement:

    calc (2 * (diagGreen 1 w₂ x) ^ 2)⁻¹
      _ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8) h_sq
      _ = 8 := by norm_num
  have hδΨ_int : Integrable δΨ_v volume := by
    have h_cont_δΨ : Continuous δΨ_v := by
      rw [funext hδΨ_v_eq]
      refine hδgv_cont.div (continuous_const.mul (hg₂_cont.pow 2)) (fun x => ?_)
      have := hg₂_ge x
      nlinarith
    have h_dom_δΨ : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖δΨ_v x‖ ≤ (32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_v) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro x
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, hδΨ_v_eq x, abs_div,
          abs_of_pos (by have := hg₂_ge x; nlinarith : 0 < 2 * (diagGreen 1 w₂ x) ^ 2), div_eq_mul_inv]
      calc |δg v x| * (2 * (diagGreen 1 w₂ x) ^ 2)⁻¹
        _ ≤ (4 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_v * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * 8 :=
          mul_le_mul (hδgv_bound x) (h_inv_2g2_sq x) (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = (32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_v) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    exact (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul _).mono'
      h_cont_δΨ.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_dom_δΨ)
  have h_second_diff_bound : ∀ x : ℝ,
      |diagGreen 1 w₁ x - diagGreen 1 w₂ x - δg (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) x| ≤
        4 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro x
    let K₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenKernel 1 w₁ x y * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x * (w₁ y - w₂ y)
    let K₂ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenKernel 1 w₂ x y * (w₁ y - w₂ y) * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x
    let K_diff : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      (greenKernel 1 w₁ x y - greenKernel 1 w₂ x y) * ((w₁ y - w₂ y) * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x)
    have hK₁_cont : Continuous K₁ := by
      dsimp [K₁]
      have hc1 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel 1 w₁ x y) :=
        hG₁_cont.comp (continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id)
      have hc2 : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel 1 w₂ y x) :=
        hG₂_cont.comp (continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const)
      exact (hc1.mul hc2).mul (w₁.continuous.sub w₂.continuous)
    have hK₁_dom : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖K₁ y‖ ≤ B_Δ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      dsimp [K₁]
      rw [abs_mul, abs_mul]
      have h12 : |greenKernel 1 w₁ x y| * |greenKernel 1 w₂ y x| ≤ 1 := by
        calc |greenKernel 1 w₁ x y| * |greenKernel 1 w₂ y x|
          _ ≤ 1 * 1 := mul_le_mul (hG₁_le x y) (hG₂_le y x) (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
          _ = 1 := one_mul 1
      have hw_y : |w₁ y - w₂ y| ≤ B_Δ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        le_trans (hΔ_decay y) (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_inv_sq_le y) hB_Δ)
      calc |greenKernel 1 w₁ x y| * |greenKernel 1 w₂ y x| * |w₁ y - w₂ y|
        _ ≤ 1 * (B_Δ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) := mul_le_mul h12 hw_y (abs_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = B_Δ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := one_mul _
    have hK₁_int : Integrable K₁ volume :=
      (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul B_Δ).mono'
        hK₁_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hK₁_dom)
    have h_eq : diagGreen 1 w₁ x - diagGreen 1 w₂ x - δg (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) x =
        -∫ y : ℝ, K_diff y := by
      dsimp [diagGreen, δg]
      rw [h_res x x]
      change -(∫ y : ℝ, K₁ y) - -(∫ y : ℝ, K₂ y) = -∫ y : ℝ, K_diff y
      have h_sub : ∫ y : ℝ, K_diff y = (∫ y : ℝ, K₁ y) - (∫ y : ℝ, K₂ y) := by
        have h_fun_eq : K_diff = fun y => K₁ y - K₂ y := by
          ext y
          dsimp [K_diff, K₁, K₂]
          ring
        rw [h_fun_eq, integral_sub hK₁_int (hKΔ_int x)]
      linarith
    let C_x : ℝ := 4 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹
    have hK_diff_dom : ∀ y : ℝ, ‖K_diff y‖ ≤ C_x * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro y
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      dsimp [K_diff, C_x]
      rw [abs_mul]
      have h1 := hG_lip x y
      have h2 := h_peetre_prod (fun z => w₁ z - w₂ z) B_Δ hB_Δ hΔ_decay x y
      calc |greenKernel 1 w₁ x y - greenKernel 1 w₂ x y| * |(w₁ y - w₂ y) * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x|
        _ ≤ (π * B_Δ) * ((4 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
          mul_le_mul h1 h2 (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = 4 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    have hK_diff_int : Integrable K_diff volume := by
      have h_fun_eq : K_diff = fun y => K₁ y - K₂ y := by
        ext y
        dsimp [K_diff, K₁, K₂]
        ring
      rw [h_fun_eq]
      exact hK₁_int.sub (hKΔ_int x)
    have h_major_x : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => C_x * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹) volume :=
      integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul C_x
    rw [h_eq, abs_neg]
    calc |∫ y : ℝ, K_diff y|
      _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, ‖K_diff y‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm K_diff
      _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, C_x * (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_mono hK_diff_int.norm h_major_x hK_diff_dom
      _ = C_x * ∫ y : ℝ, (1 + y ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul _ _
      _ = 4 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
        dsimp [C_x]
        ring
  have h_pt_bound : ∀ x : ℝ,
      |recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x - h * δΨ_v x| ≤
        (32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem + 160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro x
    set g₁ : ℝ := diagGreen 1 w₁ x
    set g₂ : ℝ := diagGreen 1 w₂ x
    set D_Δ : ℝ := δg (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y) x
    set D_v : ℝ := δg v x
    set D_rem : ℝ := δg (fun y => w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y) x
    have hg₁_ge_x : 1 / 4 ≤ g₁ := hg₁_ge x
    have hg₂_ge_x : 1 / 4 ≤ g₂ := hg₂_ge x
    have hg₁_pos : 0 < g₁ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hg₁_ge_x
    have hg₂_pos : 0 < g₂ := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hg₂_ge_x
    have hg₁_ne : g₁ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hg₁_pos
    have hg₂_ne : g₂ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hg₂_pos
    have hD_rem_eq : D_rem = D_Δ - h * D_v := by
      dsimp [D_rem, D_Δ, D_v, δg]
      have h_fun_eq : (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel 1 w₂ x y * (w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y) * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x) =
          (fun y : ℝ => greenKernel 1 w₂ x y * (w₁ y - w₂ y) * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x -
            h * (greenKernel 1 w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel 1 w₂ y x)) := by
        ext y
        ring
      rw [h_fun_eq, integral_sub (hKΔ_int x) ((hKv_int x).const_mul h), integral_const_mul]
      ring
    have h_alg : recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x - h * δΨ_v x =
        D_rem / (2 * g₂ ^ 2) + (g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂) +
        (-(g₁ - g₂) * D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2) := by
      rw [hδΨ_v_eq x]
      change (1 - 1 / (2 * g₁)) - (1 - 1 / (2 * g₂)) - h * (D_v / (2 * g₂ ^ 2)) =
        D_rem / (2 * g₂ ^ 2) + (g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂) +
        (-(g₁ - g₂) * D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)
      rw [hD_rem_eq]
      field_simp
      ring
    have h_inv_2g1g2 : (2 * g₁ * g₂)⁻¹ ≤ 8 := by
      have h_prod : (1 / 8 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * g₁ * g₂ := by nlinarith
      calc (2 * g₁ * g₂)⁻¹
        _ ≤ (1 / 8 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 8) h_prod
        _ = 8 := by norm_num
    have h_inv_2g1g2_sq : (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ 32 := by
      have h_prod : (1 / 32 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2 := by
        have : (1 / 16 : ℝ) ≤ g₂ ^ 2 := by nlinarith
        nlinarith
      calc (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)⁻¹
        _ ≤ (1 / 32 : ℝ)⁻¹ := inv_anti₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 32) h_prod
        _ = 32 := by norm_num
    have ht1 : |D_rem / (2 * g₂ ^ 2)| ≤ 32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * g₂ ^ 2), div_eq_mul_inv]
      calc |D_rem| * (2 * g₂ ^ 2)⁻¹
        _ ≤ (4 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * 8 :=
          mul_le_mul (hδgrem_bound x) (h_inv_2g2_sq x) (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = 32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    have ht2 : |(g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂)| ≤ 32 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * g₁ * g₂), div_eq_mul_inv]
      calc |g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ| * (2 * g₁ * g₂)⁻¹
        _ ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * 8 :=
          mul_le_mul (h_second_diff_bound x) h_inv_2g1g2 (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = 32 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    have ht3 : |(-(g₁ - g₂) * D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)| ≤
        128 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      rw [abs_div, abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < 2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2), div_eq_mul_inv]
      have h_num : |g₁ - g₂| * |D_Δ| ≤ 4 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        calc |g₁ - g₂| * |D_Δ|
          _ ≤ (π * B_Δ) * (4 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) :=
            mul_le_mul (hG_lip x x) (hδgΔ_bound x) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
          _ = 4 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
      calc (|g₁ - g₂| * |D_Δ|) * (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)⁻¹
        _ ≤ (4 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) * 32 :=
          mul_le_mul h_num h_inv_2g1g2_sq (by positivity) (by positivity)
        _ = 128 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
    rw [h_alg]
    calc |D_rem / (2 * g₂ ^ 2) + (g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂) +
          (-(g₁ - g₂) * D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)|
      _ ≤ |D_rem / (2 * g₂ ^ 2) + (g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂)| +
          |(-(g₁ - g₂) * D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)| := abs_add_le _ _
      _ ≤ |D_rem / (2 * g₂ ^ 2)| + |(g₁ - g₂ - D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂)| +
          |(-(g₁ - g₂) * D_Δ) / (2 * g₁ * g₂ ^ 2)| := add_le_add_left (abs_add_le _ _) _
      _ ≤ 32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ +
          32 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ +
          128 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
        add_le_add (add_le_add ht1 ht2) ht3
      _ = (32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem + 160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2) * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by ring
  refine ⟨hΨ₂_int, hδΨ_int, h_pt_bound, ?_⟩
  let R : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => recipGreenDiff w₁ x - recipGreenDiff w₂ x - h * δΨ_v x
  let C_tot : ℝ := 32 * π * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem + 160 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2
  have hΨ₁_cont : Continuous (recipGreenDiff w₁) := by
    dsimp [recipGreenDiff]
    refine continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.div (continuous_const.mul hg₁_cont) fun x => ?_)
    have := hg₁_ge x
    linarith
  have hΨ₂_cont : Continuous (recipGreenDiff w₂) := by
    dsimp [recipGreenDiff]
    refine continuous_const.sub (continuous_const.div (continuous_const.mul hg₂_cont) fun x => ?_)
    have := hg₂_ge x
    linarith
  have hδΨ_cont : Continuous δΨ_v := by
    rw [funext hδΨ_v_eq]
    refine hδgv_cont.div (continuous_const.mul (hg₂_cont.pow 2)) (fun x => ?_)
    have := hg₂_ge x
    nlinarith
  have hR_abs_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => |R x|) :=
    ((hΨ₁_cont.sub hΨ₂_cont).sub (continuous_const.mul hδΨ_cont)).abs
  have h_major_tot : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => C_tot * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹) volume :=
    integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul C_tot
  have hR_abs_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |R x|) volume := by
    refine h_major_tot.mono' hR_abs_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_abs]
    exact h_pt_bound x
  calc ∫ x : ℝ, |R x|
    _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, C_tot * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_mono hR_abs_int h_major_tot h_pt_bound
    _ = C_tot * ∫ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul _ _
    _ = 32 * π ^ 2 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_rem + 160 * π ^ 3 * (1 + π * B₂) * B_Δ ^ 2 := by
      rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
      dsimp [C_tot]
      ring

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 :
      (∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f volume →
        Continuous (fourierLine f) ∧
        (∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |f x|)) ∧
      (∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f₁ volume → Integrable f₂ volume →
        ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (fun x => f₁ x - f₂ x) ξ = fourierLine f₁ ξ - fourierLine f₂ ξ) ∧
      (∀ (c : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f volume →
        ∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine (fun x => c * f x) ξ = (c : ℂ) * fourierLine f ξ) := by
    clear hΨ_int hF_int h_l1_deriv hM_flux h_flux Ψ F t M_flux
    have h_2pi_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ 2 * π := by
      have := Real.two_le_pi
      linarith
    have h_sqrt_2pi_ge_one : (1 : ℝ) ≤ Real.sqrt (2 * π) := by
      rw [← Real.sqrt_one]
      exact Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_2pi_ge_one
    have h_inv_sqrt_le_one : (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ ≤ 1 :=
      inv_le_one_of_one_le₀ h_sqrt_2pi_ge_one
    have h_exp_norm : ∀ ξ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)‖ = 1 := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
    have h_fourier_props : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f volume →
        (∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) volume) ∧
        Continuous (fourierLine f) ∧
        (∀ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |f x|) := by
      intro f hf
      have hK_meas : ∀ ξ : ℝ, AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) volume := by
        intro ξ
        have hc1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by fun_prop
        have hm2 : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x : ℝ => (f x : ℂ)) volume :=
          Complex.continuous_ofReal.comp_aestronglyMeasurable hf.aestronglyMeasurable
        exact hc1.aestronglyMeasurable.mul hm2
      have hK_dom : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume,
          ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ‖f x‖ := by
        intro ξ
        filter_upwards with x
        rw [norm_mul, h_exp_norm ξ x, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
      have hK_int : ∀ ξ : ℝ, Integrable
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) volume :=
        fun ξ => hf.norm.mono' (hK_meas ξ) (hK_dom ξ)
      have hK_cont : ∀ᵐ x : ℝ ∂volume, Continuous
          (fun ξ : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by
        filter_upwards with x
        fun_prop
      have h_int_cont : Continuous
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) :=
        continuous_of_dominated hK_meas hK_dom hf.norm hK_cont
      have h_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine f) :=
        continuous_const.mul h_int_cont
      refine ⟨hK_int, h_fl_cont, ?_⟩
      intro ξ
      unfold fourierLine
      rw [norm_mul, norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_int_norm : ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |f x| := by
        calc ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖
          _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ :=
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, |f x| := by
            refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
            dsimp only
            rw [norm_mul, h_exp_norm ξ x, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
      calc (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ * ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖
        _ ≤ 1 * ∫ x : ℝ, |f x| := mul_le_mul h_inv_sqrt_le_one h_int_norm (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = ∫ x : ℝ, |f x| := one_mul _
    refine ⟨fun f hf => ⟨(h_fourier_props f hf).2.1, (h_fourier_props f hf).2.2⟩, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ ξ
      have h1 := (h_fourier_props f₁ hf₁).1 ξ
      have h2 := (h_fourier_props f₂ hf₂).1 ξ
      unfold fourierLine
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f₁ x - f₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f₁ x : ℂ) -
            Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f₂ x : ℂ)) := by
        ext x
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq, integral_sub h1 h2, mul_sub]
    · intro c f hf ξ
      unfold fourierLine
      have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((c * f x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
          (fun x : ℝ => (c : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ))) := by
        ext x
        push_cast
        ring
      rw [h_eq, integral_const_mul, mul_left_comm]
  have h_s2 :
      (∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ),
        hm2PairIntegrand f f ξ = ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f₁ volume → Integrable f₂ volume →
        Integrable (hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂) volume ∧
        |∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ| ≤ π * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|) ∧
        ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
          |∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ| ≤
            (1 / (2 * ε)) * hm2NormSq f₁ + (ε / 2) * hm2NormSq f₂) := by
    have h_fl := h_s1.1
    clear h_s1 hΨ_int hF_int h_l1_deriv hM_flux h_flux Ψ F t M_flux
    have h_self : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ),
        hm2PairIntegrand f f ξ = ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 := by
      intro f ξ
      unfold hm2PairIntegrand
      congr 1
      have h_conj : starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f ξ) * fourierLine f ξ =
          ((‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 : ℝ) : ℂ) := by
        rw [mul_comm, Complex.mul_conj, Complex.normSq_eq_norm_sq]
      rw [h_conj, Complex.ofReal_re]
    have h_weight_le : ∀ ξ : ℝ, ((4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro ξ
      exact inv_anti₀ (by positivity) (by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ, sq_nonneg (ξ ^ 2)])
    have h_int_and_cauchy : ∀ (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f₁ volume → Integrable f₂ volume →
        Integrable (hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂) volume ∧
        |∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ| ≤ π * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|) := by
      intro f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂
      obtain ⟨hfl₁_cont, hfl₁_bound⟩ := h_fl f₁ hf₁
      obtain ⟨hfl₂_cont, hfl₂_bound⟩ := h_fl f₂ hf₂
      have hB₁_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x| := integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
      have hB₂_nn : 0 ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x| := integral_nonneg (fun x => abs_nonneg _)
      have h_cont : Continuous (hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂) := by
        unfold hm2PairIntegrand
        have hc_num : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re)) :=
          Complex.continuous_re.comp ((Complex.continuous_conj.comp hfl₁_cont).mul hfl₂_cont)
        have hc_den : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) := by fun_prop
        exact hc_num.div hc_den (fun ξ => ne_of_gt (by positivity))
      have h_dom : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
          ‖hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ‖ ≤ ((∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|)) * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        intro ξ
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
        unfold hm2PairIntegrand
        rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2), div_eq_mul_inv]
        have h_re : |(starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re| ≤
            (∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|) := by
          calc |(starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re|
            _ ≤ ‖starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
            _ = ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ * ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ := by rw [norm_mul, RCLike.norm_conj]
            _ ≤ (∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|) :=
              mul_le_mul (hfl₁_bound ξ) (hfl₂_bound ξ) (norm_nonneg _) hB₁_nn
        exact mul_le_mul h_re (h_weight_le ξ) (by positivity) (mul_nonneg hB₁_nn hB₂_nn)
      have h_major : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ((∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|)) * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹) volume :=
        integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul ((∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|))
      have h_int : Integrable (hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂) volume :=
        h_major.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_dom)
      refine ⟨h_int, ?_⟩
      calc |∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ|
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ‖ := by
          simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂)
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|)) * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          integral_mono h_int.norm h_major h_dom
        _ = ((∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|)) * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          integral_const_mul _ _
        _ = π * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₁ x|) * (∫ x : ℝ, |f₂ x|) := by
          rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
          ring
    refine ⟨h_self, fun f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂ => ⟨(h_int_and_cauchy f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂).1,
      (h_int_and_cauchy f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂).2, ?_⟩⟩
    intro ε hε
    have h_int_pair := (h_int_and_cauchy f₁ f₂ hf₁ hf₂).1
    have h_int_1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) volume :=
      (h_int_and_cauchy f₁ f₁ hf₁ hf₁).1.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (h_self f₁))
    have h_int_2 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) volume :=
      (h_int_and_cauchy f₂ f₂ hf₂ hf₂).1.congr (Filter.Eventually.of_forall (h_self f₂))
    have h_young_pt : ∀ (a b : ℝ), a * b ≤ (1 / (2 * ε)) * a ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * b ^ 2 := by
      intro a b
      have h_sq : 0 ≤ (a - ε * b) ^ 2 := sq_nonneg (a - ε * b)
      have h_div : 0 ≤ (a - ε * b) ^ 2 / (2 * ε) := div_nonneg h_sq (by positivity)
      have h_id : (1 / (2 * ε)) * a ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * b ^ 2 - a * b = (a - ε * b) ^ 2 / (2 * ε) := by
        field_simp
        ring
      linarith
    have h_young : ∀ ξ : ℝ,
        ‖hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ‖ ≤
          (1 / (2 * ε)) * (‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) +
          (ε / 2) * (‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) := by
      intro ξ
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
      unfold hm2PairIntegrand
      rw [abs_div, abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2)]
      have h_re_le : |(starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re| ≤
          ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ * ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ := by
        calc |(starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re|
          _ ≤ ‖starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ := Complex.abs_re_le_norm _
          _ = ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ * ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ := by rw [norm_mul, RCLike.norm_conj]
      have h_num : |(starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re| ≤
          (1 / (2 * ε)) * ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 :=
        le_trans h_re_le (h_young_pt _ _)
      calc |(starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re| / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2
        _ ≤ ((1 / (2 * ε)) * ‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 + (ε / 2) * ‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2 :=
          div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
        _ = (1 / (2 * ε)) * (‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) +
            (ε / 2) * (‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) := by ring
    calc |∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ|
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂ ξ‖ := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using norm_integral_le_integral_norm (hm2PairIntegrand f₁ f₂)
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, ((1 / (2 * ε)) * (‖fourierLine f₁ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2) +
            (ε / 2) * (‖fourierLine f₂ ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2)) :=
        integral_mono h_int_pair.norm
          ((h_int_1.const_mul (1 / (2 * ε))).add (h_int_2.const_mul (ε / 2))) h_young
      _ = (1 / (2 * ε)) * hm2NormSq f₁ + (ε / 2) * hm2NormSq f₂ := by
        rw [integral_add (h_int_1.const_mul _) (h_int_2.const_mul _),
            integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
        rfl
  have h_hm2_nn : ∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, 0 ≤ hm2NormSq f :=
    fun f => integral_nonneg (fun ξ => by positivity)
  have h_flux_sq : ∀ s : ℝ, hm2NormSq (F s) ≤ M_flux ^ 2 := by
    intro s
    have h1 := pow_le_pow_left₀ (Real.sqrt_nonneg _) (h_flux s) 2
    rwa [Real.sq_sqrt (h_hm2_nn (F s))] at h1
  have h_s3 : ∀ (Δ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable Δ volume →
      (∀ ξ : ℝ, fourierLine Δ ξ = fourierLine (Ψ t) ξ - fourierLine (Ψ 0) ξ) →
      ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
        hm2NormSq Δ ≤ ((1 / (2 * ε)) * hm2NormSq Δ + (ε / 2) * M_flux ^ 2) * |t| := by
    intro Δ hΔ_int hΔ_fl
    have h_fl_sub := h_s1.2.1
    have h_fl_smul := h_s1.2.2
    have h_pair_self := h_s2.1
    have h_pair_props := h_s2.2
    clear h_s1 h_s2 h_flux hM_flux h_hm2_nn
    have h_re_lin : ∀ (z w₁ w₂ w₃ : ℂ) (c : ℝ),
        (z * (w₁ - w₂ + (c : ℂ) * w₃)).re =
          (z * w₁).re - (z * w₂).re + c * (z * w₃).re := by
      intro z w₁ w₂ w₃ c
      have h_exp : z * (w₁ - w₂ + (c : ℂ) * w₃) =
          z * w₁ - z * w₂ + (c : ℂ) * (z * w₃) := by ring
      have h_mul_c : ∀ u : ℂ, ((c : ℂ) * u).re = c * u.re := by
        intro u
        simp [Complex.mul_re]
      rw [h_exp, Complex.add_re, Complex.sub_re, h_mul_c]
    have h_pair_lin : ∀ (g₁ g₂ h : ℝ → ℝ) (c : ℝ),
        Integrable g₁ volume → Integrable g₂ volume → Integrable h volume →
        ∀ ξ : ℝ,
          hm2PairIntegrand Δ (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x - c * (-h x)) ξ =
            hm2PairIntegrand Δ g₁ ξ - hm2PairIntegrand Δ g₂ ξ + c * hm2PairIntegrand Δ h ξ := by
      intro g₁ g₂ h c hg₁ hg₂ hh ξ
      have h_sub1 := h_fl_sub (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x) (fun x => c * (-h x))
        (hg₁.sub hg₂) (hh.neg.const_mul c) ξ
      have h_sub2 := h_fl_sub g₁ g₂ hg₁ hg₂ ξ
      have h_smul := h_fl_smul c (fun x => -h x) hh.neg ξ
      have h_neg : fourierLine (fun x => -h x) ξ = -fourierLine h ξ := by
        simpa using h_fl_smul (-1) h hh ξ
      have h_fl_eq : fourierLine (fun x => g₁ x - g₂ x - c * (-h x)) ξ =
          fourierLine g₁ ξ - fourierLine g₂ ξ + (c : ℂ) * fourierLine h ξ := by
        rw [h_sub1, h_sub2, h_smul, h_neg]
        ring
      unfold hm2PairIntegrand
      rw [h_fl_eq, h_re_lin]
      ring
    have hE_diff_eq :
        (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ t) ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ 0) ξ) =
          hm2NormSq Δ := by
      rw [← integral_sub (h_pair_props Δ (Ψ t) hΔ_int (hΨ_int t)).1
            (h_pair_props Δ (Ψ 0) hΔ_int (hΨ_int 0)).1]
      unfold hm2NormSq
      refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      dsimp only
      have h_step : hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ t) ξ - hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ 0) ξ =
          hm2PairIntegrand Δ Δ ξ := by
        unfold hm2PairIntegrand
        rw [← sub_div, ← Complex.sub_re, ← mul_sub, ← hΔ_fl ξ]
      rw [h_step, h_pair_self Δ ξ]
    have hE_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (fun τ => ∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ)
          (-∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) s := by
      intro s
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
      have h_rem_eq : ∀ τ : ℝ,
          (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ) -
            (τ - s) • (-∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) =
          ∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (fun x => Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)) ξ := by
        intro τ
        rw [smul_eq_mul]
        have h1 := (h_pair_props Δ (Ψ τ) hΔ_int (hΨ_int τ)).1
        have h2 := (h_pair_props Δ (Ψ s) hΔ_int (hΨ_int s)).1
        have h3 := (h_pair_props Δ (F s) hΔ_int (hF_int s)).1
        have h_lin : (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ) -
            (τ - s) * (-∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) =
            ∫ ξ : ℝ, (hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ - hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ +
              (τ - s) * hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) := by
          calc (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ) -
                (τ - s) * (-∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ)
            _ = ((∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ) - (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ)) +
                (τ - s) * (∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) := by ring
            _ = (∫ ξ : ℝ, (hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ - hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ)) +
                (∫ ξ : ℝ, (τ - s) * hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) := by
              rw [← integral_sub h1 h2, ← integral_const_mul]
            _ = ∫ ξ : ℝ, (hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ τ) ξ - hm2PairIntegrand Δ (Ψ s) ξ +
                (τ - s) * hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ) :=
              (integral_add (h1.sub h2) (h3.const_mul (τ - s))).symm
        rw [h_lin]
        refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
        exact (h_pair_lin (Ψ τ) (Ψ s) (F s) (τ - s) (hΨ_int τ) (hΨ_int s) (hF_int s) ξ).symm
      have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
          (fun τ : ℝ => (π * ∫ x : ℝ, |Δ x|) * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)|))
          (nhds s) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (h_l1_deriv s).const_mul (π * ∫ x : ℝ, |Δ x|)
      refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_upper_tendsto
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => by positivity)
        (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun τ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, h_rem_eq τ]
      have hρ_int : Integrable (fun x => Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)) volume :=
        ((hΨ_int τ).sub (hΨ_int s)).sub ((hF_int s).neg.const_mul (τ - s))
      have h_bound := (h_pair_props Δ _ hΔ_int hρ_int).2.1
      calc ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * |∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (fun x => Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)) ξ|
        _ ≤ ‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * (π * (∫ x : ℝ, |Δ x|) * ∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)|) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_bound (by positivity)
        _ = (π * ∫ x : ℝ, |Δ x|) * (‖τ - s‖⁻¹ * ∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ τ x - Ψ s x - (τ - s) * (-F s x)|) := by ring
    intro ε hε
    have hE'_bound : ∀ s ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
        ‖-∫ ξ : ℝ, hm2PairIntegrand Δ (F s) ξ‖ ≤
          (1 / (2 * ε)) * hm2NormSq Δ + (ε / 2) * M_flux ^ 2 := by
      intro s _
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_neg]
      have h_young := (h_pair_props Δ (F s) hΔ_int (hF_int s)).2.2 ε hε
      have h_fs := h_flux_sq s
      have h_mul : (ε / 2) * hm2NormSq (F s) ≤ (ε / 2) * M_flux ^ 2 :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_fs (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_sub_norm := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      (fun s _ => (hE_deriv s).hasDerivWithinAt) hE'_bound convex_univ (Set.mem_univ 0) (Set.mem_univ t)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, sub_zero, hE_diff_eq] at h_sub_norm
    exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h_sub_norm
  have h_mvt := h_s3 (fun x => Ψ t x - Ψ 0 x) ((hΨ_int t).sub (hΨ_int 0))
    (h_s1.2.1 (Ψ t) (Ψ 0) (hΨ_int t) (hΨ_int 0))
  have h_sq_bound : hm2NormSq (fun x => Ψ t x - Ψ 0 x) ≤ (|t| * M_flux) ^ 2 := by
    rcases eq_or_ne t 0 with rfl | ht
    · have h1 := h_mvt 1 one_pos
      simpa using h1
    · have ht_pos : 0 < |t| := abs_pos.mpr ht
      have h1 := h_mvt |t| ht_pos
      have h_alg : ∀ A : ℝ, ((1 / (2 * |t|)) * A + (|t| / 2) * M_flux ^ 2) * |t| =
          (1 / 2) * A + (1 / 2) * (|t| * M_flux) ^ 2 := by
        intro A
        have : |t| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht_pos
        field_simp
      rw [h_alg] at h1
      linarith
  calc Real.sqrt (hm2NormSq (fun x => Ψ t x - Ψ 0 x))
    _ ≤ Real.sqrt ((|t| * M_flux) ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_bound
    _ = |t| * M_flux := Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)

hm2NormSq_sub_le_of_l1_hasDerivAt.definitions:
def hm2PairIntegrand (f₁ f₂ : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ((starRingEnd ℂ (fourierLine f₁ ξ) * fourierLine f₂ ξ).re) / (4 + ξ ^ 2) ^ 2

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (δ_reg : ℝ), 0 < δ_reg →
    (∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ_reg →
      ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ q x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x) →
    ∀ (δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ' → 2 * δ' ≤ min δ_reg (1 / 256) →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
        (∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q)‖ ≤ 96 * κ ^ 5 * δ') ∧
        (∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
          ‖ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₁) - ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₂)‖ ≤
            144 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖)

signature.name: regTruncatedVec_global_hm1_lipschitz
signature.statement:
∀ (δ_reg : ℝ), 0 < δ_reg →
    (∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ_reg →
      ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ q x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x) →
    ∀ (δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ' → 2 * δ' ≤ min δ_reg (1 / 256) →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
        (∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q)‖ ≤ 96 * κ ^ 5 * δ') ∧
        (∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
          ‖ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₁) - ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₂)‖ ≤
            144 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖)

proof.tactics:
by
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
    intro q ξ x
    have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
    intro q ξ
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
  have h_hm1Profile_sq : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ : ℝ),
      ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro q ξ
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    dsimp [hm1Profile]
    rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity), inv_mul_eq_div]
  have h_bound_pw : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro q ξ
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
    have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
      dsimp [fourierLine, C]
      rw [norm_mul]
      gcongr
      calc
        ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
          ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
            congr 1 with x
            exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
    rw [h_hm1Profile_sq q ξ, div_eq_inv_mul]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    calc
      (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
  have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
      Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
      h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
    refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
      (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact h_bound_pw q ξ
  have hm1Profile_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      hm1Profile (q₁ - q₂) ξ = hm1Profile q₁ ξ - hm1Profile q₂ ξ := by
    intro q₁ q₂ ξ
    dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₁ x - q₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₁ x : ℂ) -
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₂ x : ℂ)) := by
      ext x; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand q₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand q₂ ξ)]
    ring
  have hm1Profile_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      hm1Profile (c • q) ξ = c • hm1Profile q ξ := by
    intro c q ξ
    dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((c * q x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => (c : ℂ) * (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ))) := by
      ext x; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_const_mul]
    ring
  have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
    intro q
    dsimp [toHm1]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_iota_sub : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ι (f - g) = ι f - ι g := by
    intro f g
    ext1
    change toHm1 (f - g) = toHm1 f - toHm1 g
    rw [h_toHm1 (f - g), h_toHm1 f, h_toHm1 g, ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem f) (h_mem g)]
    apply MemLp.toLp_congr
    filter_upwards with ξ
    exact hm1Profile_sub f g ξ
  have h_iota_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ι (c • f) = c • ι f := by
    intro c f
    ext1
    change toHm1 (c • f) = c • toHm1 f
    rw [h_toHm1 (c • f), h_toHm1 f, ← MemLp.toLp_const_smul c (h_mem f)]
    apply MemLp.toLp_congr
    filter_upwards with ξ
    exact hm1Profile_smul c f ξ
  have h_norm_sq_profile : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro q
    rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
    apply integral_congr_ae
    filter_upwards [(h_mem q).coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
    rw [h_toHm1 q, hξ, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
  have h_norm_sq_eq : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2) := by
    intro q
    change ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
    rw [h_norm_sq_profile q]
    congr 1 with ξ
    exact h_hm1Profile_sq q ξ
  have h_fl_deriv : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      fourierLine (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f) ξ = ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * fourierLine f ξ := by
    intro f ξ
    let f' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ f
    let F : ℝ → ℂ := fun x => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)
    let F' : ℝ → ℂ := fun x =>
      Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f' x : ℂ) -
        ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ))
    have hF_deriv : ∀ x : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (F' x) x := by
      intro x
      have hd_x : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (y : ℂ)) 1 x := by
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id x).ofReal_comp
      have hd_arg : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => -((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I) (-((ξ : ℂ) * 1) * I) x :=
        ((hd_x.const_mul (ξ : ℂ)).neg).mul_const I
      have hd_exp : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (y : ℂ)) * I))
          (Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (-((ξ : ℂ) * 1) * I)) x :=
        hd_arg.cexp
      have hd_f_real : HasDerivAt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f' x) x := by
        rw [SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
        exact f.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      have hd_f : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => (f y : ℂ)) (f' x : ℂ) x :=
        hd_f_real.ofReal_comp
      have hd_prod := hd_exp.mul hd_f
      convert hd_prod using 1
      dsimp [F']
      ring
    have hF'_int : Integrable F' volume :=
      (integrable_fourier_integrand f' ξ).sub ((integrable_fourier_integrand f ξ).const_mul ((ξ : ℂ) * I))
    have hF_cocompact : Filter.Tendsto F (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) := by
      rw [tendsto_zero_iff_norm_tendsto_zero]
      have hf_zero : Filter.Tendsto (f : ℝ → ℝ) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) :=
        f.toZeroAtInfty.zero_at_infty'
      have hf_norm : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℝ) x‖) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using (continuous_norm.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hf_zero
      refine hf_norm.congr (fun x => (norm_fourier_integrand f ξ x).symm)
    have hF_atBot : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atBot (nhds 0) :=
      hF_cocompact.mono_left (le_trans le_sup_left atBot_atTop_le_cocompact)
    have hF_atTop : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      hF_cocompact.mono_left (le_trans le_sup_right atBot_atTop_le_cocompact)
    have h_ftc := MeasureTheory.integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_deriv hF'_int hF_atBot hF_atTop
    rw [sub_self] at h_ftc
    dsimp [F'] at h_ftc
    rw [integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand f' ξ)
          ((integrable_fourier_integrand f ξ).const_mul ((ξ : ℂ) * I)),
        integral_const_mul] at h_ftc
    have h_int_eq := sub_eq_zero.mp h_ftc
    change ((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * (∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f' x : ℂ)) =
      ((ξ : ℂ) * I) * (((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ) * ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ))
    rw [h_int_eq]
    ring
  have h_fl_int : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f → ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by
    intro f hf ξ
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I)) := by fun_prop
    refine (Integrable.ofReal hf).bdd_mul (c := 1) h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
    have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I]
  have h_fl_cont : ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f → Continuous (fourierLine f) := by
    intro f hf
    have h_bound : ∀ ξ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)‖ ≤ |f x| := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_eq : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_eq, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h_cont_int : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ)) := by
      refine continuous_of_dominated (fun ξ => (h_fl_int f hf ξ).aestronglyMeasurable)
        (fun ξ => Filter.Eventually.of_forall (h_bound ξ)) hf.abs (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x => ?_)
      fun_prop
    exact continuous_const.mul h_cont_int
  have h_fl_add : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f → Integrable g → ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
      fourierLine (fun x => f x + g x) ξ = fourierLine f ξ + fourierLine g ξ := by
    intro f g hf hg ξ
    dsimp [fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((f x + g x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (f x : ℂ) +
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) := by
      ext x; push_cast; ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_add (h_fl_int f hf ξ) (h_fl_int g hg ξ), mul_add]
  have h_add_h1 : ∀ (f g : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable f → Integrable g →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) →
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2) →
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => f x + g x) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => f x + g x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => f x + g x) ≤ 2 * h1NormSq f + 2 * h1NormSq g := by
    intro f g hf hg hf_h1 hg_h1
    have hfg : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => f x + g x) := hf.add hg
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => f x + g x) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
      have h_fl : Continuous (fourierLine (fun x => f x + g x)) := h_fl_cont _ hfg
      fun_prop
    have h_pw_upper : ∀ ξ : ℝ, (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => f x + g x) ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤
        2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
      intro ξ
      rw [h_fl_add f g hf hg ξ]
      have h_tri : ‖fourierLine f ξ + fourierLine g ξ‖ ≤ ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ :=
        norm_add_le _ _
      have h_sq1 : ‖fourierLine f ξ + fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine g ξ‖) ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_tri 2
      have h_sq2 : (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ + ‖fourierLine g ξ‖) ^ 2 ≤
          2 * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2 + 2 * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (‖fourierLine f ξ‖ - ‖fourierLine g ξ‖)]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg ξ]
    have h_dom_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ =>
        2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2)) :=
      (hf_h1.const_mul 2).add (hg_h1.const_mul 2)
    have hfg_h1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => f x + g x) ξ‖ ^ 2) := by
      refine h_dom_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact h_pw_upper ξ
    refine ⟨hfg, hfg_h1, ?_⟩
    calc h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => f x + g x)
      _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, (2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine f ξ‖ ^ 2) + 2 * ((4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2)) :=
        integral_mono hfg_h1 h_dom_int h_pw_upper
      _ = 2 * h1NormSq f + 2 * h1NormSq g := by
        rw [integral_add (hf_h1.const_mul 2) (hg_h1.const_mul 2), integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
        rfl
  have h_one_diff : ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 256 → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 256 →
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - diagGreen 1 w₂ x) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - diagGreen 1 w₂ x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - diagGreen 1 w₂ x) ≤ 3 * ‖ι (w₁ - w₂)‖ ^ 2 := by
    intro w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, h_dh1_int, h_dh1_h1int, h_dh1_norm⟩ :=
      greenIterKernel_one_first_h1_isometry w₁ w₂
    obtain ⟨h_all_ℓ1, h_all_m12⟩ :=
      greenIterKernel_one_higher_diff_bounds (1 / 256) (by norm_num) w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂
    obtain ⟨h_all_ℓ2, _⟩ :=
      greenIterKernel_one_higher_diff_bounds (1 / 256) (by norm_num) w₂ w₂ hw₂ hw₂
    obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, _, h_dr2_int, h_dr2_h1int, h_dr2_norm⟩ :=
      diagGreen_one_tail_diff_h1_bounds w₁ w₂ hw₁ hw₂ h_all_ℓ1 h_all_ℓ2 h_all_m12
    obtain ⟨h_sum_int, h_sum_h1int, h_sum_norm⟩ :=
      h_add_h1 (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x)
        (fun x => (diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) -
          (diagGreen 1 w₂ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x))
        h_dh1_int h_dr2_int h_dh1_h1int h_dr2_h1int
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => (greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x) +
        ((diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x) -
          (diagGreen 1 w₂ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ 1 x x))) =
        (fun x : ℝ => diagGreen 1 w₁ x - diagGreen 1 w₂ x) := by
      ext x; ring
    rw [h_eq] at h_sum_int h_sum_h1int h_sum_norm
    rw [← h_iota_sub w₁ w₂] at h_dh1_norm h_dr2_norm
    refine ⟨h_sum_int, h_sum_h1int, ?_⟩
    linarith [h_sum_norm, h_dh1_norm, h_dr2_norm, sq_nonneg ‖ι (w₁ - w₂)‖]
  have h_s3 : ∀ (δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ' →
      (∀ r : ℝ, 0 ≤ regCutoff δ' r ∧ regCutoff δ' r ≤ 1) ∧
      (∀ r : ℝ, 2 * δ' ≤ r → regCutoff δ' r = 0) ∧
      (∀ r₁ r₂ : ℝ, |regCutoff δ' r₁ - regCutoff δ' r₂| ≤ (1 / δ') * |r₁ - r₂|) := by
    intro δ' hδ'

        _ ≤ (lam * (4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2)) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2 :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (by positivity)
        _ = lam * ((4 + (lam * ξ) ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ (lam * ξ)‖ ^ 2) := by ring
    let Φ : ℝ → ℝ := fun ζ => (4 + ζ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine Δg₁ ζ‖ ^ 2
    have hΦ_comp_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => lam * Φ (lam * ξ)) volume :=
      (hΔ_h1int.comp_mul_left' hlam_ne).const_mul lam
    have hΦ_comp_eq : (∫ ξ : ℝ, lam * Φ (lam * ξ)) = h1NormSq Δg₁ := by
      rw [integral_const_mul, Measure.integral_comp_mul_left Φ lam, abs_of_pos (inv_pos.mpr hlam_pos),
          smul_eq_mul, ← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ hlam_ne, one_mul]
      rfl
    have hr_int : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) volume := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)) := by
        have hr_fl_cont : Continuous (fourierLine r) := h_fl_cont r r.integrable
        exact Continuous.div (hr_fl_cont.norm.pow 2) (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => by positivity)
      refine hΦ_comp_int.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ξ => ?_)
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity)]
      exact h_pw_r ξ
    have h_r_sq_le : ‖ι r‖ ^ 2 ≤ (3 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) ^ 2 := by
      rw [h_norm_sq_eq r]
      have h_S_diff : ‖ι (S q₁ - S q₂)‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ ^ 2 := by
        rw [← S.map_sub]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) (hS_norm (q₁ - q₂)) 2
      calc ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖fourierLine r ξ‖ ^ 2 / (4 + ξ ^ 2)
        _ ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, lam * Φ (lam * ξ) := integral_mono hr_int hΦ_comp_int h_pw_r
        _ = h1NormSq Δg₁ := hΦ_comp_eq
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖ι (S q₁ - S q₂)‖ ^ 2 := hΔ_h1norm
        _ ≤ 3 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ ^ 2 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_S_diff (by norm_num)
        _ ≤ 9 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ ^ 2 := by nlinarith [sq_nonneg ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖]
        _ = (3 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) ^ 2 := by ring
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_r_sq_le
    rw [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)] at h_sqrt
    rw [← h_iota_sub, h_vec_diff, h_iota_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity)]
    calc (16 * κ ^ 5) * ‖ι r‖
      _ ≤ (16 * κ ^ 5) * (3 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sqrt (by positivity)
      _ = 48 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by ring
  have hF_bdd : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      ‖ι q‖ ≤ min δ_reg (1 / 256) →
      ‖ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q)‖ ≤ 48 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι q‖ := by
    intro q hq
    have h0_min : ‖ι (0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))‖ ≤ min δ_reg (1 / 256) := by
      rw [h_iota_zero, norm_zero]
      positivity
    have h_q0 := hF_lip q 0 hq h0_min
    rwa [hF_zero, h_iota_zero, sub_zero, sub_zero] at h_q0
  obtain ⟨hχ_range, hχ_vanish, hχ_lip⟩ := h_s3 δ' hδ'
  have hF_2δ' : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι q‖ ≤ 2 * δ' →
      ‖ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q)‖ ≤ 96 * κ ^ 5 * δ' := by
    intro q hq
    have hq_min : ‖ι q‖ ≤ min δ_reg (1 / 256) := le_trans hq h2δ'
    calc ‖ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q)‖
      _ ≤ 48 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι q‖ := hF_bdd q hq_min
      _ ≤ 48 * κ ^ 5 * (2 * δ') := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hq (by positivity)
      _ = 96 * κ ^ 5 * δ' := by ring
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro q
    by_cases hq : ‖ι q‖ ≤ 2 * δ'
    · unfold regTruncatedVec
      rw [h_iota_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hχ_range ‖ι q‖).1]
      calc regCutoff δ' ‖ι q‖ * ‖ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q)‖
        _ ≤ 1 * (96 * κ ^ 5 * δ') :=
          mul_le_mul (hχ_range ‖ι q‖).2 (hF_2δ' q hq) (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
        _ = 96 * κ ^ 5 * δ' := one_mul _
    · have hq_ge : 2 * δ' ≤ ‖ι q‖ := le_of_not_ge hq
      unfold regTruncatedVec
      rw [hχ_vanish ‖ι q‖ hq_ge, zero_smul, h_iota_zero, norm_zero]
      positivity
  · have h_mixed : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι q₁‖ ≤ 2 * δ' → 2 * δ' ≤ ‖ι q₂‖ →
        ‖ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₁) - ι (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₂)‖ ≤
          144 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
      intro q₁ q₂ h1 h2
      have h_V2 : regTruncatedVec δ' κ q₂ = 0 := by
        unfold regTruncatedVec
        rw [hχ_vanish ‖ι q₂‖ h2, zero_smul]
      rw [h_V2, h_iota_zero, sub_zero]
      unfold regTruncatedVec
      rw [h_iota_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg (hχ_range ‖ι q₁‖).1]
      have hχ_2δ' : regCutoff δ' (2 * δ') = 0 := hχ_vanish (2 * δ') le_rfl
      have hχ1_bound : regCutoff δ' ‖ι q₁‖ ≤ (1 / δ') * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
        have h_lip_2δ' := hχ_lip ‖ι q₁‖ (2 * δ')
        rw [hχ_2δ', sub_zero, abs_of_nonneg (hχ_range ‖ι q₁‖).1] at h_lip_2δ'
        have h_diff_le : |‖ι q₁‖ - 2 * δ'| ≤ ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
          have h_sub_nonpos : ‖ι q₁‖ - 2 * δ' ≤ 0 := by linarith
          rw [abs_of_nonpos h_sub_nonpos]
          have h_le1 : -(‖ι q₁‖ - 2 * δ') ≤ ‖ι q₂‖ - ‖ι q₁‖ := by linarith
          have h_le2 : ‖ι q₂‖ - ‖ι q₁‖ ≤ |‖ι q₁‖ - ‖ι q₂‖| := by
            rw [abs_sub_comm]
            exact le_abs_self _
          have h_le3 : |‖ι q₁‖ - ‖ι q₂‖| ≤ ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
            rw [h_iota_sub]
            exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le (ι q₁) (ι q₂)
          linarith
        exact le_trans h_lip_2δ' (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_le (by positivity))
      calc regCutoff δ' ‖ι q₁‖ * ‖ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q₁)‖
        _ ≤ ((1 / δ') * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) * (96 * κ ^ 5 * δ') :=
          mul_le_mul hχ1_bound (hF_2δ' q₁ h1) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
        _ = 96 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
          have : δ' ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ'
          field_simp
        _ ≤ 144 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
          have : 0 ≤ κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by positivity
          linarith
    intro q₁ q₂
    by_cases h1 : ‖ι q₁‖ ≤ 2 * δ'
    · by_cases h2 : ‖ι q₂‖ ≤ 2 * δ'
      · unfold regTruncatedVec
        rw [h_iota_smul, h_iota_smul]
        set χ₁ := regCutoff δ' ‖ι q₁‖
        set χ₂ := regCutoff δ' ‖ι q₂‖
        set F₁ := ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q₁)
        set F₂ := ι (regMovingFrameVec κ q₂)
        have h_decomp : χ₁ • F₁ - χ₂ • F₂ = (χ₁ - χ₂) • F₁ + χ₂ • (F₁ - F₂) := by
          rw [sub_smul, smul_sub, sub_add_sub_cancel]
        rw [h_decomp]
        have h_tri := norm_add_le ((χ₁ - χ₂) • F₁) (χ₂ • (F₁ - F₂))
        rw [norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs,
            abs_of_nonneg (hχ_range ‖ι q₂‖).1] at h_tri
        have h_χ_diff : |χ₁ - χ₂| ≤ (1 / δ') * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
          have h_lip12 := hχ_lip ‖ι q₁‖ ‖ι q₂‖
          have h_norm_sub : |‖ι q₁‖ - ‖ι q₂‖| ≤ ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
            rw [h_iota_sub]
            exact abs_norm_sub_norm_le (ι q₁) (ι q₂)
          exact le_trans h_lip12 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_norm_sub (by positivity))
        have h_term1 : |χ₁ - χ₂| * ‖F₁‖ ≤ 96 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
          calc |χ₁ - χ₂| * ‖F₁‖
            _ ≤ ((1 / δ') * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) * (96 * κ ^ 5 * δ') :=
              mul_le_mul h_χ_diff (hF_2δ' q₁ h1) (norm_nonneg _) (by positivity)
            _ = 96 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
              have : δ' ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hδ'
              field_simp
        have h_term2 : χ₂ * ‖F₁ - F₂‖ ≤ 48 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := by
          have hF12 := hF_lip q₁ q₂ (le_trans h1 h2δ') (le_trans h2 h2δ')
          calc χ₂ * ‖F₁ - F₂‖
            _ ≤ 1 * (48 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) :=
              mul_le_mul (hχ_range ‖ι q₂‖).2 hF12 (norm_nonneg _) zero_le_one
            _ = 48 * κ ^ 5 * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := one_mul _
        linarith
      · exact h_mixed q₁ q₂ h1 (le_of_not_ge h2)
    · by_cases h2 : ‖ι q₂‖ ≤ 2 * δ'
      · rw [norm_sub_rev]
        have h_symm_q : ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ = ‖ι (q₂ - q₁)‖ := by
          rw [h_iota_sub, h_iota_sub, norm_sub_rev]
        rw [h_symm_q]
        exact h_mixed q₂ q₁ h2 (le_of_not_ge h1)
      · have h1_ge : 2 * δ' ≤ ‖ι q₁‖ := le_of_not_ge h1
        have h2_ge : 2 * δ' ≤ ‖ι q₂‖ := le_of_not_ge h2
        unfold regTruncatedVec
        rw [hχ_vanish ‖ι q₁‖ h1_ge, hχ_vanish ‖ι q₂‖ h2_ge, zero_smul, zero_smul, sub_self, norm_zero]
        positivity

      linarith
    have h_step_m : ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ),
        F 0 ≤ R₁ →
        (∀ τ₀ τ : ℝ, |τ₀| ≤ T → |τ| ≤ T → |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₂ → F τ ≤ 2 * F τ₀ + A) →
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), |τ| ≤ T → |τ| ≤ (m : ℝ) * σ₂ → F τ ≤ M m := by
      intro F hF0 hF_step m
      induction m with
      | zero =>
        intro τ _ hτ_le
        rw [Nat.cast_zero, zero_mul] at hτ_le
        have hτ0 : τ = 0 := abs_nonpos_iff.mp hτ_le
        subst hτ0
        exact hF0
      | succ m ihm =>
        intro τ hτ_T hτ_le
        have h_cast : ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * σ₂ = (m : ℝ) * σ₂ + σ₂ := by
          push_cast
          ring
        rw [h_cast] at hτ_le
        rcases le_or_gt |τ| ((m : ℝ) * σ₂) with h_le | h_gt
        · exact le_trans (ihm τ hτ_T h_le) (hM_mono m)
        · have hm_nn : 0 ≤ (m : ℝ) * σ₂ := mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg m) (le_of_lt hσ₂)
          let τ₀ : ℝ := if 0 ≤ τ then (m : ℝ) * σ₂ else -((m : ℝ) * σ₂)
          have hτ₀_abs : |τ₀| = (m : ℝ) * σ₂ := by
            dsimp [τ₀]
            split_ifs with h_sign
            · exact abs_of_nonneg hm_nn
            · rw [abs_neg, abs_of_nonneg hm_nn]
          have hτ₀_le_m : |τ₀| ≤ (m : ℝ) * σ₂ := le_of_eq hτ₀_abs
          have hτ₀_T : |τ₀| ≤ T := by linarith
          have h_diff : |τ - τ₀| ≤ σ₂ := by
            dsimp [τ₀]
            split_ifs with h_sign
            · have h_abs_τ : |τ| = τ := abs_of_nonneg h_sign
              rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
              linarith
            · push_neg at h_sign
              have h_abs_τ : |τ| = -τ := abs_of_neg h_sign
              rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
              linarith
          have hF_τ₀ : F τ₀ ≤ M m := ihm τ₀ hτ₀_T hτ₀_le_m
          have hF_τ : F τ ≤ 2 * F τ₀ + A := hF_step τ₀ τ hτ₀_T hτ_T h_diff
          rw [hM_succ]
          linarith
    let m_star : ℕ := Nat.ceil (T / σ₂)
    refine ⟨M m_star, hM_ge m_star, ?_⟩
    intro F hF0 hF_step τ hτ_T
    have h_ceil : T / σ₂ ≤ (m_star : ℝ) := Nat.le_ceil (T / σ₂)
    have hT_le : T ≤ (m_star : ℝ) * σ₂ := (div_le_iff₀ hσ₂).mp h_ceil
    exact h_step_m F hF0 hF_step m_star τ hτ_T (le_trans hτ_T hT_le)
  have h_tier : ∀ (K D : ℕ) (T R₁ : ℝ),
      0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ R₁ →
      ∃ B₂ : ℝ, R₁ ≤ B₂ ∧
        ∀ w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          (∀ (p d : ℕ), Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ))) →
          (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
            (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ)) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde y) →
            HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ')) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
              (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) g_tilde (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ δ_diag) →
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ K D (w 0) ≤ R₁ →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T →
            (∀ p ≤ K, ∀ d < D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ) ≤ R₁) ∧
            (∀ p < K, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p D (w τ) ≤ R₁)) →
          ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ K D (w τ) ≤ B₂ := by
    intro K D T R₁ hT hR₁
    obtain ⟨σ₂, A, hσ₂_pos, hA_nn, h_double⟩ := h_single_tier_step K D T R₁ hT hR₁
    obtain ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, h_rec⟩ := h_recurrence T σ₂ R₁ A hT hσ₂_pos hR₁ hA_nn
    refine ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
    intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init hw_low τ hτ
    exact h_rec (fun s => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ K D (w s)) hw_init
      (h_double w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_low) τ hτ
  have h_ind : ∀ (D k : ℕ) (T R₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → 0 ≤ R₀ →
      ∃ B : ℝ, R₀ ≤ B ∧
        ∀ w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          (∀ (p d : ℕ), Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ))) →
          (∀ (d : ℕ) (τ₀ σ x : ℝ) (g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
            (∀ y : ℝ, diagGreen κ (w (τ₀ + σ)) y = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde y) →
            HasDerivAt (fun σ' : ℝ => iteratedDeriv d (w (τ₀ + σ')) (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ'))
              (16 * κ ^ 5 * iteratedDeriv (d + 1) g_tilde (x - 4 * κ ^ 2 * σ)) σ) →
          (∀ τ : ℝ, ‖ι (w τ)‖ ≤ δ_diag) →
          (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w 0) ≤ R₀) →
          ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T →
            ∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d (w τ) ≤ B := by
    intro D
    induction D with
    | zero =>
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro T R₀ hT hR₀
        obtain ⟨B₂, hR₀_le, h_step⟩ := h_tier 0 0 T R₀ hT hR₀
        refine ⟨B₂, hR₀_le, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have hp0 : p = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hp
        have hd0 : d = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hd
        subst hp0 hd0
        refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball (hw_init 0 le_rfl 0 le_rfl) ?_ τ hτ
        intro τ' _
        exact ⟨fun _ _ d' hd' => (Nat.not_lt_zero d' hd').elim,
               fun q' hq' => (Nat.not_lt_zero q' hq').elim⟩
      | succ k ihk =>
        intro T R₀ hT hR₀
        obtain ⟨R₁, hR₀_le_R₁, h_ihk⟩ := ihk T R₀ hT hR₀
        have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
        obtain ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ := h_tier (k + 1) 0 T R₁ hT hR₁_nn
        refine ⟨B₂, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have hd0 : d = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hd
        subst hd0
        have h_low : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ'| ≤ T → ∀ q ≤ k, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q 0 (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' q hq
          exact h_ihk w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
            (fun q' hq' d' hd' => hw_init q' (le_trans hq' (Nat.le_succ k)) d' hd')
            τ' hτ' q hq 0 le_rfl
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hp with hp_le_k | rfl
        · exact le_trans (h_low τ hτ p hp_le_k) hR₁_le_B₂
        · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
            (le_trans (hw_init (k + 1) le_rfl 0 le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
          intro τ' hτ'
          exact ⟨fun _ _ d' hd' => (Nat.not_lt_zero d' hd').elim,
                 fun q hq => h_low τ' hτ' q (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hq)⟩
    | succ D ihD =>
      intro k
      induction k with
      | zero =>
        intro T R₀ hT hR₀
        obtain ⟨R₁, hR₀_le_R₁, h_ihD⟩ := ihD 0 T R₀ hT hR₀
        have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
        obtain ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ := h_tier 0 (D + 1) T R₁ hT hR₁_nn
        refine ⟨B₂, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have hp0 : p = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hp
        subst hp0
        have h_low : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ'| ≤ T → ∀ d' ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 d' (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' d' hd'
          exact h_ihD w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
            (fun q' hq' d'' hd'' => hw_init q' hq' d'' (le_trans hd'' (Nat.le_succ D)))
            τ' hτ' 0 le_rfl d' hd'
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hd with hd_le_D | rfl
        · exact le_trans (h_low τ hτ d hd_le_D) hR₁_le_B₂
        · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
            (le_trans (hw_init 0 le_rfl (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
          intro τ' hτ'
          refine ⟨fun q hq d' hd' => ?_, fun q hq => (Nat.not_lt_zero q hq).elim⟩
          have hq0 : q = 0 := Nat.le_zero.mp hq
          subst hq0
          exact h_low τ' hτ' d' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hd')
      | succ k ihk =>
        intro T R₀ hT hR₀
        obtain ⟨R_a, hR₀_le_Ra, h_ihD⟩ := ihD (k + 1) T R₀ hT hR₀
        obtain ⟨R_b, hR₀_le_Rb, h_ihk⟩ := ihk T R₀ hT hR₀
        let R₁ : ℝ := max R_a R_b
        have hR₀_le_R₁ : R₀ ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀_le_Ra (le_max_left _ _)
        have hR₁_nn : 0 ≤ R₁ := le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_R₁
        obtain ⟨B₂, hR₁_le_B₂, h_step⟩ := h_tier (k + 1) (D + 1) T R₁ hT hR₁_nn
        refine ⟨B₂, le_trans hR₀_le_R₁ hR₁_le_B₂, ?_⟩
        intro w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ p hp d hd
        have h_low_D : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ'| ≤ T →
            ∀ q ≤ k + 1, ∀ d' ≤ D, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q d' (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' q hq d' hd'
          exact le_trans
            (h_ihD w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
              (fun q' hq' d'' hd'' => hw_init q' hq' d'' (le_trans hd'' (Nat.le_succ D)))
              τ' hτ' q hq d' hd')
            (le_max_left _ _)
        have h_low_k : ∀ τ' : ℝ, |τ'| ≤ T →
            ∀ q ≤ k, ∀ d' ≤ D + 1, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ q d' (w τ') ≤ R₁ := by
          intro τ' hτ' q hq d' hd'
          exact le_trans
            (h_ihk w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
              (fun q' hq' d'' hd'' => hw_init q' (le_trans hq' (Nat.le_succ k)) d'' hd'')
              τ' hτ' q hq d' hd')
            (le_max_right _ _)
        rcases Nat.of_le_succ hd with hd_le_D | rfl
        · exact le_trans (h_low_D τ hτ p hp d hd_le_D) hR₁_le_B₂
        · rcases Nat.of_le_succ hp with hp_le_k | rfl
          · exact le_trans (h_low_k τ hτ p hp_le_k (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₁_le_B₂
          · refine h_step w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball
              (le_trans (hw_init (k + 1) le_rfl (D + 1) le_rfl) hR₀_le_R₁) ?_ τ hτ
            intro τ' hτ'
            exact ⟨fun q hq d' hd' => h_low_D τ' hτ' q hq d' (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hd'),
                   fun q hq => h_low_k τ' hτ' q (Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp hq) (D + 1) le_rfl⟩
  intro k n T R₀ hT hR₀
  obtain ⟨B, hR₀_le_B, h_bound⟩ := h_ind n k T R₀ hT hR₀
  refine ⟨B, le_trans hR₀ hR₀_le_B, ?_⟩
  intro w hw_reg hw_ball hw_init τ hτ
  obtain ⟨hw_cont, hw_mov⟩ := h_s1 w hw_reg
  exact h_bound w hw_cont hw_mov hw_ball hw_init τ hτ k le_rfl n le_rfl

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (δ_brack : ℝ), 0 < δ_brack →
      ∃ δ_hm1 : ℝ, 0 < δ_hm1 ∧ δ_hm1 ≤ δ_brack ∧
        ∀ κ : ℝ, 2 ≤ κ →
          (∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ_brack → ∀ x : ℝ,
            (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ q x y * kdvRHS q y * greenKernel κ q y x =
              -iteratedDeriv 3 (diagGreen κ q) x + 6 * q x * deriv (diagGreen κ q) x) ∧
            (16 * κ ^ 5 * deriv (fun z => -∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ q z y * kdvRHS q y * greenKernel κ q y z) x +
                4 * κ ^ 2 * deriv (kdvRHS q) x =
              -iteratedDeriv 3 (regFlowRHS κ q) x + 6 * deriv (fun z => q z * regFlowRHS κ q z) x)) →
          ∀ V : ℝ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
            (∀ s : ℝ, IsRegFlowSolution κ (fun τ => V s τ)) →
            IsSchwartzSolution (fun s => V s 0) →
            (∀ s τ : ℝ, ‖ι (V s τ)‖ ≤ δ_hm1) →
            ∀ (s₀ τ : ℝ) (v₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
              (∀ x : ℝ, v₀ x = kdvRHS (V s₀ τ) x) →
              ∃ C η : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧ 0 < η ∧
                ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ η →
                  ‖ι (V s τ - V s₀ τ - (s - s₀) • v₀)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C * |s - s₀| ^ 3
