by
  intro δ_brack hδ_brack
  obtain ⟨h_iota_add_sub, h_iota_smul, h_iota_l1, h_iota_deriv, h_ortho, h_deriv_l2⟩ :=
    derivCLM_iota_orthogonality_and_hm1_sq_le_l2 exp_two_abs_double_integral_eq_hm1_norm_sq
  obtain ⟨h_kdv_horiz, h_kdv_init⟩ :=
    kdv_vector_field_hm1_hasDerivAt_and_initial_taylor_bound
      h_iota_add_sub h_iota_smul h_iota_l1 h_iota_deriv
  obtain ⟨δ_hm1, hδ_hm1_pos, hδ_hm1_le_brack, h_pred⟩ :=
    diagGreen_linear_predictor_hm1_and_l2_bounds
      greenIterKernel_one_higher_diff_bounds
      diagGreen_sub_and_linearization_bound
      greenKernel_sq_div_diagGreen_sq_integral
      δ_brack hδ_brack

  intro κ hκ h_brack V hV_reg hV_kdv0 hV_ball s₀ τ v₀ hv₀
  have hκ_pos : 0 < κ := by linarith
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ
  let K_map : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun q =>
    -(D (D (D q))) + (6 : ℝ) • SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ q (D q)
  have hK_map_eq : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), K_map q x = kdvRHS q x := by
    intro q x
    change -(D (D (D q)) x) + 6 * (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ q (D q) x) =
      -iteratedDeriv 3 q x + 6 * q x * deriv q x
    have hD3 : D (D (D q)) x = iteratedDeriv 3 q x := by
      have h1 : (D (D (D q)) : ℝ → ℝ) = deriv (deriv (deriv q)) := rfl
      rw [h1, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have h_mul : SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ q (D q) x = q x * deriv q x := by
      have h_smul := SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply q.hasTemperateGrowth (D q) x

  let K : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun τ' => K_map (V s₀ τ')

    fun τ' x => hK_map_eq (V s₀ τ') x

    ext x

  have hV_s₀_diff : ∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt (fun τ' => V s₀ τ') v t :=

  obtain ⟨h_K_bounds_all, h_K_deriv⟩ := h_kdv_horiz (fun τ' => V s₀ τ') K hV_s₀_diff hK_eq

  refine ⟨C, η, hC_nn, hη_pos, ?_⟩
  intro s hs

  have hh_le_η₀ : |h| ≤ η₀ := le_trans hs (min_le_left _ _)
  have hh_le_δ : |h| ≤ δ_hm1 / (M_K + 1) := le_trans hs (min_le_right _ _)
  let Δ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun τ' => V s τ' - V s₀ τ' - h • K τ'
  let E : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ' => ‖ι (Δ τ')‖ ^ 2

  let v₁ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun τ' => (hV_reg s τ').choose

    have hD3 : D (D (D (v₂ τ'))) x = iteratedDeriv 3 (v₂ τ') x := by
      have h1 : (D (D (D (v₂ τ'))) : ℝ → ℝ) = deriv (deriv (deriv (v₂ τ'))) := rfl
      rw [h1, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero]
    have h_prod_fn : (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (V s₀ τ') (v₂ τ') : ℝ → ℝ) =

    have hv₁_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, v₁ τ' x = regFlowRHS κ (V s τ') x := (hV_reg s τ').choose_spec.2

subgoal_signatures.name: greenIterKernel_one_higher_diff_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
    ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ →
    (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x) ∧
      ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ ℓ) ∧
    (∀ m : ℕ,
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (m + 2) ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2)) ∧
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ∧
      (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ∧
      Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
      h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ≤ (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2)

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_and_linearization_bound
subgoal_signatures.statement:
(κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ)
    (h_cont : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2))
    (h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ)
    (h_tele : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
      greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
        -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
          greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z))
    (w₁ w₂ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hw₁ : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (hw₂ : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (h x : ℝ) :
    diagGreen κ w₂ x ≠ 0 ∧
    |diagGreen κ w₁ x - diagGreen κ w₂ x -
      h * (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x)| ≤
      (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y|) ^ 2

subgoal_signatures.name: greenKernel_sq_div_diagGreen_sq_integral

      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_weyl →
      ∀ (y : ℝ),
        ∫ x : ℝ, (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) =
          diagGreen κ w y

by
  have h_iter_deriv : ∀ (d : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv d g) (iteratedDeriv (d + 1) g y) y := by
    intro d g y
    have hd_diff : Differentiable ℝ (iteratedDeriv d g) :=
      (g.smooth (d + 1)).differentiable_iteratedDeriv d (by norm_cast; omega)
    have hd := (hd_diff.differentiableAt (x := y)).hasDerivAt
    rwa [← congr_fun iteratedDeriv_succ y] at hd
  have h_s1 : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (σ : ℝ), 0 < σ →
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f ≤
        (2 / σ ^ 2 + 2) * ‖ι f‖ + 3 * σ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 f := by
    intro f σ hσ
    let h₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => greenIterKernel 1 f 1 y y
    let d₁ : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY 1 f 1 y y
    have hh₁_bound : ∀ y : ℝ, |h₁ y| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι f‖ := by
      intro y
      have h := (greenIterKernel_one_diag_bounds f).1 1 y
      simpa [h₁, pow_one] using h
    have hh₁_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt h₁ (d₁ y) y :=
      fun y => greenIterKernel_diag_hasDerivAt 1 le_rfl f 0 y
    have hh₁_cont : ∀ S : Set ℝ, ContinuousOn h₁ S :=
      fun S y _ => (hh₁_deriv y).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hd₁_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt d₁ (4 * h₁ y + f y) y := by
      intro y
      have hg0 : greenIterKernel 1 f 0 y y = 1 / 2 := by
        dsimp [greenIterKernel, freeGreenKernel]
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, mul_one]
      have h_ae : ∀ᵐ z : ℝ ∂volume,
          freeGreenDerivY 1 z y * f z * freeGreenDerivY 1 z y =
            freeGreenKernel 1 y z * f z * freeGreenKernel 1 z y := by
        filter_upwards [compl_mem_ae_iff.mpr (measure_singleton y)] with z hz
        have h_ne : z ≠ y := Set.mem_compl_singleton_iff.mp hz
        dsimp [freeGreenDerivY, freeGreenKernel]
        rcases lt_or_gt_of_ne h_ne with hlt | hgt
        · have h_yz : |y - z| = y - z := abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hlt)
          have h_zy : |z - y| = y - z := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact h_yz
          rw [if_pos hlt, h_yz, h_zy]
          ring
        · have h_zy : |z - y| = z - y := abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hgt)
          have h_yz : |y - z| = z - y := by rw [abs_sub_comm]; exact h_zy
          rw [if_neg (not_lt.mpr (le_of_lt hgt)), if_pos hgt, h_yz, h_zy]
          ring
      have h_mixed : greenIterMixedDiag 1 f 0 y = h₁ y := by
        dsimp [greenIterMixedDiag, greenIterDerivY, h₁, greenIterKernel]
        rw [integral_congr_ae h_ae]
      have hd₁_raw := greenIterDerivY_one_diag_hasDerivAt 1 le_rfl f y
      have hd₁_eq : 2 * 1 ^ 2 * greenIterKernel 1 f 1 y y +
          2 * f y * greenIterKernel 1 f 0 y y +
          2 * greenIterMixedDiag 1 f 0 y = 4 * h₁ y + f y := by
        rw [hg0, h_mixed]
        dsimp [h₁]
        ring
      rw [hd₁_eq] at hd₁_raw
      exact hd₁_raw
    have hd₁_cont : ∀ S : Set ℝ, ContinuousOn d₁ S :=
      fun S y _ => (hd₁_deriv y).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have hf_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt f (iteratedDeriv 1 f y) y := by
      intro y
      simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero] using h_iter_deriv 0 f y
    have hf_cont : ∀ S : Set ℝ, ContinuousOn f S :=
      fun S y _ => (hf_deriv y).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    have h_rhs_nn : 0 ≤ (2 / σ ^ 2 + 2) * ‖ι f‖ + 3 * σ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 f := by
      have : 0 ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 f := apply_nonneg _ _
      positivity
    refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound' ℝ 0 0 f h_rhs_nn (fun x => ?_)
    rw [pow_zero, one_mul, iteratedDeriv_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs]
    obtain ⟨c₁, hc₁, hc₁_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope h₁ d₁ (by linarith : x < x + σ)
      (hh₁_cont _) (fun y _ => hh₁_deriv y)
    have hc₁_mul : d₁ c₁ * σ = h₁ (x + σ) - h₁ x := by
      have h_sub : x + σ - x = σ := by ring
      rw [h_sub] at hc₁_eq
      exact ((div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hσ)).mp hc₁_eq.symm).symm
    have hc₁_bound : |d₁ c₁| * σ ≤ ‖ι f‖ := by
      calc |d₁ c₁| * σ
        _ = |d₁ c₁| * |σ| := by rw [abs_of_pos hσ]
        _ = |d₁ c₁ * σ| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
        _ = |h₁ (x + σ) - h₁ x| := by rw [hc₁_mul]
        _ ≤ |h₁ (x + σ)| + |h₁ x| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι f‖ + (1 / 2) * ‖ι f‖ := add_le_add (hh₁_bound (x + σ)) (hh₁_bound x)
        _ = ‖ι f‖ := by ring
    obtain ⟨c₁', hc₁', hc₁'_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope h₁ d₁
      (by linarith : x + 2 * σ < x + 3 * σ) (hh₁_cont _) (fun y _ => hh₁_deriv y)
    have hc₁'_mul : d₁ c₁' * σ = h₁ (x + 3 * σ) - h₁ (x + 2 * σ) := by
      have h_sub : x + 3 * σ - (x + 2 * σ) = σ := by ring
      rw [h_sub] at hc₁'_eq
      exact ((div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt hσ)).mp hc₁'_eq.symm).symm
    have hc₁'_bound : |d₁ c₁'| * σ ≤ ‖ι f‖ := by
      calc |d₁ c₁'| * σ
        _ = |d₁ c₁'| * |σ| := by rw [abs_of_pos hσ]
        _ = |d₁ c₁' * σ| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
        _ = |h₁ (x + 3 * σ) - h₁ (x + 2 * σ)| := by rw [hc₁'_mul]
        _ ≤ |h₁ (x + 3 * σ)| + |h₁ (x + 2 * σ)| := abs_sub _ _
        _ ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι f‖ + (1 / 2) * ‖ι f‖ :=
          add_le_add (hh₁_bound (x + 3 * σ)) (hh₁_bound (x + 2 * σ))
        _ = ‖ι f‖ := by ring
    have hc₁_lt_c₁' : c₁ < c₁' := by linarith [hc₁.2, hc₁'.1]
    have h_diff_ge : σ ≤ c₁' - c₁ := by linarith [hc₁.2, hc₁'.1]
    obtain ⟨c₂, hc₂, hc₂_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope d₁ (fun y => 4 * h₁ y + f y)
      hc₁_lt_c₁' (hd₁_cont _) (fun y _ => hd₁_deriv y)
    have hc₂_mul : (4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂) * (c₁' - c₁) = d₁ c₁' - d₁ c₁ :=
      ((div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hc₁_lt_c₁'))).mp hc₂_eq.symm).symm
    have hc₂_sq_bound : |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| * σ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖ι f‖ := by
      have h1 : |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| * σ ≤ |d₁ c₁' - d₁ c₁| := by

            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_diff_ge (abs_nonneg _)
          _ = |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| * |c₁' - c₁| := by
            rw [abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hc₁_lt_c₁')]
          _ = |(4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂) * (c₁' - c₁)| := (abs_mul _ _).symm
          _ = |d₁ c₁' - d₁ c₁| := by rw [hc₂_mul]
      calc |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| * σ ^ 2
        _ = (|4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| * σ) * σ := by ring
        _ ≤ |d₁ c₁' - d₁ c₁| * σ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h1 (le_of_lt hσ)
        _ ≤ (|d₁ c₁'| + |d₁ c₁|) * σ := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (abs_sub _ _) (le_of_lt hσ)
        _ = |d₁ c₁'| * σ + |d₁ c₁| * σ := by ring
        _ ≤ ‖ι f‖ + ‖ι f‖ := add_le_add hc₁'_bound hc₁_bound
        _ = 2 * ‖ι f‖ := by ring
    have hc₂_div_bound : |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| ≤ (2 / σ ^ 2) * ‖ι f‖ := by
      have h_sq_pos : 0 < σ ^ 2 := sq_pos_of_pos hσ
      have h_div := div_le_div_of_nonneg_right hc₂_sq_bound (le_of_lt h_sq_pos)
      rw [mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ (ne_of_gt h_sq_pos), div_eq_mul_inv, mul_comm (2 * ‖ι f‖),
        ← mul_assoc, ← div_eq_inv_mul] at h_div
      exact h_div

      have h_id : f c₂ = (4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂) - 4 * h₁ c₂ := by ring
      have h_tri : |f c₂| ≤ |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| + 4 * |h₁ c₂| := by
        calc |f c₂|
          _ = |(4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂) - 4 * h₁ c₂| := by rw [← h_id]
          _ ≤ |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| + |4 * h₁ c₂| := abs_sub _ _
          _ = |4 * h₁ c₂ + f c₂| + 4 * |h₁ c₂| := by
            rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 4)]
      have hh₁_c₂ := hh₁_bound c₂
      linarith
    have hx_lt_c₂ : x < c₂ := by linarith [hc₁.1, hc₂.1]
    have hc₂_sub_le : c₂ - x ≤ 3 * σ := by linarith [hc₂.2, hc₁'.2]
    obtain ⟨c₃, hc₃, hc₃_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope f (iteratedDeriv 1 f)
      hx_lt_c₂ (hf_cont _) (fun y _ => hf_deriv y)
    have hc₃_mul : f c₂ - f x = iteratedDeriv 1 f c₃ * (c₂ - x) :=
      (div_eq_iff (ne_of_gt (sub_pos.mpr hx_lt_c₂))).mp hc₃_eq.symm
    have hc₃_sem : |iteratedDeriv 1 f c₃| ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 f := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 1 f c₃
    have h_fx_sub : |f c₂ - f x| ≤ 3 * σ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 f := by
      calc |f c₂ - f x|
        _ = |iteratedDeriv 1 f c₃ * (c₂ - x)| := by rw [hc₃_mul]
        _ = |iteratedDeriv 1 f c₃| * (c₂ - x) := by
          rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (sub_pos.mpr hx_lt_c₂)]
        _ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 f * (3 * σ) :=
          mul_le_mul hc₃_sem hc₂_sub_le (le_of_lt (sub_pos.mpr hx_lt_c₂)) (apply_nonneg _ _)

    have h_fx_tri : |f x| ≤ |f c₂| + |f c₂ - f x| := by

    have h_cont : ∀ (d : ℕ) (S : Set ℝ), ContinuousOn (iteratedDeriv d g) S :=
      fun d S y _ => (h_iter_deriv d g y).continuousAt.continuousWithinAt
    obtain ⟨c, hc, hc_eq⟩ := exists_hasDerivAt_eq_slope (iteratedDeriv n g) (iteratedDeriv (n + 1) g)
      (by linarith : x < x + σ) (h_cont n _) (fun y _ => h_iter_deriv n g y)

        have h_t2 : σ ^ (m + 1) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + m + 2) (r s) ≤ M * h * σ := by
          calc σ ^ (m + 1) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + m + 2) (r s)
            _ ≤ σ ^ (m + 1) * M :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM s hh_η) (by positivity)
            _ = (h * σ) * M := by rw [hσ_m1]
            _ = M * h * σ := by ring
        change SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + 1) (r s) ≤ (2 * (8 : ℝ) ^ m * K_n + M) * h * σ
        linarith
  have h_s3 : ∀ k n : ℕ, ∃ K : ℝ, 0 ≤ K ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ min η 1 →
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (r s) ≤ K * |s - s₀| * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|) := by
    intro k n
    obtain ⟨K_n, hK_n_nn, hK_n⟩ := h_unweighted n
    let m : ℕ := 2 ^ (n + 3) + 1
    obtain ⟨M, hM_nn, hM⟩ := h_r_sem (k + k * m) n
    refine ⟨K_n + M, by positivity, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    by_cases h_eq : s = s₀
    · subst h_eq
      rw [hr₀, sub_self, abs_zero, h_sqrt_zero]
      simp
    · let h : ℝ := |s - s₀|
      have hh_pos : 0 < h := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq)
      have hh_nn : 0 ≤ h := le_of_lt hh_pos
      have hh_η : h ≤ η := le_trans hs (min_le_left _ _)
      let σ : ℝ := Real.sqrt^[n + 3] h
      have hσ_pos : 0 < σ := h_sqrt_pos (n + 3) h hh_pos
      have hσ_sq : σ ^ 2 = Real.sqrt^[n + 2] h := h_sqrt_sq (n + 2) h hh_nn
      have hσ_m : ((σ⁻¹) ^ m)⁻¹ = h * σ := by
        rw [inv_pow, inv_inv]
        dsimp [m]
        rw [pow_succ, h_sqrt_pow (n + 3) h hh_nn]
      have h_w := h_s2_2 k n m (r s) σ⁻¹ (inv_pos.mpr hσ_pos)
      have h_t1 : σ⁻¹ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (r s) ≤ K_n * h * σ := by
        calc σ⁻¹ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (r s)
          _ ≤ σ⁻¹ * (K_n * h * (Real.sqrt^[n + 2] h)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK_n s hs) (by positivity)
          _ = σ⁻¹ * (K_n * h * σ ^ 2) := by rw [← hσ_sq]
          _ = K_n * h * σ := by
            have : σ ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hσ_pos
            field_simp
      have h_t2 : ((σ⁻¹) ^ m)⁻¹ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (k + k * m) n (r s) ≤ M * h * σ := by
        calc ((σ⁻¹) ^ m)⁻¹ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (k + k * m) n (r s)
          _ ≤ ((σ⁻¹) ^ m)⁻¹ * M :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hM s hh_η) (by positivity)
          _ = (h * σ) * M := by rw [hσ_m]
          _ = M * h * σ := by ring
      change SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (r s) ≤ (K_n + M) * h * σ
      linarith
  let Q : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => (s - s₀)⁻¹ • r s
  have hQ_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto Q (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) := by
    rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds]
    rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
    rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply]
    obtain ⟨K, hK_nn, hK⟩ := h_s3 k n
    have h_min_pos : 0 < min η 1 := lt_min hη one_pos
    have h_Icc_mem : Set.Icc (s₀ - min η 1) (s₀ + min η 1) ∈ nhds s₀ :=
      Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h_upper_cont : Continuous (fun s : ℝ => K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|)) :=
      continuous_const.mul ((h_sqrt_cont (n + 3)).comp (continuous_abs.comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)))
    have h_upper_zero : K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s₀ - s₀|) = 0 := by
      rw [sub_self, abs_zero, h_sqrt_zero, mul_zero]
    have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|)) (nhds s₀) (nhds 0) := by
      rw [← h_upper_zero]
      exact h_upper_cont.continuousAt
    have h_ev_lt : ∀ᶠ s in nhds s₀, K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|) < ε :=
      h_upper_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hε)
    filter_upwards [h_Icc_mem, h_ev_lt] with s hs_mem hs_lt
    have hs_abs : |s - s₀| ≤ min η 1 :=
      abs_sub_le_iff.mpr ⟨by linarith [hs_mem.2], by linarith [hs_mem.1]⟩
    have h_sem_Q : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (Q s - 0) ≤
        K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|) := by
      rw [sub_zero]
      change SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((s - s₀)⁻¹ • r s) ≤ K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|)
      rw [map_smul_eq_mul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_inv]
      by_cases h_eq : s = s₀
      · subst h_eq
        rw [sub_self, abs_zero, inv_zero, zero_mul]
        exact mul_nonneg hK_nn (h_sqrt_nn (n + 3) 0 le_rfl)
      · have hh_pos : 0 < |s - s₀| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr h_eq)
        calc |s - s₀|⁻¹ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (r s)
          _ ≤ |s - s₀|⁻¹ * (K * |s - s₀| * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hK s hs_abs) (by positivity)
          _ = K * (Real.sqrt^[n + 3] |s - s₀|) := by
            have : |s - s₀| ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hh_pos
            field_simp
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_sem_Q hs_lt
  rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt, HasFDerivAt, hasFDerivAtFilter_iff_isLittleOTVS]
  rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul]
  · exact hQ_tendsto
  · refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s hs => ?_)
    rw [sub_eq_zero.mp hs]
    simp

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 : ∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      ‖ι g‖ ≤ 4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g) := by
    intro g
    have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (ξ x : ℝ),
        ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)‖ = ‖g x‖ := by
      intro ξ x
      have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
      rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
    let I_g : ℝ := ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * I_g
    have h_bound_pw : ∀ (ξ : ℝ),
        ‖hm1Profile g ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro ξ
      have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ≤ C := by
        dsimp [fourierLine, C, I_g]
        rw [norm_mul]
        gcongr
        calc
          ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)‖
            ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)‖ :=
              norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
          _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖g x‖ := by
              congr 1 with x
              exact norm_fourier_integrand ξ x
      have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
        rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
      have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile g ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
        dsimp [hm1Profile]
        rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      rw [h_sq]
      have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
        apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
        linarith
      have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
        pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
      calc
        (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine g ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
        _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
    have h_mem : MemLp (hm1Profile g) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
      have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
          Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (g p.2 : ℂ)) := by
        have := g.continuous
        fun_prop
      have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
          (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (g x : ℂ)) volume :=
        h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
      have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine g) volume :=
        aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
      have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
        Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
      have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile g) volume :=
        h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
      rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
      refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
        (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
      filter_upwards with ξ
      rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
      exact h_bound_pw ξ
    have h_toHm1 : toHm1 g = h_mem.toLp (hm1Profile g) := by
      dsimp [toHm1]
      rw [dif_pos h_mem]
    have h_norm_sq : ‖toHm1 g‖ ^ 2 = ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile g ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, MeasureTheory.L2.inner_def]
      apply integral_congr_ae
      filter_upwards [h_mem.coeFn_toLp] with ξ hξ
      rw [h_toHm1, hξ, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
    have h_int_hm1 : Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => ‖hm1Profile g ξ‖ ^ 2) volume :=
      (memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_mem.1).mp h_mem
    have h_int_le : ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile g ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 * Real.pi := by
      calc
        ∫ ξ : ℝ, ‖hm1Profile g ξ‖ ^ 2
          ≤ ∫ ξ : ℝ, C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
            integral_mono h_int_hm1 (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)) h_bound_pw
        _ = C ^ 2 * ∫ ξ : ℝ, (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul (C ^ 2) _
        _ = C ^ 2 * Real.pi := by rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
    have h_C_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_C_sq : C ^ 2 * Real.pi ≤ I_g ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [C]
      rw [h_C_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
      have h_pi : (2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * I_g ^ 2 * Real.pi = (1 / 2) * I_g ^ 2 := by
        have h_pi_ne : Real.pi ≠ 0 := Real.pi_ne_zero
        field_simp
      rw [h_pi]
      have : 0 ≤ I_g ^ 2 := sq_nonneg I_g
      linarith
    have h_Ig_nn : 0 ≤ I_g := integral_nonneg (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    have h_norm_le_Ig : ‖ι g‖ ≤ I_g := by
      change ‖toHm1 g‖ ≤ I_g
      have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1 g‖ ^ 2 ≤ I_g ^ 2 := by linarith
      have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
      rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq h_Ig_nn] at h_sqrt
    let S : ℝ := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g
    have h_pw_g : ∀ x : ℝ, ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ ≤ S * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      intro x
      have h0 : ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g :=
        SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ g x
      have h2 : x ^ 2 * ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g := by
        have h2' := SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 2 0 g x
        simpa [iteratedDeriv_zero, sq_abs] using h2'
      have h_sum : (1 + x ^ 2) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ ≤ S := by
        change (1 + x ^ 2) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ ≤
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g
        linarith
      have h_pos : 0 < 1 + x ^ 2 := by positivity
      calc ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖
        _ = (1 + x ^ 2) * ‖(g : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
          rw [mul_comm (1 + x ^ 2), mul_inv_cancel_right₀ (ne_of_gt h_pos)]
        _ ≤ S * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_sum (by positivity)
    have h_Ig_le : I_g ≤ 4 * S := by
      have h_S_nn : 0 ≤ S := add_nonneg (apply_nonneg _ _) (apply_nonneg _ _)
      calc I_g
        _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, S * (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ :=
          integral_mono g.integrable.norm (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul S) h_pw_g
        _ = S * ∫ x : ℝ, (1 + x ^ 2)⁻¹ := integral_const_mul S _
        _ = S * Real.pi := by rw [integral_univ_inv_one_add_sq]
        _ ≤ S * 4 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left Real.pi_le_four h_S_nn
        _ = 4 * S := mul_comm S 4
    exact le_trans h_norm_le_Ig h_Ig_le
  have h_hm1_c0 : ∀ (Λ : ℝ), 1 ≤ Λ → ∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g ≤
        4 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ι g‖ + (2 / Λ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 g := by
    intro Λ hΛ g
    have hΛ_pos : 0 < Λ := by linarith
    have h_laplace : ∀ (c : ℝ), 0 < c →
        Integrable (fun v : ℝ => Real.exp (-c * |v|)) volume ∧
        (∫ v : ℝ, Real.exp (-c * |v|)) = 2 / c := by
      intro c hc
      let f_c : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => Real.exp (-c * |v|)
      have hf_Ici : IntegrableOn f_c (Set.Ici 0) volume := by
        have h_ioi := (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi (-1 : ℝ) hc).mono_set
          (Set.Ici_subset_Ioi.mpr (by norm_num : (-1 : ℝ) < 0))
        refine h_ioi.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Ici
        intro v hv
        dsimp [f_c]
        have hv_nn : 0 ≤ v := hv
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hv_nn]
      have hf_Iic : IntegrableOn f_c (Set.Iic 0) volume := by
        have h_neg := hf_Ici.comp_neg
        rw [Set.neg_Ici, neg_zero] at h_neg
        refine h_neg.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
        intro v _
        dsimp [f_c]
        rw [abs_neg]
      have hf_int : Integrable f_c volume := by
        rw [← integrableOn_univ, ← Set.Iic_union_Ioi (a := (0 : ℝ))]
        exact hf_Iic.union (hf_Ici.mono_set Set.Ioi_subset_Ici_self)
      refine ⟨hf_int, ?_⟩
      let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun v => -(1 / c) * Real.exp (-c * v)
      have hF_cont : ContinuousWithinAt F (Set.Ici 0) 0 := by dsimp [F]; fun_prop
      have hF_deriv : ∀ v ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), HasDerivAt F (Real.exp (-c * v)) v := by
        intro v _
        dsimp [F]
        have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) (-c) v := by
          simpa using (hasDerivAt_id v).const_mul (-c)
        have hd2 := hd1.exp.const_mul (-(1 / c))
        convert hd2 using 1
        have : c ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hc
        field_simp
      have hF_lim : Filter.Tendsto F Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
        rw [show (0 : ℝ) = -(1 / c) * 0 by ring]
        apply Filter.Tendsto.const_mul
        apply Real.tendsto_exp_atBot.comp
        have h_neg : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => c * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
          Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hc Filter.tendsto_id
        have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) = (fun x : ℝ => -(c * x)) := by ext x; ring
        change Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => -c * x) Filter.atTop Filter.atBot
        rw [h_eq]
        exact Filter.tendsto_neg_atTop_atBot.comp h_neg
      have h_ioi_val : (∫ v in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), Real.exp (-c * v)) = 1 / c := by
        have h_res := integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hF_cont hF_deriv
          (exp_neg_integrableOn_Ioi 0 hc) hF_lim
        rw [h_res]
        dsimp [F]
        rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero]
        ring
      have h_split : ∫ v : ℝ, f_c v = (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, f_c v) + (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v) :=
        (intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi hf_int.integrableOn hf_int.integrableOn).symm
      have h_iic_eq : (∫ v in Set.Iic 0, f_c v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v := by
        have h_neg := integral_comp_neg_Iic (0 : ℝ) f_c
        rw [neg_zero] at h_neg
        rw [← h_neg]
        congr 1 with v
        dsimp [f_c]
        rw [abs_neg]
      have h_ioi_eq : (∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, f_c v) = ∫ v in Set.Ioi 0, Real.exp (-c * v) := by
        refine setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi ?_
        intro v hv
        dsimp [f_c]
        have hv_pos : 0 < v := hv

        ∃ D : ℝ, 0 ≤ D ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
            (∀ p j : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j g ≤ B p j) →
            ‖ι g‖ ≤ C₀ * L ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n' g ≤ D * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
      intro n'
      induction n' with
      | zero =>
        intro A hA
        have hA_pos : 0 < A := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hA
        have hA_ne : A ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA_pos
        let D₀ : ℝ := 4 * C₀ * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) + 2 * B' 0 1
        have hD₀_nn : 0 ≤ D₀ := by
          have : 0 ≤ B' 0 1 := hB'_nn 0 1
          positivity
        refine ⟨D₀, hD₀_nn, ?_⟩
        intro m g hg_B hg_hm1
        let Λ : ℝ := A ^ m
        have hΛ_ge1 : 1 ≤ Λ := one_le_pow₀ hA
        have h_step0 := h_hm1_c0 Λ hΛ_ge1 g
        have hg_01 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 g ≤ B' 0 1 :=
          le_trans (hg_B 0 1) (hB_le_B' 0 1)
        have h_exp_bound : (A ^ 4 * L) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) :=
          Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp (A ^ 4 * L) (by positivity) m
        have h_pow_id : Λ ^ 3 * (C₀ * L ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) =
            C₀ * (A⁻¹) ^ m * ((A ^ 4 * L) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) := by
          dsimp [Λ]
          rw [mul_pow, ← pow_mul, ← pow_mul, inv_pow]
          have h_A3m : (A ^ (m * 3)) = (A ^ m)⁻¹ * A ^ (4 * m) := by
            have h_eq : A ^ m * A ^ (m * 3) = A ^ (4 * m) := by
              rw [← pow_add]
              congr 1
              omega
            rw [← h_eq, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ (pow_ne_zero m hA_ne)]
          rw [h_A3m]
          ring
        have h_term1 : 4 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ι g‖ ≤ 4 * C₀ * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          calc 4 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ι g‖
            _ ≤ 4 * (Λ ^ 3 * (C₀ * L ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ))) := by
              rw [mul_assoc]
              exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
                (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_hm1 (by positivity)) (by positivity)
            _ = 4 * C₀ * (A⁻¹) ^ m * ((A ^ 4 * L) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) := by
              rw [h_pow_id]
              ring
            _ ≤ 4 * C₀ * (A⁻¹) ^ m * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_bound (by positivity)
            _ = 4 * C₀ * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by ring
        have h_term2 : (2 / Λ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 g ≤ 2 * B' 0 1 * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          have h_2Λ : 2 / Λ = 2 * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
            dsimp [Λ]
            rw [div_eq_mul_inv, inv_pow]
          rw [h_2Λ]
          calc 2 * (A⁻¹) ^ m * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 g
            _ ≤ 2 * (A⁻¹) ^ m * B' 0 1 :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_01 (by positivity)
            _ = 2 * B' 0 1 * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by ring
        calc SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g
          _ ≤ 4 * Λ ^ 3 * ‖ι g‖ + (2 / Λ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 1 g := h_step0
          _ ≤ 4 * C₀ * Real.exp (A ^ 4 * L) * (A⁻¹) ^ m + 2 * B' 0 1 * (A⁻¹) ^ m :=
            add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
          _ = D₀ * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by dsimp [D₀]; ring
      | succ n' ih =>
        intro A hA
        have hA_pos : 0 < A := lt_of_lt_of_le one_pos hA
        have hA_ne : A ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hA_pos
        have hA2 : 1 ≤ A ^ 2 := one_le_pow₀ hA
        obtain ⟨D_n, hD_n_nn, hD_n_ih⟩ := ih (A ^ 2) hA2
        let D_succ : ℝ := 2 * D_n + B' 0 (n' + 2)
        have hD_succ_nn : 0 ≤ D_succ := add_nonneg (by positivity) (hB'_nn 0 (n' + 2))
        refine ⟨D_succ, hD_succ_nn, ?_⟩
        intro m g hg_B hg_hm1
        let δ : ℝ := (A⁻¹) ^ m
        have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by positivity
        have h_step_d := h_deriv n' δ hδ_pos g
        have hg_0n' : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n' g ≤ D_n * ((A ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ m :=
          hD_n_ih m g hg_B hg_hm1
        have hg_0n2 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n' + 2) g ≤ B' 0 (n' + 2) :=
          le_trans (hg_B 0 (n' + 2)) (hB_le_B' 0 (n' + 2))
        have h_alg : (2 / δ) * (D_n * ((A ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ m) = 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          dsimp [δ]
          rw [inv_pow, inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
          have h_2m : A ^ (2 * m) = A ^ m * A ^ m := by
            rw [← pow_add]
            congr 1
            omega
          rw [h_2m, mul_inv]
          have hAm_ne : (A ^ m)⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero (pow_ne_zero m hA_ne)
          field_simp
        have h_term1 : (2 / δ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n' g ≤ 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          calc (2 / δ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n' g
            _ ≤ (2 / δ) * (D_n * ((A ^ 2)⁻¹) ^ m) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_0n' (by positivity)
            _ = 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m := h_alg
        have h_term2 : δ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n' + 2) g ≤ B' 0 (n' + 2) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by
          calc δ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n' + 2) g
            _ ≤ δ * B' 0 (n' + 2) :=
              mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_0n2 (le_of_lt hδ_pos)
            _ = B' 0 (n' + 2) * (A⁻¹) ^ m := mul_comm _ _
        calc SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n' + 1) g
          _ ≤ (2 / δ) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n' g + δ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n' + 2) g :=
            h_step_d
          _ ≤ 2 * D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m + B' 0 (n' + 2) * (A⁻¹) ^ m :=
            add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
          _ = D_succ * (A⁻¹) ^ m := by dsimp [D_succ]; ring
    let A : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ (k + 1)
    have hA_ge1 : 1 ≤ A := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    obtain ⟨D_n, hD_n_nn, hD_n_0n⟩ := h_zero_n n A hA_ge1
    let C : ℝ := D_n + B' (k + 1) n
    have hC_nn : 0 ≤ C := add_nonneg hD_n_nn (hB'_nn (k + 1) n)
    refine ⟨C, hC_nn, ?_⟩
    intro m g hg_B hg_hm1
    let R : ℝ := (2 : ℝ) ^ m
    have hR_ge1 : 1 ≤ R := one_le_pow₀ (by norm_num)
    have h_step_w := h_weight k n R hR_ge1 g
    have hg_0n : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n g ≤ D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m :=
      hD_n_0n m g hg_B hg_hm1
    have hg_k1n : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (k + 1) n g ≤ B' (k + 1) n :=
      le_trans (hg_B (k + 1) n) (hB_le_B' (k + 1) n)
    have h_pow_2 : R ^ k * (A⁻¹) ^ m = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      dsimp [R, A]
      rw [← pow_mul, inv_pow, ← pow_mul]
      have h_split : (2 : ℝ) ^ ((k + 1) * m) = (2 : ℝ) ^ (m * k) * (2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        rw [← pow_add]
        congr 1
        ring
      rw [h_split, mul_inv, mul_inv_cancel_left₀ (by positivity), one_div, inv_pow]
    have h_term1 : R ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n g ≤ D_n * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      calc R ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n g
        _ ≤ R ^ k * (D_n * (A⁻¹) ^ m) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_0n (by positivity)
        _ = D_n * (R ^ k * (A⁻¹) ^ m) := by ring
        _ = D_n * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by rw [h_pow_2]
    have h_term2 : (1 / R) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (k + 1) n g ≤ B' (k + 1) n * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
      have h_1R : 1 / R = (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        dsimp [R]
        rw [one_div, one_div, inv_pow]
      rw [h_1R]
      calc (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (k + 1) n g
        _ ≤ (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m * B' (k + 1) n :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hg_k1n (by positivity)
        _ = B' (k + 1) n * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := mul_comm _ _
    calc SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n g
      _ ≤ R ^ k * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n g + (1 / R) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ (k + 1) n g :=
        h_step_w
      _ ≤ D_n * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m + B' (k + 1) n * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m :=
        add_le_add h_term1 h_term2
      _ = C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by dsimp [C]; ring

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ n : ℕ) (B : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∀ x v : ℝ, |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v| ≤ B j) →
      ∀ (K k : ℕ), k ≤ K → ∀ (x : ℝ),
        ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x‖ ≤
          2 * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * B j * schwartzTierNorm K (n - j) w

signature.name: greenIterKernel_diag_iteratedDeriv_succ_tier_bound
signature.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ n : ℕ) (B : ℕ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), ∀ x v : ℝ, |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v| ≤ B j) →
      ∀ (K k : ℕ), k ≤ K → ∀ (x : ℝ),
        ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x‖ ≤
          2 * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * B j * schwartzTierNorm K (n - j) w

proof.tactics:
by
  intro κ hκ w ℓ n B hB K k hkK x
  have hκ1 : 1 ≤ κ := by linarith
  have h_lt_top : ∀ d : ℕ, (d : WithTop ℕ∞) < (⊤ : ℕ∞) :=
    fun d => WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mpr (WithTop.coe_lt_top d)
  have h_le_top : ∀ d : ℕ, (d : WithTop ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) :=
    fun d => le_of_lt (h_lt_top d)
  have h_sg_smooth : ∀ v : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x' => shiftedGreenIter κ w ℓ x' v) :=
    (shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrence κ hκ1 w).1 ℓ
  have h_off_d1 : ∀ (m : ℕ) (a y : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun y' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a y')
        (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a y) y :=
    (greenIterKernel_offDiag_hasDerivAt_and_symm κ hκ1 w).2.1
  have h_fg1_int : Integrable (freeGreenKernel 1 0) volume :=
    (freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds 1 le_rfl).1.1.2.1
  have h_diag_deriv : deriv (fun y' => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y' y') =
      fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) y y := by
    ext y
    exact (greenIterKernel_diag_hasDerivAt κ hκ1 w ℓ y).deriv
  have h_fderiv_eq :
      ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ (n + 1) (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x‖ =
        |iteratedDeriv n (fun y => 2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) y y) x| := by
    rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, Real.norm_eq_abs, iteratedDeriv_succ', h_diag_deriv]
  have h_fg1_eq : ∀ v : ℝ, freeGreenKernel 1 0 v = (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-|v|) := by
    intro v
    dsimp [freeGreenKernel]
    rw [zero_sub, abs_neg, mul_one, neg_one_mul]
  have h_fg1_nn : ∀ v : ℝ, 0 ≤ freeGreenKernel 1 0 v := by
    intro v
    rw [h_fg1_eq]
    positivity
  have h_fg1_int_eq : (∫ v : ℝ, freeGreenKernel 1 0 v) = 1 := by
    rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_Iic_add_Ioi h_fg1_int.integrableOn h_fg1_int.integrableOn]
    have h_iic : (∫ v in Set.Iic (0 : ℝ), freeGreenKernel 1 0 v) = 1 / 2 := by
      have h_congr : Set.EqOn (freeGreenKernel 1 0) (fun v : ℝ => (1 / 2) * Real.exp v) (Set.Iic 0) := by
        intro v hv
        dsimp only []
        rw [h_fg1_eq, abs_of_nonpos hv, neg_neg]
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic h_congr,
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, integral_exp_Iic_zero, mul_one]
    have h_ioi : (∫ v in Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ), freeGreenKernel 1 0 v) = 1 / 2 := by
      have h_congr : Set.EqOn (freeGreenKernel 1 0) (fun v : ℝ => (1 / 2) * Real.exp (-1 * v)) (Set.Ioi 0) := by
        intro v hv
        dsimp only []
        rw [h_fg1_eq, abs_of_pos hv, neg_one_mul]
      rw [MeasureTheory.setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Ioi h_congr,
          MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul, @integral_exp_mul_Ioi (-1) (by norm_num) 0]
      norm_num
    rw [h_iic, h_ioi]
    norm_num
  have h_fgd_shift : ∀ y v : ℝ, freeGreenDerivY κ (y + v) y = freeGreenDerivY κ v 0 := by
    intro y v
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
    have h1 : (y + v < y) ↔ (v < 0) := by constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    have h2 : (y < y + v) ↔ (0 < v) := by constructor <;> intro h <;> linarith
    have h3 : y - (y + v) = 0 - v := by ring
    have h4 : (y + v) - y = v - 0 := by ring
    simp only [h1, h2, h3, h4]
  have h_fgd_meas : Measurable (fun v : ℝ => freeGreenDerivY κ v 0) := by
    unfold freeGreenDerivY
    refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_id measurable_const) ?_ ?_
    · fun_prop
    · refine Measurable.ite (measurableSet_lt measurable_const measurable_id) ?_ measurable_const
      fun_prop
  have h_fgd_le_exp : ∀ v : ℝ, |freeGreenDerivY κ v 0| ≤ freeGreenKernel 1 0 v * Real.exp (-|v|) := by
    intro v
    rw [h_fg1_eq, mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add]
    dsimp [freeGreenDerivY]
    split_ifs with hv1 hv2
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_neg, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2),
          abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (by norm_num)
      rw [abs_of_neg hv1]
      nlinarith
    · rw [abs_mul, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 1 / 2),
          abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr ?_) (by norm_num)
      rw [abs_of_pos hv2]
      nlinarith
    · rw [abs_zero]
      positivity
  have h_fgd_le_fg1 : ∀ v : ℝ, |freeGreenDerivY κ v 0| ≤ freeGreenKernel 1 0 v := by
    intro v
    have h_exp_le1 : Real.exp (-|v|) ≤ 1 :=
      Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (neg_nonpos.mpr (abs_nonneg v))
    calc |freeGreenDerivY κ v 0|
      _ ≤ freeGreenKernel 1 0 v * Real.exp (-|v|) := h_fgd_le_exp v
      _ ≤ freeGreenKernel 1 0 v * 1 := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_exp_le1 (h_fg1_nn v)
      _ = freeGreenKernel 1 0 v := mul_one _
  have h_pow_fgd : ∀ (r : ℕ) (v : ℝ),
      ‖v‖ ^ r * |freeGreenDerivY κ v 0| ≤ (Nat.factorial r : ℝ) * freeGreenKernel 1 0 v := by
    intro r v
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    have h1 : |v| ^ r / (Nat.factorial r : ℝ) ≤ Real.exp |v| :=
      Real.pow_div_factorial_le_exp |v| (abs_nonneg v) r
    have h2 : |v| ^ r ≤ Real.exp |v| * (Nat.factorial r : ℝ) :=
      (div_le_iff₀ (Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos r))).mp h1
    have h_exp_cancel : Real.exp |v| * Real.exp (-|v|) = 1 := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add, add_neg_cancel, Real.exp_zero]
    calc |v| ^ r * |freeGreenDerivY κ v 0|
      _ ≤ (Real.exp |v| * (Nat.factorial r : ℝ)) * (freeGreenKernel 1 0 v * Real.exp (-|v|)) :=
        mul_le_mul h2 (h_fgd_le_exp v) (abs_nonneg _) (by positivity)
      _ = (Nat.factorial r : ℝ) * freeGreenKernel 1 0 v * (Real.exp |v| * Real.exp (-|v|)) := by ring
      _ = (Nat.factorial r : ℝ) * freeGreenKernel 1 0 v := by rw [h_exp_cancel, mul_one]
  have h_sg0_cont : ∀ x' : ℝ, Continuous (fun v : ℝ => shiftedGreenIter κ w ℓ x' v) := by
    intro x'
    cases ℓ with
    | zero =>
      change Continuous (fun v : ℝ => freeGreenKernel κ x' (x' + v))
      unfold freeGreenKernel
      fun_prop
    | succ m =>
      have h_diff : Differentiable ℝ (fun y : ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) x' y) :=
        fun y => (h_off_d1 m x' y).differentiableAt
      exact h_diff.continuous.comp (continuous_const.add continuous_id)
  have h_sg_meas : ∀ (j : ℕ) (x' : ℝ),
      AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x' v) volume := by
    intro j
    induction j with
    | zero =>
      intro x'
      change AEStronglyMeasurable (fun v : ℝ => shiftedGreenIter κ w ℓ x' v) volume
      exact (h_sg0_cont x').aestronglyMeasurable
    | succ j ih =>
      intro x'
      let h : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => 1 / ((m : ℝ) + 1)
      have hh_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto h Filter.atTop (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) := by
        rw [tendsto_nhdsWithin_iff]
        refine ⟨tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat, Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun m => ?_⟩
        rw [Set.mem_Ioi]
        dsimp [h]
        positivity
      let f_seq : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m v =>
        (h m)⁻¹ • (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j (x' + h m) v - shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x' v)
      have hf_meas : ∀ m : ℕ, AEStronglyMeasurable (f_seq m) volume := by
        intro m
        exact ((ih (x' + h m)).sub (ih x')).const_smul (h m)⁻¹
      have hf_lim : ∀ v : ℝ, Filter.Tendsto (fun m => f_seq m v) Filter.atTop
          (nhds (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ (j + 1) x' v)) := by
        intro v
        have hd : HasDerivAt (fun z => shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j z v)
            (shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ (j + 1) x' v) x' := by
          change HasDerivAt (iteratedDeriv j (fun z => shiftedGreenIter κ w ℓ z v))
            (iteratedDeriv (j + 1) (fun z => shiftedGreenIter κ w ℓ z v) x') x'
          rw [iteratedDeriv_succ]
          exact ((h_sg_smooth v).differentiable_iteratedDeriv j (h_lt_top j) x').hasDerivAt
        exact hd.tendsto_slope_zero_right.comp hh_tendsto
      exact aestronglyMeasurable_of_tendsto_ae Filter.atTop hf_meas (Filter.Eventually.of_forall hf_lim)
  let P : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun y v => shiftedGreenIter κ w ℓ y v * w (y + v)

            |-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0| := by
    calc |∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0)|
      _ ≤ ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          |(Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0)| :=
        Finset.abs_sum_le_sum_abs _ _
      _ = ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            |-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0| := by
        refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
        rw [abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _)]
  calc ‖x‖ ^ k * (2 * |∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
            iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0)|)
    _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ k * (2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          |-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
            iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0|) := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by positivity)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_abs (by norm_num)
    _ = 2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (‖x‖ ^ k * |-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
            iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0|) := by
      have h_comm : ‖x‖ ^ k * (2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            |-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0|) =
          2 * (‖x‖ ^ k * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
            |-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w ℓ j x v *
              iteratedDeriv (n - j) w (x + v) * freeGreenDerivY κ v 0|) := by ring
      rw [h_comm, Finset.mul_sum]
      congr 1
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring
    _ ≤ 2 * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
        (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * ((Nat.factorial K : ℝ) * B j * schwartzTierNorm K (n - j) w) := by
      refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (by norm_num)
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun j hj => ?_
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_term_bound j hj) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = 2 * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) *
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * B j * schwartzTierNorm K (n - j) w := by
      rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
      refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => ?_
      ring

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      ‖ι g‖ ≤ 4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g)) →

          2 * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) *
            ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
              (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * B j * schwartzTierNorm K (n - j) w) →
    ∀ (δ' : ℝ), 0 < δ' → δ' ≤ 1 / 512 →
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
        (∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), 2 * δ' ≤ ‖ι q‖ → regTruncatedVec δ' κ q = 0) →

                (∀ m < n, schwartzTierNorm K m q ≤ M m) →
                schwartzTierNorm K n (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q) ≤
                  A * schwartzTierNorm K n q + B

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_iter_eq : ∀ (m : ℕ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      iteratedDeriv m (f : ℝ → ℝ) = (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[m] f) : ℝ → ℝ) := by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro f
      ext y
      rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, Function.iterate_zero_apply]
    | succ m ih =>
      intro f
      ext y
      rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih f, ← SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ _ y,
        ← Function.iterate_succ_apply' (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ) m f]
  have h_s1 : (∀ (K n : ℕ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), 0 ≤ schwartzTierNorm K n q) ∧
      (∀ (K n : ℕ), schwartzTierNorm K n (0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) = 0) ∧
      (∀ (δ' κ : ℝ) (K n : ℕ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        schwartzTierNorm K n (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q) ≤
          schwartzTierNorm K n (regMovingFrameVec κ q)) ∧
      ((∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
          ‖ι g‖ ≤ 4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g)) →
        ∀ (K i : ℕ), 2 ≤ K → ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
          ‖ι (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[i]) q)‖ ≤ 8 * schwartzTierNorm K i q) := by
    refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
    · intro K n q
      unfold schwartzTierNorm
      exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n) q)
    · intro K n
      unfold schwartzTierNorm
      exact Finset.sum_eq_zero (fun p _ => map_zero (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n))
    · intro δ' κ K n q
      have h_cut_nn : 0 ≤ regCutoff δ' ‖ι q‖ := le_max_left 0 _
      have h_cut_le : regCutoff δ' ‖ι q‖ ≤ 1 :=
        max_le zero_le_one (min_le_left 1 _)
      have h_norm_cut : ‖regCutoff δ' ‖ι q‖‖ ≤ 1 := by
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_nonneg h_cut_nn]
        exact h_cut_le
      unfold schwartzTierNorm regTruncatedVec
      refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun p _ => ?_)
      rw [map_smul_eq_mul]
      calc ‖regCutoff δ' ‖ι q‖‖ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n (regMovingFrameVec κ q)
        _ ≤ 1 * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n (regMovingFrameVec κ q) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h_norm_cut (apply_nonneg _ _)
        _ = SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n (regMovingFrameVec κ q) := one_mul _
    · intro h_iota_le K i hK q
      have h_semi_le : ∀ p ≤ K,
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p 0 (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[i]) q) ≤
            schwartzTierNorm K i q := by
        intro p hp
        have h1 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p 0 (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[i]) q) ≤
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p i q := by
          refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound' ℝ p 0 (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[i]) q)
            (apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p i) q) (fun x => ?_)
          rw [iteratedDeriv_zero, ← h_iter_eq i q]
          exact SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ p i q x
        have hp_mem : p ∈ Finset.range (K + 1) := Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le hp)
        have h2 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p i q ≤ schwartzTierNorm K i q :=
          Finset.single_le_sum (fun m _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ m i) q) hp_mem
        exact le_trans h1 h2
      have h0 := h_semi_le 0 (Nat.zero_le K)
      have h2 := h_semi_le 2 hK
      have hiota := h_iota_le (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[i]) q)
      linarith
  have h_s2 : ∀ (n : ℕ) (M : ℕ → ℝ),
      ∃ (A₀ B₀ : ℝ), 0 ≤ A₀ ∧ 0 ≤ B₀ ∧
        ∀ (r T : ℕ → ℝ),
          (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ r i) →
          r 0 ≤ 1 / 2 →
          (∀ i : ℕ, r i ≤ 8 * T i) →
          (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ T i) →
          (∀ m < n, T m ≤ M m) →
          (∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ j)) ∧
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r ℓ j) * T (n - j) ≤
            A₀ * T n + B₀ := by
    intro n M
    have h_step_sum : ∀ (a R : ℕ → ℝ),
        (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ a m) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, 0 ≤ R m) →
        (∀ m : ℕ, a (m + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * a m + R m) →
        Summable R →
        Summable a ∧ (∑' m : ℕ, a m) ≤ 2 * a 0 + 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, R m := by
      intro a R ha_nn hR_nn h_le hR_sum
      have h_range_le : ∀ N : ℕ, ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m ≤ 2 * a 0 + 2 * ∑' m : ℕ, R m := by
        intro N
        have h_shift : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m + a N = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1) + a 0 := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_range_succ, ← Finset.sum_range_succ']
        have haN : 0 ≤ a N := ha_nn N
        have h_sum_step : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1) ≤
            (1 / 2) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m := by
          calc ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a (m + 1)
            _ ≤ ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, ((1 / 2) * a m + R m) :=
              Finset.sum_le_sum (fun m _ => h_le m)
            _ = (1 / 2) * (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, a m) + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m := by
              rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum]
        have hR_bound : ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, R m ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, R m :=
          hR_sum.sum_le_tsum (Finset.range N) (fun m _ => hR_nn m)
        linarith
      exact ⟨summable_of_sum_range_le ha_nn h_range_le, Real.tsum_le_of_sum_range_le ha_nn h_range_le⟩
    have h_nn : ∀ (s : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ s i) →
        ∀ ℓ j : ℕ, 0 ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ j := by
      intro s hs_nn ℓ
      induction ℓ with
      | zero =>
        intro j
        rcases j with _ | j
        · exact zero_le_one
        · exact le_rfl
      | succ ℓ ih =>
        intro j
        change 0 ≤ ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
          (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ i)
        exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
          mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hs_nn _) (ih i)))
    have h_sum_bound : ∀ (s : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ s i) → s 0 ≤ 1 / 2 →
        ∀ j : ℕ, Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ j) ∧
          (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ j) ≤
            2 * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s 0 j +
            2 * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j,
              (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s (j - i) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ i) := by
      intro s hs_nn hs0 j
      induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
      | h j ih =>
        let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ => shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ j
        let R : ℕ → ℝ := fun ℓ =>
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j,
            (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ i)
        have ha_nn : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 0 ≤ a ℓ := fun ℓ => h_nn s hs_nn ℓ j
        have hR_nn : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, 0 ≤ R ℓ := fun ℓ =>
          Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ =>
            mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg _) (mul_nonneg (hs_nn _) (h_nn s hs_nn ℓ i)))
        have h_le : ∀ ℓ : ℕ, a (ℓ + 1) ≤ (1 / 2) * a ℓ + R ℓ := by
          intro ℓ
          have h_eq : a (ℓ + 1) = R ℓ + (Nat.choose j j : ℝ) * (s (j - j) * a ℓ) := by
            change ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
                (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ i) =
              R ℓ + (Nat.choose j j : ℝ) * (s (j - j) * a ℓ)
            exact Finset.sum_range_succ _ j
          rw [Nat.choose_self, Nat.cast_one, one_mul, Nat.sub_self] at h_eq
          have hs0_mul : s 0 * a ℓ ≤ (1 / 2) * a ℓ :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hs0 (ha_nn ℓ)
          linarith
        have h_term_sum : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range j,
            Summable (fun ℓ : ℕ => (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ i)) := by
          intro i hi
          exact (((ih i (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)).1).mul_left (s (j - i))).mul_left (Nat.choose j i : ℝ)
        have hR_sum : Summable R := summable_sum h_term_sum
        obtain ⟨ha_sum, ha_tsum⟩ := h_step_sum a R ha_nn hR_nn h_le hR_sum
        refine ⟨ha_sum, ?_⟩
        have hR_tsum : (∑' ℓ : ℕ, R ℓ) =
            ∑ i ∈ Finset.range j,
              (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s (j - i) * ∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq s ℓ i) := by
          dsimp [R]
          rw [Summable.tsum_finsetSum h_term_sum]
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ => ?_)
          rw [tsum_mul_left, tsum_mul_left]
        linarith
    have h_mono : ∀ (s₁ s₂ : ℕ → ℝ) (N : ℕ),
        (∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ s₁ i) →
        (∀ i ≤ N, s₁ i ≤ s₂ i) →
        ∀ (ℓ j : ℕ), j ≤ N → shiftedGreenBoundSeq s₁ ℓ j ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq s₂ ℓ j := by
      intro s₁ s₂ N hs₁_nn hs_le ℓ
      induction ℓ with
      | zero =>
        intro j _
        rcases j with _ | j <;> exact le_rfl
      | succ ℓ ih =>
        intro j hj
        change ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
            (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s₁ (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s₁ ℓ i) ≤
          ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (j + 1),
            (Nat.choose j i : ℝ) * (s₂ (j - i) * shiftedGreenBoundSeq s₂ ℓ i)
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i hi => ?_)
        have hi_le_j : i ≤ j := Nat.lt_succ_iff.mp (Finset.mem_range.mp hi)
        have hi_le_N : i ≤ N := le_trans hi_le_j hj
        have hji_le_N : j - i ≤ N := le_trans (Nat.sub_le j i) hj
        have h1 : s₁ (j - i) ≤ s₂ (j - i) := hs_le (j - i) hji_le_N
        have h2 : shiftedGreenBoundSeq s₁ ℓ i ≤ shiftedGreenBoundSeq s₂ ℓ i := ih i hi_le_N
        have hs₂_nn : 0 ≤ s₂ (j - i) := le_trans (hs₁_nn (j - i)) h1
        refine mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ?_ (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
        exact mul_le_mul h1 h2 (h_nn s₁ hs₁_nn ℓ i) hs₂_nn
    let M' : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => max (M i) 0
    have hM'_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ M' i := fun i => le_max_right (M i) 0
    let r_max : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if i = 0 then 1 / 2 else 8 * M' i
    have hr_max_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ r_max i := by
      intro i
      dsimp [r_max]
      split_ifs
      · norm_num
      · exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hM'_nn i)
    have hr_max_0 : r_max 0 ≤ 1 / 2 := by

      calc ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n ((16 * κ ^ 5) • SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g_tilde)
        _ = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
              (16 * κ ^ 5) * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ g_tilde) := by
          refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun k _ => ?_)
          rw [map_smul_eq_mul, h_norm_c]
        _ ≤ ∑ _k ∈ Finset.range (K + 1),
              (16 * κ ^ 5) * (2 * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) * S_sum) := by
          refine Finset.sum_le_sum (fun k hk => ?_)
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_semi_deriv k hk) (by positivity)
        _ = ((K : ℝ) + 1) * ((16 * κ ^ 5) * (2 * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) * S_sum)) := by
          rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
        _ = 32 * κ ^ 5 * (K + 1 : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ) * S_sum := by ring
    · rw [h_s1.2.1 K n]
      exact mul_nonneg (by positivity) hS_sum_nn
  intro h_iota_le h_iter_bound δ' hδ'_pos hδ'_le κ hκ h_vanish K n hK M
  obtain ⟨h_tier_nn, h_tier_zero, h_cut_le, h_iota_tier⟩ := h_s1
  obtain ⟨A₀, B₀, hA₀_nn, hB₀_nn, h_seq_growth⟩ := h_s2 n M
  let C_pref : ℝ := 32 * κ ^ 5 * (K + 1 : ℝ) * (Nat.factorial K : ℝ)
  have hC_pref_nn : 0 ≤ C_pref := by
    dsimp [C_pref]
    positivity
  refine ⟨C_pref * A₀, C_pref * B₀, mul_nonneg hC_pref_nn hA₀_nn, mul_nonneg hC_pref_nn hB₀_nn, ?_⟩
  intro q hq_low
  rcases le_or_gt (2 * δ') ‖ι q‖ with h_ge | h_lt
  · rw [h_vanish q h_ge, h_tier_zero K n]
    have h1 : 0 ≤ C_pref * A₀ * schwartzTierNorm K n q :=
      mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hC_pref_nn hA₀_nn) (h_tier_nn K n q)
    have h2 : 0 ≤ C_pref * B₀ := mul_nonneg hC_pref_nn hB₀_nn
    linarith
  · have hq_half : ‖ι q‖ ≤ 1 / 2 := by linarith
    let r_q : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => ‖ι (((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[i]) q)‖
    let T_q : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => schwartzTierNorm K i q
    have hr_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ r_q i := fun _ => norm_nonneg _
    have hr0 : r_q 0 ≤ 1 / 2 := by
      simpa [r_q] using hq_half
    have hr_T : ∀ i : ℕ, r_q i ≤ 8 * T_q i :=
      fun i => h_iota_tier h_iota_le K i hK q
    have hT_nn : ∀ i : ℕ, 0 ≤ T_q i :=
      fun i => h_tier_nn K i q
    obtain ⟨h_sum_rq, h_sum_le⟩ :=
      h_seq_growth r_q T_q hr_nn hr0 hr_T hT_nn hq_low
    have h_mf := h_s3 h_iter_bound κ hκ q hq_half h_sum_rq K n
    have h_tr := h_cut_le δ' κ K n q
    calc schwartzTierNorm K n (regTruncatedVec δ' κ q)
      _ ≤ schwartzTierNorm K n (regMovingFrameVec κ q) := h_tr
      _ ≤ C_pref * ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) * (∑' ℓ : ℕ, shiftedGreenBoundSeq r_q ℓ j) * T_q (n - j) := h_mf
      _ ≤ C_pref * (A₀ * T_q n + B₀) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_sum_le hC_pref_nn
      _ = C_pref * A₀ * schwartzTierNorm K n q + C_pref * B₀ := by
        dsimp [T_q]
        ring

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_iterates_weighted_deriv_summable
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x v *
            ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) →
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ B : ℕ → ℝ, Summable B ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, |shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m n x u| ≤ B m) →
    ∀ (k n : ℕ), ∃ U : ℕ → ℝ, Summable U ∧
      ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) y y) x‖ ≤ U m

subgoal_signatures.name: freeGreenKernel_h1Kappa_step_bounds
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ →
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (freeGreenKernel κ 0)) ≤ 1) ∧
    (IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun _ : ℝ => 0)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ f : ℝ → ℝ, IsGoodGreenProfile κ f → ∀ u : ℝ, |f u| ≤ Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (W : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ) (f : ℝ → ℝ), IsGoodGreenProfile κ f →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => -∫ v : ℝ, f v * W (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u)) ≤
        ‖ι W‖ * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ f)) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (c : ℕ → ℝ) (F : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ),
      (∀ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), 0 ≤ c j ∧ IsGoodGreenProfile κ (F j)) →
      IsGoodGreenProfile κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u) ∧
      Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (fun u => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * F j u)) ≤
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), c j * Real.sqrt (h1KappaNormSq κ (F j)))

subgoal_signatures.name: shiftedGreenIter_smooth_and_leibniz_recurrence
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
    (∀ m : ℕ, ∀ u : ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) (fun x => shiftedGreenIter κ w m x u)) ∧
    (∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 0 x u = freeGreenKernel κ 0 u) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w 0 (n + 1) x u = 0) ∧
    (∀ m n : ℕ, ∀ x u : ℝ,
      shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w (m + 1) n x u =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Nat.choose n j : ℝ) *
          (-∫ v : ℝ, shiftedGreenIterDeriv κ w m j x v *
            ((SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ)^[n - j] w) (x + v) * freeGreenKernel κ v u))

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Continuous G →
      ∃ W : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        Continuous W ∧
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W t) x =
            iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) ∧
        (∀ (K n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
          schwartzTierNorm K n (W t) ≤
            schwartzTierNorm K n w₀ +
              |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, schwartzTierNorm K n (G τ)|)) ∧
    (∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G₁ G₂ W₁ W₂ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Continuous G₁ → Continuous G₂ →

        iteratedDeriv n (W₁ t) x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ) x) →
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (W₂ t) x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ) x) →
      ∀ (t : ℝ),
        ‖ι (W₁ t - W₂ t)‖ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ι (G₁ τ - G₂ τ)‖|)

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (f - g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = iteratedDeriv n f x - iteratedDeriv n g x := by
    intro f g n x
    exact iteratedDeriv_sub ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) ((g.smooth n).contDiffAt)
  have h_iter_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (c • f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = c * iteratedDeriv n f x := by
    intro c f n x
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using iteratedDeriv_const_smul ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) c
  have h_iter_zero : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), iteratedDeriv n (0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = 0 := by
    intro n x
    simpa using h_iter_smul 0 (0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) n x
  have h_semi_cont : ∀ (k n : ℕ), Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n f) := by
    intro k n
    change Continuous (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    rw [← SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
    exact (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, n)
  have h_eval_cont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => iteratedDeriv n f x) := by
    intro n x
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro f
    rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    have h_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (g - f)) (nhds f) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_c : Continuous (fun g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (g - f)) :=
        (h_semi_cont 0 n).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
      simpa [sub_self, map_zero] using (h_c.continuousAt (x := f)).tendsto
    refine squeeze_zero (fun g => dist_nonneg) (fun g => ?_) h_zero
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← h_iter_sub g f n x]
    simpa [pow_zero, one_mul] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 n (g - f) x
  have h_s1 : ∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Continuous G → ∀ (t : ℝ),
      ∃ wt : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n wt x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x := by
    intro w₀ G hG t
    let I : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun n x => ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x
    have hI_deriv : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x₀ : ℝ), HasDerivAt (I n) (I (n + 1) x₀) x₀ := by
      intro n x₀
      let F : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x τ => iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x
      let F' : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ := fun x τ => iteratedDeriv (n + 1) (G τ) x
      let bound : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 (n + 1) (G τ)
      have h1 : (Set.univ : Set ℝ) ∈ nhds x₀ := Filter.univ_mem
      have h2 : ∀ᶠ (x : ℝ) in nhds x₀,
          AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 t)) :=
        Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x =>
          ((h_eval_cont n x).comp hG).aestronglyMeasurable
      have h3 : IntervalIntegrable (F x₀) volume 0 t :=
        ((h_eval_cont n x₀).comp hG).intervalIntegrable 0 t
      have h4 : AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) (volume.restrict (Set.uIoc 0 t)) :=
        ((h_eval_cont (n + 1) x₀).comp hG).aestronglyMeasurable
      have h5 : ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ) ∂volume, τ ∈ Set.uIoc 0 t → ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
          ‖F' x τ‖ ≤ bound τ := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ _ x _ => ?_)
        simpa [F', bound, pow_zero, one_mul] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 (n + 1) (G τ) x
      have h6 : IntervalIntegrable bound volume 0 t :=
        ((h_semi_cont 0 (n + 1)).comp hG).intervalIntegrable 0 t
      have h7 : ∀ᵐ (τ : ℝ) ∂volume, τ ∈ Set.uIoc 0 t → ∀ x ∈ (Set.univ : Set ℝ),
          HasDerivAt (fun x => F x τ) (F' x τ) x := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ _ x _ => ?_)
        have h_diff : DifferentiableAt ℝ (iteratedDeriv n (G τ)) x :=
          (((G τ).smooth (n + 1)).differentiable_iteratedDeriv n (by norm_cast; omega)).differentiableAt
        have hd := h_diff.hasDerivAt
        rw [← iteratedDeriv_succ] at hd
        exact hd
      exact (intervalIntegral.hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7).2
    have hI_iter : ∀ n : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (I 0) = I n := by
      intro n
      induction n with
      | zero =>
        rw [iteratedDeriv_zero]
      | succ n ih =>
        ext x
        rw [iteratedDeriv_succ, ih]
        exact (hI_deriv n x).deriv
    have hI0_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (I 0) := by
      refine contDiff_of_differentiable_iteratedDeriv (fun m _ => ?_)
      rw [hI_iter m]
      exact fun x => (hI_deriv m x).differentiableAt
    let f_wt : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => w₀ x + I 0 x
    have hf_wt_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) f_wt :=
      (w₀.smooth ⊤).add hI0_smooth
    have hf_wt_iter : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n f_wt x = iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + I n x := by
      intro n x
      have h_I0_n : ContDiff ℝ n (I 0) := hI0_smooth.of_le (WithTop.coe_le_coe.mpr le_top)
      have h_add : iteratedDeriv n (fun y => w₀ y + I 0 y) x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + iteratedDeriv n (I 0) x :=
        iteratedDeriv_add ((w₀.smooth n).contDiffAt) (h_I0_n.contDiffAt)
      simpa [f_wt, hI_iter n] using h_add
    have hf_wt_decay : ∀ (k n : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ (x : ℝ),
        ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n f_wt x‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k n
      let g_kn : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (G τ)
      have hg_kn_int : IntervalIntegrable g_kn volume 0 t :=
        ((h_semi_cont k n).comp hG).intervalIntegrable 0 t
      refine ⟨SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n w₀ + |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, g_kn τ|, fun x => ?_⟩
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv, hf_wt_iter n x]
      have h_tri : ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + I n x‖ ≤
          ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n w₀ x‖ + ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖I n x‖ := by
        calc ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + I n x‖
          _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ k * (‖iteratedDeriv n w₀ x‖ + ‖I n x‖) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (norm_add_le _ _) (by positivity)
          _ = ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n w₀ x‖ + ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖I n x‖ := mul_add _ _ _
      have h_w0 : ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedDeriv n w₀ x‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n w₀ :=
        SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ k n w₀ x
      have h_In : ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖I n x‖ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, g_kn τ| := by
        have h_pull : ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖I n x‖ =
            ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖x‖ ^ k * iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x‖ := by
          change ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x‖ =
            ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖x‖ ^ k * iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x‖
          rw [intervalIntegral.integral_const_mul, norm_mul,
              Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) k)]
        rw [h_pull]
        refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_abs_of_norm_le ?_ hg_kn_int
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun τ => ?_)
        rw [norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (pow_nonneg (norm_nonneg x) k)]
        exact SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ k n (G τ) x
      linarith
    let wt : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.mk f_wt hf_wt_smooth hf_wt_decay
    refine ⟨wt, fun n x => ?_⟩
    exact hf_wt_iter n x
  have h_s2 : ∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w G : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      Continuous G →
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (w t) x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) →
      w 0 = w₀ ∧ (∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (G s) s) ∧ Continuous w := by
    intro w₀ w G hG h_int
    have hw0 : w 0 = w₀ := by
      ext x
      have h0 := h_int 0 0 x
      simp only [iteratedDeriv_zero, intervalIntegral.integral_same, add_zero] at h0
      exact h0
    have hw_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt w (G s) s := by
      intro s
      rw [hasDerivAt_iff_hasFDerivAt]
      apply HasFDerivAtFilter.of_isLittleOTVS
      have h_ev : ∀ᶠ s' : ℝ in nhds s,
          s' - s = 0 →
          w s' - w s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (G s)) (s' - s) = 0 := by
        refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun s' hs' => ?_)
        have h_eq : s' = s := sub_eq_zero.mp hs'
        subst h_eq
        simp
      rw [Asymptotics.isLittleOTVS_iff_tendsto_inv_smul h_ev]
      let R : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s' =>
        (s' - s)⁻¹ • (w s' - w s - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ (G s)) (s' - s))
      change Filter.Tendsto R (nhds s) (nhds 0)
      rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds R 0]
      rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
      rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
      have h_p_cont : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (G τ - G s)) :=
        (h_semi_cont k n).comp (hG.sub continuous_const)
      have h_p_zero : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (G s - G s) = 0 := by
        rw [sub_self, map_zero]
      obtain ⟨η, hη, h_close⟩ :=
        Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp (h_p_cont.continuousAt (x := s)) (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
      filter_upwards [Metric.ball_mem_nhds s hη] with s' hs'_ball
      rw [sub_zero]
      by_cases hs' : s' = s
      · subst hs'
        simp [R, hε]
      · have h_le_half : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (R s') ≤ ε / 2 := by
          refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound' ℝ k n (R s') (by positivity) (fun x => ?_)
          have h_int_0_s : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) volume 0 s :=
            ((h_eval_cont n x).comp hG).intervalIntegrable 0 s
          have h_int_s_s' : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) volume s s' :=
            ((h_eval_cont n x).comp hG).intervalIntegrable s s'
