    have h_sq_le : ‖toHm1 q‖ ^ 2 ≤ ‖L q‖ ^ 2 := by
      rw [← h_Iq_eq]
      linarith [h_norm_sq, h_int_le, h_C_sq]
    have h_sqrt := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt h_sq_le
    rwa [Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)] at h_sqrt
  have h_cont_toHm1 : Continuous toHm1 := by
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro q₀
    rw [ContinuousAt, Metric.tendsto_nhds]
    intro ε hε
    have hL : ∀ᶠ q in nhds q₀, dist (L q) (L q₀) < ε :=
      Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp L.continuous.continuousAt ε hε
    refine hL.mono (fun q hq => ?_)
    have h_dist_le : dist (toHm1 q) (toHm1 q₀) ≤ dist (L q) (L q₀) := by
      rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, ← h_toHm1_sub q q₀, ← map_sub L q q₀]
      exact h_norm_le (q - q₀)
    exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_dist_le hq
  have h_toHm1_deriv : ∀ (w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt w v t → HasDerivAt (fun s => toHm1 (w s)) (toHm1 v) t := by
    intro w v t hw
    rw [hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto]
    have h_inv_smul : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (w s - w t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (s - t)))
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) :=
      hw.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
    have h_norm_cont : Continuous (fun q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => ‖L q‖) :=
      continuous_norm.comp L.continuous
    have h_upper_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto
        (fun s : ℝ => ‖L ((s - t)⁻¹ • (w s - w t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (s - t)))‖)
        (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using (h_norm_cont.tendsto 0).comp h_inv_smul
    refine tendsto_of_tendsto_of_tendsto_of_le_of_le' tendsto_const_nhds h_upper_tendsto
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => by positivity)
      (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun s => ?_)
    dsimp only [Function.comp_apply]
    rw [ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply, map_smul, norm_smul, norm_inv]
    have h_rem_eq : toHm1 (w s) - toHm1 (w t) - (s - t) • toHm1 v = toHm1 (w s - w t - (s - t) • v) := by
      rw [h_toHm1_sub, h_toHm1_sub, h_toHm1_smul]
    rw [h_rem_eq]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_norm_le (w s - w t - (s - t) • v)) (by positivity)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro w₀ G hG
    let W : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun t => Classical.choose (h_s1 w₀ G hG t)
    have hW_int : ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (W t) x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x :=
      fun t => Classical.choose_spec (h_s1 w₀ G hG t)
    obtain ⟨_, _, hW_cont⟩ := h_s2 w₀ W G hG hW_int
    exact ⟨W, hW_cont, hW_int, h_s3 w₀ W G hG hW_int⟩
  · intro w₀ G₁ G₂ W₁ W₂ hG₁ hG₂ hW₁ hW₂ t
    let U : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => W₁ s - W₂ s
    let D : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => G₁ s - G₂ s
    have hD_cont : Continuous D := hG₁.sub hG₂
    have hU_int : ∀ (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (U s) x =
          iteratedDeriv n (0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (D τ) x := by
      intro s n x
      have h_int1 : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ) x) volume 0 s :=
        ((h_eval_cont n x).comp hG₁).intervalIntegrable 0 s
      have h_int2 : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ) x) volume 0 s :=
        ((h_eval_cont n x).comp hG₂).intervalIntegrable 0 s
      change iteratedDeriv n (W₁ s - W₂ s : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x =
        iteratedDeriv n (0 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ - G₂ τ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x
      rw [h_iter_sub, hW₁ s n x, hW₂ s n x, h_iter_zero n x, zero_add]
      have h_sub_eq : (iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ) x) -
          (iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ) x) =
          (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ) x) -
            (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..s, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ) x) := by ring
      rw [h_sub_eq, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int1 h_int2]
      refine intervalIntegral.integral_congr (fun τ _ => ?_)
      exact (h_iter_sub (G₁ τ) (G₂ τ) n x).symm
    obtain ⟨hU0, hU_deriv, hU_cont⟩ := h_s2 0 U D hD_cont hU_int
    let γ : ℝ → Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := fun s => toHm1 (U s)
    let γ' : ℝ → Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := fun s => toHm1 (D s)
    have hγ_cont : Continuous γ := h_cont_toHm1.comp hU_cont
    have hγ'_cont : Continuous γ' := h_cont_toHm1.comp hD_cont
    have hγ_deriv : ∀ s : ℝ, HasDerivAt γ (γ' s) s :=
      fun s => h_toHm1_deriv U (D s) s (hU_deriv s)
    have h_ftc : ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, γ' τ = γ t - γ 0 :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right
        hγ_cont.continuousOn
        (fun x _ => (hγ_deriv x).hasDerivWithinAt)
        (hγ'_cont.intervalIntegrable 0 t)
    have hγ0 : γ 0 = 0 := by
      dsimp [γ]
      rw [hU0, h_toHm1_zero]
    rw [hγ0, sub_zero] at h_ftc
    change ‖γ t‖ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖γ' τ‖|
    rw [← h_ftc]
    exact intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_abs_integral_norm

informal_problem.statement:
((∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        ‖ι g‖ ≤ 4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g)) ∧
      (∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
            (∀ p m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m g ≤ B p m) →
            ‖ι g‖ < η →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n g < ε) ∧
      (∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (C₀ L : ℝ), 0 ≤ C₀ → 0 ≤ L →
        ∀ (k n : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
            (∀ p j : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j g ≤ B p j) →
            ‖ι g‖ ≤ C₀ * L ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n g ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)) →
    ((∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        Continuous G →
        ∃ W : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          Continuous W ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
            iteratedDeriv n (W t) x =
              iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) ∧
          (∀ (K n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
            schwartzTierNorm K n (W t) ≤
              schwartzTierNorm K n w₀ +
                |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, schwartzTierNorm K n (G τ)|)) ∧
      (∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G₁ G₂ W₁ W₂ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        Continuous G₁ → Continuous G₂ →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W₁ t) x =
            iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ) x) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W₂ t) x =
            iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ) x) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ),
          ‖ι (W₁ t - W₂ t)‖ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ι (G₁ τ - G₂ τ)‖|)) →
    ∀ (V : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (M₀ L_lip : ℝ),
      0 ≤ M₀ → 0 ≤ L_lip →
      (∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (V q)‖ ≤ M₀) →
      (∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (V q₁) - ι (V q₂)‖ ≤ L_lip * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) →
      (∀ (K n : ℕ), 2 ≤ K →
        ∀ (M : ℕ → ℝ),
          ∃ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
            ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
              (∀ m < n, schwartzTierNorm K m q ≤ M m) →
              schwartzTierNorm K n (V q) ≤ A * schwartzTierNorm K n q + B) →
      ∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        ∃ w_tilde : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          Continuous (fun t : ℝ => V (w_tilde t)) ∧
          ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
            iteratedDeriv n (w_tilde t) x =
              iteratedDeriv n w₀ x +
                ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ)) x

  obtain ⟨w_tilde, hw_tilde_cont, hw_tilde_unif, hw_tilde_pt⟩ :=
    schwartz_telescoping_series_limit_curve w₀ w_seq hw_seq0 hw_seq_cont hw_seq_geom

by

      have h_conv_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w z) := by
        have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w z) =
            fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * y) * (∫ z in Set.Iic y, gL w z) +
              Real.exp (2 * y) * (∫ z in Set.Ioi y, gR w z) :=
          funext (h_exp_split w)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (-2 * y)).mul h_IL_cont).add
          ((by fun_prop : Continuous fun y : ℝ => Real.exp (2 * y)).mul h_IR_cont)
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun y : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w y * w z) := by
        have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w y * w z) =
            fun y : ℝ => w y * ∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * w z :=
          funext (hH_eq w)
        rw [h_eq]
        exact w.continuous.mul h_conv_cont
      refine (w.integrable.norm.mul_const (∫ z : ℝ, ‖w z‖)).mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
      refine Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun y => ?_
      rw [hH_eq w y, norm_mul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_int_bound w y) (norm_nonneg _)
    have h_sq_int : Integrable (fun y : ℝ => (f y) ^ 2) volume := by
      have h_eq : (fun y : ℝ => (f y) ^ 2) = (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f f : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        ext y
        have h_smul := SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply f.hasTemperateGrowth f y
        simpa [smul_eq_mul, sq] using h_smul.symm
      rw [h_eq]
      exact (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f f).integrable
    let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun y => f y * J y
    let G' : ℝ → ℝ := fun y =>
      (1 / 4) * (∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * f' y * f' z) +
        (∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * f y * f z) - (f y) ^ 2
    have hG_deriv : ∀ y : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (G' y) y := by
      intro y
      have hd_f : HasDerivAt (f : ℝ → ℝ) (f' y) y := by
        rw [SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply]
        exact f.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
      convert hd_f.mul (hJ_deriv y) using 1
      dsimp [G']
      rw [hJ_eq y, hH_eq f' y, hH_eq f y]
      ring
    have h_int12 : Integrable (fun y : ℝ =>
        (1 / 4) * (∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * f' y * f' z) +
          (∫ z : ℝ, Real.exp (-2 * |y - z|) * f y * f z)) volume :=
      ((hH_int f').const_mul (1 / 4)).add (hH_int f)
    have hG'_int : Integrable G' volume :=
      h_int12.sub h_sq_int
    have hG_cocompact : Filter.Tendsto G (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) := by
      have hf_zero : Filter.Tendsto (f : ℝ → ℝ) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) :=
        f.toZeroAtInfty.zero_at_infty'
      let M : ℝ := (1 / 4) * ∫ z : ℝ, ‖f' z‖
      have hf_bound : Filter.Tendsto (fun y : ℝ => ‖(f : ℝ → ℝ) y‖ * M) (Filter.cocompact ℝ) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using ((continuous_norm.tendsto (0 : ℝ)).comp hf_zero).mul_const M
      refine squeeze_zero_norm (fun y => ?_) hf_bound
      change ‖f y * J y‖ ≤ ‖f y‖ * ((1 / 4) * ∫ z : ℝ, ‖f' z‖)
      rw [norm_mul, hJ_eq y, norm_mul, Real.norm_of_nonneg (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 4)]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
        (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_exp_int_bound f' y) (by positivity)) (norm_nonneg _)
    have hG_atBot : Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atBot (nhds 0) :=
      hG_cocompact.mono_left (le_trans le_sup_left atBot_atTop_le_cocompact)
    have hG_atTop : Filter.Tendsto G Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
      hG_cocompact.mono_left (le_trans le_sup_right atBot_atTop_le_cocompact)
    have h_ftc_G := MeasureTheory.integral_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto hG_deriv hG'_int hG_atBot hG_atTop
    rw [sub_self] at h_ftc_G
    dsimp [G'] at h_ftc_G
    rw [integral_sub h_int12 h_sq_int,
        integral_add ((hH_int f').const_mul (1 / 4)) (hH_int f),
        integral_const_mul] at h_ftc_G
    have h_exp_f' := h_exp_hm1 f'
    have h_exp_f := h_exp_hm1 f
    have h_hm1_f_nn : 0 ≤ ‖ι f‖ ^ 2 := sq_nonneg _
    linarith
  refine ⟨fun f g => ⟨h_iota_add f g, h_iota_sub f g⟩, h_iota_smul, h_iota_l1, h_iota_deriv,
    inner_iota_derivCLM_self_eq_zero, h_deriv_l2⟩

(h_iota_add_sub : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ι (f + g) = ι f + ι g ∧ ι (f - g) = ι f - ι g)
    (h_iota_smul : ∀ (c : ℝ) (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ι (c • f) = c • ι f)
    (h_iota_l1 : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι f‖ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, |f x|)
    (h_iota_deriv : ∀ (w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (t : ℝ), HasDerivAt w v t → HasDerivAt (fun s => ι (w s)) (ι v) t) :
    (∀ (w : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (K : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ t : ℝ, ∃ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), HasDerivAt w v t) →
      (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, K t x = kdvRHS (w t) x) →
      (∀ τ : ℝ, ∃ M_K : ℝ, 0 ≤ M_K ∧ ∀ τ' ∈ Set.uIcc 0 τ, (∫ x : ℝ, |K τ' x|) ≤ M_K ∧ ‖ι (K τ')‖ ≤ M_K) ∧
      (∀ (t : ℝ) (v K' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        HasDerivAt w v t →
        (∀ x : ℝ, K' x = -iteratedDeriv 3 v x + 6 * deriv (fun z => w t z * v z) x) →
        HasDerivAt (fun s => ι (K s)) (ι K') t)) ∧
    (∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (s₀ : ℝ) (k₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      IsSchwartzSolution u →
      (∀ x : ℝ, k₀ x = kdvRHS (u s₀) x) →
      ∃ C_init η₀ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C_init ∧ 0 < η₀ ∧
        ∀ s : ℝ, |s - s₀| ≤ η₀ →
          ‖ι (u s - u s₀ - (s - s₀) • k₀)‖ ^ 2 ≤ C_init * |s - s₀| ^ 3)

proof.tactics:
by
  let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ
  let L : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) →L[ℝ] Lp ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ) := SchwartzMap.toLpCLM ℝ ℝ 1 (volume : Measure ℝ)
  have hD : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), (D f) x = deriv f x :=
    fun f x => SchwartzMap.derivCLM_apply ℝ f x
  have hD3 : ∀ (f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), (D (D (D f))) x = iteratedDeriv 3 f x := by
    intro f x
    have h1 : (D (D (D f)) : ℝ → ℝ) = deriv (deriv (deriv f)) := rfl
    rw [h1, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_succ, iteratedDeriv_zero]
  have hM : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ), (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f g) x = f x * g x := by
    intro f g x
    have h_smul := SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply f.hasTemperateGrowth g x
    simpa [smul_eq_mul] using h_smul
  have h_prod_deriv : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (x : ℝ),
      deriv (fun z => f z * g z) x = (D f) x * g x + f x * (D g) x := by
    intro f g x
    have hf : HasDerivAt f (deriv f x) x := f.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have hg : HasDerivAt g (deriv g x) x := g.differentiableAt.hasDerivAt
    have h_mul : HasDerivAt (fun z => f z * g z) (deriv f x * g x + f x * deriv g x) x := hf.mul hg
    rw [h_mul.deriv, hD f x, hD g x]
  have hL_eq : ∀ f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∫ x : ℝ, |f x|) = ‖L f‖ := by
    intro f
    have h1 : (∫ x : ℝ, |f x|) = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖(f : ℝ → ℝ) x‖ := by
      simp_rw [Real.norm_eq_abs]
    rw [h1, MeasureTheory.integral_norm_eq_lintegral_enorm f.continuous.aestronglyMeasurable,
        ← MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_one_eq_lintegral_enorm]
    have h2 : eLpNorm (f : ℝ → ℝ) 1 volume = eLpNorm (f.toLp 1 volume) 1 volume :=
      (MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_congr_ae (f.coeFn_toLp 1 volume)).symm
    rw [h2, ← MeasureTheory.Lp.norm_def]
    rfl
  have hL_mul : ∀ f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      ‖L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f g)‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f * ‖L g‖ := by
    intro f g
    rw [← hL_eq (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f g), ← hL_eq g, ← MeasureTheory.integral_const_mul]
    have h_int1 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |(SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f g) x|) volume := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ f g).integrable.norm
    have h_int2 : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f * |g x|) volume := by
      have hg_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => |g x|) volume := by
        simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using g.integrable.norm
      exact hg_int.const_mul (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f)
    apply MeasureTheory.integral_mono h_int1 h_int2
    intro x
    dsimp
    rw [hM f g x, abs_mul]
    have hf_le : |f x| ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f := by
      simpa [Real.norm_eq_abs] using SchwartzMap.norm_le_seminorm ℝ f x
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hf_le (abs_nonneg (g x))
  have h_both_deriv : ∀ (w K : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ t : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ, K t x = kdvRHS (w t) x) →
      ∀ (t : ℝ) (v K' : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        HasDerivAt w v t →
        (∀ x : ℝ, K' x = -iteratedDeriv 3 v x + 6 * deriv (fun z => w t z * v z) x) →
        HasDerivAt (fun s => L (K s)) (L K') t ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ι (K s)) (ι K') t := by
    intro w K hK t v K' hw hK'
    let δ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => w s - w t - (s - t) • v
    let q : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => (s - t)⁻¹ • δ s
    let Δw : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => w s - w t
    let q_Δ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => (s - t)⁻¹ • Δw s
    let Q_K : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s => (s - t)⁻¹ • (K s - K t - (s - t) • K')
    have hQ_K_eq : ∀ s : ℝ, Q_K s =
        -(D (D (D (q s)))) + (6 : ℝ) • (
          SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q s) (D (w t)) +
          SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (w t) (D (q s)) +
          SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s))) := by
      intro s
      ext x
      have hD3_q : (D (D (D (q s)))) x =
          (s - t)⁻¹ * ((D (D (D (w s)))) x - (D (D (D (w t)))) x - (s - t) * (D (D (D v))) x) := by
        dsimp [q, δ]
        rw [map_smul, map_smul, map_smul, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub, map_sub,
            map_smul, map_smul, map_smul]
        rfl
      have hD_q : (D (q s)) x = (s - t)⁻¹ * ((D (w s)) x - (D (w t)) x - (s - t) * (D v) x) := by
        dsimp [q, δ]
        rw [map_smul, map_sub, map_sub, map_smul]
        rfl
      have hD_Δw : (D (Δw s)) x = (D (w s)) x - (D (w t)) x := by
        dsimp [Δw]
        rw [map_sub]
        rfl
      change (s - t)⁻¹ * (K s x - K t x - (s - t) * K' x) =
        -(D (D (D (q s))) x) + 6 * (
          (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q s) (D (w t))) x +
          (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (w t) (D (q s))) x +
          (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s))) x)
      rw [hK s x, hK t x, hK' x, h_prod_deriv (w t) v x,
          hM (q s) (D (w t)) x, hM (w t) (D (q s)) x, hM (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s)) x,
          hD3_q, hD_q, hD_Δw,
          hD3 (w s) x, hD3 (w t) x, hD3 v x,
          hD (w s) x, hD (w t) x, hD v x]
      change (s - t)⁻¹ * (kdvRHS (w s) x - kdvRHS (w t) x -
          (s - t) * (-iteratedDeriv 3 v x + 6 * (deriv (w t) x * v x + w t x * deriv v x))) =
        -((s - t)⁻¹ * (iteratedDeriv 3 (w s) x - iteratedDeriv 3 (w t) x - (s - t) * iteratedDeriv 3 v x)) +
          6 * (((s - t)⁻¹ * (w s x - w t x - (s - t) * v x)) * deriv (w t) x +
               w t x * ((s - t)⁻¹ * (deriv (w s) x - deriv (w t) x - (s - t) * deriv v x)) +
               ((s - t)⁻¹ * (w s x - w t x)) * (deriv (w s) x - deriv (w t) x))
      dsimp [kdvRHS]
      ring
    have h_q_Δ_semi : ∀ s : ℝ,
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q_Δ s) ≤
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q s) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 v := by
      intro s
      by_cases hs : s = t
      · subst hs
        have h0 : q_Δ s = 0 := by dsimp [q_Δ, Δw]; simp
        rw [h0, map_zero]
        exact add_nonneg (apply_nonneg _ _) (apply_nonneg _ _)
      · have hne : s - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hs
        have h_eq : q_Δ s = q s + v := by
          dsimp [q_Δ, q, Δw, δ]
          rw [smul_sub (s - t)⁻¹ (w s - w t) ((s - t) • v), inv_smul_smul₀ hne, sub_add_cancel]
        rw [h_eq]
        exact map_add_le_add (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) (q s) v
    let p00 : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → ℝ := fun f => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 f
    let U : ℝ → ℝ := fun s =>
      ‖L (D (D (D (q s))))‖ + 6 * (
        p00 (q s) * ‖L (D (w t))‖ +
        p00 (w t) * ‖L (D (q s))‖ +
        (p00 (q s) + p00 v) * ‖L (D (Δw s))‖)
    have hQ_K_L1_le : ∀ s : ℝ, ‖L (Q_K s)‖ ≤ U s := by
      intro s
      rw [hQ_K_eq s, map_add L, map_neg L, map_smul L, map_add L, map_add L]
      have h1 := norm_add_le (-(L (D (D (D (q s))))))
        ((6 : ℝ) • (L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q s) (D (w t))) +
          L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (w t) (D (q s))) +
          L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s)))))
      rw [norm_neg, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 6)] at h1
      have h2 := norm_add_le
        (L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q s) (D (w t))) +
          L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (w t) (D (q s))))
        (L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s))))
      have h3 := norm_add_le
        (L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q s) (D (w t))))
        (L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (w t) (D (q s))))
      have hm1 := hL_mul (q s) (D (w t))
      have hm2 := hL_mul (w t) (D (q s))
      have hm3 : ‖L (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s)))‖ ≤
          (p00 (q s) + p00 v) * ‖L (D (Δw s))‖ :=
        le_trans (hL_mul (q_Δ s) (D (Δw s)))
          (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (h_q_Δ_semi s) (norm_nonneg _))
      dsimp [U, p00] at hm3 ⊢
      linarith
    have hq_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto q (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_inv := hw.isLittleOTVS.tendsto_inv_smul
      have h_eq : (fun s : ℝ => (s - t)⁻¹ • (w s - w t - (ContinuousLinearMap.toSpanSingleton ℝ v) (s - t))) = q := by
        ext s : 1
        dsimp [q, δ]
      rwa [h_eq] at h_inv
    have h_sub_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => s - t) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [sub_self] using
        (continuousAt_id.sub (continuousAt_const : ContinuousAt (fun _ : ℝ => t) t)).tendsto
    have hΔw_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto Δw (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_smul_q : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t) • q s) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_sub_tendsto.smul hq_tendsto
      have h_smul_v : Filter.Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => (s - t) • v) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa using h_sub_tendsto.smul (tendsto_const_nhds (x := v))
      have h_sum := h_smul_q.add h_smul_v
      have h_eq : (fun s : ℝ => (s - t) • q s + (s - t) • v) = Δw := by
        ext s : 1
        dsimp [q, δ, Δw]
        by_cases hs : s = t
        · subst hs; simp
        · have hne : s - t ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hs
          rw [smul_inv_smul₀ hne, sub_add_cancel]
      simpa [h_eq] using h_sum
    have hp00_cont : Continuous p00 :=
      (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (0, 0)
    have hp00_q : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => p00 (q s)) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [p00] using (hp00_cont.tendsto 0).comp hq_tendsto
    have hLD3_q : Filter.Tendsto (fun s => ‖L (D (D (D (q s))))‖) (nhds t) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_cont : Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => ‖L (D (D (D f)))‖) :=
        continuous_norm.comp (L.continuous.comp (D.continuous.comp (D.continuous.comp D.continuous)))
      simpa using (h_cont.tendsto 0).comp hq_tendsto

    let K_u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := fun s' =>

      intro s' x
      change -(D (D (D (u s'))) x) + 6 * (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (u s') (D (u s')) x) =
        -iteratedDeriv 3 (u s') x + 6 * u s' x * deriv (u s') x
      rw [hD3 (u s') x, hM (u s') (D (u s')) x, hD (u s') x]

      rw [hK_u_eq s₀ x, hk₀ x]
    have hu_deriv : ∀ s' : ℝ, HasDerivAt u (K_u s') s' := by

      obtain ⟨v, hv_deriv, hv_eq⟩ := hu s'

    have hF_deriv : ∀ s' : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (G s') s' :=

    let K'₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) :=

      change -(D (D (D k₀)) x) + 6 * (D (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (u s₀) k₀)) x =
        -iteratedDeriv 3 k₀ x + 6 * deriv (fun z => u s₀ z * k₀ z) x
      have h_prod_fn : (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (u s₀) k₀ : ℝ → ℝ) = (fun z => u s₀ z * k₀ z) :=
        funext (hM (u s₀) k₀)
      rw [hD3 k₀ x, hD (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ (u s₀) k₀) x, h_prod_fn]
    have hu_deriv_s₀ : HasDerivAt u k₀ s₀ := by
      rw [← hK_u_s₀]
      exact hu_deriv s₀

      (h_both_deriv u K_u hK_u_eq s₀ k₀ K'₀ hu_deriv_s₀ hK'₀_eq).2

    have hη₀_le_half : η₀ ≤ δ₀ / 2 := min_le_right _ _

      have h_rem_le : ‖G s' - G s₀ - (s' - s₀) • G'₀‖ ≤ |s' - s₀| := by
        by_cases hs'_eq : s' = s₀
        · subst hs'_eq
          simp
        · have h_abs_pos : 0 < |s' - s₀| := abs_pos.mpr (sub_ne_zero.mpr hs'_eq)
          have h_dist_lt : dist s' s₀ < δ₀ := by
            rw [Real.dist_eq]
            linarith
          have h_lt1 := hδ₀_spec h_dist_lt
          rw [Real.dist_eq, sub_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs,
              abs_of_nonneg (mul_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr (abs_nonneg _)) (norm_nonneg _))] at h_lt1
          have h_mul := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_lt1 h_abs_pos
          rw [← mul_assoc, mul_inv_cancel₀ (ne_of_gt h_abs_pos), one_mul, mul_one] at h_mul
          exact le_of_lt h_mul
      have h_tri : ‖G s' - G s₀‖ ≤ ‖G s' - G s₀ - (s' - s₀) • G'₀‖ + ‖(s' - s₀) • G'₀‖ := by
        calc ‖G s' - G s₀‖
          _ = ‖(G s' - G s₀ - (s' - s₀) • G'₀) + (s' - s₀) • G'₀‖ := by congr 1; abel
          _ ≤ ‖G s' - G s₀ - (s' - s₀) • G'₀‖ + ‖(s' - s₀) • G'₀‖ := norm_add_le _ _
      rw [norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_tri
      linarith
    refine ⟨C_init, η₀, hC_init_nn, hη₀_pos, ?_⟩
    intro s hs
    let f : ℝ → Hm1 := fun s' => F s' - (s' - s₀) • G s₀
    have hf_deriv : ∀ s' ∈ Set.uIcc s₀ s, HasDerivWithinAt f (G s' - G s₀) (Set.uIcc s₀ s) s' := by
      intro s' _
      have hd1 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => t - s₀) 1 s' := (hasDerivAt_id s').sub_const s₀
      have hd2 : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => (t - s₀) • G s₀) (G s₀) s' := by
        simpa using hd1.smul_const (G s₀)
      exact ((hF_deriv s').sub hd2).hasDerivWithinAt
    have hf'_bound : ∀ s' ∈ Set.uIcc s₀ s, ‖G s' - G s₀‖ ≤ (‖G'₀‖ + 1) * |s - s₀| := by
      intro s' hs'_mem
      have hs'_le_s : |s' - s₀| ≤ |s - s₀| := by
        rw [Set.mem_uIcc] at hs'_mem
        rcases hs'_mem with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · rw [abs_of_nonneg (by linarith), abs_of_nonneg (by linarith)]
          linarith
        · rw [abs_of_nonpos (by linarith), abs_of_nonpos (by linarith)]
          linarith
      calc ‖G s' - G s₀‖
        _ ≤ (‖G'₀‖ + 1) * |s' - s₀| := hG_lip s' (le_trans hs'_le_s hs)
        _ ≤ (‖G'₀‖ + 1) * |s - s₀| :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs'_le_s (by positivity)
    have h_mvt := Convex.norm_image_sub_le_of_norm_hasDerivWithin_le
      hf_deriv hf'_bound (convex_uIcc s₀ s) Set.left_mem_uIcc Set.right_mem_uIcc
    have hf_diff : f s - f s₀ = ι (u s - u s₀ - (s - s₀) • k₀) := by
      dsimp [f, F, G]
      rw [sub_self, zero_smul, sub_zero, hK_u_s₀,
          (h_iota_add_sub (u s - u s₀) ((s - s₀) • k₀)).2,
          (h_iota_add_sub (u s) (u s₀)).2,
          h_iota_smul (s - s₀) k₀]
      abel
    rw [hf_diff, Real.norm_eq_abs] at h_mvt

      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_mvt 2

      dsimp [C_init]
      ring
    have h_le_pow3 : C_init * |s - s₀| * |s - s₀| ^ 3 ≤ C_init * 1 * |s - s₀| ^ 3 := by
      apply mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right _ (by positivity)
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_abs_le1 hC_init_nn
    linarith

(h_higher : ∀ (δ : ℝ), 0 ≤ δ → ∀ w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
      ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ → ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ δ →
      (∀ ℓ : ℕ, Continuous (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x) ∧
        ∀ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ ℓ x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖ ^ ℓ) ∧
      (∀ m : ℕ,
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ∧
        (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (m + 2) ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
        h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ≤ ‖ι w₁‖ ^ (2 * (m + 2)) ∧
        Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ∧
        (∫ x : ℝ, |greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x|) ≤ (2 * δ) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ∧
        Integrable (fun ξ : ℝ => (4 + ξ ^ 2) * ‖fourierLine (fun x => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ξ‖ ^ 2) ∧
        h1NormSq (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x - greenIterKernel 1 w₂ (m + 2) x x) ≤ (4 * δ ^ 2) ^ (m + 1) * ‖ι w₁ - ι w₂‖ ^ 2))
    (h_lin : ∀ (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 1 ≤ κ)
      (h_cont : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ℓ : ℕ), Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ => greenIterKernel κ w ℓ p.1 p.2))
      (h_bound : ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ 1 / 4 → ∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
        |greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y| ≤ (1 / (2 * κ)) * (1 / 4) ^ ℓ)
      (h_tele : ∀ (w₁ w₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (m : ℕ) (x y : ℝ),
        greenIterKernel κ w₁ (m + 1) x y - greenIterKernel κ w₂ (m + 1) x y =
          -∫ z : ℝ, (∑ p ∈ Finset.antidiagonal m,
            greenIterKernel κ w₁ p.1 x z * greenIterKernel κ w₂ p.2 z y) * (w₁ z - w₂ z))
      (w₁ w₂ v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (hw₁ : ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (hw₂ : ‖ι w₂‖ ≤ 1 / 4) (h x : ℝ),
      diagGreen κ w₂ x ≠ 0 ∧
      |diagGreen κ w₁ x - diagGreen κ w₂ x -
        h * (-∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w₂ x y * v y * greenKernel κ w₂ y x)| ≤
        (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y - h * v y|) + (∫ y : ℝ, |w₁ y - w₂ y|) ^ 2)
    (h_weyl : ∃ δ_weyl : ℝ, 0 < δ_weyl ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 1 ≤ κ → ∀ (w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_weyl →
      ∀ (y : ℝ),
        ∫ x : ℝ, (greenKernel κ w x y * greenKernel κ w y x) / (2 * (diagGreen κ w x) ^ 2) =
          diagGreen κ w y) :
    ∀ (δ_brack : ℝ), 0 < δ_brack →
      ∃ δ_hm1 : ℝ, 0 < δ_hm1 ∧ δ_hm1 ≤ δ_brack ∧
        ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
          ∀ (w₁ q v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (h : ℝ),
            ‖ι w₁‖ ≤ δ_hm1 → ‖ι q‖ ≤ δ_hm1 → ‖ι (q + h • v)‖ ≤ 2 * δ_hm1 →
            (∀ x : ℝ, -∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ q x y * v y * greenKernel κ q y x =
              -iteratedDeriv 3 (diagGreen κ q) x + 6 * q x * deriv (diagGreen κ q) x) →
            ∃ Φ₁ Φ₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
              (∀ x : ℝ, (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ (Φ₁ + Φ₂)) x =
                deriv (diagGreen κ w₁) x - deriv (diagGreen κ q) x -
                  h * deriv (fun z => -∫ y : ℝ, greenKernel κ q z y * v y * greenKernel κ q y z) x) ∧
              ‖ι (SchwartzMap.derivCLM ℝ ℝ Φ₁)‖ ≤ 3 * ‖ι (w₁ - q - h • v)‖ ∧
              (∫ x : ℝ, (Φ₂ x) ^ 2) ≤ 3 * (∫ y : ℝ, |v y|) ^ 3 * |h| ^ 3

                (greenKernel κ q x y * greenKernel κ q y x) * v y := by ring
            rw [h_rearr, abs_mul, abs_of_nonneg (hGq_prod_nn x y)]
      have h_rhs_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => ∫ y : ℝ, H (y, x)) volume :=
        hH_prod_int.swap.integral_prod_left
      calc ∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ x|
        _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ∫ y : ℝ, H (y, x) := integral_mono Ψ.integrable.abs h_rhs_int hΨ_pw
        _ = ∫ y : ℝ, ∫ x : ℝ, H (y, x) := integral_integral_swap hH_prod_int.swap
        _ ≤ ∫ y : ℝ, 2 * |v y| := by
          refine integral_mono hH_prod_int.integral_prod_left (v.integrable.abs.const_mul 2) (fun y => ?_)
          dsimp [H]
          rw [integral_mul_const]
          exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hGq_prod_integral_le y) (abs_nonneg _)
        _ = 2 * I_v := integral_const_mul 2 _
    have hg_pred_sub_eq : ∀ x : ℝ, (g_pred - gq) x = diagGreen κ ((q + h • v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))) x - diagGreen κ q x := by
      intro x
      change g_pred x - gq x = diagGreen κ ((q + h • v : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))) x - diagGreen κ q x
      rw [hg_pred x, hgq x]
      ring
    have hg_pred_l1 : (∫ x : ℝ, |(g_pred - gq) x|) ≤ |h| * I_v := by
      have h_b2 := (h_kappa_diff κ hκ (q + h • v) q (g_pred - gq) hpred_256 hq_256 hg_pred_sub_eq).2
      have h_rhs_eq : (∫ x : ℝ, |(q + h • v) x - q x|) = |h| * I_v := by
        have h_fn : (fun x : ℝ => |(q + h • v) x - q x|) = (fun x : ℝ => |h| * |v x|) := by
          ext x
          change |q x + h * v x - q x| = |h| * |v x|
          have : q x + h * v x - q x = h * v x := by ring
          rw [this, abs_mul]
        rw [h_fn, integral_const_mul]
      rwa [h_rhs_eq] at h_b2
    have hΦ₂_l1 : (∫ x : ℝ, |Φ₂ x|) ≤ 3 * |h| * I_v := by
      have h_pw_tri : ∀ x : ℝ, |Φ₂ x| ≤ |(g_pred - gq) x| + |h| * |Ψ x| := by
        intro x
        change |(g_pred - gq) x - h * Ψ x| ≤ |(g_pred - gq) x| + |h| * |Ψ x|
        rw [← abs_mul]
        exact abs_sub _ _
      have h_int_tri : (∫ x : ℝ, |Φ₂ x|) ≤
          (∫ x : ℝ, |(g_pred - gq) x|) + ∫ x : ℝ, |h| * |Ψ x| := by
        rw [← integral_add (g_pred - gq).integrable.abs (Ψ.integrable.abs.const_mul |h|)]
        exact integral_mono Φ₂.integrable.abs
          ((g_pred - gq).integrable.abs.add (Ψ.integrable.abs.const_mul |h|)) h_pw_tri
      rw [integral_const_mul] at h_int_tri
      have h_hΨ_le : |h| * (∫ x : ℝ, |Ψ x|) ≤ |h| * (2 * I_v) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΨ_l1 (abs_nonneg h)
      linarith
    have hΦ₂_sq_int : Integrable (fun x : ℝ => (Φ₂ x) ^ 2) volume := by
      have h_prod : (fun x : ℝ => (Φ₂ x) ^ 2) = (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ Φ₂ Φ₂ : ℝ → ℝ) := by
        ext x
        have h_smul := SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM_apply_apply Φ₂.hasTemperateGrowth Φ₂ x
        simpa [sq, smul_eq_mul] using h_smul.symm
      rw [h_prod]
      exact (SchwartzMap.smulLeftCLM ℝ Φ₂ Φ₂).integrable
    have h_pw_sq : ∀ x : ℝ, (Φ₂ x) ^ 2 ≤ (|h| ^ 2 * I_v ^ 2) * |Φ₂ x| := by
      intro x
      rw [← sq_abs (Φ₂ x), sq]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right (hΦ₂_linf x) (abs_nonneg _)
    calc ∫ x : ℝ, (Φ₂ x) ^ 2
      _ ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, (|h| ^ 2 * I_v ^ 2) * |Φ₂ x| :=
        integral_mono hΦ₂_sq_int (Φ₂.integrable.abs.const_mul (|h| ^ 2 * I_v ^ 2)) h_pw_sq
      _ = (|h| ^ 2 * I_v ^ 2) * ∫ x : ℝ, |Φ₂ x| := integral_const_mul _ _
      _ ≤ (|h| ^ 2 * I_v ^ 2) * (3 * |h| * I_v) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hΦ₂_l1 (by positivity)
      _ = 3 * I_v ^ 3 * |h| ^ 3 := by ring

      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => greenIterKernel 1 w₁ (m + 2) x x) ∧

    (∀ x : ℝ, |diagGreen 1 w₁ x - 1 / 2 - greenIterKernel 1 w₁ 1 x x| ≤ (1 / 2) * ‖ι w₁‖) ∧

subgoal_signatures.name: diagGreen_sub_const_schwartz_seminorm_step
subgoal_signatures.statement:
∃ δ_diag : ℝ, 0 < δ_diag ∧
      ∀ (κ : ℝ), 2 ≤ κ →
        ∀ (k n : ℕ) (R : ℝ), 0 ≤ R →
          ∃ C₁ C₂ : ℝ, 0 ≤ C₁ ∧ 0 ≤ C₂ ∧
            ∀ w : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι w‖ ≤ δ_diag →
              (∀ p ≤ k, ∀ d < n, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p d w ≤ R) →
              (∀ p < k, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n w ≤ R) →
              ∃ g_tilde : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
                (∀ x : ℝ, diagGreen κ w x = 1 / (2 * κ) + g_tilde x) ∧
                SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k (n + 1) g_tilde ≤ C₁ * SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n w + C₂

      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun y => greenIterKernel κ w (ℓ + 1) y y)
          (2 * greenIterDerivY κ w (ℓ + 1) x x) x) →
      (∀ (ℓ : ℕ) (x y : ℝ), greenIterKernel κ w ℓ x y = greenIterKernel κ w ℓ y x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        HasDerivAt (fun x' => greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x')
          (κ ^ 2 * greenIterKernel κ w (m + 1) a x + w x * greenIterKernel κ w m a x) x) →
      (∀ (m : ℕ) (a x : ℝ),
        |greenIterDerivY κ w (m + 1) a x| ≤ ((∫ z : ℝ, |w z|) / (4 * κ)) * ‖ι w‖ ^ m) →
      (∀ x y : ℝ, greenKernel κ w x y = greenKernel κ w y x) ∧
      (∀ x : ℝ, 1 / (4 * κ) ≤ diagGreen κ w x ∧ HasDerivAt (diagGreen κ w) (diagGreenDeriv κ w x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → greenKernelLeft κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → greenKernelRight κ w a x = greenKernel κ w a x)) ∧
      (∀ a : ℝ,
        greenDerivLeft κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a + 1) / 2 ∧
        greenDerivRight κ w a a = (diagGreenDeriv κ w a - 1) / 2) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelLeft κ w a) (greenDerivLeft κ w a x) x ∧
        HasDerivAt (greenKernelRight κ w a) (greenDerivRight κ w a x) x) ∧
      (∀ a x : ℝ,
        (x ≤ a → HasDerivAt (greenDerivLeft κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelLeft κ w a x) x) ∧
        (a ≤ x → HasDerivAt (greenDerivRight κ w a) ((κ ^ 2 + w x) * greenKernelRight κ w a x) x))

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_comp : ∀ (φ ψ F : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ),
      a ≤ b → Continuous ψ →
      (∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (ψ τ) τ) →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc a b, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ ψ τ) →
      |∫ τ in a..b, φ τ| ≤ F b - F a := by
    intro φ ψ F a b hab hψ_cont hF hφ
    have hψ_int : IntervalIntegrable ψ volume a b := hψ_cont.intervalIntegrable a b
    have hF_cont : Continuous F := continuous_iff_continuousAt.mpr (fun τ => (hF τ).continuousAt)
    have h_ftc : ∫ τ in a..b, ψ τ = F b - F a :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDeriv_right hF_cont.continuousOn
        (fun τ _ => (hF τ).hasDerivWithinAt) hψ_int
    have hψ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ τ in a..b, ψ τ :=
      intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab (fun τ hτ => le_trans (hφ τ hτ).1 (hφ τ hτ).2)
    by_cases hφ_int : IntervalIntegrable φ volume a b
    · have hφ_nonneg : 0 ≤ ∫ τ in a..b, φ τ :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_nonneg hab (fun τ hτ => (hφ τ hτ).1)
      have h_mono : ∫ τ in a..b, φ τ ≤ ∫ τ in a..b, ψ τ :=
        intervalIntegral.integral_mono_on hab hφ_int hψ_int (fun τ hτ => (hφ τ hτ).2)
      rw [abs_of_nonneg hφ_nonneg, ← h_ftc]
      exact h_mono
    · rw [intervalIntegral.integral_undef hφ_int, abs_zero, ← h_ftc]
      exact hψ_nonneg
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro φ C m t _hC hφ
    have h_fact_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)
    have h_fact_ne : (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt h_fact_pos
    have hm1_ne : (m : ℝ) + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
    rcases le_total 0 t with ht | ht
    · let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => C * τ ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)
      let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => C * τ ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)
      have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by fun_prop
      have hF : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (ψ τ) τ := by
        intro τ
        have hd := ((hasDerivAt_pow (m + 1) τ).const_mul C).div_const (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)
        convert hd using 1
        dsimp [ψ]
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        push_cast
        field_simp
      have hφ_Icc : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ ψ τ := by
        intro τ hτ
        have hτ_uIcc : τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t := by rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le ht]
        have h := hφ τ hτ_uIcc
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hτ.1] at h
        exact h
      have h_bound := h_comp φ ψ F 0 t ht hψ_cont hF hφ_Icc
      have h_eval : F t - F 0 = C * |t| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [F]
        rw [zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), abs_of_nonneg ht]
        ring
      linarith
    · let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => C * (-τ) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)
      let F : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => -C * (-τ) ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)
      have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by fun_prop
      have hF : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt F (ψ τ) τ := by
        intro τ
        have hd := (((hasDerivAt_id τ).neg.pow (m + 1)).const_mul (-C)).div_const (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)
        convert hd using 1
        dsimp [ψ]
        rw [Nat.factorial_succ]
        push_cast
        field_simp
      have hφ_Icc : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc t 0, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ ψ τ := by
        intro τ hτ
        have hτ_uIcc : τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t := by rwa [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht]
        have h := hφ τ hτ_uIcc
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hτ.2] at h
        exact h
      have h_bound := h_comp φ ψ F t 0 ht hψ_cont hF hφ_Icc
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm t 0, abs_neg]
      have h_eval : F 0 - F t = C * |t| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := by
        dsimp [F]
        rw [neg_zero, zero_pow (Nat.succ_ne_zero m), abs_of_nonpos ht]
        ring
      linarith
  · intro φ A B C₀ t _hA _hB _hC₀ hφ
    rcases le_total 0 t with ht | ht
    · let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => A * (C₀ * Real.exp (A * τ)) + B
      let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => C₀ * Real.exp (A * τ) + B * τ
      have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by fun_prop
      have hG : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (ψ τ) τ := by
        intro τ
        have hd := (((hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul A).exp.const_mul C₀).add ((hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul B)
        convert hd using 1
        dsimp [ψ]
        ring
      have hφ_Icc : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc 0 t, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ ψ τ := by
        intro τ hτ
        have hτ_uIcc : τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t := by rwa [Set.uIcc_of_le ht]
        have h := hφ τ hτ_uIcc
        rw [abs_of_nonneg hτ.1] at h
        exact h
      have h_bound := h_comp φ ψ G 0 t ht hψ_cont hG hφ_Icc
      have h_eval : G t - G 0 = C₀ * (Real.exp (A * |t|) - 1) + B * |t| := by
        dsimp [G]
        rw [mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, abs_of_nonneg ht]
        ring
      linarith
    · let ψ : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => A * (C₀ * Real.exp (A * (-τ))) + B
      let G : ℝ → ℝ := fun τ => -C₀ * Real.exp (A * (-τ)) + B * τ
      have hψ_cont : Continuous ψ := by fun_prop
      have hG : ∀ τ : ℝ, HasDerivAt G (ψ τ) τ := by
        intro τ
        have hd := ((((hasDerivAt_id τ).neg.const_mul A).exp).const_mul (-C₀)).add ((hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul B)
        convert hd using 1
        dsimp [ψ]
        ring
      have hφ_Icc : ∀ τ ∈ Set.Icc t 0, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ ψ τ := by
        intro τ hτ
        have hτ_uIcc : τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t := by rwa [Set.uIcc_of_ge ht]
        have h := hφ τ hτ_uIcc
        rw [abs_of_nonpos hτ.2] at h
        exact h
      have h_bound := h_comp φ ψ G t 0 ht hψ_cont hG hφ_Icc
      rw [intervalIntegral.integral_symm t 0, abs_neg]
      have h_eval : G 0 - G t = C₀ * (Real.exp (A * |t|) - 1) + B * |t| := by
        dsimp [G]
        rw [neg_zero, mul_zero, Real.exp_zero, abs_of_nonpos ht]
        ring
      linarith

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ = ‖ι q₁ - ι q₂‖) ∧
    ∀ (V : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (L_lip : ℝ),
      0 ≤ L_lip →
      (∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        ‖ι g‖ ≤ 4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 g + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 g)) →
      (∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
        ∃ η : ℝ, 0 < η ∧
          ∀ (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
            (∀ p m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m g ≤ B p m) →
            ‖ι g‖ < η →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n g < ε) →
      (∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (V q₁) - ι (V q₂)‖ ≤ L_lip * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) →
      (∀ (K n : ℕ), 2 ≤ K →
        ∀ (M : ℕ → ℝ),
          ∃ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
            ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
              (∀ m < n, schwartzTierNorm K m q ≤ M m) →
              schwartzTierNorm K n (V q) ≤ A * schwartzTierNorm K n q + B) →
      (∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Continuous u → Continuous (fun t : ℝ => V (u t))) ∧
      (∀ (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w_tilde : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        (∀ N : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq N)) →
        Continuous w_tilde →
        (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (k n : ℕ),
          ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
            ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w_seq N t - w_tilde t) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun N : ℕ => ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ)) x)
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds (∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ)) x)))

proof.tactics:
by
  have norm_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : ℝ → ℝ) (ξ x : ℝ),
      ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ = ‖q x‖ := by
    intro q ξ x
    have h_exp : -((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I = ((-(ξ * x) : ℝ) : ℂ) * I := by push_cast; ring
    rw [norm_mul, h_exp, Complex.norm_exp_ofReal_mul_I, one_mul, Complex.norm_real]
  have integrable_fourier_integrand : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      Integrable (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume := by
    intro q ξ
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    refine q.integrable.norm.mono' h_cont.aestronglyMeasurable ?_
    filter_upwards with x
    rw [norm_fourier_integrand]
  have h_bound_pw : ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖) ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
    intro q ξ
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
    have h_fl_bound : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ≤ C := by
      dsimp [fourierLine, C]
      rw [norm_mul]
      gcongr
      calc
        ‖∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖
          ≤ ∫ x : ℝ, ‖Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)‖ :=
            norm_integral_le_integral_norm _
        _ = ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖ := by
            congr 1 with x
            exact norm_fourier_integrand q ξ x
    have h_w_norm : ‖((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ = (Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ := by
      rw [norm_inv, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_of_nonneg (Real.sqrt_nonneg _)]
    have h_sq : ‖hm1Profile q ξ‖ ^ 2 = (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 := by
      dsimp [hm1Profile]
      rw [norm_mul, h_w_norm, mul_pow, inv_pow, Real.sq_sqrt (by positivity)]
    rw [h_sq]
    have h_inv_le : (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := by
      apply inv_anti₀ (by positivity)
      linarith
    have h_sq_le : ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ C ^ 2 :=
      pow_le_pow_left₀ (norm_nonneg _) h_fl_bound 2
    calc
      (4 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * ‖fourierLine q ξ‖ ^ 2 ≤ (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ * C ^ 2 := by gcongr
      _ = C ^ 2 * (1 + ξ ^ 2)⁻¹ := mul_comm _ _
  have h_mem : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), MemLp (hm1Profile q) 2 (volume : Measure ℝ) := by
    intro q
    have h_cont2 : Continuous (fun p : ℝ × ℝ =>
        Complex.exp (-((p.1 : ℂ) * (p.2 : ℂ)) * I) * (q p.2 : ℂ)) := by
      have := q.continuous
      fun_prop
    have h_meas_int : AEStronglyMeasurable
        (fun ξ : ℝ => ∫ x : ℝ, Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q x : ℂ)) volume :=
      h_cont2.aestronglyMeasurable.integral_prod_right'
    have h_meas_fl : AEStronglyMeasurable (fourierLine q) volume :=
      aestronglyMeasurable_const.mul h_meas_int
    have h_cont_w : Continuous (fun ξ : ℝ => ((Real.sqrt (4 + ξ ^ 2))⁻¹ : ℂ)) :=
      Continuous.inv₀ (by fun_prop) (fun ξ => Complex.ofReal_ne_zero.mpr (by positivity))
    have h_meas : AEStronglyMeasurable (hm1Profile q) volume :=
      h_cont_w.aestronglyMeasurable.mul h_meas_fl
    rw [memLp_two_iff_integrable_sq_norm h_meas]
    let C : ℝ := ‖((Real.sqrt (2 * π))⁻¹ : ℂ)‖ * ∫ x : ℝ, ‖q x‖
    refine (integrable_inv_one_add_sq.const_mul (C ^ 2)).mono'
      (h_meas.norm.pow 2) ?_
    filter_upwards with ξ
    rw [Real.norm_of_nonneg (sq_nonneg _)]
    exact h_bound_pw q ξ
  have hm1Profile_sub : ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (ξ : ℝ),
      hm1Profile (q₁ - q₂) ξ = hm1Profile q₁ ξ - hm1Profile q₂ ξ := by
    intro q₁ q₂ ξ
    dsimp [hm1Profile, fourierLine]
    have h_eq : (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * ((q₁ x - q₂ x : ℝ) : ℂ)) =
        (fun x : ℝ => Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₁ x : ℂ) -
          Complex.exp (-((ξ : ℂ) * (x : ℂ)) * I) * (q₂ x : ℂ)) := by
      ext x
      push_cast
      ring
    rw [h_eq, integral_sub (integrable_fourier_integrand q₁ ξ) (integrable_fourier_integrand q₂ ξ)]
    ring
  have h_toHm1 : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 q = (h_mem q).toLp (hm1Profile q) := by
    intro q
    dsimp [toHm1]
    rw [dif_pos (h_mem q)]
  have h_sub : ∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), toHm1 (q₁ - q₂) = toHm1 q₁ - toHm1 q₂ := by
    intro q₁ q₂
    rw [h_toHm1 (q₁ - q₂), h_toHm1 q₁, h_toHm1 q₂, ← MemLp.toLp_sub (h_mem q₁) (h_mem q₂)]
    apply MemLp.toLp_congr
    filter_upwards with ξ
    exact hm1Profile_sub q₁ q₂ ξ
  have h_iota_sub : ∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ = ‖ι q₁ - ι q₂‖ := by
    intro q₁ q₂
    change ‖toHm1 (q₁ - q₂)‖ = ‖toHm1 q₁ - toHm1 q₂‖
    rw [h_sub q₁ q₂]
  refine ⟨h_iota_sub, ?_⟩
  intro V L_lip hL_lip h_hm1_le h_eps_eta hV_lip hV_tier
  have hV_mod : ∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (k n : ℕ) (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε →
      ∃ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ ∧
        ∀ (q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
          (∀ p m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m q₁ ≤ B p m) →
          (∀ p m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m q₂ ≤ B p m) →
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q₁ - q₂) < δ →
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (q₁ - q₂) < δ →
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (V q₁ - V q₂) < ε := by
    intro B k n ε hε
    let K_fn : ℕ → ℕ := fun p => max p 2
    let M_fn : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p j => ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (K_fn p + 1), B i j
    have hV_ex : ∀ p m : ℕ, ∃ B_pm : ℝ,
        ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), (∀ i j : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ i j q ≤ B i j) →
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (V q) ≤ B_pm := by
      intro p m
      obtain ⟨A_pm, B_pm, hA_nonneg, _hB_nonneg, h_tier⟩ :=
        hV_tier (K_fn p) m (le_max_right p 2) (M_fn p)
      refine ⟨A_pm * M_fn p m + B_pm, ?_⟩
      intro q hq
      have hq_tier : ∀ j : ℕ, schwartzTierNorm (K_fn p) j q ≤ M_fn p j := by
        intro j
        dsimp [schwartzTierNorm, M_fn]
        exact Finset.sum_le_sum (fun i _ => hq i j)
      have hVq_tier : schwartzTierNorm (K_fn p) m (V q) ≤ A_pm * M_fn p m + B_pm := by
        calc schwartzTierNorm (K_fn p) m (V q)
          _ ≤ A_pm * schwartzTierNorm (K_fn p) m q + B_pm :=
            h_tier q (fun j _ => hq_tier j)
          _ ≤ A_pm * M_fn p m + B_pm := by
            gcongr
            exact hq_tier m
      have hp_mem : p ∈ Finset.range (K_fn p + 1) := by
        rw [Finset.mem_range]
        have : p ≤ K_fn p := le_max_left p 2
        omega
      have hp_le : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (V q) ≤ schwartzTierNorm (K_fn p) m (V q) := by
        dsimp [schwartzTierNorm]
        exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ i m) (V q)) hp_mem
      exact le_trans hp_le hVq_tier
    let B_V : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p m => Classical.choose (hV_ex p m)
    have hB_V_spec : ∀ (p m : ℕ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        (∀ i j : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ i j q ≤ B i j) →
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (V q) ≤ B_V p m :=
      fun p m => Classical.choose_spec (hV_ex p m)
    obtain ⟨η, hη_pos, h_eta⟩ := h_eps_eta (fun p m => 2 * B_V p m) k n ε hε
    let δ : ℝ := η / (8 * (L_lip + 1))
    have hδ_pos : 0 < δ := by positivity
    refine ⟨δ, hδ_pos, ?_⟩
    intro q₁ q₂ hq₁ hq₂ hs0 hs2
    apply h_eta (V q₁ - V q₂)
    · intro p m
      calc SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (V q₁ - V q₂)
        _ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (V q₁) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (V q₂) :=
          map_sub_le_add (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m) (V q₁) (V q₂)
        _ ≤ B_V p m + B_V p m := add_le_add (hB_V_spec p m q₁ hq₁) (hB_V_spec p m q₂ hq₂)
        _ = 2 * B_V p m := by ring
    · have hs0_nonneg : 0 ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q₁ - q₂) :=
        apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0) (q₁ - q₂)
      have hs2_nonneg : 0 ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (q₁ - q₂) :=
        apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0) (q₁ - q₂)
      have h_sum_lt : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q₁ - q₂) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (q₁ - q₂) < 2 * δ := by
        linarith
      have h_sum_nonneg : 0 ≤ 4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q₁ - q₂) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (q₁ - q₂)) := by
        positivity
      have h_alg : (L_lip + 1) * (4 * (2 * δ)) = η := by
        dsimp [δ]
        have : L_lip + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
        field_simp
        ring
      calc ‖ι (V q₁ - V q₂)‖
        _ = ‖ι (V q₁) - ι (V q₂)‖ := h_iota_sub (V q₁) (V q₂)
        _ ≤ L_lip * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ := hV_lip q₁ q₂
        _ ≤ L_lip * (4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q₁ - q₂) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (q₁ - q₂))) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_hm1_le (q₁ - q₂)) hL_lip
        _ ≤ (L_lip + 1) * (4 * (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (q₁ - q₂) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (q₁ - q₂))) := by
          gcongr
          linarith
        _ < (L_lip + 1) * (4 * (2 * δ)) := by
          apply mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left _ (by positivity)
          linarith
        _ = η := h_alg
  have h_iter_sub : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
      iteratedDeriv n (f - g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = iteratedDeriv n f x - iteratedDeriv n g x := by
    intro f g n x
    exact iteratedDeriv_sub ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) ((g.smooth n).contDiffAt)
  have h_semi_cont : ∀ (k n : ℕ), Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n f) := by
    intro k n
    change Continuous (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ))
    rw [← SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
    exact (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).continuous_seminorm (k, n)
  have h_eval_cont : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ), Continuous (fun f : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => iteratedDeriv n f x) := by
    intro n x
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro f
    rw [ContinuousAt, tendsto_iff_dist_tendsto_zero]
    have h_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (g - f)) (nhds f) (nhds 0) := by
      have h_c : Continuous (fun g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (g - f)) :=
        (h_semi_cont 0 n).comp (continuous_id.sub continuous_const)
      simpa [sub_self, map_zero] using (h_c.continuousAt (x := f)).tendsto
    refine squeeze_zero (fun g => dist_nonneg) (fun g => ?_) h_zero
    rw [Real.dist_eq, ← Real.norm_eq_abs, ← h_iter_sub g f n x]
    simpa [pow_zero, one_mul] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 n (g - f) x
  have hV_cont_curve : ∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Continuous u → Continuous (fun t : ℝ => V (u t)) := by
    intro u hu
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t₀
    rw [ContinuousAt, (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds (fun t => V (u t)) (V (u t₀))]
    rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
    rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
    have h_bu_ex : ∀ p m : ℕ, ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ t ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1),
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (u t) ≤ C := by
      intro p m
      have h_c : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (u t)) :=
        (h_semi_cont p m).comp hu
      obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn h_c.continuousOn
      refine ⟨C, fun t ht => ?_⟩
      have h1 := hC t ht
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
      exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h1
    let B_u : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p m => Classical.choose (h_bu_ex p m)
    have hB_u_spec : ∀ (p m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) →
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (u t) ≤ B_u p m :=
      fun p m => Classical.choose_spec (h_bu_ex p m)
    have ht₀_mem : t₀ ∈ Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) := ⟨by linarith, by linarith⟩
    obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, h_mod⟩ := hV_mod B_u k n ε hε
    have h_ev_Icc : Set.Icc (t₀ - 1) (t₀ + 1) ∈ nhds t₀ :=
      Icc_mem_nhds (by linarith) (by linarith)
    have h_ev0 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds t₀, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (u t - u t₀) < δ := by
      have h_c0 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (u t - u t₀)) :=
        (h_semi_cont 0 0).comp (hu.sub continuous_const)
      have h_t0 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (u t - u t₀)) (nhds t₀) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [sub_self, map_zero] using (h_c0.continuousAt (x := t₀)).tendsto
      exact h_t0.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ_pos)
    have h_ev2 : ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds t₀, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (u t - u t₀) < δ := by
      have h_c2 : Continuous (fun t : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (u t - u t₀)) :=
        (h_semi_cont 2 0).comp (hu.sub continuous_const)
      have h_t2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (u t - u t₀)) (nhds t₀) (nhds 0) := by
        simpa [sub_self, map_zero] using (h_c2.continuousAt (x := t₀)).tendsto
      exact h_t2.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ_pos)
    filter_upwards [h_ev_Icc, h_ev0, h_ev2] with t ht hs0 hs2
    exact h_mod (u t) (u t₀) (fun p m => hB_u_spec p m t ht) (fun p m => hB_u_spec p m t₀ ht₀_mem) hs0 hs2
  refine ⟨hV_cont_curve, ?_⟩
  intro w_seq w_tilde hw_seq_cont hw_tilde_cont hw_geom t n x
  let T : ℝ := |t|
  have hT_nonneg : 0 ≤ T := abs_nonneg t
  have h_bw_ex : ∀ p m : ℕ, ∃ B_pm : ℝ, ∀ τ : ℝ, |τ| ≤ T →
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_tilde τ) ≤ B_pm := by
    intro p m
    have h_c : Continuous (fun τ : ℝ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_tilde τ)) :=
      (h_semi_cont p m).comp hw_tilde_cont
    obtain ⟨B_pm, hB⟩ := isCompact_Icc.exists_bound_of_continuousOn (s := Set.Icc (-T) T) h_c.continuousOn
    refine ⟨B_pm, fun τ hτ => ?_⟩
    have h1 := hB τ (abs_le.mp hτ)
    rw [Real.norm_eq_abs] at h1
    exact le_trans (le_abs_self _) h1
  let B_w : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p m => Classical.choose (h_bw_ex p m)
  have hB_w_spec : ∀ (p m : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), |τ| ≤ T →
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_tilde τ) ≤ B_w p m :=
    fun p m => Classical.choose_spec (h_bw_ex p m)
  let C_fn : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p m => Classical.choose (hw_geom T hT_nonneg p m)
  have hC_spec : ∀ p m : ℕ, 0 ≤ C_fn p m ∧
      ∀ (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), |τ| ≤ T →
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_seq N τ - w_tilde τ) ≤ C_fn p m * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N :=
    fun p m => Classical.choose_spec (hw_geom T hT_nonneg p m)
  let B_all : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p m => C_fn p m + B_w p m
  have hB_tilde : ∀ (τ : ℝ), |τ| ≤ T → ∀ p m : ℕ,
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_tilde τ) ≤ B_all p m := by
    intro τ hτ p m
    dsimp [B_all]
    linarith [(hC_spec p m).1, hB_w_spec p m τ hτ]
  have hB_seq : ∀ (N : ℕ) (τ : ℝ), |τ| ≤ T → ∀ p m : ℕ,
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_seq N τ) ≤ B_all p m := by
    intro N τ hτ p m
    have h_eq : w_seq N τ = (w_seq N τ - w_tilde τ) + w_tilde τ := by abel
    have h_pow_le : (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N ≤ 1 := pow_le_one₀ (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
    have h_c_le : C_fn p m * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N ≤ C_fn p m * 1 :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow_le (hC_spec p m).1
    calc SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_seq N τ)
      _ = SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m ((w_seq N τ - w_tilde τ) + w_tilde τ) := by rw [← h_eq]
      _ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_seq N τ - w_tilde τ) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m (w_tilde τ) :=
        map_add_le_add (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p m) _ _
      _ ≤ C_fn p m * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N + B_w p m :=
        add_le_add ((hC_spec p m).2 N τ hτ) (hB_w_spec p m τ hτ)
      _ ≤ C_fn p m + B_w p m := by linarith
  rw [Metric.tendsto_atTop]
  intro ε hε
  let ε' : ℝ := ε / (|t| + 1)
  have hε'_pos : 0 < ε' := by positivity
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ_pos, h_mod⟩ := hV_mod B_all 0 n ε' hε'_pos
  have h_pow_zero : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num) (by norm_num)
  have h_ev0 : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, C_fn 0 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N < δ := by
    have h_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C_fn 0 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul h_pow_zero
    exact h_t.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ_pos)
  have h_ev2 : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, C_fn 2 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N < δ := by
    have h_t : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C_fn 2 0 * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa using tendsto_const_nhds.mul h_pow_zero
    exact h_t.eventually (gt_mem_nhds hδ_pos)
  obtain ⟨N₀, hN₀⟩ := Filter.eventually_atTop.mp (h_ev0.and h_ev2)
  refine ⟨N₀, fun N hN => ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨hN_0, hN_2⟩ := hN₀ N hN
  have h_int_seq : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ)) x) volume 0 t :=
    ((h_eval_cont n x).comp (hV_cont_curve (w_seq N) (hw_seq_cont N))).intervalIntegrable 0 t
  have h_int_tilde : IntervalIntegrable (fun τ : ℝ => iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ)) x) volume 0 t :=
    ((h_eval_cont n x).comp (hV_cont_curve w_tilde hw_tilde_cont)).intervalIntegrable 0 t
  rw [dist_eq_norm, ← intervalIntegral.integral_sub h_int_seq h_int_tilde]
  have h_int_bound : ‖∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t,
      (iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ)) x - iteratedDeriv n (V (w_tilde τ)) x)‖ ≤ ε' * |t - 0| := by
    refine intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_of_norm_le_const (fun τ hτ => ?_)
    have hτ_uIcc : τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t := Set.uIoc_subset_uIcc hτ
    have hτ_T : |τ| ≤ T := by
      dsimp [T]
      rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hτ_uIcc with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans h1 h2)]
        exact h2
      · rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos (le_trans h1 h2)]
        linarith
    have hs0 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 0 (w_seq N τ - w_tilde τ) < δ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt ((hC_spec 0 0).2 N τ hτ_T) hN_0
    have hs2 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 2 0 (w_seq N τ - w_tilde τ) < δ :=
      lt_of_le_of_lt ((hC_spec 2 0).2 N τ hτ_T) hN_2
    have hV_lt : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (V (w_seq N τ) - V (w_tilde τ)) < ε' :=
      h_mod (w_seq N τ) (w_tilde τ) (hB_seq N τ hτ_T) (hB_tilde τ hτ_T) hs0 hs2
    rw [← h_iter_sub (V (w_seq N τ)) (V (w_tilde τ)) n x]
    have h_pt : ‖iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq N τ) - V (w_tilde τ) : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x‖ ≤
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (V (w_seq N τ) - V (w_tilde τ)) := by
      simpa [pow_zero, one_mul] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 n (V (w_seq N τ) - V (w_tilde τ)) x
    exact le_trans h_pt (le_of_lt hV_lt)
  have h_strict : ε' * |t - 0| < ε := by
    rw [sub_zero]
    have h_alg : ε' * (|t| + 1) = ε := by
      dsimp [ε']
      have : |t| + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
      field_simp
    calc ε' * |t|
      _ < ε' * (|t| + 1) := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left (by linarith) hε'_pos
      _ = ε := h_alg
  exact lt_of_le_of_lt h_int_bound h_strict

informal_problem.statement:
(∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖ = ‖ι q₁ - ι q₂‖) →
    (∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (C : ℝ) (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
      0 ≤ C →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ C * |τ| ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ)) →
      |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ τ| ≤ C * |t| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)) →
    (∀ (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (A B C₀ t : ℝ),
      0 ≤ A → 0 ≤ B → 0 ≤ C₀ →
      (∀ τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t, 0 ≤ φ τ ∧ φ τ ≤ A * (C₀ * Real.exp (A * |τ|)) + B) →
      |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, φ τ| ≤ C₀ * (Real.exp (A * |t|) - 1) + B * |t|) →
    (∀ (B : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ) (C₀ L : ℝ), 0 ≤ C₀ → 0 ≤ L →
      ∀ (k n : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
        ∀ (m : ℕ) (g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
          (∀ p j : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j g ≤ B p j) →
          ‖ι g‖ ≤ C₀ * L ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) →
          SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n g ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) →
    ((∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        Continuous G →
        ∃ W : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          Continuous W ∧
          (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
            iteratedDeriv n (W t) x =
              iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G τ) x) ∧
          (∀ (K n : ℕ) (t : ℝ),
            schwartzTierNorm K n (W t) ≤
              schwartzTierNorm K n w₀ +
                |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, schwartzTierNorm K n (G τ)|)) ∧
      (∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (G₁ G₂ W₁ W₂ : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        Continuous G₁ → Continuous G₂ →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W₁ t) x =
            iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₁ τ) x) →
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          iteratedDeriv n (W₂ t) x =
            iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (G₂ τ) x) →
        ∀ (t : ℝ),
          ‖ι (W₁ t - W₂ t)‖ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ι (G₁ τ - G₂ τ)‖|)) →
    ∀ (V : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (M₀ L_lip : ℝ),
      0 ≤ M₀ → 0 ≤ L_lip →
      (∀ (u : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), Continuous u → Continuous (fun t : ℝ => V (u t))) →
      (∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (V q)‖ ≤ M₀) →
      (∀ q₁ q₂ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), ‖ι (V q₁) - ι (V q₂)‖ ≤ L_lip * ‖ι (q₁ - q₂)‖) →
      (∀ (K n : ℕ), 2 ≤ K →
        ∀ (M : ℕ → ℝ),
          ∃ (A B : ℝ), 0 ≤ A ∧ 0 ≤ B ∧
            ∀ (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
              (∀ m < n, schwartzTierNorm K m q ≤ M m) →
              schwartzTierNorm K n (V q) ≤ A * schwartzTierNorm K n q + B) →
      ∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
        ∃ w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
          (∀ t : ℝ, w_seq 0 t = w₀) ∧
          (∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq m)) ∧
          (∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
            iteratedDeriv n (w_seq (m + 1) t) x =
              iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, iteratedDeriv n (V (w_seq m τ)) x) ∧
          (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (k n : ℕ),
            ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
              ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
                SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m)

      calc ‖ι (w_seq (0 + 1) t - w_seq 0 t)‖
        _ ≤ |∫ τ in (0 : ℝ)..t, ‖ι (V (w_seq 0 τ) - 0)‖| := h_diff0
        _ ≤ M₀ * |t| ^ (0 + 1) / (Nat.factorial (0 + 1) : ℝ) := h_mono0
        _ = M₀ * L_lip ^ 0 * |t| ^ (0 + 1) / (Nat.factorial (0 + 1) : ℝ) := by ring
    | succ m ih =>
      intro t
      have h_diff_succ := h_int_diff w₀ (fun τ => V (w_seq (m + 1) τ)) (fun τ => V (w_seq m τ))
        (w_seq (m + 2)) (w_seq (m + 1))
        (hV_cont (w_seq (m + 1)) (hw_seq_cont (m + 1)))
        (hV_cont (w_seq m) (hw_seq_cont m))
        (hw_seq_int (m + 1)) (hw_seq_int m) t
      have h_mono_succ := h_int_mono (fun τ => ‖ι (V (w_seq (m + 1) τ) - V (w_seq m τ))‖)
        (M₀ * L_lip ^ (m + 1)) (m + 1) t (by positivity) (fun τ _ => by
        refine ⟨norm_nonneg _, ?_⟩
        calc ‖ι (V (w_seq (m + 1) τ) - V (w_seq m τ))‖
          _ = ‖ι (V (w_seq (m + 1) τ)) - ι (V (w_seq m τ))‖ := h_iota_sub _ _
          _ ≤ L_lip * ‖ι (w_seq (m + 1) τ - w_seq m τ)‖ := hV_lip _ _
          _ ≤ L_lip * (M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |τ| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ)) :=
            mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih τ) hL_lip
          _ = M₀ * L_lip ^ (m + 1) * |τ| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := by ring)
      exact le_trans h_diff_succ h_mono_succ
  have h_uIcc_abs : ∀ (t τ : ℝ), τ ∈ Set.uIcc 0 t → |τ| ≤ |t| := by
    intro t τ hτ
    rcases Set.mem_uIcc.mp hτ with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · rw [abs_of_nonneg h1, abs_of_nonneg (le_trans h1 h2)]
      exact h2
    · rw [abs_of_nonpos h2, abs_of_nonpos (le_trans h1 h2)]
      exact neg_le_neg h1
  have h_tier_nonneg : ∀ (K n : ℕ) (q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)), 0 ≤ schwartzTierNorm K n q := by
    intro K n q
    exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun p _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p n) q)
  refine ⟨w_seq, hw_seq0, hw_seq_cont, hw_seq_int, ?_⟩
  intro T hT k n
  have h_hm1_shift : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
      ‖ι (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t)‖ ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := by
    intro m t ht
    have h_pow : |t| ^ (m + 1) ≤ T ^ (m + 1) := pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg t) ht (m + 1)
    have h_num : M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1) ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m := by
      calc M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1)
        _ ≤ M₀ * L_lip ^ m * T ^ (m + 1) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_pow (by positivity)
        _ = (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m := by ring
    have h_fact_pos : (0 : ℝ) < (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) := Nat.cast_pos.mpr (Nat.factorial_pos m)
    have h_fact_le : (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) ≤ (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) :=
      Nat.cast_le.mpr (Nat.factorial_le (Nat.le_succ m))
    calc ‖ι (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t)‖
      _ ≤ M₀ * L_lip ^ m * |t| ^ (m + 1) / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) := h_hm1_exact m t
      _ ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m / (Nat.factorial (m + 1) : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_right h_num (by positivity)
      _ ≤ (M₀ * T) * (L_lip * T) ^ m / (Nat.factorial m : ℝ) :=
        div_le_div_of_nonneg_left (by positivity) h_fact_pos h_fact_le
  have h_tier_bdd : ∀ (K : ℕ), 2 ≤ K → ∀ (j : ℕ),
      ∃ M_j : ℝ, ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T → schwartzTierNorm K j (w_seq m t) ≤ M_j := by
    intro K hK j
    induction j using Nat.strong_induction_on with
    | h j ih =>
      let M_prev : ℕ → ℝ := fun i => if h : i < j then (ih i h).choose else 0
      have hM_prev : ∀ i < j, ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
          schwartzTierNorm K i (w_seq m t) ≤ M_prev i := by
        intro i hi m t ht
        dsimp [M_prev]
        rw [dif_pos hi]
        exact (ih i hi).choose_spec m t ht
      obtain ⟨A, B, hA, hB, hAB⟩ := hV_tier K j hK M_prev
      let C₀ : ℝ := schwartzTierNorm K j w₀ + B * T
      have hC₀ : 0 ≤ C₀ := add_nonneg (h_tier_nonneg K j w₀) (mul_nonneg hB hT)
      have h_gron_m : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
          schwartzTierNorm K j (w_seq m t) ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := by
        intro m
        induction m with
        | zero =>
          intro t _
          rw [hw_seq0 t]
          have h1 : schwartzTierNorm K j w₀ ≤ C₀ := by
            dsimp [C₀]
            linarith [mul_nonneg hB hT]
          have h2 : 1 ≤ Real.exp (A * |t|) := Real.one_le_exp (by positivity)
          calc schwartzTierNorm K j w₀
            _ ≤ C₀ * 1 := by linarith
            _ ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h2 hC₀
        | succ m ih_m =>
          intro t ht
          have h_gron_step := h_int_gron (fun τ => schwartzTierNorm K j (V (w_seq m τ)))
            A B C₀ t hA hB hC₀ (fun τ hτ => by
              have hτ_le_t : |τ| ≤ |t| := h_uIcc_abs t τ hτ
              have hτ_le_T : |τ| ≤ T := le_trans hτ_le_t ht
              refine ⟨h_tier_nonneg K j (V (w_seq m τ)), ?_⟩
              calc schwartzTierNorm K j (V (w_seq m τ))
                _ ≤ A * schwartzTierNorm K j (w_seq m τ) + B :=
                  hAB (w_seq m τ) (fun i hi => hM_prev i hi m τ hτ_le_T)
                _ ≤ A * (C₀ * Real.exp (A * |τ|)) + B := by
                  linarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (ih_m τ hτ_le_T) hA])
          have h_step := hw_seq_tier m K j t
          have h_Bt : B * |t| ≤ B * T := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hB
          have h_alg : schwartzTierNorm K j w₀ + (C₀ * (Real.exp (A * |t|) - 1) + B * |t|) ≤
              C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := by
            dsimp [C₀]
            linarith
          linarith
      refine ⟨C₀ * Real.exp (A * T), fun m t ht => ?_⟩
      calc schwartzTierNorm K j (w_seq m t)
        _ ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * |t|) := h_gron_m m t ht
        _ ≤ C₀ * Real.exp (A * T) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ht hA)) hC₀
  let B_T : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun p j =>
    2 * (h_tier_bdd (max p 2) (le_max_right p 2) j).choose
  have hB_T : ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T → ∀ (p j : ℕ),
      SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t) ≤ B_T p j := by
    intro m t ht p j
    let K_p := max p 2
    have h_p_mem : p ∈ Finset.range (K_p + 1) :=
      Finset.mem_range.mpr (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (le_max_left p 2))
    have h_le_tier : ∀ q : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ), SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j q ≤ schwartzTierNorm K_p j q := by
      intro q
      exact Finset.single_le_sum (fun i _ => apply_nonneg (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ i j) q) h_p_mem
    have h_m1 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j (w_seq (m + 1) t) ≤
        (h_tier_bdd K_p (le_max_right p 2) j).choose :=
      le_trans (h_le_tier _) ((h_tier_bdd K_p (le_max_right p 2) j).choose_spec (m + 1) t ht)
    have h_m0 : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j (w_seq m t) ≤
        (h_tier_bdd K_p (le_max_right p 2) j).choose :=
      le_trans (h_le_tier _) ((h_tier_bdd K_p (le_max_right p 2) j).choose_spec m t ht)
    have h_tri : SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t) ≤
        SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j (w_seq (m + 1) t) + SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j (w_seq m t) :=
      map_sub_le_add (SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ p j) (w_seq (m + 1) t) (w_seq m t)
    dsimp [B_T]
    linarith
  obtain ⟨C, hC_nonneg, hC_geom⟩ :=
    h_fact_geom B_T (M₀ * T) (L_lip * T) (by positivity) (by positivity) k n
  exact ⟨C, hC_nonneg, fun m t ht =>
    hC_geom m (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t) (hB_T m t ht) (h_hm1_shift m t ht)⟩

informal_problem.statement:
∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ t : ℝ, w_seq 0 t = w₀) →
      (∀ m : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq m)) →
      (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (k n : ℕ),
        ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (m : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w_seq (m + 1) t - w_seq m t) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) →
      ∃ w_tilde : ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        Continuous w_tilde ∧
        (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (k n : ℕ),
          ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
            ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
              SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w_seq N t - w_tilde t) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) ∧
        (∀ (t : ℝ) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (w_seq N t) x)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n (w_tilde t) x)))

∀ (w₀ : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (w_seq : ℕ → ℝ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ t : ℝ, w_seq 0 t = w₀) →

proof.tactics:
by
  have h_s1 : ∀ (d : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      (∀ (k n : ℕ), Summable (fun m : ℕ => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (d m))) →
      ∃ D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ),
        ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
          Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (d m) x‖) ∧
          iteratedDeriv n D x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (d m) x := by
    intro d h_sum
    let f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ := fun m x => d m x
    have hf_smooth : ∀ m : ℕ, ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) (f m) :=
      fun m => (d m).smooth'
    let v : ℕ → ℕ → ℝ := fun n m => SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ 0 n (d m)
    have hv_sum : ∀ n : ℕ, (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) → Summable (v n) :=
      fun n _ => h_sum 0 n
    have hv_bound : ∀ (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ), (n : ℕ∞) ≤ (⊤ : ℕ∞) →
        ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ ≤ v n m := by
      intro n m x _
      rw [norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      simpa [f, v, pow_zero, one_mul] using SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ 0 n (d m) x
    let D_fun : ℝ → ℝ := fun x => ∑' m : ℕ, f m x
    have h_smooth : ContDiff ℝ (↑(⊤ : ℕ∞)) D_fun :=
      contDiff_tsum hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound
    have h_decay : ∀ (k n : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ, ∀ x : ℝ,
        ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n D_fun x‖ ≤ C := by
      intro k n
      refine ⟨∑' m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (d m), ?_⟩
      intro x
      have h_fderiv_eq :
          iteratedFDeriv ℝ n D_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x :=
        iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤) x
      rw [h_fderiv_eq]
      have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖) :=
        Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => norm_nonneg _)
          (fun m => hv_bound n m x le_top) (hv_sum n le_top)
      have h_tsum_norm :
          ‖∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ :=
        norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_norm_sum
      have h_mul_sum :
          Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖) :=
        h_norm_sum.mul_left (‖x‖ ^ k)
      have h_term_le : ∀ m : ℕ,
          ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (d m) := by
        intro m
        rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
        exact SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ k n (d m) x
      calc ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖
        _ ≤ ‖x‖ ^ k * ∑' m : ℕ, ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tsum_norm (by positivity)
        _ = ∑' m : ℕ, ‖x‖ ^ k * ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x‖ :=
          (tsum_mul_left).symm
        _ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (d m) :=
          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_term_le h_mul_sum (h_sum k n)
    let D : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.mk D_fun h_smooth h_decay
    refine ⟨D, ?_⟩
    intro n x
    have h_norm_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (d m) x‖) := by
      refine Summable.of_nonneg_of_le (fun m => norm_nonneg _) (fun m => ?_) (hv_sum n le_top)
      rw [← norm_iteratedFDeriv_eq_norm_iteratedDeriv]
      exact hv_bound n m x le_top
    have h_fderiv_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x) :=
      Summable.of_norm_bounded (hv_sum n le_top) (fun m => hv_bound n m x le_top)
    refine ⟨h_norm_sum, ?_⟩
    change iteratedDeriv n D_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (f m) x
    rw [iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
    have h_fd := iteratedFDeriv_tsum_apply hf_smooth hv_sum hv_bound (le_top : (n : ℕ∞) ≤ ⊤) x
    change iteratedFDeriv ℝ n D_fun x = ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedFDeriv ℝ n (f m) x at h_fd
    rw [h_fd, ContinuousMultilinearMap.tsum_eval h_fderiv_sum (fun _ => 1)]
    simp_rw [← iteratedDeriv_eq_iteratedFDeriv]
  have h_s2 : ∀ (w₀ w_infty : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (u : ℕ → 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)),
      u 0 = w₀ →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x‖) ∧
        iteratedDeriv n w_infty x =
          iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x) →
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n (u N) x)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n w_infty x))) ∧
      (∀ (k n : ℕ) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C →
        (∀ m : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (u (m + 1) - u m) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) →
        ∀ N : ℕ, SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (u N - w_infty) ≤ (2 * C) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) := by
    intro w₀ w_infty u hu0 h_tsum
    have h_iter_sub : ∀ (f g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ),
        iteratedDeriv n (f - g : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = iteratedDeriv n f x - iteratedDeriv n g x :=
      fun f g n x => iteratedDeriv_sub ((f.smooth n).contDiffAt) ((g.smooth n).contDiffAt)
    have h_tele : ∀ (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) (N : ℕ),
        (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x) =
          iteratedDeriv n (u N) x - iteratedDeriv n w₀ x := by
      intro n x N
      have h_congr :
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x) =
          (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, (iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1)) x - iteratedDeriv n (u m) x)) :=
        Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun m _ => h_iter_sub (u (m + 1)) (u m) n x)
      rw [h_congr, Finset.sum_range_sub (fun m => iteratedDeriv n (u m) x) N, hu0]
    refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · intro n x
      let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x
      have hδ_sum : Summable δ := (h_tsum n x).1.of_norm
      have h_tendsto_sum :
          Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m)
            Filter.atTop (nhds (∑' m : ℕ, δ m)) :=
        hδ_sum.hasSum.tendsto_sum_nat
      have h_add : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m)
          Filter.atTop (nhds (iteratedDeriv n w₀ x + ∑' m : ℕ, δ m)) :=
        tendsto_const_nhds.add h_tendsto_sum
      rw [← (h_tsum n x).2] at h_add
      refine h_add.congr (fun N => ?_)
      have ht := h_tele n x N
      dsimp [δ]
      linarith
    · intro k n C hC h_step N
      refine SchwartzMap.seminorm_le_bound' ℝ k n (u N - w_infty) (by positivity) (fun x => ?_)
      let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun m => iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x
      have hδ_sum : Summable δ := (h_tsum n x).1.of_norm
      have h_split : (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m) + (∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)) = ∑' m : ℕ, δ m :=
        Summable.sum_add_tsum_nat_add N hδ_sum
      have h_diff_eq : iteratedDeriv n (u N - w_infty : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x = -(∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)) := by
        rw [h_iter_sub, (h_tsum n x).2]
        have ht := h_tele n x N
        change (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m) = iteratedDeriv n (u N) x - iteratedDeriv n w₀ x at ht
        change (∑ m ∈ Finset.range N, δ m) + (∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)) =
          ∑' m : ℕ, iteratedDeriv n (u (m + 1) - u m : 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ)) x at h_split
        linarith
      rw [h_diff_eq, norm_neg]
      have h_tail_norm : Summable (fun m : ℕ => ‖δ (m + N)‖) :=
        (summable_nat_add_iff N).mpr (h_tsum n x).1
      have h_tsum_norm : ‖∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)‖ ≤ ∑' m : ℕ, ‖δ (m + N)‖ :=
        norm_tsum_le_tsum_norm h_tail_norm
      have h_mul_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => |x| ^ k * ‖δ (m + N)‖) :=
        h_tail_norm.mul_left (|x| ^ k)
      have h_geom_sum : Summable (fun m : ℕ => (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m) :=
        summable_geometric_two.mul_left (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N)
      have h_term_le : ∀ m : ℕ,
          |x| ^ k * ‖δ (m + N)‖ ≤ (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
        intro m
        calc |x| ^ k * ‖δ (m + N)‖
          _ ≤ SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (u (m + N + 1) - u (m + N)) :=
            SchwartzMap.le_seminorm' ℝ k n (u (m + N + 1) - u (m + N)) x
          _ ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ (m + N) := h_step (m + N)
          _ = (C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ m := by
            rw [pow_add]
            ring
      calc |x| ^ k * ‖∑' m : ℕ, δ (m + N)‖
        _ ≤ |x| ^ k * ∑' m : ℕ, ‖δ (m + N)‖ :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_tsum_norm (by positivity)
        _ = ∑' m : ℕ, |x| ^ k * ‖δ (m + N)‖ := (tsum_mul_left).symm

          Summable.tsum_le_tsum h_term_le h_mul_sum h_geom_sum

        _ = (2 * C) * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N := by
          rw [tsum_geometric_two]
          ring

      (∀ N : ℕ, Continuous (w_seq N)) →
      (∀ (T : ℝ), 0 ≤ T → ∀ (k n : ℕ),
        ∃ C : ℝ, 0 ≤ C ∧
          ∀ (N : ℕ) (t : ℝ), |t| ≤ T →
            SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n (w_seq N t - w_tilde t) ≤ C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) →
      Continuous w_tilde := by
    intro w_seq w_tilde hw_cont h_unif
    rw [continuous_iff_continuousAt]
    intro t₀
    rw [ContinuousAt, (schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds w_tilde (w_tilde t₀)]
    rintro ⟨k, n⟩ ε hε
    rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n]
    let p : Seminorm ℝ 𝓢(ℝ, ℝ) := SchwartzMap.seminorm ℝ k n
    change ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds t₀, p (w_tilde t - w_tilde t₀) < ε
    set T : ℝ := |t₀| + 1
    have hT : 0 ≤ T := by positivity
    obtain ⟨C, _hC_nonneg, hC_bound⟩ := h_unif T hT k n
    have h_pow_tendsto : Filter.Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := by
      simpa [mul_zero] using
        Filter.Tendsto.const_mul C
          (tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) ≤ 1 / 2) (by norm_num : (1 / 2 : ℝ) < 1))
    have h_ev_lt : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in Filter.atTop, C * (1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ N < ε / 3 :=
      h_pow_tendsto.eventually (gt_mem_nhds (by linarith))
    obtain ⟨N, hN_lt⟩ := h_ev_lt.exists
    have h_cont_N : Filter.Tendsto (w_seq N) (nhds t₀) (nhds (w_seq N t₀)) :=
      (hw_cont N).continuousAt
    rw [(schwartz_withSeminorms ℝ ℝ ℝ).tendsto_nhds (w_seq N) (w_seq N t₀)] at h_cont_N
    have h_ev_N := h_cont_N (k, n) (ε / 3) (by linarith)
    rw [SchwartzMap.schwartzSeminormFamily_apply ℝ ℝ ℝ k n] at h_ev_N
    change ∀ᶠ t : ℝ in nhds t₀, p (w_seq N t - w_seq N t₀) < ε / 3 at h_ev_N

    rw [Metric.mem_ball, Real.dist_eq] at ht_ball
    have ht_T : |t| ≤ T := by

        simpa using abs_add_le (t - t₀) t₀
      dsimp [T]
      linarith
    have ht₀_T : |t₀| ≤ T := by
      dsimp [T]
      linarith

      have h_neg : w_tilde t - w_seq N t = -(w_seq N t - w_tilde t) := by abel
      rw [h_neg, map_neg_eq_map]
